source_records.title: From Investor Nudges to SME Operational Resilience: Evidence on Financial Slack in Revenue‐Based Lending
source_records.abstract: Revenue‐based lending (RBL) has emerged as a prominent alternative to traditional fixed‐term debt for small and medium‐sized enterprises (SMEs), whose survival often depends on operational resilience, defined as the ability to maintain essential business functions under demand volatility, liquidity shocks, and external disruptions. Because SMEs frequently face severe credit frictions, short cash‐to‐cash cycles, and limited access to traditional operational buffers, timely and predictable financing can create financial slack that helps them absorb short‐term disruptions. In RBL, repayment is tied to realized revenue, but the resilience benefits of this model depend on a stable and responsive supply of investor capital. Drawing on behavioral operations, investor psychology, and OM research on financial slack, we examine whether investor‐directed digital nudges can increase investor engagement and, through more timely and reliable capital flows, strengthen SME operational resilience. Collaborating with a major RBL platform in Asia, we conduct a large‐scale randomized field experiment in which investors are randomly assigned to one of five messages: (i) cooperative social‐value message (ii) competitive social‐value message, (iii) precommitment message designed to mitigate time‐inconsistent preferences, (iv) ease‐and‐convenience message designed to reduce perceived cognitive costs, or a plain message control that accounts for attention effects. Our results show that the ease‐and‐convenience‐framed nudge significantly increases investor engagement, leading to more timely and predictable funding aligned with SMEs' operational needs. These improved capital flows reduce delinquency and shorten payoff durations, suggesting that investor‐side nudges can strengthen borrower resilience by creating financial slack that helps SMEs maintain operational continuity under cash‐flow pressure. Our empirical evidence combines an investor‐side online experiment, a borrower‐side mechanism experiment, and semi‐structured interviews with SME borrowers. Together, these analyses show that ease‐and‐convenience messaging is especially effective for long‐tenured, risk‐averse, institutionally affiliated, and urban‐based investors, while borrower‐side evidence suggests that financial slack is the most strongly supported borrower‐side mechanism through which timely and predictable funding helps SMEs absorb short‐term shocks, meet urgent operating obligations, and maintain repayment continuity. By documenting how investor‐side nudges generate cross‐side benefits for SME borrowers through financial slack and buffering, this study advances behavioral operations research on context‐dependent nudging, extends OM work on platform‐mediated resilience, and offers guidance for fintech platforms seeking to stabilize capital flows to vulnerable SMEs.

title_zh: 从对投资者的助推到中小企业运营韧性：来自营收挂钩贷款中财务冗余作用的证据
abstract_zh: 营收挂钩贷款（RBL）已成为中小企业（SMEs）传统固定期限债务的一种重要替代方案，这些企业的生存往往取决于运营韧性，即在需求波动、流动性冲击和外部干扰下维持基本业务功能的能力。由于中小企业经常面临严重的信贷摩擦、较短的现金周转周期以及传统运营缓冲手段获取受限，及时且可预测的融资能够创造财务冗余，帮助其吸收短期干扰。在RBL中，还款与实际收入挂钩，但该模式的韧性收益取决于稳定且响应迅速的投资者资本供给。借鉴行为运营、投资者心理学以及运营管理（OM）关于财务冗余的研究，我们考察面向投资者的数字助推能否提高投资者参与度，并通过更及时、可靠的资本流动增强中小企业运营韧性。我们与亚洲一家主要RBL平台合作，开展了一项大规模随机实地实验，将投资者随机分配到五种信息之一：（i）合作型社会价值信息，（ii）竞争型社会价值信息，（iii）旨在缓解时间不一致偏好的预先承诺信息，（iv）旨在降低感知认知成本的便捷省心信息，或一个用于控制注意力效应的普通信息对照组。我们的结果表明，以便捷省心为框架的助推显著提高了投资者参与度，从而带来与中小企业运营需求相匹配的更及时、可预测的资金。这些改善后的资本流动降低了拖欠率并缩短了还清期限，表明投资者侧助推能够通过创造财务冗余增强借款人的韧性，帮助中小企业在现金流压力下维持运营连续性。我们的实证证据结合了投资者侧在线实验、借款人侧机制实验以及对中小企业借款人的半结构化访谈。总体而言，这些分析表明，便捷省心信息对参与时间较长、风险厌恶、机构关联以及城市地区的投资者尤为有效，而借款人侧证据表明，财务冗余是得到最强支持的借款人侧机制，通过该机制，及时且可预测的资金帮助中小企业吸收短期冲击、履行紧急运营义务并维持还款连续性。通过记录投资者侧助推如何通过财务冗余和缓冲为中小企业借款人产生跨侧收益，本研究推进了关于情境依赖助推的行为运营研究，拓展了运营管理关于平台中介韧性的研究，并为寻求稳定向脆弱中小企业资本流动的金融科技平台提供了指导。

source_records.title: Impact of Carbon Emission Trading Schemes on Firms' Environmental and Social Disclosure Under Institutional Pressure
source_records.abstract: Carbon emissions trading schemes (CETS) are a prominent market‐based instrument for addressing climate change, yet their effects on corporate disclosure remain insufficiently understood. Drawing on institutional theory, we develop a pressure–capability–cognition framework to examine how CETS influence firms' environmental and social (E&S) disclosure and how institutional pressures and internal organizational factors shape heterogeneous disclosure responses. Exploiting the staggered implementation of China's CETS between 2013 and 2024 as a quasi‐natural experiment, we employ a multi‐period difference‐in‐differences design using 16,348 firm‐year observations from 1682 listed firms between 2010 and 2024. We report three principal findings. First, CETS significantly increase the level of firm E&S disclosure, indicating that the influence of CETS extends beyond environmental reporting to social responsibility disclosure. Second, institutional pressures generate distinct disclosure strategies. Under coercive participation, CETS exhibits a marginally significant positive effect on social disclosure but no significant effect on environmental disclosure, consistent with a legitimacy compensation mechanism whereby firms offset environmental legitimacy deficits through low‐cost, highly visible symbolic reporting. By contrast, under non‐coercive participation, CETS significantly promotes both environmental and social disclosure, suggesting that firms use disclosure as a strategic signaling device. Third, operational efficiency negatively moderates the CETS–disclosure relationship, whereas managerial environmental focus positively moderates this relationship, revealing that internal capabilities and managerial cognition condition the effectiveness of institutional pressures in shaping disclosure outcomes. These findings contribute to sustainable operations management research by demonstrating how institutional pressures interact with operational capabilities and managerial cognition to shape corporate sustainability disclosure.

abstract_zh: 碳排放权交易机制（CETS）是应对气候变化的一项重要市场化工具，但其对企业信息披露的影响仍未被充分理解。基于制度理论，我们构建了一个“压力—能力—认知”框架，以考察CETS如何影响企业的环境与社会（E&S）信息披露，以及制度压力和内部组织因素如何塑造异质性的披露反应。我们利用2013年至2024年间中国CETS的分批实施作为准自然实验，采用多期双重差分设计，使用2010年至2024年间1682家上市公司共16348个企业—年度观测值。我们报告三项主要发现。第一，CETS显著提高了企业E&S信息披露水平，表明CETS的影响超越环境报告而延伸至社会责任披露。第二，制度压力产生了不同的披露策略。在强制性参与下，CETS对社会披露呈现出边际显著的正向效应，但对环境披露没有显著影响，这与合法性补偿机制相一致，即企业通过低成本、高可见度的象征性报告来抵消环境合法性赤字。相比之下，在非强制性参与下，CETS显著促进环境披露和社会披露，表明企业将披露用作战略性信号传递工具。第三，运营效率负向调节CETS—披露关系，而管理者环境关注正向调节这一关系，揭示出内部能力和管理者认知会制约制度压力在塑造披露结果方面的有效性。这些发现通过表明制度压力如何与运营能力和管理者认知相互作用以塑造企业可持续性披露，为可持续运营管理研究作出了贡献。

source_records.title: Estimating Hierarchical Demand in Retail Operations
source_records.abstract: A hierarchical structure over product attributes is a central input to many product assortment and inventory optimization models, yet no existing method can recover such structures from the aggregate sales data that retailers routinely collect. We introduce HASTERAD (hierarchical attribute substitution tree estimation via recursive attribute discovery), which recovers a substitution tree from standard SKU–store–week scanner data. Leveraging variation in prices and promotions, HASTERAD compares attribute‐based substitution patterns and then recursively partitions the product space to recover a candidate hierarchy of attribute‐level substitution. Applied to the IRI Marketing Data Set, it recovers a stable and economically interpretable tree. To quantify its economic value, we execute a three‐step optimization process on synthetic data with known ground truth: we recover a tree with HASTERAD, estimate demand parameters on that tree, and optimize assortments. HASTERAD's chosen assortments forgo less than 11% of the profit available to a clairvoyant planner, even in demanding settings where a traditional flat demand model forgoes almost 100%. Performance remains strong whether the method is applied to a multi‐store panel, where stockouts are unobservable, or to a single store's internal records, where data are sparse but stockouts are observed. These findings are robust across several alternative specifications. Our central empirical finding concerns model selection. A tree chosen by best in‐sample fit, from an exhaustive search over simple hierarchies, fits the observed sales nearly as well as HASTERAD's recovered tree, yet prescribes assortments whose expected profits are substantially lower. Fit evaluates observed purchases, but assortment optimization depends on predicting demand under assortments not yet observed.

title_zh: 估计零售运营中的层级需求
abstract_zh: 产品属性上的层级结构是许多产品组合与库存优化模型的核心输入，然而现有方法均无法从零售商常规收集的汇总销售数据中恢复此类结构。我们提出HASTERAD（通过递归属性发现进行层级属性替代树估计），该方法从标准的SKU–门店–周扫描数据中恢复一棵替代树。利用价格与促销的变动，HASTERAD比较基于属性的替代模式，然后递归划分产品空间，以恢复属性层面替代的候选层级。将其应用于IRI营销数据集，它恢复出一棵稳定且具有经济可解释性的树。为量化其经济价值，我们在具有已知真实基准的合成数据上执行三步优化过程：用HASTERAD恢复一棵树，在该树上估计需求参数，并优化产品组合。即便在传统扁平需求模型几乎损失100%利润的严苛情形下，HASTERAD所选产品组合所放弃的利润也不到全知规划者可获得利润的11%。无论将该方法应用于缺货不可观测的多门店面板，还是应用于数据稀疏但缺货可观测的单门店内部记录，其表现均保持强劲。这些发现在若干替代设定下均稳健。我们的核心实证发现涉及模型选择。通过穷举搜索简单层级结构、以最佳样本内拟合选出的树，对观测销售的拟合几乎与HASTERAD恢复的树一样好，但其给出的产品组合的期望利润却大幅更低。拟合评估的是已观测购买，而产品组合优化取决于预测尚未观测到的产品组合下的需求。

source_records.title: Beyond earnings quality: evaluating the quality of corporate disclosure practices
source_records.abstract: We propose a framework to assess the decision-usefulness of heterogeneous disclosure practices that managers use to convey information to market participants. We illustrate an application of our framework to non-GAAP earnings, management earnings guidance, and earnings conference calls. We first identify key quality attributes for each disclosure practice and then develop a list of quality metrics that we apply to a small pilot sample. We focus on metrics that are easily measured in real time and discuss the practical challenges of conducting assessments of disclosure quality at the firm-quarter-disclosure level. Our descriptive analysis provides preliminary insights into whether and how voluntary disclosure quality varies across firms and highlights the interconnectedness of these disclosure practices. We discuss future research opportunities to expand and fine-tune the application of the framework to develop a comprehensive disclosure quality assessment.

title_zh: 超越盈余质量：评估公司披露实践的质量
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个框架，用以评估管理者向市场参与者传递信息时所使用的异质性披露实践的决策有用性。我们展示了该框架在非GAAP盈余、管理层盈余指引和业绩电话会议中的应用。我们首先识别每种披露实践的关键质量属性，然后制定一系列质量指标，并将其应用于一个小型试点样本。我们侧重于可实时轻松测量的指标，并讨论在公司-季度-披露层面进行披露质量评估的实际挑战。我们的描述性分析提供了关于自愿披露质量是否以及如何因公司而异的初步见解，并强调了这些披露实践之间的相互关联性。我们讨论了未来的研究机会，以扩展和微调该框架的应用，从而形成全面的披露质量评估。

source_records.title: “Show Me!” The Informativeness of images in firms’ annual reports
source_records.abstract: We consider how images (i.e., photos but not graphs, charts, or infographics) in annual reports provide users with information and use machine-learning algorithms to assess their informativeness. We develop a metric of content reinforcement, defined as the degree to which information investors extract from images complements and reinforces details in textual narratives. We find that firms are more likely to use images when they experience greater asset growth, have greater business complexity, and provide less readable textual disclosures—suggesting images are used more often when information processing costs are high. Our main results indicate that increases in visual prevalence and the extent to which images reinforce text are associated with greater analyst forecast accuracy and lower dispersion, suggesting that images improve users’ information processing. Firms also increase image use after an exogenous decline in analyst coverage. Overall, firms use images when their information environment is poorer, and visual informativeness facilitates information assimilation.

title_zh: “给我看！”企业年报中图像的信息含量
abstract_zh: 我们考察年报中的图像（即照片，而非图表、图形或信息图）如何为用户提供信息，并使用机器学习算法评估其信息含量。我们构建了一个内容强化指标，其定义为投资者从图像中提取的信息对文本叙述中细节的补充和强化程度。我们发现，当企业经历更大的资产增长、具有更高的业务复杂性以及提供可读性较低的文本披露时，更可能使用图像——这表明在信息处理成本较高时，图像被更频繁地使用。我们的主要结果表明，图像使用程度的提高以及图像强化文本的程度与更高的分析师预测准确性和更低的预测离散度相关，这表明图像改善了用户的信息处理。企业还会在分析师覆盖范围出现外生性下降后增加图像使用。总体而言，当企业的信息环境较差时，它们会使用图像，而视觉信息含量促进了信息吸收。

source_records.title: Role of environmental disclosure policy on access to finance: evidence from crowdfunding
source_records.abstract: We study the impact of an online market’s policy (environmental policy) offering entrepreneurs the option to disclose their environmental engagement on entrepreneurship outcomes, using Kickstarter as a laboratory. Following the policy’s implementation, 32.4% of entrepreneurs opted to disclose their environmental commitments. Using the passage of the environmental policy as an instrument, we show that environmental commitment improves funding outcomes, with the funding success rate increasing by 13.2% and the pledged funding ratio by 8.7%. Environmental commitment also attracts more environmentally conscious backers and brings in new backers, which likely contributes to these improved outcomes. However, environmental commitment does not have a material impact on the ultimate project success rate and significantly delays project delivery. Overall, the evidence suggests that Kickstarter’s nudge policy encourages entrepreneurs’ environmental engagement and helps them expand access to environmentally conscious backers by internalizing backers’ environmental preferences.

Overall, the evidence suggests that Kickstarter’s nudge policy encourages entrepreneurs’ environmental engagement and helps them expand access to environmentally conscious backers by internalizing backers’ environmental preferences.

title_zh: 环境披露政策对融资可得性的作用：来自众筹的证据
abstract_zh: 我们以Kickstarter作为实验场所，研究在线市场的一项政策（环境政策）对创业结果的影响，该政策为创业者提供了披露其环境参与情况的选择。该政策实施后，32.4%的创业者选择披露其环境承诺。我们以该环境政策的通过作为工具变量，表明环境承诺改善了融资结果，融资成功率提高了13.2%，承诺出资比例提高了8.7%。环境承诺还吸引了更多具有环保意识的支持者，并带来了新的支持者，这可能促成了这些改善的结果。然而，环境承诺对项目的最终成功率没有实质性影响，并显著延迟了项目交付。总体而言，证据表明Kickstarter的助推政策鼓励了创业者的环境参与，并通过将支持者的环境偏好内部化，帮助创业者更容易获得具有环保意识的支持者的资金。

source_records.title: Non-audit services and earnings announcement timeliness
source_records.abstract: We examine the association between permissible non-audit services provided by auditors and the timeliness of earnings announcements. Although earnings announcements are unaudited, audit progress influences management’s ability to release earnings while maintaining confidence in reported results. We posit that non-audit services generate earnings announcement timeliness benefits by improving the efficiency and timing of audits through knowledge transfer. We find that tax non-audit services are associated with timelier earnings announcements while nontax non-audit services are not. These benefits are concentrated in the pre-regulatory period before changes in the mid-2000s. Following these changes, the association persists for firms with weaker information environments, poorer performance, and greater audit-related challenges. Overall, our findings show that auditor-provided tax services are associated with enhanced timeliness of unaudited disclosures and that these benefits vary across firms and over time, highlighting previously undocumented spillovers from non-audit services with implications for academic research and regulation.

title_zh: 非审计服务与盈余公告及时性
abstract_zh: 我们考察了审计师提供的允许范围内的非审计服务与盈余公告及时性之间的关联。尽管盈余公告未经审计，但审计进展会影响管理层在保持对报告结果信心的同时发布盈余的能力。我们假设，非审计服务通过知识转移提高审计效率并改善审计时间安排，从而产生盈余公告及时性方面的收益。我们发现，税务非审计服务与更及时的盈余公告相关，而非税务非审计服务则不然。这些收益主要集中在2000年代中期监管变化发生之前。在这些变化之后，对于信息环境较弱、业绩较差以及审计相关挑战较大的公司，这种关联依然存在。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，审计师提供的税务服务与未经审计披露的及时性增强相关，且这些收益因公司而异并随时间变化，凸显了非审计服务此前未被记录的溢出效应，对学术研究和监管具有启示意义。

source_records.title: Exogenous stock liquidity improvements and voluntary disclosure
source_records.abstract: We study whether exogenous improvements in stock liquidity, unrelated to the information environment, affect managers’ disclosure choices. We exploit the 1997 Nasdaq reforms, which exogenously improved stock liquidity by reducing the non-information asymmetry components of the bid-ask spread, and find that Nasdaq firms reduced voluntary disclosure relative to a control group of unaffected firms. This evidence is consistent with managers substituting between components of the bid-ask spread when forming disclosure choices. Specifically, as the non-information asymmetry components decline, managers respond by decreasing disclosure, which in turn raises the information asymmetry component. Despite the reduction in disclosure and corresponding increase in information asymmetry, total stock liquidity nevertheless improves, suggesting that maintaining prior disclosure levels would have yielded minimal marginal benefits.

title_zh: 股票流动性的外生改善与自愿披露
abstract_zh: 我们研究股票流动性的外生改善（与信息环境无关）是否会影响管理者的披露选择。我们利用1997年纳斯达克改革，该改革通过降低买卖价差中并非源于信息不对称的成分外生地改善了股票流动性，并发现纳斯达克公司相对于未受影响的对照组公司减少了自愿披露。这一证据与管理者在形成披露选择时在买卖价差各成分之间进行替代相一致。具体而言，随着并非源于信息不对称的成分下降，管理者通过减少披露来回应，这反过来又提高了信息不对称成分。尽管披露减少且信息不对称相应增加，总体股票流动性仍然改善，这表明维持先前的披露水平只会带来极小的边际收益。

source_records.title: Does news media affect audit quality? Evidence from variation in the “contagion effect”
source_records.abstract: We examine whether negative news media coverage of peer audit firms affects audit quality by mitigating the contagion effect of low-quality audits. We find that when a company issues a restatement, other companies served by the same audit office or within the same city are more likely to subsequently issue a restatement. However, we find that higher negative peer firm news coverage mitigates this contagion effect, particularly when auditors have greater opportunity to improve audit quality (smaller companies) and when media attention amplifies reputational pressures (higher local news intensity). Our findings extend to litigation-related news but not to nonnegative news, suggesting that auditors respond to perceived reputational threats stemming from negative news. Additionally, negative peer news increases auditor attention, consistent with an auditor supply-side effect that improves audit quality. Our findings highlight the media’s role as an informal oversight mechanism.

title_zh: 新闻媒体是否影响审计质量？来自“传染效应”差异的证据
abstract_zh: 我们考察同行审计事务所的负面新闻报道是否通过缓解低质量审计的传染效应来影响审计质量。我们发现，当一家公司发布财务报表重述时，由同一审计分所提供服务或位于同一城市的其他公司更有可能随后发布财务报表重述。然而，我们发现，更多关于同行事务所的负面新闻报道缓解了这种传染效应，尤其是当审计师有更大机会提高审计质量（较小的公司）以及当媒体关注放大声誉压力（较高的本地新闻强度）时。我们的发现延伸至与诉讼相关的新闻，但不适用于非负面新闻，这表明审计师对负面新闻所引发的感知声誉威胁作出反应。此外，同行负面新闻增加了审计师的关注，这与提高审计质量的审计师供给侧效应一致。我们的发现凸显了媒体作为非正式监督机制的作用。

source_records.title: How labor market competition shapes workplace information on social media: evidence from Glassdoor reviews
source_records.raw_title: How labor market competition shapes workplace information on social media: evidence from Glassdoor reviews

source_records.title: How labor market competition shapes workplace information on social media: evidence from Glassdoor reviews
source_records.abstract: We examine how labor market competition affects the quality of workplace information on social media. Using employer reviews on Glassdoor for U.S. publicly listed firms from 2011 to 2022, we find that reviews become less informative about actual workplace practices when firms face more intense competition for labor, consistent with competition inducing workplace information management. The decline in review informativeness is more pronounced when employees have narrower external networks, when firms are less unionized, and when firms have a smaller review base, suggesting that workplace information management is more likely when labor market information asymmetry is greater. Additional analyses show that positive reviews in highly competitive labor markets predict higher short-term labor inflows but greater subsequent employee turnover, indicating a gap between managed expectations and actual workplace conditions. Taken together, our evidence suggests that labor market competition potentially distorts the crowdsourced signals available to job seekers on anonymous review websites.

title_zh: 劳动力市场竞争如何塑造社交媒体上的职场信息：来自Glassdoor评论的证据
abstract_zh: 我们考察劳动力市场竞争如何影响社交媒体上职场信息的质量。利用2011年至2022年美国上市公司的Glassdoor雇主评论，我们发现，当企业面临更激烈的劳动力竞争时，评论对实际职场实践的信息含量降低，这与竞争诱发职场信息管理相一致。当员工的外部网络较窄、企业工会化程度较低以及企业评论基数较小时，评论信息含量的下降更为明显，这表明当劳动力市场信息不对称更大时，职场信息管理更可能发生。进一步分析显示，在高度竞争的劳动力市场中，正面评论预示着更高的短期劳动力流入，但随后员工流动率更高，表明被管理的预期与实际职场状况之间存在差距。总体而言，我们的证据表明，劳动力市场竞争可能扭曲求职者在匿名评论网站上可获得的众包信号。

source_records.title: The information content of private information acquisition: evidence from FOIA requests to the SEC
source_records.abstract: This study examines whether Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) requests to the Securities and Exchange Commission convey value-relevant information about publicly traded firms and whether sophisticated investors trade on that information. Our empirical analysis reveals heterogeneous value relevance associated with different types of requests. Specifically, requests submitted by proxy agents to probe for ongoing investigations as well as anonymous requests are negatively correlated with future returns, while requests from institutional investors and intellectual property entities are associated with positive future returns. Our results also support the direct-trading hypothesis, showing institutional investors and short sellers trade on FOIA-obtained information. Our findings add to the information-acquisition literature by highlighting the heterogeneous value signals in FOIA requests, particularly the negative value signals.

abstract_zh: 本研究考察向美国证券交易委员会（SEC）提交的《信息自由法》（FOIA）请求是否传递了关于上市公司的价值相关信息，以及成熟投资者是否依据该信息进行交易。我们的实证分析揭示了与不同类型请求相关的异质性价值相关性。具体而言，由代理代理人提交的、旨在探查正在进行的调查的请求以及匿名请求与未来收益负相关，而来自机构投资者和知识产权实体的请求则与未来收益正相关。我们的结果还支持直接交易假说，表明机构投资者和卖空者会依据通过FOIA获得的信息进行交易。我们的发现通过凸显FOIA请求中的异质性价值信号，尤其是负面价值信号，为信息获取文献作出了贡献。

source_records.title: The consequences of audit firm mobility for attestation services across states
source_records.abstract: This study investigates how audit firm-level spatial licensing requirements affect audit market competition and audit quality, focusing on small (triennially inspected) audit firms, for which licensing frictions are most relevant. Exploiting the staggered state-level adoption of CPA firm mobility provisions that remove spatial licensing barriers, we find that adoption increases competition among small audit firms, as reflected by lower market concentration and greater first-time entry by small out-of-state auditors. Firm mobility adoption also improves audit quality, as indicated by a lower likelihood of client misstatements. These effects are concentrated in less competitive audit markets and among auditors with higher PCAOB deficiency rates. Audit quality improvements extend to both incumbent auditors and new out-of-state entrants, and we find no evidence of audit fee discounting. Overall, our results suggest that removing spatial licensing barriers fosters a more competitive small audit firm market while improving audit outcomes, without increasing audit costs.

title_zh: 审计事务所流动性对各州鉴证服务的后果
abstract_zh: 本研究考察审计事务所层面的空间许可要求如何影响审计市场竞争与审计质量，重点关注小型（三年一次接受检查的）审计事务所，因为许可摩擦对它们最为相关。利用各州交错采用取消空间许可壁垒的注册会计师事务所流动性条款，我们发现，采用该条款加剧了小型审计事务所之间的竞争，表现为市场集中度下降以及外州小型审计师首次进入增多。事务所流动性的采用还提高了审计质量，表现为客户错报的可能性降低。这些效应集中在竞争较弱的审计市场以及PCAOB缺陷率较高的审计师中。审计质量的改善既体现在现有审计师身上，也体现在新进入的外州审计师身上，并且我们未发现审计费用打折的证据。总体而言，我们的结果表明，取消空间许可壁垒促进了更具竞争性的小型审计事务所市场，同时改善了审计结果，且未增加审计成本。

source_records.title: The informativeness of stock price at dual-class firms
source_records.abstract: We examine whether disproportionate insider control, or the divergence between insider voting and cash flow rights at dual-class firms, influences the extent to which stock price reflects information about future firm performance. We find that current returns incorporate less information about future earnings and cash flows as disproportionate insider control increases. However, monitoring by influential institutional investors, strong board oversight, and high-quality disclosure significantly attenuate this effect, such that disproportionate insider control does not result in less informative stock prices. Collectively, our findings reveal that, although the dual-class structure is associated with less informative stock prices, on average, monitoring and disclosure can alleviate investor concerns about disproportionate insider control while allowing firms to take advantage of the benefits of a dual-class ownership structure.

title_zh: 双重股权公司中股价的信息含量
abstract_zh: 我们考察双重股权公司中不成比例的内部人控制，即内部人投票权与现金流权的分离，是否会影响股价反映未来公司业绩信息的程度。我们发现，随着不成比例的内部人控制增加，当期回报所包含的关于未来盈余和现金流的信息更少。然而，有影响力的机构投资者的监督、强有力的董事会监督以及高质量的信息披露显著削弱了这一效应，使得不成比例的内部人控制不会导致股价信息含量降低。总体而言，我们的发现表明，尽管双重股权结构平均而言与股价信息含量较低相关，但监督和披露可以缓解投资者对不成比例内部人控制的担忧，同时使公司能够利用双重股权所有权结构的优势。

source_records.title: Competing creditor claims and loan recoverability: evidence from anti-recharacterization laws
source_records.abstract: Anti-recharacterization laws significantly increase the rights of securitization creditors by allowing the buyers of securitized assets to exclusively and immediately seize collateral in bankruptcy. However, strengthening the rights of securitization creditors can limit other creditors’ ability to recover loans. We find that, after a state adopts an anti-recharacterization law, local banks operating in the same state accrue more loan loss provisions, tighten their loan contracts, and incur higher future loan charge-offs. These findings are consistent with the argument that a safe harbor for securitization transactions advantages Wall Street-style structured finance at the expense of Main Street-style lending.

title_zh: 竞争性债权人求偿权与贷款可回收性：来自反重新定性法的证据
abstract_zh: 反重新定性法通过允许证券化资产的买方在破产中独家且立即扣押抵押品，显著增强了证券化债权人的权利。然而，强化证券化债权人的权利可能限制其他债权人回收贷款的能力。我们发现，在一个州通过反重新定性法之后，在该州经营的本地银行计提了更多的贷款损失准备，收紧了贷款合同，并产生了更高的未来贷款核销。这些发现与以下论点一致：证券化交易的安全港使华尔街式的结构化融资受益，而以主街式的贷款为代价。

source_records.title: Routine dynamics and the relationality of auditor judgement: How auditors navigate situated novelty
source_records.abstract: This paper contributes to a long-standing debate in the audit literature about the place of professional judgement within the constraints of the formal audit process. Responding to recent calls for deeper exploration, we examine how auditors exercise judgement when facing a practical challenge they perceive as novel, for which they are unable to easily deploy prior understandings and judgement scripts. Drawing on semi-structured interviews with practicing auditors and the Routine Dynamics (RD) perspective, emphasising patterns of routine action as having internal dynamics, we provide a nuanced account of how auditors progress from the position of relative epistemic obscurity to being comfortable enough to form a conclusion. Our findings show how auditors performed routines to establish social , temporal, and spatial relationalities within and beyond the present audit context, enabling them to nuance their interpretations and grow confident in their judgements. We reveal how auditor judgement is continuously present but fluctuates in intensity, depending on the auditors’ reflexive intent during individual routine performances, resulting in the augmentation or curtailment of opportunities for inference. We also show how auditors accrue comfort in their judgements in a progressive manner along a continuum, spanning from largely ritualistic performances to the more effortful, inferentially intensive ones that together shape how auditors grapple with novelty.

title_zh: 惯例动态与审计师判断的关系性：审计师如何应对情境中的新颖性
abstract_zh: 本文对审计文献中一个长期存在的争论作出贡献，该争论涉及职业判断在正式审计流程约束中的位置。回应近期对更深入探索的呼吁，我们考察审计师在面临其认为新颖、且无法轻易运用先前理解和判断脚本的实际挑战时，如何行使判断。基于对执业审计师的半结构化访谈以及惯例动态（RD）视角——该视角强调惯例行动模式具有内在动态性——我们细致地描述了审计师如何从相对认知模糊的状态进展到足以舒适地形成结论的状态。我们的发现表明，审计师如何执行惯例以在当前审计情境之内及之外建立社会性、时间性和空间性的关系，从而使他们能够细化其解释并对自己的判断建立信心。我们揭示审计师判断如何持续存在但强度波动，这取决于审计师在个别惯例执行过程中的反思性意图，从而导致推理机会的增强或缩减。我们还表明审计师如何沿着一个连续统以渐进方式在其判断中积累舒适感，该连续统从很大程度上仪式化的执行延伸到更费力、推理密集型的执行，二者共同塑造了审计师如何应对新颖性。

source_records.title: Investor judgments of human capital initiatives: The role of initiative type, investor orientation, and financial performance
source_records.abstract: Companies increasingly disclose human capital initiatives, such as diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) and non-DEI initiatives. Yet, DEI initiatives have become a focal point of debate, raising questions about whether investors view them as appropriate uses of company resources. Across two experiments, we examine how nonprofessional investors perceive DEI versus non-DEI initiatives. Drawing on equity theory, we propose that investors' fairness-based perceptions of an initiative's appropriateness depend on their underlying preferences for what companies should prioritize, and that these perceptions influence their investment willingness. Experiment 1 finds that investors perceive DEI (versus non-DEI) initiatives as less appropriate, and this difference is exacerbated when investors are more shareholder-oriented than stakeholder-oriented. Furthermore, the mediating effect of perceived appropriateness on investment willingness is stronger when company financial performance is unfavorable than when it is favorable. Building on these findings, Experiment 2 tests a boundary condition of our theory by examining whether explicitly stating merit-based selection criteria attenuates shareholder-oriented investors' stronger negative perceptions of DEI initiatives. We find that when DEI initiatives are explicitly presented as merit-based, investors' negative perceptions of appropriateness of DEI (versus non-DEI) initiatives are attenuated, and the exacerbating moderating effect of shareholder (versus stakeholder) investor orientation also diminishes. Our findings demonstrate how investors' fairness-based perceptions of appropriateness can explain divergent responses to DEI disclosures, offering timely implications for companies and regulators concerned with human capital reporting.

title_zh: 投资者对人力资本举措的判断：举措类型、投资者导向与财务绩效的作用
abstract_zh: 公司越来越多地披露人力资本举措，例如多元化、公平与包容（DEI）举措和非DEI举措。然而，DEI举措已成为争论的焦点，引发了投资者是否将其视为公司资源的适当用途的疑问。通过两项实验，我们考察非专业投资者如何看待DEI与非DEI举措。基于公平理论，我们提出，投资者基于公平性对某项举措适当性的感知取决于其对该公司应优先考虑事项的潜在偏好，并且这些感知会影响其投资意愿。实验1发现，投资者认为DEI（相对于非DEI）举措的适当性较低，而当投资者更偏向股东导向而非利益相关者导向时，这一差异会加剧。此外，当公司财务绩效不佳时，感知适当性对投资意愿的中介效应比财务绩效良好时更强。基于这些发现，实验2通过考察明确陈述基于择优的选择标准是否会减弱股东导向投资者对DEI举措更强的负面感知，来检验我们理论的边界条件。我们发现，当DEI举措被明确表述为基于择优时，投资者对DEI（相对于非DEI）举措适当性的负面感知会被减弱，股东（相对于利益相关者）投资者导向的加剧性调节效应也会减弱。我们的发现表明，投资者基于公平性的适当性感知如何能够解释对DEI披露的分歧反应，为关注人力资本报告的公司和监管机构提供了及时的启示。

source_records.title: Supporting underperforming agents: The role of human capital development and relative performance information
source_records.abstract: We study principals’ use of performance information to allocate human capital development resources to underperforming agents. We use proprietary data from a retail firm that sets uniform, noncalibrated performance targets to ensure consistent quality and customer experience across all stores. Unlike calibrated targets, uniform, noncalibrated targets do not account for heterogeneity in local conditions. Given that human capital development is costly, we predict and find that principals do not support all agents who underperform on noncalibrated targets. Instead, they use relative performance information and concentrate support on underperforming agents who outperform their geographical peers. In contrast, for calibrated targets, we find no evidence that principals rely on relative performance; agents who underperform calibrated targets are generally eligible for human capital support. Consistent with our assumption that relative performance is informative about returns to human capital investment, we find that support for underperforming agents who outperform their peers improves performance.

title_zh: 支持表现不佳的代理人：人力资本开发与相对绩效信息的作用
abstract_zh: 我们研究委托人如何利用绩效信息将人力资本开发资源配置给表现不佳的代理人。我们使用一家零售企业的专有数据，该企业设定统一、未校准的绩效目标，以确保所有门店的质量和客户体验一致。与校准目标不同，统一、未校准的目标不考虑当地条件的异质性。鉴于人力资本开发成本高昂，我们预测并发现，委托人不会支持所有在未校准目标上表现不佳的代理人。相反，他们会利用相对绩效信息，将支持集中于那些表现优于其地理同行的表现不佳代理人。相比之下，对于校准目标，我们没有发现委托人依赖相对绩效的证据；在校准目标上表现不佳的代理人通常有资格获得人力资本支持。与我们关于相对绩效能提供有关人力资本投资回报信息的假设一致，我们发现，对表现优于同行的表现不佳代理人的支持能够改善绩效。

source_records.title: Horizontal directors and investment efficiency
source_records.abstract: Horizontal directors, board members who also hold board seats in same-industry peers, are common in U.S. corporations. We posit that horizontal directorships can enhance the efficiency of corporate investment decisions. Horizontal directors enjoy access to current information flows, which help boards fulfill their roles of advising and monitoring – a form of learning from peers. We find that horizontal directorships are negatively related to investment inefficiency, and with over-investment in particular. Exogenous shocks to board composition provide a causal interpretation to our findings. Our paper contributes to a nuanced view of horizontal directors by highlighting their contribution to mitigate excessive investment.

title_zh: 横向董事与投资效率
abstract_zh: 横向董事，即在同行业同行中同时担任董事会席位的董事会成员，在美国公司中很常见。我们假设横向董事职位能够提升公司投资决策的效率。横向董事能够获取当前的信息流，这有助于董事会履行其咨询和监督的职责——一种向同行学习的形式。我们发现，横向董事职位与投资低效呈负相关，尤其是与过度投资呈负相关。对董事会构成的外生冲击为我们的发现提供了因果解释。我们的论文通过强调横向董事在缓解过度投资方面的贡献，为更细致地看待横向董事提供了贡献。

source_records.title: Not in my backyard: Personal bias in mutual fund voting on environmental and social proposals
source_records.abstract: Fund managers cast votes that are more critical of firm environmental and social (ES) practices when the firm has operations located close to fund headquarters. This elevated support for shareholder ES proposals is not mirrored in governance proposals, which likely have less impact on the local community. We find similar pro-ES fund voting practices at firms with operations near the fund manager’s college and prior employment locations and in utility companies that provide electric and gas service to the fund’s address. Manager and sub-advisor turnover events provide additional evidence: tracking the same decision-maker’s votes at a fixed set of firms before and after the move, we find that support for ES proposals increases significantly once the manager gains proximity to those firms. The proximity effect is concentrated at high-polluting plants, consistent with managers responding to personal exposure to environmental harm. We conclude that fund managers exhibit a personal bias in ES voting, being more likely to support ES proposals that impact them personally.

title_zh: 不要在我家后院：共同基金在环境与社会提案投票中的个人偏见
abstract_zh: 当公司运营地点靠近基金总部时，基金经理投出的票更倾向于批评公司的环境与社会（ES）实践。这种对股东ES提案的支持度提升并未体现在治理提案中，而治理提案对当地社区的影响可能较小。我们在以下情形中也发现了类似的亲ES基金投票行为：公司运营地点靠近基金经理的大学母校或先前工作地点，以及为基金地址提供电力和燃气服务的公用事业公司。经理和副顾问的更换事件提供了额外证据：追踪同一决策者在固定的一组公司中搬迁前后的投票，我们发现一旦经理与这些公司距离拉近，对ES提案的支持度显著增加。这种邻近效应集中体现在高污染工厂，与经理对个人暴露于环境危害作出反应相一致。我们得出结论，基金经理在ES投票中表现出个人偏见，更可能支持那些对他们个人产生影响的ES提案。

source_records.title: How does relief from mandatory disclosure affect firm investment and growth?
source_records.raw_title: How does relief from mandatory disclosure affect firm investment and growth?

source_records.title: How does relief from mandatory disclosure affect firm investment and growth?
source_records.abstract: We examine the effects of time-limited disclosure relief under the Jumpstart Our Business Startups (JOBS) Act of 2012. The Act grants newly public firms up to five years of exemptions, and our results suggest that the fixed duration of this relief, as much as its availability, shapes post-IPO behavior. Using an intention-to-treat design, we compare treated firms with smaller reporting companies whose exemptions are similar but carry no fixed expiry date. Equity issuance by treated firms increases significantly as the deadline nears while debt issuance declines, and cash reserves accumulate over the period. Capital expenditure increases relative to controls in the early post-IPO years, while R&D shows no differential response. As expiry approaches, the differential with the control group in internal investment weakens but cash-financed acquisitions accelerate. This shift in investment composition coincides with deteriorating operating performance and declining market valuations relative to IPO levels. Our post-expiry analysis reveals an abrupt reversal in acquisition activity upon transition to full disclosure while internal investment remains unchanged, supporting the argument that pre-expiry behavior was driven by the regulatory timeline rather than natural firm maturation. We conclude that the duration of regulatory relief is as important as its scope in shaping corporate behavior, and that time-limited exemptions from mandatory disclosure can induce anticipatory firm responses that work against the policy's intended objectives.

title_zh: 强制披露豁免如何影响企业投资与增长？
abstract_zh: 我们考察了2012年《创业企业融资法案》（JOBS Act）下限时披露豁免的影响。该法案给予新上市公司最多五年的豁免，我们的结果表明，这一豁免的固定期限与其可获得性一样，塑造了IPO后的行为。采用意向性治疗设计，我们将受处理企业与小型报告公司进行比较，后者的豁免类似但没有固定到期日。随着截止日期临近，受处理企业的股权发行显著增加，而债务发行下降，现金储备在此期间不断累积。相对于对照组，资本支出在IPO后早期增加，而研发没有表现出差异化反应。随着到期临近，内部投资方面与对照组的差异减弱，但现金融资的收购加速。这种投资构成的变化伴随着经营业绩恶化和相对于IPO水平的市场估值下降。我们的到期后分析揭示，在过渡到完全披露后，收购活动出现突然逆转，而内部投资保持不变，这支持了以下论点：到期前的行为是由监管时间表而非企业自然成熟所驱动。我们得出结论：监管豁免的期限与其范围在塑造企业行为方面同样重要，而且强制披露的限时豁免可能诱使企业做出预期性反应，从而与政策的预期目标相悖。

source_records.title: When peers fail: Spillover effects of CSR incidents on real investment
source_records.abstract: This paper investigates how peer firms’ Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR)-related incidents influence the corporate investment efficiency of non-incident firms. Using a sample of U.S. firms from 2007 to 2021, we document a significant increase in investment-Tobin’s Q sensitivity following negative peer events, thereby improving investment efficiency. We identify three non-mutually exclusive channels. First, the effect is stronger among firms with higher analyst coverage, greater stock trading volume, and closer product-market proximity to the incident firm, consistent with the notion of heightened external scrutiny. Second, peer incidents act as informational shocks that enhance managerial learning from external signals, particularly when firms operate in competitive industries, face high product market uncertainty, or have more informative stock prices. Furthermore, we find that the performance of focal firms deteriorates following peer incidents and that efficiency gains are greater among firms that were previously overinvesting. Taken together, these findings suggest that peer CSR scandals act as disciplining and learning events that improve investment behaviour across the industry.

Taken together, these findings suggest that peer CSR scandals act as disciplining and learning events that improve investment behaviour across the industry.

title_original: When peers fail: Spillover effects of CSR incidents on real investment
abstract_original: This paper investigates how peer firms’ Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR)-related incidents influence the corporate investment efficiency of non-incident firms. Using a sample of U.S. firms from 2007 to 2021, we document a significant increase in investment-Tobin’s Q sensitivity following negative peer events, thereby improving investment efficiency. We identify three non-mutually exclusive channels. First, the effect is stronger among firms with higher analyst coverage, greater stock trading volume, and closer product-market proximity to the incident firm, consistent with the notion of heightened external scrutiny. Second, peer incidents act as informational shocks that enhance managerial learning from external signals, particularly when firms operate in competitive industries, face high product market uncertainty, or have more informative stock prices. Furthermore, we find that the performance of focal firms deteriorates following peer incidents and that efficiency gains are greater among firms that were previously overinvesting. Taken together, these findings suggest that peer CSR scandals act as disciplining and learning events that improve investment behaviour across the industry.
title_zh: 当同行失范：CSR事件对实体投资的溢出效应
abstract_zh: 本文研究同行企业与企业社会责任（CSR）相关的事件如何影响非事件企业的公司投资效率。我们以2007年至2021年的美国公司为样本，发现同行负面事件后，投资对托宾Q的敏感性显著上升，从而提高了投资效率。我们识别出三条并非互斥的渠道。第一，在分析师覆盖度更高、股票交易量更大、与事件公司在产品市场上更为接近的公司中，这一效应更强，这与外部监督加强的观点一致。第二，同行事件作为信息冲击，增强了管理者从外部信号中的学习，尤其当公司处于竞争性行业、面临较高的产品市场不确定性或股价信息含量更高时更是如此。此外，我们发现，同行事件后焦点公司的业绩恶化，且此前投资过度的公司中效率提升更大。综合来看，这些发现表明，同行CSR丑闻作为惩戒性和学习性事件，改善了整个行业的投资行为。

source_records.title: Co-opted boards and anti-takeover provisions in US firms: Do better financial outcomes and dynamic governance matter?
source_records.abstract: This research examines the relationship between co-opted boards and firms' anti-takeover provisions (ATPs). Analyzing 5585 US firm-year observations for the period 2012–2022, we document a positive relationship between co-opted boards and ATPs. We further illustrate that the positive relationship is stronger in firms that exhibit subpar performance and compensate senior executives and directors more than the industry average. Furthermore, our research finds that good governance, board and executive gender diversity, gender equality, and board cultural diversity moderate the positive relationship between co-opted boards and ATPs. Our results remain robust across a battery of tests. The findings of this research have important implications for corporate boards and managers. The study contributes to the mainstream agency theory by demonstrating that co-opted boards exacerbate firms' agency problems by blocking the potential of external disciplinary mechanisms.

title_zh: 被拉拢董事会与美国公司的反收购条款：更好的财务结果与动态治理是否重要？
abstract_zh: 本研究考察被拉拢董事会与公司反收购条款（ATPs）之间的关系。通过分析2012—2022年期间5585个美国公司—年度观测值，我们记录了被拉拢董事会与ATPs之间的正向关系。我们进一步表明，这种正向关系在业绩表现不佳以及向高管和董事支付的薪酬高于行业平均水平的公司中更强。此外，我们的研究发现，良好的治理、董事会与高管性别多样性、性别平等以及董事会文化多样性会调节被拉拢董事会与ATPs之间的正向关系。我们的结果在一系列检验中保持稳健。本研究发现对公司董事会和管理者具有重要启示。该研究通过证明被拉拢董事会因阻断外部约束机制的潜力而加剧公司代理问题，为主流代理理论作出了贡献。

source_records.title: CEO aging and investment propensity: Experimental evidence
source_records.abstract: Firms led by older CEOs invest less, but the mechanism behind this age–investment gradient remains unclear. We study how CEO age shapes investment evaluation by eliciting CEOs' ratings of a project's investment attractiveness in a large-scale scenario-based experiment with more than 3700 CEOs from owner-managed Danish firms. Our design provides direct evidence on CEOs' investment evaluations by separating baseline differences in investment attractiveness from sensitivity to risk moments and payout horizon. Each CEO evaluates randomized capital-budgeting scenarios relative to the status quo, allowing us to distinguish a baseline shift in willingness to view projects as compelling from age differences in responsiveness to risk characteristics and payout horizon. We document a pronounced negative association between CEO age and investment attractiveness. Holding expected IRR, variance, skewness, and payout horizon constant, CEOs aged 60 or older rate the same opportunities as less attractive, while age differences in sensitivity to these attributes are weak. Standard stated risk attitudes and a lottery measure show no systematic age pattern. For external validity, we construct a CEO-specific inaction propensity from the experiment—the residual tendency to rate otherwise identical projects as less attractive after accounting for project characteristics—and show that it predicts lower investment in administrative data. Including this measure attenuates the reduced-form age–investment association, suggesting that age-related investment declines are not readily explained by conventional risk preferences or investment horizons alone, but also reflect a broader residual tendency towards lower investment propensity.

title_zh: CEO年龄与投资倾向：实验证据
abstract_zh: 由年长CEO领导的企业投资更少，但这一年龄—投资梯度背后的机制仍不清楚。我们通过一项大规模情景实验，让来自丹麦所有者管理型企业的3700多名CEO对项目的投资吸引力进行评分，从而研究CEO年龄如何影响投资评估。我们的设计通过将投资吸引力的基线差异与对风险矩和支付期限的敏感性区分开来，为CEO的投资评估提供了直接证据。每位CEO相对于现状评估随机化的资本预算情景，这使我们能够区分将项目视为有吸引力的意愿的基线偏移与对风险特征和支付期限反应性的年龄差异。我们记录了CEO年龄与投资吸引力之间显著的负相关关系。在预期IRR、方差、偏度和支付期限保持不变的情况下，60岁或以上的CEO对相同机会的评分更低，而对这些属性的敏感性的年龄差异较弱。标准的陈述性风险态度和彩票测量未显示出系统性的年龄模式。为了外部有效性，我们从实验中构建了一个CEO特定的不作为倾向——在考虑项目特征后，将其他方面相同的项目评为吸引力更低的残差倾向——并表明它预测了行政数据中更低的投资。纳入这一测量会减弱简约式年龄—投资关联，这表明与年龄相关的投资下降不能仅由传统风险偏好或投资期限来解释，还反映了更广泛的、朝向更低投资倾向的残差倾向。

source_records.title: Defining family firms: A survey of empirical criteria
source_records.abstract: We survey 153 empirical studies of family firms and document 192 operational definitions representing 25 distinct definition types. These definitions can be decomposed into five recurring, codable dimensions: ownership, management, board representation, embeddedness, and succession. We relate these dimensions to economic mechanisms including agency conflicts, residual control rights, transaction costs, and dynastic control. Alternative definitions select systematically different populations and yield materially different estimates of firm performance and innovation. Definition choice is largely unrelated to the research question, except in succession studies. Ownership thresholds track private enforcement of self-dealing rules, but not statutory shareholder rights or rule of law. We conclude that the family firm is a family of related constructs rather than a single latent construct. Definitions should therefore match the family-firm construct implied by the research question, and results should be reported across alternative classification rules.

title_zh: 界定家族企业：一项关于实证标准的综述
abstract_zh: 我们综述了153项关于家族企业的实证研究，并记录了192种操作性定义，代表25种不同的定义类型。这些定义可分解为五个反复出现且可编码的维度：所有权、管理、董事会代表、嵌入性和继任。我们将这些维度与包括代理冲突、剩余控制权、交易成本和王朝控制在内的经济机制联系起来。不同的定义会系统地选择不同的人群，并对企业绩效和创新得出实质性不同的估计。除继任研究外，定义选择在很大程度上与研究问题无关。所有权阈值与自我交易规则的私人执行相关，但与法定股东权利或法治无关。我们得出结论：家族企业是一组相关构念的家族，而非单一潜在构念。因此，定义应与研究问题所隐含的家族企业构念相匹配，并且结果应在不同的分类规则下报告。

source_records.title: Strategic communication among banks
source_records.abstract: How do bank networks facilitate information flows that shape market outcomes? Using international banks’ advisory activities in corporate takeovers as their source of private information, we show in supervisory data that banks with closer ties to the target, but not the acquirer, advisor trade profitably in the target’s stock prior to the deal announcement. This trading behavior is associated with a higher premium paid without compromising deal success. As connected banks’ incentives are aligned only with target shareholders’ interests, which are represented by the target advisor, our evidence suggests that economic incentives determine which banks share information and with whom.

source_records.title: Segmented Dollar Funding
source_records.abstract: Deviations from covered interest rate parity (CIP) are often linked to limits to arbitrage, yet trading volumes surge during periods of apparent no-arbitrage violations. We show that these distortions stem from constraints on non-U.S. agents’ access to wholesale U.S. dollar markets and reflect a premium for unencumbered synthetic dollar funding: non-U.S. banks substitute secured USD borrowing with FX swaps to meet regulatory requirements. A shadow cost-augmented CIP condition holds, implying no riskless arbitrage. U.S. dealers extract rents on dollar provision while non-U.S. customers bear $10.4 billion in additional annual hedging costs. Our results illustrate how intermediary constraints segment global dollar funding.

source_records.title: Removing the fine print: Disclosure, standardized products, and consumer outcomes
source_records.abstract: Hidden fees can distort consumer decision-making. In response, regulators historically have (a) improved disclosure to make fees more salient or (b) standardized products to restrict what fees can be charged. We use Chilean administrative data and a multi-stage natural experiment to separately identify the effects of disclosure and standardization on repayment. We find that disclosure reduces delinquencies by 13.7 percentage points (40%) and default by 1.68 percentage points (98%), whereas standardization has no effect. We find no effect on initial loan terms, suggesting that disclosure’s effects are specific to repayment behavior: specifically, disclosure improves borrowers’ understanding of their credit obligations.

title_zh: 移除细则：信息披露、标准化产品与消费者结果
abstract_zh: 隐藏费用可能扭曲消费者决策。作为回应，监管机构历来采取两种做法：(a) 改进信息披露以使费用更加显眼，或 (b) 标准化产品以限制可收取的费用。我们利用智利行政数据和一个多阶段自然实验，分别识别信息披露和标准化对还款的影响。我们发现，信息披露使逾期率降低13.7个百分点（40%），使违约率降低1.68个百分点（98%），而标准化则没有影响。我们未发现对初始贷款条款的影响，这表明信息披露的影响特定于还款行为：具体而言，信息披露改善了借款人对自身信贷义务的理解。

source_records.title: Financing innovation: A hurdle rate theory of inventive procyclicality
source_records.abstract: Schumpeterian arguments of ''creative destruction'' predict that innovation is countercyclical. However, empirical findings demonstrate the contrary. We apply corporate finance principles to innovation economics and propose a ''hurdle-rate theory of inventive procyclicality.'' Macroeconomic episodes of high equity risk premia (ERP) stifle innovation in our sample of U.S. firms because many R&D projects do not pass corporate budgeting decisions when the aggregate discount rate is high. Consistent evidence suggests that the discount rate effect is less pronounced in firms with financial slack, weak product market competition, and institutional investor ownership with long-term orientation. In an attempt to reconcile our procyclical empirical evidence with Schumpeter’s countercyclical theory, we show that firms engaging in exploratory research suffer less during high-ERP episodes than those focusing on exploitative research, and patents developed during high-ERP periods have a higher technological impact and receive significantly more forward citations. Finally, we exploit the staggered variation in state-level R&D tax credits in difference-in-differences analyses to establish a causal link between the ERP and patent value.

title_zh: 为创新融资：发明顺周期性的门槛利率理论
abstract_zh: 熊彼特式的“创造性破坏”论点预测创新是逆周期的。然而，实证研究结果却相反。我们将公司金融原则应用于创新经济学，并提出了一种“发明顺周期性的门槛利率理论”。在我们的美国企业样本中，宏观经济中高股权风险溢价（ERP）的时期会抑制创新，因为当总体贴现率较高时，许多研发项目无法通过公司预算决策。一致的证据表明，在拥有财务冗余、产品市场竞争较弱以及具有长期导向的机构投资者持股的企业中，贴现率效应不那么明显。为了试图将我们的顺周期实证证据与熊彼特的逆周期理论相调和，我们表明，从事探索性研究的企业在高ERP时期受到的冲击小于那些专注于利用性研究的企业，并且在高ERP时期开发的专利具有更高的技术影响力，并获得显著更多的前向引用。最后，我们利用州级研发税收抵免的交错变化进行双重差分分析，以建立ERP与专利价值之间的因果联系。

source_records.title: Open user innovation, producer innovation and industrial dynamics: An ABM approach
source_records.abstract: This paper sets out to develop a unified theoretical framework integrating von Hippel user innovation and Schumpeterian industrial dynamics through a relatively simple agent-based model (ABM). The model reproduces known stylised facts, and it also generates some important theoretical results to explain the transition from community-phase to market-phase innovation, that neither paradigm addresses on its own. In our model, as user innovators develop the technology for their own use, complementary interactions with producers also begin to form. These firms seek market opportunity and require a certain minimum scale of operations before they enter. Where firms enter, they bring scale and often further innovate, which in turn, recursively feeds back into user innovation. In this way, von Hippel and Schumpeterian innovation co-evolve. Our ABM provides a formal and endogenous framework to understand these coevolutionary processes, generating theoretical results about the conditions under which it occurs. Specifically, the model simulations explore how two structural key parameters: users' attribute requirement thresholds and the degree of local sticky information , shape this co-evolutionary process. title_zh: 开放用户创新、生产者创新与产业动态：一种基于主体建模的方法
abstract_zh: 本文旨在通过一个相对简单的主体基模型（ABM），构建一个统一的理论框架，将冯·希佩尔用户创新与熊彼特式产业动态整合起来。该模型再现了已知的典型事实，同时也产生了一些重要的理论结果，用以解释从社区阶段向市场阶段创新的转变，而这两种范式各自都无法单独解释这一转变。在我们的模型中，随着用户创新者为自身使用而开发技术，与生产者之间的互补性互动也开始形成。这些企业寻求市场机会，并且在进入之前需要达到一定的最低运营规模。在企业进入的地方，它们带来了规模，并且往往进一步创新，这反过来又递归地反馈到用户创新中。通过这种方式，冯·希佩尔式创新与熊彼特式创新共同演化。我们的ABM提供了一个正式且内生的框架来理解这些共同演化过程，并产生了关于其发生条件的理论结果。具体而言，模型模拟探讨了两个结构性关键参数：用户的属性要求阈值和局部黏性信息的程度，如何塑造这一共同演化过程。模拟表明：(i) 由高信息黏性驱动的社区碎片化，即使用户需求存在，也可能阻碍可行的生产者进入；(ii) 用户属性要求阈值的中等取值，会为落在属性空间中心的先驱企业带来竞争优势；(iii) 从用户社区中涌现出的产业动态再现了熊彼特式典型事实，从而为两种范式之间提供了统一的桥梁。这些理论发现对创新政策具有直接含义：(i) 政策应监测社区一致性，将其作为特定可行商业化的早期信号；(ii) 一种处理信息黏性的政策模型必然依赖于具体情境；(iii) 属性要求阈值表明，生产者进入策略应与用户需求异质性的分布相匹配。

source_records.title: Are circular innovations disruptive? An analysis of the role of inventor networks in the European semiconductor industry
source_records.abstract: The expansion of advanced technologies is intensifying demand for energy, materials, and efficiency of production systems, with semiconductors exemplifying the tension between rapid technological progress and resource sustainability, and the development of circular innovations. Yet it remains unclear whether circular innovations in this sector tend to be genuinely disruptive. This study examines the disruptiveness of circular (vs. non-circular) innovations and analyses the role of inventor network structures. The empirical analysis relies on the patents of 299 European Semiconductor Equipment Manufacturing (SEM) companies retrieved from the ORBIS IP database for the period 2013-2022. First, we operationalize disruptiveness by adopting a citation-based measure to reveal whether subsequent inventions build upon or bypass a focal patent’s prior art. Then, co-inventor networks are constructed, and inventor centrality and cohesion measures are aggregated to the patent level to link inventor network structure to disruptive outcomes over time. Our findings show that circular patents exhibit, on average, higher disruptiveness than non-circular patents, and that inventor network structures characterized by more peripheral and high local cohesive configurations align with disruptive circular outcomes. The effect of the network antecedents differs systematically between circular and non-circular innovations, indicating distinct pathways to disruption. The study contributes to the innovation literature by integrating a structural disruptiveness measure with inventor network analytics, offering one of the first patent-level comparisons of circular versus non-circular disruptiveness in the semiconductor industry, and by deriving implications for organizing collaboration portfolios and policy instruments that foster circular transitions.

title_zh: 循环创新具有颠覆性吗？发明人网络在欧洲半导体产业中作用的一项分析
abstract_zh: 先进技术的扩张正在加剧对能源、材料和生产系统效率的需求，半导体正是快速技术进步与资源可持续性之间张力以及循环创新发展的典型例证。然而，该领域的循环创新是否往往具有真正的颠覆性，仍不清楚。本研究考察循环（相对于非循环）创新的颠覆性，并分析发明人网络结构的作用。实证分析依赖于从ORBIS IP数据库检索到的299家欧洲半导体设备制造（SEM）企业在2013—2022年期间的专利。首先，我们通过采用基于引用的测度来操作化颠覆性，以揭示后续发明是建立在焦点专利的现有技术之上还是绕开其现有技术。然后，构建共同发明人网络，并将发明人中心性和凝聚性测度聚合到专利层面，以将发明人网络结构与随时间变化的颠覆性结果联系起来。我们的研究结果表明，循环专利平均而言比非循环专利表现出更高的颠覆性，并且以更边缘化和高局部凝聚性配置为特征的发明人网络结构与颠覆性的循环结果相一致。网络前因的效应在循环创新与非循环创新之间存在系统性差异，表明通向颠覆的路径不同。本研究通过将结构性颠覆性测度与发明人网络分析相结合，为创新文献作出贡献，提供了半导体产业中循环与非循环颠覆性的首批专利层面比较之一，并得出了关于组织合作组合以及促进循环转型的政策工具的含义。

source_records.title: How experience moderates the impact of AI suggestions on researchers' perceptions of their ideas
source_records.abstract: At the heart of scientific discovery are researchers who identify ideas worthy of inquiry. In performing research tasks, researchers increasingly use generative artificial intelligence (AI) technologies. While this technology offers the promise of increased efficiency across the research process, little is known about how generative AI assists researchers with the generation of initial research ideas—one of the most fundamental tasks in science—and their willingness to adopt it for such purpose. In a pre-registered randomized online experiment with 310 researchers and a follow-up ideation study with 28 researchers, we show how one's research experience plays a role in receiving generative AI suggestions when formulating new research ideas. Experience negatively moderates both the incorporation of generative AI suggestions as well as its effect on perceived novelty and impact of the researcher's idea. We also find that generative AI may be reshaping research ideation by adding a layer of non-human exchange that precedes feedback from human experts. By focusing on the critical moment at which research ideas spark, we provide an initial understanding of how researchers respond to generative AI at a time when the paradigm of human knowledge production may be shifting from a human-only to a joint human-AI model.

title_zh: 经验如何调节AI建议对研究者对其想法感知的影响
abstract_zh: 科学发现的核心在于研究者识别值得探究的想法。在执行研究任务时，研究者越来越多地使用生成式人工智能（AI）技术。尽管这项技术有望在整个研究过程中提高效率，但关于生成式AI如何协助研究者生成初始研究想法——科学中最基本的任务之一——以及他们是否愿意为此目的采用它，我们知之甚少。在一项有310名研究者参与的预注册随机在线实验和一项有28名研究者参与的后续构思研究中，我们展示了研究经验在形成新研究想法时接受生成式AI建议方面所起的作用。经验对生成式AI建议的采纳及其对研究者想法的感知新颖性和影响力的效应均起到负向调节作用。我们还发现，生成式AI可能通过增加一层先于人类专家反馈的非人类交流，正在重塑研究构思。通过聚焦研究想法迸发的关键时刻，我们在人类知识生产范式可能正从纯人类模式转向人机联合模式之际，初步理解了研究者如何回应生成式AI。

source_records.title: Temporary technology and the maintenance of technological sovereignty
source_records.abstract: This study investigates how technologies emerge to sustain technological sovereignty in response to exogenous shocks. We focus on the efforts of the Finnish state to overcome the shortage of mineral oil-based lubricants during the Second World War and identify tar oil as a central technology in this endeavor. By analyzing the emergence and decline of the Finnish tar oil industry, we elaborate on the life cycle and key mechanisms of temporary technologies as well as their role in maintaining technological sovereignty. These findings lead to a definition of temporary technology as a distinct form of technology evolution. Our findings contribute to the technology evolution literature by theorizing a form of technology that has a limited long-term impact, making it suitable for addressing temporary shocks without altering long-term technology evolution. For the technological sovereignty literature, we extend understanding of how sovereignty can be maintained in the face of unanticipated exogenous shocks and how that involves cooperation between the state and non-state actors.

title_zh: 临时技术与技术主权的维持
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨技术如何涌现以在应对外生冲击时维持技术主权。我们聚焦于芬兰国家在第二次世界大战期间为克服矿物油基润滑剂短缺所做的努力，并确定焦油是该努力中的一项核心技术。通过分析芬兰焦油产业的兴起与衰落，我们阐述了临时技术的生命周期与关键机制，以及它们在维持技术主权中的作用。这些发现引出了对临时技术的定义，即一种独特的技术演化形式。我们的发现为技术演化文献做出贡献，通过理论化一种具有有限长期影响的技术形式，使其适合在应对临时冲击的同时不改变长期技术演化。对于技术主权文献，我们拓展了对在面对未预料到的外生冲击时如何维持主权的理解，以及这如何涉及国家与非国家行为者之间的合作。

source_records.title: Equity crowdfunding exemptions, industrial structure, and new venture creation
source_records.abstract: We investigate the impact of equity crowdfunding exemptions on new venture creation. We further explore whether the effect varies across industries with different levels of external finance dependence, and whether this heterogeneity is influenced by regional industrial structures. Empirical evidence shows that, while the average effect of crowdfunding exemptions on new venture entry is not statistically significant, the impact is positive and significant in industries with higher external finance dependence. Moreover, this positive effect is further amplified in regions characterized by greater related variety. Complementary analyses show that the increase in new venture creation does not appear to be accompanied by a decline in entry quality. These findings highlight the importance of firm-level financial constraints and regional industrial context in shaping the effectiveness of crowdfunding policies.

title_zh: 股权众筹豁免、产业结构与新企业创建
abstract_zh: 我们研究了股权众筹豁免对新企业创建的影响。我们进一步探讨了这一效应是否在不同外部融资依赖程度的行业中有所差异，以及这种异质性是否受到区域产业结构的影响。实证证据表明，尽管众筹豁免对新企业进入的平均效应在统计上不显著，但在外部融资依赖程度较高的行业中，其影响是正向且显著的。此外，这种正向效应在相关多样性程度更高的地区被进一步放大。补充分析表明，新企业创建的增加似乎并未伴随进入质量的下降。这些发现凸显了企业层面的融资约束和区域产业背景在塑造众筹政策有效性方面的重要性。

source_records.title: Follow the technology or follow the leader? Radical innovation and strategic leadership at a crossroads
source_records.abstract: Radical innovation and strategic leadership research share a foundational challenge of theorizing how firms make choices about an uncertain future that shape their competitiveness, survival, and long-term performance. Yet, each field has developed a distinct explanatory signature. Radical innovation research has followed the technology, tracing how the architecture and trajectories of technological discontinuities determine organizational fates. Strategic leadership research has followed the leader(s), tracing how the cognition, composition, and interactions of those at the organizational apex shape organizational choices. We argue that this productive division of labor is being jointly frustrated by four shifts in contemporary organizing: structurally , innovation is migrating from firms to ecosystems; technologically , AI is transforming both the creative process and the cognitive conditions of leadership; relationally , permeable boundaries are redistributing influence across actors; and culturally , evaluative criteria are expanding from performance to purpose. We identify the foundational assumptions these shifts unsettle and propose four research frontiers organized around where, how, with whom, and why radical innovation happens. We conclude with key reflections from three foundational scholars on the future of the field.

We conclude with key reflections from three foundational scholars on the future of the field.

title_zh: 跟随技术还是跟随领导者？激进创新与战略领导力处于十字路口
abstract_zh: 激进创新与战略领导力研究面临一个共同的基础性挑战，即如何理论化企业在不确定未来面前做出塑造其竞争力、生存和长期绩效的选择。然而，每个领域都发展出了独特的解释特征。激进创新研究一直跟随技术，追踪技术不连续性的架构与轨迹如何决定组织的命运。战略领导力研究一直跟随领导者，追踪组织顶层人物的认知、构成与互动如何塑造组织选择。我们认为，这种富有成效的分工正共同受到当代组织四项转变的阻碍：在结构上，创新正从企业迁移到生态系统；在技术上，人工智能正在改变创造性过程以及领导力的认知条件；在关系上，可渗透的边界正在重新分配各行动者之间的影响力；在文化上，评价标准正从绩效扩展到目的。我们识别出这些转变所动摇的基础性假设，并提出四个研究前沿，分别围绕激进创新在何处、如何、与谁以及为何发生来组织。最后，我们以三位奠基性学者对该领域未来的关键反思作为结论。

source_records.title: Risk and the discursive construction of quantum technologies in Australia: How geopolitical and economic threats are used in hyping emerging technologies
source_records.abstract: In this paper, we examine the role of hype in the discursive construction of emerging quantum technologies. Our findings reveal that, as these technologies transition from academia to industry, they are the object of ‘hyping’ in which the discourses of risk and responsibility figure prominently. We find that hype – a collective vision around which attention, excitement, and expectations escalate – emerges from a process of discursively constructing emerging technologies as risk management solutions to highly salient geopolitical and economic risks to state actors, while acknowledging that they may pose less salient, novel social risks to citizens and social groups within a state. We also find that the former construction overwhelms the latter, which has important implications for what actions associated with developing these emerging technologies are considered responsible. As a result, and building on the sociology of expectations, we develop a discursive model showing how hyping mobilizes risk and responsibility to shape the meanings attached to emerging technologies and, in turn, the expectations that form around them – with important implications for the direction and pace of technological development.

title_zh: 风险与澳大利亚量子技术的话语建构：地缘政治和经济威胁如何被用于炒作新兴技术
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们考察了炒作在新兴量子技术话语建构中的作用。我们的研究发现，随着这些技术从学术界向产业界转移，它们成为“炒作”的对象，其中风险与责任的话语占据显著位置。我们发现，炒作——一种围绕其注意力、兴奋和期望不断升级的集体愿景——产生于这样一个话语建构过程：将新兴技术建构为针对国家行为者所面临的高度显著的地缘政治和经济风险的风险管理解决方案，同时承认这些技术可能对一国内部的公民和社会群体构成不那么显著的新颖社会风险。我们还发现，前一种建构压倒了后一种建构，这对于哪些与开发这些新兴技术相关的行动被视为负责任具有重要影响。因此，并在期望社会学的基础上，我们建立了一个话语模型，展示炒作如何调动风险与责任来塑造附着于新兴技术的意义，进而塑造围绕它们形成的期望——这对技术发展的方向和速度具有重要影响。

source_records.title: Science under sanctions: The impact of the entity list on Chinese academic research
source_records.abstract: This study examines the effects of geopolitical tensions and technology-related sanctions on academic research, with a focus on the U.S. Entity List's inclusion of Chinese academic institutions. Using a comprehensive dataset of academic publications from the Open Academic Graph, we employ a stacked event study design to estimate the causal effects of the Entity List sanctions on academic research productivity. Our findings reveal that Entity List sanctions reduce the quantity but improve the quality of research output among affected Chinese researchers. Mechanism analyses, supplemented by semi-structured interviews, show that these changes are driven by research diversification and collaboration network reconfiguration. Sanctioned researchers shift toward new topics and form partnerships with non-listed Chinese institutions, which serve as intermediaries that restore access to restricted resources and expose researchers to novel knowledge. Notably, we find no significant decline in collaboration with U.S.-based researchers, suggesting that sanctions reconfigure rather than sever international networks. Theoretically, this study extends the disruption-as-catalyst logic to geopolitically imposed resource constraints, showing that sanctions can trigger productive diversification. By demonstrating that sanctions affect research quantity and quality in opposing directions through specific behavioral mechanisms, this study also reconciles inconsistent findings in prior literature and advances our understanding of how geopolitical tensions reshape the global academic research landscape.

title_zh: 制裁下的科学：实体清单对中国学术研究的影响
abstract_zh: 本研究考察地缘政治紧张局势与技术相关制裁对学术研究的影响，重点关注美国实体清单将中国学术机构列入其中。我们使用来自Open Academic Graph的学术出版物综合数据集，采用堆叠事件研究设计来估计实体清单制裁对学术研究生产力的因果效应。我们的研究发现，实体清单制裁降低了受影响中国研究人员研究产出的数量，但提高了其质量。机制分析辅以半结构化访谈表明，这些变化由研究多元化和合作网络重构所驱动。受制裁的研究人员转向新主题，并与未被列入清单的中国机构建立合作关系，这些机构作为中介，恢复了获取受限资源的渠道，并使研究人员接触到新知识。值得注意的是，我们发现与美国研究人员的合作没有显著下降，这表明制裁是重构而非切断国际网络。在理论上，本研究将“干扰作为催化剂”的逻辑扩展到地缘政治施加的资源约束，表明制裁可以触发有生产力的多元化。通过证明制裁通过特定行为机制对研究数量和质量产生相反方向的影响，本研究也调和了先前文献中不一致的发现，并推进了我们对地缘政治紧张局势如何重塑全球学术研究格局的理解。

source_records.title: Modeling innovation ecosystem dynamics through interacting reinforced Bernoulli processes
source_records.abstract: Innovation is cumulative and interdependent: successful inventions build on prior knowledge within technological fields and may also affect success across related ones. Yet these dimensions are often studied separately in the innovation literature. This paper asks whether patent success across technological categories can be represented within a single dynamic framework that jointly captures within-category reinforcement, cross-category spillovers, and a set of aggregate regularities observed in patent data. To address this question, we propose a model of interacting reinforced Bernoulli processes in which the probability of success in a given category depends on past successes both within that category and across other categories. The framework yields joint predictions for success probabilities, cumulative successes, relative success shares, and cross-category dependence. We implement the model using granted US patent families from GLOBAL PATSTAT (1980–2018), defining category-specific success through a cohort-normalized forward-citation index. The empirical analysis shows that successful innovations continue to accumulate, but less than proportionally to the growth in patent opportunities, while technological categories remain interdependent without becoming homogeneous. Under a mean-field restriction, the model-based inferential exercise points to a positive but non-maximal interaction across technological categories.

title_zh: 通过相互作用的强化伯努利过程对创新生态系统动态进行建模
abstract_zh: 创新具有累积性和相互依赖性：成功的发明建立在本技术领域内既有知识的基础之上，也可能影响相关领域的成功。然而，创新文献往往将这些维度分开研究。本文提出的问题是，跨技术类别的专利成功是否能够在一个单一的动态框架内得到表示，该框架同时捕捉类别内的强化、跨类别的溢出效应，以及专利数据中观察到的一组总体规律。为回答这一问题，我们提出一个相互作用的强化伯努利过程模型，其中某一给定类别的成功概率取决于该类别内以及其他类别过去的成功。该框架对成功概率、累积成功、相对成功份额以及跨类别依赖性给出联合预测。我们使用GLOBAL PATSTAT（1980—2018年）中已授权的美国专利族来实施该模型，通过队列归一化的前向引用指数来定义类别特定的成功。实证分析表明，成功的创新会持续累积，但其累积程度低于专利机会增长的比例，而技术类别在保持相互依赖的同时并未变得同质化。在平均场限制下，基于模型的推断分析指向技术类别之间存在正向但非最大的相互作用。

source_records.title: Data and methods for identifying artificial intelligence-related patents
source_records.abstract: This paper evaluates existing approaches to identifying artificial intelligence (AI)-related patents and introduces a novel, scalable framework for improving classification performance. Motivated by growing reliance on patent data in innovation research, we assess widely used methods, including patent class-based approaches and the USPTO’s Artificial Intelligence Patent Dataset (AIPD), with an independent, human-expert-annotated ground-truth dataset. We document substantial performance limitations in existing approaches, particularly in terms of precision and generalizability. To address these challenges, we develop a CPC-informed, iterative positive-unlabeled (PU) learning framework for constructing high-quality training data. Our approach integrates hierarchical patent classification with data-driven refinement procedures to reduce label noise and improve representativeness. Using this refined dataset, we train a range of machine learning, deep learning, and transformer-based models. Our results show that models trained within our framework significantly outperform existing methods, including AIPD, achieving improvements over AIPD in F1 scores of approximately 18–21% on the same benchmark dataset. These gains are primarily driven by enhanced precision without sacrificing recall, highlighting the central role of training data quality in classification performance. We further demonstrate the empirical value of improved AI patent identification through two applications, showing that the release of ChatGPT increased both the market valuation of AI patents and firms’ allocation of innovative effort toward AI technologies. To support future research, we release our training data, source code, and patent-level predictions, with ongoing updates to reflect the evolving nature of AI innovation.

title_zh: 识别人工智能相关专利的数据与方法
abstract_zh: 本文评估了现有识别人工智能（AI）相关专利的方法，并引入了一个新颖的、可扩展的框架以提高分类性能。鉴于创新研究中日益依赖专利数据，我们使用一个独立的、由人类专家标注的真实数据集，评估了广泛使用的方法，包括基于专利类别的方法和美国专利商标局的人工智能专利数据集（AIPD）。我们记录了现有方法在性能上的重大局限，尤其是在精确度和泛化性方面。为应对这些挑战，我们开发了一个基于CPC信息、迭代的正-未标注（PU）学习框架，用于构建高质量的训练数据。我们的方法将分层专利分类与数据驱动的精炼程序相结合，以减少标签噪声并提高代表性。利用这一精炼后的数据集，我们训练了一系列机器学习、深度学习和基于Transformer的模型。我们的结果表明，在我们的框架内训练的模型显著优于现有方法，包括AIPD，在相同的基准数据集上，F1分数相较于AIPD提高了约18–21%。这些提升主要源于精确度的增强，且未牺牲召回率，突显了训练数据质量在分类性能中的核心作用。我们进一步通过两个应用展示了改进AI专利识别的实证价值，表明ChatGPT的发布提高了AI专利的市场估值以及企业对AI技术的创新投入配置。为支持未来研究，我们发布了训练数据、源代码和专利层面的预测结果，并将持续更新以反映AI创新的演变特性。

source_records.title: Minds and machines: Rethinking absorptive capacity in the age of artificial intelligence
source_records.abstract: The absorptive capacity construct derives its functions, dimensions, and internal relationships from the implicit assumption that humans are the only learning agents underlying knowledge absorption. I posit that the emergence of artificial intelligence (AI) challenges this assumption and requires a re-examination of the construct. Through a theory-building abductive study combining conceptual mapping with qualitative interviews, this work investigates the complex relationship between AI and knowledge absorption. It theorizes new dimensions of absorptive capacity pertaining to AI-driven processes and analyzes the interactions between these new dimensions and the traditional facets of the construct. Ultimately, the paper seeks to reaffirm the importance of absorptive capacity in the age of AI and develop a nuanced understanding of AI's role in reshaping the construct's antecedents, mechanisms, and implications.

source_records.title: A note on the changing appropriability conditions and technological opportunities for innovation in Japan; 1994–2020
source_records.abstract: We report findings obtained by comparing two innovation surveys in Japan conducted in 1994 and 2020. A comparison of statistical means at two points in time, controlling for firm size and industry as covariates, reveals that the following three changes have occurred for appropriabilities and technological opportunities of innovation during the past quarter-century. First, the effectiveness of almost all the mechanisms by which firms' appropriate profits from innovation declined. Second, the imitation lag has lengthened considerably. Third, while universities and government research institutes have become more important sources of technological information, internal sources and competitors have become less important. These results suggest that Japan's innovation system has undergone a fundamental transformation between the two time points.

source_records.title: The dual effects of digitalization on SMEs: export gains and learning losses
source_records.abstract: Longstanding debates persist about the impact of new technologies on firms, particularly as it relates to internationalization. Some scholars suggest that digitalization will enhance the benefits of export activity by facilitating connections with partners and customers. Others, however, suggest that digitalization will simply fail to live up to the hype—or perhaps even worse. This debate is especially relevant for SMEs given that export activity is the primary route to global markets for such firms. We propose that digitalization will exert dual effects on SMEs: on the “bright” side, larger investments in digital technologies will lead to greater export activity (i.e., higher export sales); on the “dark” side, however, digitalization-induced export activity will generate fewer learning opportunities from export partners (i.e., smaller productivity gains). The proposed hypotheses were tested and supported using detailed firm-level panel data from 20,133 Portuguese firms from 2010 to 2019. Additional analyses and case studies corroborate the proposed mechanisms and point to hybrid approaches as one possible way to balance these dual effects of digitalization. Taken together, the findings shed new light on the debate about the role of digitalization in internationalization efforts.

title_zh: 数字化对中小企业的双重效应：出口收益与学习损失
abstract_zh: 关于新技术对企业的影响，尤其是对国际化的影响，长期存在争论。一些学者认为，数字化将通过促进与合作伙伴和客户的联系来增强出口活动的收益。然而，另一些学者则认为，数字化根本达不到人们的期望——甚至可能更糟。鉴于出口活动是中小企业进入全球市场的主要途径，这一争论对中小企业尤为重要。我们提出，数字化将对中小企业产生双重效应：在“光明”的一面，对数字技术的更大投资将带来更多的出口活动（即更高的出口销售额）；然而，在“黑暗”的一面，数字化引发的出口活动将从出口伙伴那里产生更少的学习机会（即更小的生产率提升）。我们使用2010年至2019年间20,133家葡萄牙企业的详细企业层面面板数据，对所提出的假设进行了检验并得到支持。补充分析和案例研究证实了所提出的机制，并指出混合方法可能是平衡数字化这些双重效应的一种可能途径。总体而言，这些发现为关于数字化在国际化努力中作用的争论提供了新的启示。

source_records.title: Cross-border crowdfunding: an attention-based view
source_records.abstract: This study develops an attention-based view of cross-border crowdfunding by examining how informational cues in campaign narratives guide backers’ attention and funding decisions. Crowdfunding enables global reach but intensifies competition for limited backer attention. Extending the attention-based view from managerial attention in organizational settings to crowd attention on digital platforms, we conceptualize crowd attention as decentralized and stimulus-driven. We identify two key informational cues as attention stimuli: global narrative (universal relevance) and backer-country focus (localized engagement). We argue that these cues increase support for international campaigns but that their effects depend on campaign characteristics such as cultural orientation and market readiness, which align with different backer motives. We further propose that cultural differences amplify, rather than hinder, backers’ responsiveness to attention stimuli. Using large-scale Kickstarter data, we find support for our arguments and demonstrate how digital narratives shape attention and funding decisions in cross-border exchanges.

title_zh: 跨境众筹：基于注意力的视角
abstract_zh: 本研究通过考察众筹叙事中的信息线索如何引导支持者的注意力和资助决策，提出了一个关于跨境众筹的基于注意力的视角。众筹能够实现全球覆盖，但也加剧了对有限支持者注意力的竞争。我们将组织情境中管理者注意力的基于注意力的视角拓展至数字平台上的大众注意力，将大众注意力概念化为去中心化且由刺激驱动的。我们识别出两类作为注意力刺激的关键信息线索：全球叙事（普遍相关性）和支持者所在国聚焦（本地化参与）。我们认为，这些线索会增加对国际众筹活动的支持，但其效果取决于众筹活动的特征，如文化取向和市场准备度，这些特征与不同的支持者动机相一致。我们进一步提出，文化差异会放大而非阻碍支持者对注意力刺激的响应。利用大规模Kickstarter数据，我们找到了支持我们论点的证据，并展示了数字叙事如何在跨境交流中塑造注意力和资助决策。

source_records.title: The uneven path to global value chain upgrading: regulations, private governance, and supplier compliance
source_records.abstract: Global value chains (GVCs) generate efficiency through production fragmentation but simultaneously create sustainability vulnerabilities that can undermine GVC resilience. While MNE buyer-led private ordering and state regulation represent the primary governance responses to these risks, their effects on supplier compliance remain contested. We develop a domain-sensitive governance framework showing that labor and environmental compliance differ systematically in their cost–benefit structures, and which in turn shape the effectiveness of governance forms in driving compliance across sustainability domains. Using a panel of over 2000 suppliers across emerging economies, we find evidence for the asymmetric effectiveness of governance forms across compliance domains. In the labor domain, both regulation and private ordering improve compliance, as stronger labor regulations increase MNE sourcing and reinforce suppliers’ incentives to upgrade. In contrast, in the environmental domain, while private ordering improves compliance, stringent environmental regulation reduces MNE sourcing, weakening suppliers’ incentives to invest in environmental improvements. We identify a buyer–regulation intermediation mechanism through which regulatory stringency shapes supplier compliance indirectly by altering MNE sourcing strategies. Our findings advance GVC governance research by showing that sustainability compliance, and thus resilience, depends not only on governance instruments but also on domain-specific incentive structures and buyer-mediated governance dynamics.

title_zh: 全球价值链升级的不均衡路径：监管、私人治理与供应商合规
abstract_zh: 全球价值链（GVCs）通过生产碎片化产生效率，但同时制造了可能削弱GVC韧性的可持续性脆弱性。尽管由跨国企业买方主导的私人秩序与国家监管构成了应对这些风险的主要治理回应，但其对供应商合规的影响仍存争议。我们构建了一个领域敏感的治理框架，表明劳动与环境合规在成本—收益结构上存在系统性差异，进而塑造了不同治理形式在推动各可持续性领域合规方面的有效性。利用涵盖新兴经济体2000多家供应商的面板数据，我们发现了治理形式在不同合规领域间有效性的不对称性证据。在劳动领域，监管与私人秩序均能改善合规，因为更强的劳动监管增加了跨国企业采购，并强化了供应商升级的激励。相比之下，在环境领域，尽管私人秩序能改善合规，但严格的环境监管减少了跨国企业采购，削弱了供应商投资于环境改善的激励。我们识别出一种买方—监管中介机制，即监管严格性通过改变跨国企业采购策略间接塑造供应商合规。我们的发现推进了GVC治理研究，表明可持续性合规乃至韧性不仅取决于治理工具，还取决于领域特定的激励结构和买方中介的治理动态。

source_records.title: The green frontier: circular economy and firm resilience in multinational enterprises and internationally engaged firms
source_records.abstract: This article examines whether circular economy (CE) strategies enhance firm resilience after systemic shocks. Building on the natural resource-based view, we argue that CE investments made before COVID-19 can strengthen resilience by converting sustainability-oriented capabilities into absorptive and adaptive capabilities. Yet this conversion is not automatic: it depends on firms’ ability to manage three tensions between efficiency and redundancy, continuity and reconfiguration, and strategic flexibility and coordinated commitment. We test these arguments using survey data on Italian firms matched with administrative financial records and estimate ordered probit models of post-shock recovery. The results show that pre-pandemic CE investments are positively associated with firm resilience. This relationship is strongest among multinational enterprises, weaker among other firms engaged in international activities, and not statistically significant among domestic firms. We also find that upstream CE strategies are more strongly associated with resilience than downstream strategies, particularly for multinational enterprises. Overall, the findings suggest that CE contributes to resilience when firms possess the organizational and international capabilities needed to govern, integrate, and reconfigure circular practices under disruption.
