source_records.title: Public institutions, governance capability, and platform internationalization: institutional substitution at home and abroad
source_records.abstract: Digital platforms often expand internationally faster than public institutions can evolve, raising the question of how they sustain operations in weak institutional environments. I theorize governance capability, defined as the firm-level ability to design, implement, and enforce rules regulating participant behavior, as a dual institutional substitute. When home-country institutions are weak, platforms develop governance capability to fill domestic institutional voids (substitution at home), establishing order and trust where public enforcement is limited. Once developed, this capability becomes transferable across borders, enabling platforms to navigate weak host-country institutions during internationalization (substitution abroad). Its effect is conditional: it is stronger when home country institutions are stronger than those of the host country, and for broker platforms whose governance routines can be replicated globally at lower cost. Using a longitudinal sample of 50 digital platforms from China and the United States entering 61 host countries between 1996 and 2023, I find support for these predictions. These results position governance capability as a portable institutional infrastructure, offering a capability-based alternative to structural responses such as diversification in institutionally weak contexts, and highlighting its role as a supply-side driver of platform internationalization that complements demand-side forces such as network effects.

title_zh: 公共制度、治理能力与平台国际化：国内外的制度替代
abstract_zh: 数字平台的国际化扩张往往快于公共制度的演进，这引发了一个问题：它们如何在薄弱的制度环境中维持运营。我将治理能力——定义为企业在设计、实施和执行规范参与者行为的规则方面的能力——理论化为一种双重制度替代。当母国制度薄弱时，平台发展治理能力以填补国内制度空白（国内替代），在公共执法有限的地方建立秩序与信任。一旦形成，这种能力便可跨境转移，使平台在国际化过程中能够应对薄弱的东道国制度（国外替代）。其效应是有条件的：当母国制度强于东道国制度时，以及对于治理惯例能够以较低成本在全球复制的经纪平台而言，这种效应更强。我使用1996年至2023年间进入61个东道国的50个来自中国和美国的数字平台的纵向样本，发现这些预测得到了支持。这些结果将治理能力定位为一种可移植的制度基础设施，为制度薄弱情境下的多元化等结构性应对提供了基于能力的替代方案，并凸显了其作为平台国际化供给侧驱动因素的作用，与网络效应等需求侧力量形成互补。

source_records.title: National identity rhetoric under bilateral geopolitical tensions: evidence from Taiwanese MNEs
source_records.abstract: When geopolitical tensions pit home and host audiences against each other, how do multinational enterprises (MNEs) respond? We examine MNEs’ organizational identity work directed at external audiences under bilateral geopolitical tensions, where efforts to gain acceptance from one side may provoke backlash from the other. Focusing on MNEs’ national identity rhetoric—how firms use language to emphasize or downplay national affiliation—we analyze longitudinal data (2001–2020) from the public communications of two Taiwan-originated MNEs, Foxconn and TSMC, which operate amid the geopolitical dynamics of the Taiwan Strait. Our analysis identifies four rhetorical strategies—augmenting-localizing, augmenting-globalizing, ambiguating, and affirming—through which MNEs manage tensions associated with the expression of national affiliation. We theorize how the deployment of these strategies varies according to two key contingencies: the level of bilateral geopolitical tension and the MNE’s resource dependence on the host economy. We find that rising geopolitical tensions increase pressure on firms to actively calibrate their home identity, while host-country resource dependence shapes the extent to which firms accommodate host audiences. By highlighting rhetoric as a mechanism through which MNEs strategically manage national identity, this research contributes to the literature on MNEs’ responses to increasingly polarized geopolitical environments.

title_zh: 双边地缘政治紧张下的国家认同修辞：来自台湾跨国企业的证据
abstract_zh: 当地缘政治紧张使母国与东道国受众彼此对立时，跨国企业如何回应？我们考察跨国企业在双边地缘政治紧张下针对外部受众的组织认同工作，在此情境中，争取一方接纳的努力可能引发另一方的反弹。我们聚焦于跨国企业的国家认同修辞——即企业如何运用语言来强调或淡化国家归属——分析两家源自台湾的跨国企业富士康与台积电在台湾海峡地缘政治动态中运营的公开传播纵向数据（2001—2020年）。我们的分析识别出四种修辞策略——增强—本地化、增强—全球化、模糊化与确认——跨国企业借此管理与国家归属表达相关的紧张。我们理论化这些策略的运用如何随两个关键权变因素而变化：双边地缘政治紧张程度以及跨国企业对东道国经济的资源依赖。我们发现，不断上升的地缘政治紧张加大了企业主动校准其母国认同的压力，而东道国资源依赖则塑造了企业迁就东道国受众的程度。通过强调修辞作为跨国企业战略性管理国家认同的一种机制，本研究为关于跨国企业应对日益两极化的地缘政治环境的文献作出贡献。

source_records.title: Diversifying for resilience: how supply base international diversification relates to supply base sustainability performance
source_records.abstract: Recent work in international business views supply base international diversification (SBID) as an important strategy for strengthening multinational enterprises’ (MNEs’) resilience to country-level disruptions. However, it remains unclear how this resilience-oriented strategy relates to MNEs’ parallel efforts to improve supply base sustainability performance (SBSP). Drawing on transaction cost economics and the literature on supply chain governance, we argue that increasing SBID lowers MNEs’ costs of switching away from suppliers with poor sustainability performance, while simultaneously raising the costs of monitoring sustainability across heterogeneous supplier-country contexts. Together, these countervailing mechanisms suggest an inverted U-shaped relationship between SBID and SBSP. We further argue that this relationship is moderated by an MNE’s own sustainability performance, its relational embeddedness with its suppliers, and the institutional distance between its home country and supplier countries. Our analyses of 320 U.S. firms listed in the S&P 500 over the period 2010–2019 support our hypotheses. Our findings highlight the tension that MNEs face in simultaneously enhancing the resilience and sustainability performance of their supply base and indicate that SBID should be optimized rather than maximized to balance these dual objectives.

However, it remains unclear how this resilience-oriented strategy relates to MNEs’ parallel efforts to improve supply base sustainability performance (SBSP). Drawing on transaction cost economics and the literature on supply chain governance, we argue that increasing SBID lowers MNEs’ costs of switching away from suppliers with poor sustainability performance, while simultaneously raising the costs of monitoring sustainability across heterogeneous supplier-country contexts. Together, these countervailing mechanisms suggest an inverted U-shaped relationship between SBID and SBSP. We further argue that this relationship is moderated by an MNE’s own sustainability performance, its relational embeddedness with its suppliers, and the institutional distance between its home country and supplier countries. Our analyses of 320 U.S. firms listed in the S&P 500 over the period 2010–2019 support our hypotheses. Our findings highlight the tension that MNEs face in simultaneously enhancing the resilience and sustainability performance of their supply base and indicate that SBID should be optimized rather than maximized to balance these dual objectives.

title_zh: 为韧性而多元化：供应基地国际多元化如何与供应基地可持续性绩效相关
abstract_zh: 国际商务领域近期研究将供应基地国际多元化（SBID）视为增强跨国企业（MNE）抵御国家层面 disruption 韧性的重要战略。然而，这一以韧性为导向的战略如何与跨国企业同时提升供应基地可持续性绩效（SBSP）的努力相关联，仍不明确。借鉴交易成本经济学与供应链治理文献，我们认为，提高SBID会降低跨国企业从可持续性绩效不佳的供应商处转换的成本，同时会提高在异质供应商—国家情境中监测可持续性的成本。这些相互抵消的机制共同表明，SBID与SBSP之间呈倒U形关系。我们进一步认为，这一关系受到跨国企业自身可持续性绩效、其与供应商的关系嵌入性，以及其母国与供应商国家之间制度距离的调节。我们对2010—2019年间320家列入标普500指数的美国企业的分析支持了我们的假设。我们的发现凸显了跨国企业在同时提升其供应基地韧性与可持续性绩效时面临的张力，并表明应优化而非最大化SBID，以平衡这些双重目标。

source_records.title: Governing cross-border innovation: how country-specific director experience enables board-level boundary spanning in MNEs
source_records.abstract: The internationalization of innovation is critical for multinational enterprises (MNEs), yet foreign subsidiaries often struggle to gain headquarters support for their innovations, while knowledge from subsidiary-country contexts remains underused in headquarters’ R&D. This study examines how directors with professional experience in a subsidiary country help boards govern these challenges. Drawing on boundary-spanning theory, we argue that such directors improve headquarters’ evaluation of subsidiary innovations and expand the scope of knowledge that headquarters draws upon. Using 8,264 firm-country-year observations for U.S.-headquartered MNEs from 2000 to 2021, we find that headquarters-based directors with experience in subsidiary countries are positively associated with both subsidiary innovations patented in the home market and headquarters’ use of subsidiary–country knowledge reflected in patent citations. Both relationships are amplified by knowledge distance, the divergence between home and subsidiary-country innovation systems, because directors are most consequential when headquarters’ cognitive frameworks are most misaligned with the subsidiary context. The findings contribute to international business, corporate governance, and innovation research by showing how board composition shapes where innovation is supported and which foreign knowledge enters headquarters-led R&D. Practically, MNEs can improve global innovation governance by matching directors’ international experience to the countries in which their subsidiaries operate.

title_zh: 治理跨境创新：国别特定董事经验如何促成跨国企业董事会层面的边界跨越
abstract_zh: 创新的国际化对跨国企业（MNE）至关重要，然而外国子公司往往难以获得总部对其创新的支持，而来自子公司所在国情境的知识在总部研发中仍未得到充分利用。本研究考察在子公司所在国拥有专业经验的董事如何帮助董事会治理这些挑战。基于边界跨越理论，我们认为此类董事能够改善总部对子公司创新的评估，并扩大总部所汲取知识的范围。利用2000年至2021年间总部位于美国的跨国企业的8,264个企业—国家—年份观测值，我们发现，在子公司所在国拥有经验的总部董事与子公司在本国市场获得专利的创新以及总部对子公司所在国知识的使用（体现于专利引用）均呈正相关。这两种关系均被知识距离——即母国与子公司所在国创新体系之间的差异——所放大，因为当总部的认知框架与子公司情境最为不一致时，董事的作用最为关键。这些发现通过揭示董事会构成如何塑造创新在何处得到支持以及哪些外国知识进入总部主导的研发，为国际商务、公司治理与创新研究作出了贡献。在实践层面，跨国企业可以通过使董事的国际经验与其子公司运营所在的国家相匹配，来改善全球创新治理。

source_records.title: Strategic uses of the past and their liabilities: why government-pushed internationalization may fail
source_records.abstract: Governments push firms to internationalize not only through diplomacy and material incentives but also by shaping the environment in which investors, host governments, and local communities form judgments about cross-border opportunities. We conceptualize this process as government-pushed internationalization and examine how, in the Brazilian case (2003–2015), historical narratives became a central instrument for pursuing such strategies—and ultimately contributed to their failure. Drawing on a longitudinal historical case study of ProSAVANA, a flagship Brazilian agricultural cooperation scheme in Mozambique that eventually collapsed, we show how government-constructed narratives initially built broad support but also generated two strategic risks for enrolled firms: backfiring , as peripheral actors mobilized counter-narratives that transformed presumed advantages into liabilities, and blinding , a previously unidentified mechanism whereby reliance on historical narratives led policymakers to overlook institutional differences, alternative collective memories, and mounting risks. We reveal internationalization as a multi-stakeholder process in which diverse actors may contest official narratives and reframe opportunities as threats, thereby shaping the success or failure of government-pushed internationalization. We advance international business research by showing how governments use rhetorical history to enroll diverse stakeholders while explaining the risks such strategies create and why presumed historical advantages may ultimately become liabilities.

title_zh: 过去的战略运用及其负债：为何政府推动的国际化可能失败
abstract_zh: 政府推动企业国际化，不仅通过外交和物质激励，还通过塑造投资者、东道国政府和当地社区据以形成对跨境机会判断的环境。我们将这一过程概念化为政府推动的国际化，并考察在巴西案例（2003—2015年）中，历史叙事如何成为推行此类战略的核心工具——并最终促成了它们的失败。基于对ProSAVANA的纵向历史案例研究——这是巴西在莫桑比克的一项旗舰农业合作计划，最终以失败告终——我们展示了政府构建的叙事最初如何建立了广泛支持，但也为被纳入的企业带来了两种战略风险：反噬，即边缘行为者动员反叙事，将假定的优势转化为负债；以及致盲，这是一种此前未被识别的机制，即对历史叙事的依赖导致政策制定者忽视制度差异、替代性集体记忆和不断累积的风险。我们揭示国际化是一个多利益相关方过程，其中多元行为者可能争夺官方叙事，并将机会重新界定为威胁，从而塑造政府推动国际化的成功或失败。我们通过展示政府如何运用修辞历史来吸纳多元利益相关方，同时解释此类战略所创造的风险以及为何假定的历史优势最终可能变为负债，从而推进国际商务研究。

source_records.title: Collusion through Common Leadership
source_records.raw_title: Collusion through Common Leadership

source_records.title: Collusion through Common Leadership
source_records.abstract: This paper studies whether common leadership, defined as two firms sharing executives or board directors, contributes to collusion. Using an explicit measure of labor market collusion from unsealed court evidence, we find that the probability of collusion between two firms increases by 11 percentage points after the onset of common leadership, a ninefold increase over the baseline rate. These results are not driven by closeness of product or labor market competition. Our findings are consistent with the increasing attention toward common leadership under Clayton Act Section 8. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

title_zh: 通过共同领导实现的合谋
abstract_zh: 本文研究共同领导——定义为两家公司共享高管或董事会成员——是否有助于合谋。利用来自未密封法庭证据的劳动力市场合谋的明确度量，我们发现，在共同领导开始后，两家公司之间合谋的概率增加了11个百分点，是基准率的九倍。这些结果并非由产品或劳动力市场竞争的接近程度所驱动。我们的发现与《克莱顿法》第8条下对共同领导日益增加的关注相一致。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅者以及发展中国家的居民可以在www.nber.org免费下载本文。

source_records.title: Not Learning from Others
source_records.raw_title: Not Learning from Others

source_records.title: Not Learning from Others
source_records.abstract: We study social learning using experiments where two people independently learn relevant information and can share it to make accurate private decisions. Across three experiments, people are substantially less sensitive to information others discover than to equally-relevant information they discovered themselves. This holds when they must learn information from others through discussion; when the experimenter perfectly communicates the information; and even when participants observe others’ information with their own eyes. Our results therefore stem not from a failure to elicit information from others but a systematic tendency to underweight it relative to one’s own information. Our findings illustrate a powerful barrier to social learning that might underlie many documented cases of failure to learn from others.

title_zh: 不从他人处学习
abstract_zh: 我们通过实验研究社会学习，实验中两个人各自独立地学习相关信息，并可以分享这些信息以做出准确的私人决策。在三项实验中，人们对于他人发现的信息的敏感程度，显著低于对自己发现的同等相关信息。这一点在以下情形中均成立：当他们必须通过讨论从他人处学习信息时；当实验者完美地传达信息时；甚至当参与者亲眼观察他人的信息时。因此，我们的结果并非源于未能从他人处获取信息，而是源于一种系统性的倾向，即相对于自己的信息，低估他人的信息。我们的发现揭示了一种对社会学习的强大障碍，它可能是许多有记录的未能从他人处学习案例的根源。

source_records.title: The Transmission of Reliable and Unreliable Information
source_records.abstract: Information often spreads and influences beliefs regardless of its reliability. We show that this occurs in part because indicators of reliability tend to be lost in the process of word-of-mouth transmission. We conduct controlled experiments where participants listen to economic forecasts and pass them on through voice messages. Other participants listen either to original or transmitted audio recordings and report incentivized beliefs. Across various transmitter incentive schemes, a claim’s reliability is lost in transmission much more than the claim itself. Reliable and unreliable information, once filtered through transmission, affect listeners’ beliefs similarly. Mechanism experiments show that reliability is lost not because it is perceived as less relevant or harder to transmit but because it is less likely to come to mind during transmission. Evidence from our experiments, a large corpus of everyday conversations, and economic TV news shows that contextual cues can bring reliability to mind and induce its transmission, but situations in which people share information seldom contain such cues.

title_zh: 可靠与不可靠信息的传播
abstract_zh: 信息往往无论其可靠性如何都会传播并影响信念。我们表明，这部分是因为可靠性的指标在口口相传的过程中往往会丢失。我们进行了受控实验，参与者收听经济预测并通过语音信息将其传递下去。其他参与者收听原始或经过传递的音频录音，并报告有激励的信念。在各种传递者激励方案下，一项说法的可靠性在传递中丢失的程度远大于该说法本身。可靠和不可靠的信息一旦经过传递过滤，对听众信念的影响相似。机制实验表明，可靠性丢失并不是因为它被认为不太相关或更难传递，而是因为它在传递过程中不太容易被想到。来自我们实验、一个大型日常对话语料库以及经济电视新闻节目的证据表明，情境线索可以使可靠性被想到并促使其被传递，但人们分享信息的情境很少包含此类线索。

source_records.title: Wealth and Property Taxation in the United States
source_records.abstract: We study the history and geography of wealth accumulation in the United States using newly collected historical property tax records from the early 1800s onward. These records come from the administration of the General Property Tax–a tax that aspired to cover all types of property. We construct wealth series at the state, county, and national levels. At the state level, we use annual assessed values of wealth from state-level reports drawn from multiple sources. Because assessed values may differ from market values, we also require assessment ratios, defined as the ratio of assessed to market wealth. We obtain state-level assessment ratios from decadal U.S. Census wealth data (drawn from various Census reports, including those on “Wealth, Debt, and Taxation”), in which the Census carried out detailed valuation work, complemented with information on changes in assessment practices from the state reports, to build higher-frequency series of assessment ratios. The result is long-run annual wealth series for states from 1850 (or earlier, depending on the state) to 1935. We obtain national wealth series by aggregating these state series. At the county level, we use assessed values (or market values where available) from the U.S. Census wealth data for each decade, and apply either state-level or county-level assessment ratios, where available, to obtain market values of wealth for each decade from 1850 to 1930. We use these data to show, first, that the United States experienced extraordinary wealth accumulation after the Civil War and until the Great Depression. Second, spatial inequality in the United States has been large and highly persistent since the mid-1800s. We also examine the determinants of long-term wealth growth and find, among other results, that counties with a higher share of enslaved property before the Civil War or with higher wealth inequality experienced lower subsequent long-run wealth growth.

source_records.title: Mental Models of the Stock Market
source_records.abstract: Investors’ return expectations are pivotal in stock markets, but the reasoning behind these expectations is not well understood. This article explores economic agents’ mental models of what drives returns. We survey the general population, retail investors, financial professionals, and academic experts to investigate how they forecast and explain future returns in scenarios with stale news about future company earnings. We find that investors strongly disagree in their forecasts and reasoning. Most academic experts view markets as efficient. By contrast, most households express a perspective we call “expected earnings reasoning”: they directly equate higher expected earnings with higher expected returns. Professionals are split between market efficiency, mispricing, and expected earnings reasoning. In detailed experiments, we dissect why households adopt expected earnings reasoning. We show that it arises from inattention to how stock price changes affect investor costs—that is, how much investors must pay to acquire a claim to future cash flows—because the typical format and context of investment problems obscure these cost implications. Our results help connect a series of previously documented anomalies in expectation and trading data and highlight the importance of selective attention and context in shaping reasoning and belief formation.

abstract_zh: 投资者的回报预期在股票市场中至关重要，但这些预期背后的推理过程尚未得到充分理解。本文探讨了经济主体关于回报驱动因素的心理模型。我们调查了普通人群、散户投资者、金融专业人士和学术专家，以研究他们在存在关于未来公司盈利的过时新闻的情景下如何预测和解释未来回报。我们发现，投资者在预测和推理上存在强烈分歧。大多数学术专家将市场视为有效的。相比之下，大多数家庭表达了一种我们称之为“预期盈利推理”的观点：他们直接将更高的预期盈利等同于更高的预期回报。专业人士则在市场效率、错误定价和预期盈利推理之间分化。在详细的实验中，我们剖析了家庭为何采用预期盈利推理。我们表明，这源于对股价变化如何影响投资者成本的忽视——即投资者必须支付多少才能获得对未来现金流的索取权——因为投资问题的典型格式和背景掩盖了这些成本含义。我们的结果有助于将一系列先前记录的预期和交易数据中的异象联系起来，并突显了选择性注意和背景在塑造推理和信念形成中的重要性。

source_records.title: Clause and Effect: Theory and Field Experimental Evidence on Noncompete Clauses
source_records.abstract: We study worker noncompete clauses in a large field experiment with two finance firms. Across ~14,000 job offers to freelance recruiters on short-term contracts, we randomize wages and the presence, salience, and duration of noncompetes (all contracts also included a nondisclosure agreement). Removing a noncompete increases mobility between competing employers by 36–52% and raises workers’ total earnings from the two firms by 12–17%. We find no evidence—rejecting even small effects—that removing noncompetes generates secret leakage. We also find no evidence that workers choose noncompete jobs for higher pay. Many workers appear unaware of noncompetes before firms’ post-employment communication. The results align with a model of inattention and uncertainty about enforcement.

title_zh: 条款与效应：关于竞业限制条款的理论与实地实验证据
abstract_zh: 我们在两家金融公司开展的一项大型实地实验中研究了劳动者竞业限制条款。在向短期合同的自由职业招聘人员发出的约14,000份工作邀约中，我们随机化了工资以及竞业限制的存在、显著性和期限（所有合同还包含一份保密协议）。取消竞业限制使竞争性雇主之间的流动性提高36–52%，并使劳动者从两家公司获得的总收入提高12–17%。我们没有发现任何证据——甚至排除了微小效应——表明取消竞业限制会导致秘密泄露。我们也没有发现证据表明劳动者会为更高的薪酬而选择带有竞业限制的工作。许多劳动者似乎在公司进行离职后沟通之前并未意识到竞业限制的存在。这些结果与一个关于注意力不集中和对可执行性不确定的模型相一致。

source_records.title: Capital Services in Global Value Chains
source_records.abstract: This article constructs the first global data set on intersectoral capital service expenditures. I use these data to disaggregate capital services and intermediate inputs in a dynamic multisector trade model. Steady-state allocations and responses to shocks are determined by a capital-augmented global input-output matrix. Two properties of the measured network deliver larger long-run consumption gains from globalization than existing estimates, as well as larger gains in more capital-intensive countries. First, more trade-exposed sectors supply capital to more consumption-influential producers. Second, heterogeneity in the network reallocates sectoral expenditures toward producers with larger declines in capital rental prices. These reallocations raise capital incomes and lower consumption price indices.

title_zh: 全球价值链中的资本服务
abstract_zh: 本文构建了首个关于部门间资本服务支出的全球数据集。我利用这些数据在一个动态多部门贸易模型中对资本服务和中间投入进行分解。稳态配置以及对冲击的响应由一个资本增强型全球投入产出矩阵决定。所测度网络的两种性质带来了比现有估计更大的全球化长期消费收益，并且在资本更密集的国家带来更大的收益。第一，更多暴露于贸易的部门向对消费影响更大的生产商供应资本。第二，网络中的异质性将部门支出重新配置到资本租赁价格下降幅度更大的生产商。这些重新配置提高了资本收入并降低了消费价格指数。

source_records.title: The Employment Effects of a Guaranteed Income: Experimental Evidence from Two U.S. States
source_records.abstract: We study the causal impacts of income on a rich array of employment outcomes, leveraging an experiment in which 1,000 low-income individuals were randomized into receiving $1,000 per month unconditionally for three years, with a control group of 2,000 participants receiving $50/month. We gather detailed survey data, administrative records, and data from a mobile phone app. The transfer caused total individual income excluding the transfers to fall by about $1,900/year relative to the control group and a 4.2 percentage point decrease in labor market participation. Participants reduced their work hours as a result of the transfers by 1-2 hours/week and participants’ partners reduced their work hours by a comparable amount. Among other categories of time use, the greatest increase generated by the transfer was in time spent on leisure. Despite asking detailed questions about amenities, we find no impact on quality of employment, and our confidence intervals can rule out even small improvements. Treated participants broadly increase expenditures, led by spending on non-durable goods and services, with smaller increases in spending on durable goods and human capital. We observe no significant effects on degree attainment, though the magnitudes of the estimated effects generally appear larger among younger participants. Measures of subjective well-being are higher among treated participants in the first year of the transfers but then revert to control group levels. Overall, our results suggest a moderate labor supply effect that does not appear offset by other productive activities.

title_zh: 保障性收入的就业效应：来自美国两个州的实验证据
abstract_zh: 我们利用一项实验研究收入对一系列丰富就业结果的因果影响，该实验将1,000名低收入个体随机分配为无条件每月领取1,000美元、持续三年，对照组为2,000名参与者每月领取50美元。我们收集了详细的调查数据、行政记录以及来自手机应用程序的数据。与对照组相比，该转移支付导致个人总收入（不包括转移支付）每年减少约1,900美元，并使劳动力市场参与率下降4.2个百分点。参与者因转移支付而减少了工作时间，每周减少1至2小时，参与者的伴侣也减少了相当数量的工作时间。在其他时间使用类别中，转移支付带来的最大增加是休闲时间的增加。尽管我们询问了关于工作便利设施的详细问题，但我们未发现对就业质量的影响，且我们的置信区间可以排除即使是小幅改善的可能性。受处理参与者总体上增加了支出，其中以非耐用品和服务支出为主，耐用品和人力资本支出的增加较小。我们未观察到对学位获得有显著影响，尽管估计效应的幅度在较年轻参与者中通常显得更大。在转移支付的第一年，受处理参与者的主观幸福感指标更高，但随后回落至对照组水平。总体而言，我们的结果表明存在适度的劳动供给效应，且这一效应似乎并未被其他生产性活动所抵消。

source_records.title: Fairness Across the World
source_records.abstract: This paper provides the first comprehensive global evidence on people’s fairness and efficiency preferences, beliefs about the sources of inequality and the efficiency cost of redistribution, and policy attitudes toward redistribution. Using a globally harmonized consequential experiment with more than 65,000 individuals across 60 countries, we show that the source of inequality plays a substantially larger role for inequality acceptance than the efficiency cost of redistribution. At the global level, implemented inequality increases by 85 percent when inequality is caused by merit rather than luck, compared to a 14 percent increase when redistribution entails a 50 percent efficiency cost. We document substantial heterogeneity in fairness views and beliefs both within and across societies. The meritocratic fairness view is most prominent in many richer Western societies, while libertarian and egalitarian fairness views are widespread in many other parts of the world. Globally, people are more likely to believe that inequality reflects luck rather than merit, while beliefs in large efficiency costs of redistribution are relatively weak. Fairness preferences and beliefs are strongly associated with redistribution attitudes and actual redistribution through taxes and transfers across countries. Our findings illustrate how the interaction between fairness views and beliefs may shape redistribution across societies, highlighting the importance of jointly understanding preferences and beliefs in the political economy of redistribution.

title_zh: 世界各地的公平观
abstract_zh: 本文首次提供了关于人们的公平与效率偏好、对不平等来源和再分配效率成本的信念，以及对再分配的政策态度的全面全球证据。我们使用一项在全球范围内协调实施的有后果实验，涵盖60个国家的65,000多人，表明不平等的来源对不平等接受度的影响远大于再分配的效率成本。在全球层面，当不平等由功绩而非运气造成时，实际实施的不平等增加85%，相比之下，当再分配带来50%的效率成本时，不平等仅增加14%。我们记录了各社会内部和之间在公平观和信念上的巨大异质性。精英式公平观在许多较富裕的西方社会最为突出，而自由至上主义和平均主义公平观在世界许多其他地区广泛存在。在全球范围内，人们更倾向于认为不平等反映的是运气而非功绩，而认为再分配会带来巨大效率成本的信念相对较弱。公平偏好和信念与各国的再分配态度以及通过税收和转移支付实现的实际再分配密切相关。我们的发现说明了公平观与信念之间的相互作用如何可能塑造各社会的再分配，凸显了在再分配政治经济学中共同理解偏好与信念的重要性。

source_records.title: College, Cognitive Ability, and Socioeconomic Disadvantage: Policy Lessons from the U.K. in 1960–2004
source_records.abstract: University access has significantly expanded in OECD countries, and further growth figures prominently in political agendas. We study possible consequences of historical and future expansions in a stochastic, general equilibrium Roy model where tertiary educational attainment is determined by cognitive ability and socioeconomic disadvantage. In our analysis, individual productivity depends not only on education but also directly on cognitive ability. The expansion of university access in the U.K. that started in the 1960s provides an ideal case study to draw lessons for the future. We find that this expansion led to the selection into college of progressively less talented students from advantaged backgrounds. Appropriate counterfactual policies existed that would have achieved the dual goal of increasing college graduates’ cognitive ability while improving tertiary education opportunities for the disadvantaged.

source_records.title: When is Separate Sales Optimal?
source_records.abstract: This paper studies a multi-product monopolist facing a privately informed consumer with additive and type-increasing valuations. Separate monopoly pricing is robustly optimal with respect to the type distribution if and only if the marginal rate of substitution between each pair of goods is monotone. This result is obtained by extending the conventional Myersonian approach.

source_records.title: Smooth Diagnostic Expectations
source_records.abstract: We show that the formalization of representativeness (Kahneman and Tversky, 1972, Cognitive Psychology, 3, 430–454) developed by Gennaioli and Shleifer (2010, The Quarterly Journal of Economics, 125, 1399–1433) features an intrinsic connection between uncertainty and overreaction. In the time series domain, we develop this connection in a smooth version of diagnostic expectations (DE), where overreaction varies smoothly with uncertainty. Intuitively, under smoothness, lower uncertainty leaves less room for representativeness to distort beliefs. Smooth DE provides a joint, parsimonious micro-foundation for key features of survey data: overreaction to news, stronger overreaction at longer horizons, overconfidence in subjective uncertainty, and a new stylized fact documented here—overreaction intensifies with higher uncertainty. An analytical Real Business Cycle model with Smooth DE accounts for survey overreaction and overconfidence, as well as three salient business cycle properties: asymmetry, countercyclical macro volatility, and countercyclical micro volatility.

source_records.title: Industrial Clusters in the Long Run: Evidence from Million-Rouble Plants in China
source_records.abstract: We study the impact of large, successful manufacturing plants on other local producers in China, focusing on “Million-Rouble Plants” built in the 1950s during a brief alliance with the U.S.S.R. The ephemeral geopolitical situation and the locations of allied and enemy airbases provide exogenous variation in plant siting. We find a boom-and-bust pattern: Counties hosting these plants were 80% more productive than control counties in 1982 but 20% less productive by 2010. This decline reflects the performance of local establishments, which exhibit low productivity, limited innovation, and high markup. Specialization hindered spillovers, preventing the emergence of new clusters and local entrepreneurship.

source_records.title: The Long Shadow of Housing Discrimination: Evidence from Racial Covenants
source_records.abstract: Racial covenants in housing deeds were widely used in the United States during the early 20th century to segregate neighbourhoods. In 1948, the Supreme Court decision in Shelley v. Kraemer made racial covenants unenforceable in court, stopping short of prohibiting them entirely. We surmise that even after losing their judicial enforceability, such covenants could have shaped segregation if they served as a focal point for coordination on an initial equilibrium in neighbourhood formation, a context characterised by investment durability and path dependency. To test this hypothesis, we assemble novel parcel-level data on racial covenants and develop a quasi-experimental design that exploits delays between covenant execution and housing construction to isolate exposure to enforceable covenants at the time neighbourhoods were built. Covenant enforceability indeed affected early-stage neighbourhood formation in terms of housing characteristics, public infrastructure placement, and the composition of initial residents. These early differences proved durable: A one standard deviation increase in neighborhood exposure to enforceable covenants accounts for 6%–24% of the observed neighbourhood racial segregation from 1980 to 2020 and 3.1%–4.4% of housing price differentials in the 21st century. We conclude that by coordinating beliefs and decisions during neighbourhood formation, the law generated spatial inequality that has long outlived racial covenants themselves.

title_zh: 住房歧视的长期阴影：来自种族契约的证据
abstract_zh: 20世纪初，美国在住房契约中广泛使用种族契约来隔离社区。1948年，最高法院在Shelley诉Kraemer案中裁定种族契约在法庭上不可执行，但并未完全禁止它们。我们推测，即使失去司法可执行性，如果这些契约在社区形成过程中充当了协调初始均衡的焦点，那么在投资持久性和路径依赖的背景下，它们仍可能塑造隔离。为检验这一假设，我们收集了新的地块级种族契约数据，并设计了一种准实验方法，利用契约执行与住房建设之间的时间差，来分离社区建成时受可执行契约影响的程度。契约可执行性确实在住房特征、公共基础设施布局和初始居民构成方面影响了早期社区形成。这些早期差异被证明是持久的：社区受可执行契约影响程度每增加一个标准差，就解释了1980年至2020年观察到的社区种族隔离的6%–24%，以及21世纪房价差异的3.1%–4.4%。我们得出结论：通过在社区形成过程中协调信念和决策，法律产生了空间不平等，其影响远远超过了种族契约本身。

source_records.title: An Evaluation of Protected Area Policies in the European Union
source_records.abstract: The European Union (EU) designates 26% of its landmass as protected areas, limiting economic development for biodiversity. We use the staggered introduction of protected areas between 1985 and 2019 to study the selection of protected land and the causal effect of protection on vegetation cover and nightlights. We find no meaningful impacts on either outcome across four decades, countries, protection cohorts, or land characteristics. These null effects are consistent with the political economy of EU land protection: weak incentives to internalize biodiversity gains, green-glow motives, and area-based targets shape local siting and stringency choices. In practice, strict protection is applied where development pressure is low–so that protection has little bite—while in high-pressure regions, protection is typically weak, imposing only limited constraints on economic activity.

title_zh: 欧盟保护区政策评估
abstract_zh: 欧盟（EU）将其26%的陆地面积指定为保护区，以限制经济发展来保护生物多样性。我们利用1985年至2019年间保护区的交错引入，研究受保护土地的选择以及保护对植被覆盖和夜间灯光的因果效应。我们发现，在四十年、多个国家、保护批次或土地特征中，对这两种结果均无实质性影响。这些零效应与欧盟土地保护的政治经济学相一致：内部化生物多样性收益的激励薄弱、绿色光环动机以及基于面积的目标塑造了地方选址和严格程度的选择。在实践中，严格保护被应用于开发压力较低的地区——因此保护几乎没有实际约束力——而在高压力地区，保护通常较弱，仅对经济活动施加有限限制。

source_records.title: Macro Shocks and Firm Dynamics with Oligopolistic Financial Intermediaries
source_records.abstract: Motivated by a secular increase in the concentration of the U.S. banking industry, I develop a new macroeconomic model with oligopolistic financial intermediaries and heterogeneous firms. Market power allows banks to price discriminate and charge firm-specific markups, exerting greater market power over productive and more financially constrained firms. This dampens capital accumulation and amplifies the effects of macroeconomic shocks. During a crisis, banks exploit the higher share of financially constrained firms to extract higher markups, inducing a larger decline in real activity. When a large bank fails, the remaining banks use their increased market power to restrict credit supply, worsening and prolonging the downturn.

title_zh: 宏观冲击与寡头金融中介下的企业动态
abstract_zh: 受美国银行业集中度长期上升的启发，我构建了一个包含寡头金融中介和异质性企业的新宏观经济模型。市场势力使银行能够进行价格歧视并收取企业特定加成，对生产率更高且融资约束更强的企业施加更大的市场势力。这抑制了资本积累并放大了宏观经济冲击的影响。在危机期间，银行利用融资约束企业占比上升来提取更高的加成，导致实际活动出现更大幅度的下降。当一家大型银行倒闭时，其余银行利用其增强的市场势力限制信贷供给，使衰退恶化并延长。

source_records.title: Labor Supply and the Pension Contribution-Benefit Link
source_records.abstract: We estimate the impact of public pension incentives on labor supply far from the normal retirement age by exploiting Poland's switch from a Defined Benefit to a Notional Defined Contribution (NDC) scheme. This reform created a sharp cohort-based discontinuity in the link between current pension contributions and future benefits. Using this discontinuity and the universe of taxpayers, we estimate an employment elasticity with respect to the net return to work of 0.51 for men at ages 51-54. We estimate a lifecycle model to match these responses and discuss the broader implications of the reform. The shift to NDC reallocates work incentives over the lifecycle, strengthening incentives at younger ages, when labor supply is relatively inelastic, and weakening them at older ages, when labor supply is more elastic. This reallocation of work incentives tends to reduce aggregate lifecycle labor supply, which highlights the advantage of targeting pension incentives towards ages at which labor supply is most responsive.

title_zh: 劳动力供给与养老金缴费-待遇关联
abstract_zh: 我们利用波兰从待遇确定型（DB）向名义确定缴费型（NDC）计划的转变，估计了公共养老金激励在远离正常退休年龄时对劳动力供给的影响。这项改革在当期养老金缴费与未来待遇之间的关联上造成了基于出生队列的明显断点。利用这一断点以及全体纳税人数据，我们估计出51-54岁男性相对于工作净回报的就业弹性为0.51。我们估计了一个生命周期模型以匹配这些反应，并讨论了该改革更广泛的含义。向NDC的转变在整个生命周期内重新分配了工作激励，在劳动力供给相对缺乏弹性的较年轻年龄加强了激励，而在劳动力供给更有弹性的较年长年龄削弱了激励。这种工作激励的重新分配倾向于减少加总生命周期劳动力供给，这凸显了将养老金激励瞄准劳动力供给反应最敏感的年龄段的优势。

source_records.title: Informative Certification: Screening versus Acquisition
source_records.abstract: We study monopolistic certification in markets where sellers possess partial private information about product quality. A certifier can provide information through two channels: screening sellers’ private information (soft information) and acquiring new quality data (hard information). We prove that any certification menu achieving less than maximal screening is Pareto dominated by one with full screening. Among Pareto-efficient menus, the certifier’s profit-maximizing menu provides maximal soft information while restricting hard information provision. The two channels diverge because screening creates value the certifier can fully capture, whereas hard information amplifies costly information rents. Using power value functions, we derive comparative statics showing that information restrictions target low-quality sellers when information value is moderate, but high-quality sellers receive perfect quality revelation when information value is high.

title_zh: 信息性认证：筛选与获取
abstract_zh: 我们研究卖方对产品质量拥有部分私人信息的市场中的垄断性认证。认证机构可以通过两种渠道提供信息：筛选卖方的私人信息（软信息）和获取新的质量数据（硬信息）。我们证明，任何未达到最大筛选程度的认证菜单都被完全筛选的认证菜单帕累托支配。在帕累托有效菜单中，认证机构的利润最大化菜单提供最大程度的软信息，同时限制硬信息的提供。这两种渠道之所以分化，是因为筛选创造的价值可被认证机构完全获取，而硬信息会放大代价高昂的信息租金。利用幂值函数，我们推导出比较静态结果，表明当信息价值适中时，信息限制针对低质量卖方，但当信息价值较高时，高质量卖方会获得完全的质量揭示。

source_records.title: Optimal Age-Based Policies for Pandemics: An Economic Analysis of COVID-19 and Beyond
source_records.abstract: This paper investigates the importance of the age composition for pandemic policy design. To do so, it introduces an economic framework with age heterogeneity, individual choice, and incomplete information, emphasising the value of testing. Calibrating the model to the U.S. COVID-19 pandemic reveals an 80% reduction in the death toll due to voluntary actions and the lockdown implemented in the US. The optimal lockdown, however, is more stringent than what was implemented. Moreover, the social planner follows an asymmetric approach by locking down the young relatively more than the old. We highlight the role of testing in reducing deaths, lowering economic costs, and allowing for a less restrictive lockdown. A social planner would choose a faster ramp-up in testing capacity relative to what occurred in the US. We use the framework to provide insights into pandemics caused by different viruses (including the Spanish flu) and underline the influence of economic conditions on optimal policies.

title_zh: 大流行病的最优年龄政策：对COVID-19及以后的经济学分析
abstract_zh: 本文研究年龄构成在大流行病政策设计中的重要性。为此，本文引入了一个包含年龄异质性、个体选择和不完全信息的经济学框架，并强调检测的价值。将模型校准至美国COVID-19大流行后发现，自愿行为和美国实施的封锁使死亡人数减少了80%。然而，最优封锁比实际实施的封锁更为严格。此外，社会规划者采取了一种非对称方法，对年轻人实施的封锁相对多于老年人。我们强调了检测在减少死亡、降低经济成本和允许实施限制性较小的封锁方面的作用。相对于美国实际发生的情况，社会规划者会选择更快地提升检测能力。我们使用该框架为不同病毒（包括西班牙流感）引起的大流行病提供洞见，并强调经济条件对最优政策的影响。

source_records.title: Foreign Exchange Intervention with UIP and CIP Deviations
source_records.abstract: We examine the welfare-based opportunity cost of foreign exchange (FX) intervention when both covered interest rate parity (CIP) and uncovered interest rate parity (UIP) deviations are present. We consider a small open economy that receives international capital flows through constrained international financial intermediaries. Deviations from CIP come from limited arbitrage or through a convenience yield, while UIP deviations are also affected by global risk. We show that the sign of CIP and UIP deviations may differ for safe haven countries. We find that FX reserves may provide a net benefit, rather than a cost, when international intermediaries value the safe-haven properties of a currency more than domestic households. We show that this has been the case for the Swiss franc and the Japanese Yen. We examine the optimal policy of a constrained central bank planner in this context.

title_zh: 在UIP与CIP偏离下的外汇干预
abstract_zh: 我们考察了当抛补利率平价（CIP）与无抛补利率平价（UIP）偏离同时存在时，基于福利的外汇（FX）干预机会成本。我们考虑一个通过受约束的国际金融中介获得国际资本流动的小型开放经济。CIP偏离来自有限套利或便利收益，而UIP偏离还受到全球风险的影响。我们表明，对于避险国家，CIP与UIP偏离的符号可能不同。我们发现，当国际中介比国内家庭更看重某种货币的避险属性时，外汇储备可能提供净收益，而非成本。我们表明，瑞士法郎和日元的情况一直如此。我们考察了在此背景下受约束的中央银行规划者的最优政策。

source_records.title: How You Pay Drives What You Choose: Mental Accounting in Health Insurance Plan Choice
source_records.abstract: We document that the source of funds for paying health insurance premiums has a dramatic impact on plan choices. We focus on the MediSave programme in Singapore, a medical savings account that is used to pay out-of-pocket medical spending. Residents can also pay their health insurance premiums with cash or MediSave funds, but are subject to limits that vary by age and over time. By exploiting variations in those limits, we consistently find that when individuals are able to pay their health insurance premiums with MediSave funds, they are less price sensitive and more willing to enrol in more generous plans. We develop and estimate a mental accounting model which explains these patterns. We embed and reject alternative explanations such as hassle costs and liquidity constraints. We then extend this model and show that mental accounting can explain much, but not all, of the misweighting of premiums relative to out-of-pocket expenses in health insurance choice. We also find that allowing MediSave payment for both premiums and out-of-pocket expenses (e.g. putting them in the same mental account) enhances individual welfare and reduces adverse selection.

title_zh: 支付方式如何驱动选择：健康保险计划选择中的心理账户
abstract_zh: 我们记录到，支付健康保险保费的资金来源对计划选择具有显著影响。我们聚焦于新加坡的MediSave计划，这是一个用于支付自付医疗支出的医疗储蓄账户。居民也可以用现金或MediSave资金支付健康保险保费，但受到随年龄和时间变化的限额约束。通过利用这些限额的变动，我们一致地发现，当个人能够用MediSave资金支付健康保险保费时，他们对价格不那么敏感，并且更愿意加入更慷慨的计划。我们开发并估计了一个心理账户模型来解释这些模式。我们纳入并否定了诸如麻烦成本和流动性约束等替代解释。随后我们扩展该模型，并表明心理账户可以解释健康保险选择中保费相对于自付费用被错误加权的大部分现象，但并非全部。我们还发现，允许MediSave同时支付保费和自付费用（例如将它们放入同一心理账户）会提升个人福利并减少逆向选择。

source_records.title: Marriage, Assortative Mating, and Wealth Inequality
source_records.abstract: We use population data on capital income and wealth holdings for Norway to measure asset positions and wealth returns before individuals marry and after the household is formed. These data allow us to establish a number of novel facts. First, individuals sort on personal wealth rather than parental wealth. Second, people match also on their personal returns to wealth, and assortative mating on returns is as strong as that on wealth. Third, post-marriage returns on family wealth reflect in equal part the pre-marriage returns of the two spouses. However, for households at the top of the wealth distribution at marriage, family wealth is largely managed by the spouse with the highest potential to grow it, providing a microfoundation for the scale dependence in wealth returns documented in several empirical papers. Fourth, marriage lowers the degree of wealth inequality as well as the heterogeneity in returns relative to the counterfactual case of no marriages. We use a simple framework to illustrate how the inequality-attenuating role of marriage is affected by assortative mating on wealth and returns and by wealth management task allocation between spouses.

title_zh: 婚姻、选型婚配与财富不平等
abstract_zh: 我们使用挪威的资本收入和财富持有的人口数据，来衡量个人在结婚前以及家庭形成后的资产头寸和财富回报。这些数据使我们能够确立若干新的事实。第一，个人依据自身财富而非父母财富进行择偶。第二，人们在个人财富回报上也进行匹配，且基于回报的选型婚配强度与基于财富的选型婚配一样强。第三，婚后家庭财富的回报同等程度地反映了两位配偶婚前的回报。然而，对于结婚时处于财富分布顶端的家庭，家庭财富主要由最有潜力使其增长的那位配偶管理，这为多篇实证论文所记录的财富回报中的规模依赖性提供了微观基础。第四，与无婚姻的反事实情形相比，婚姻降低了财富不平等程度以及回报的异质性。我们使用一个简单框架来说明婚姻的不平等削弱作用如何受到基于财富和回报的选型婚配以及配偶之间财富管理任务分配的影响。

source_records.title: Capital Unemployment
source_records.abstract: This paper studies the unemployment of physical capital—defined as idle units searching to be traded—and its macroeconomic implications. I provide evidence documenting that capital unemployment is large, volatile, and increases during economic downturns. I construct a capital-accumulation model that explains these patterns, with trading frictions in capital markets, which give rise to equilibrium capital unemployment, and financial shocks, which lead to large fluctuations in trading probabilities and capital unemployment. Using the model, I show that trading frictions and capital unemployment matter for aggregate dynamics. First, unemployed capital affects aggregate investment dynamics: Downturns characterized by large increases in unemployed capital are followed by investment slumps, because the economy tends to recover by absorbing existing unemployed capital rather than by producing new capital goods. Second, capital unemployment constitutes a propagation mechanism from financial shocks to economic activity, which shows up at the aggregate level as measured total factor productivity.

title_zh: 资本失业
abstract_zh: 本文研究实物资本的失业——定义为闲置的、正在寻找交易机会的资本单位——及其宏观经济含义。我提供证据表明，资本失业规模大、波动剧烈，并在经济低迷期间上升。我构建了一个资本积累模型来解释这些模式，该模型包含资本市场中的交易摩擦，这些摩擦导致均衡资本失业，以及金融冲击，这些冲击导致交易概率和资本失业的大幅波动。利用该模型，我表明交易摩擦和资本失业对总体动态具有重要影响。第一，失业资本影响总体投资动态：以失业资本大幅增加为特征的低迷期之后会出现投资骤降，因为经济往往通过吸收现有的失业资本而非生产新的资本品来复苏。第二，资本失业构成了从金融冲击到经济活动的传导机制，这在总体层面上表现为测得的全要素生产率。

source_records.title: An Optimal Test for Strategic Interaction in Network Formation Games
source_records.abstract: Consider a setting where N players, partitioned into K observable types, form a directed network. Agents’ preferences over the form of the network consist of an arbitrary network benefit function (e.g. agents may have preferences over their network centrality) and a private, or dyadic, component which is additively separable in own links. This latter component allows for unobserved heterogeneity in the costs of sending and receiving links across agents (respectively out- and in- degree heterogeneity) as well as homophily/heterophily across the K types of agents. In contrast, the network benefit function allows agents’ preferences over links to vary with the presence or absence of links elsewhere in the network (and hence with the link formation behavior of their peers). In the null model, which excludes the network benefit function, links form independently across dyads in the manner described by Charbonneau, 2017, Econometrics Journal, 20, S1–S13 among others. Under the alternative, there is interdependence across linking decisions (i.e. strategic interaction). We show how to test the null with power optimized in specific directions. These alternative directions include many common models of strategic network formation (e.g. “connections” models, “structural hole” models etc.). Our random utility specification induces an exponential family structure under the null which we exploit to construct a similar test which exactly controls size (despite the the null being a composite one with many nuisance parameters). We further show how to construct locally best tests for specific alternatives without making any assumptions about equilibrium selection. To make our tests feasible, we introduce a new MCMC algorithm for simulating the null distributions of our test statistics.

title_zh: 网络形成博弈中策略互动的最优检验
abstract_zh: 考虑一个由N个参与者组成、划分为K个可观测类型并形成有向网络的情形。参与者对网络形式的偏好由一个任意的网络收益函数（例如，参与者可能对其网络中心性有偏好）以及一个私人成分或二元成分构成，后者在自身链接上可加可分。后一成分允许发送和接收链接成本在参与者之间存在不可观测异质性（分别为出度和入度异质性），以及K种参与者类型之间的同质性/异质性。相比之下，网络收益函数允许参与者对链接的偏好随网络中其他位置链接的存在或缺失而变化（从而随其同伴的链接形成行为而变化）。在排除了网络收益函数的原假设模型中，链接按照Charbonneau, 2017, Econometrics Journal, 20, S1–S13等人所描述的方式在各二元组之间独立形成。在备择假设下，链接决策之间存在相互依赖（即策略互动）。我们展示了如何在特定方向上以最优功效检验原假设。这些备择方向包括许多常见的策略性网络形成模型（例如“连接”模型、“结构洞”模型等）。我们的随机效用设定在原假设下诱导出指数族结构，我们利用该结构构造一个类似的检验，该检验能够精确控制规模（尽管原假设是一个带有许多冗余参数的复合假设）。我们进一步展示了如何在不 equilibrium selection 作任何假设的情况下，为特定备择构造局部最优检验。为使我们的检验可行，我们引入了一种新的MCMC算法来模拟我们检验统计量的原假设分布。

source_records.title: Embracing the Enemy
source_records.abstract: A principal (such as a centrist political party) can partially influence the allocation of power between two competing parties. The principal is closer to one party, the “Friend”, than to the other, the “Enemy”. The principal’s optimal contract initially seeks to exclude the Enemy. However, once the Enemy gains power, the principal embraces him in exchange for policy moderation. Moderation also disciplines the Friend, inducing him to move closer to the principal’s preferred policy. Principals close to the Friend fully embrace the Enemy; more centrist principals divide their support. Commitment benefits the principal only if she is close to the Friend and parties value power little.

title_zh: 拥抱敌人
abstract_zh: 一个委托人（例如一个中间派政党）可以部分影响两个相互竞争的政党之间的权力分配。委托人与其中一个政党——即“朋友”——比与另一个政党——即“敌人”——更为接近。委托人的最优契约最初试图将敌人排除在外。然而，一旦敌人获得权力，委托人就会拥抱他，以换取政策上的温和化。温和化也会约束朋友，促使他更接近委托人偏好的政策。与朋友关系密切的委托人会完全拥抱敌人；更为中间派的委托人则会分散其支持。只有当委托人接近朋友且政党对权力重视程度较低时，承诺才会使委托人受益。

source_records.title: Recruiting Talent
source_records.abstract: We study a parsimonious model of a competitive labor market in which firms privately screen workers to identify talent. The equilibrium exhibits dispersion in wages and productivity; when talent is scarce, firms with superior screening skills post higher wages, attract better applicants, and recruit more talented workers. High-wage firms impose a compositional externality on low-wage firms, leading to equilibrium inefficiency: Welfare would be higher if low-skilled firms posted high wages and selected first. We also provide a micro-foundation for firms heterogeneous screening skills. When talented workers are better at screening (e.g. via superior referrals), a dynamic version of the economy converges to a unique steady state in which differences in talent, profits and screening skills persist forever.

source_records.abstract: We study a parsimonious model of a competitive labor market in which firms privately screen workers to identify talent. The equilibrium exhibits dispersion in wages and productivity; when talent is scarce, firms with superior screening skills post higher wages, attract better applicants, and recruit more talented workers. We also provide a micro-foundation for firms heterogeneous screening skills. title_zh: 招募人才
abstract_zh: 我们研究一个竞争性劳动力市场的简约模型，其中企业私下筛选工人以识别人才。均衡表现出工资和生产率上的分散；当人才稀缺时，拥有更优筛选技能的企业会发布更高的工资，吸引更好的申请者，并招募到更有才华的工人。高工资企业对低工资企业施加了构成性外部性，导致均衡无效率：如果低技能企业发布高工资并首先进行选择，福利将会更高。我们还为企业异质性筛选技能提供了一个微观基础。当有才华的工人更擅长筛选（例如通过更优的推荐）时，该经济的一个动态版本会收敛到一个唯一稳态，其中人才、利润和筛选技能的差异将永远持续。

source_records.title: Early-Career Discrimination: Spiralling or Self-Correcting?
source_records.abstract: Do workers from social groups with comparable productivity distributions obtain comparable lifetime earnings? We study how a small amount of early-career discrimination propagates over time when workers’ productivity is revealed through employment. In breakdown learning environments that primarily track on-the-job failures, such discrimination spirals into a substantial lifetime earnings gap for groups of comparable productivity, whereas in breakthrough learning environments that track successes, early-career discrimination can be self-corrected, so comparable groups obtain comparable lifetime earnings. This contrast persists in large labour markets and with flexible wages, inconclusive learning, and misspecified employer beliefs.

title_zh: 早期职业歧视：螺旋式恶化还是自我纠正？
abstract_zh: 来自生产率分布相近的社会群体的工人能否获得相近的终身收入？我们研究当工人的生产率通过就业得以揭示时，少量早期职业歧视如何随时间推移而扩散。在主要追踪在职失败的学习环境中，此类歧视会螺旋式恶化，使生产率相近的群体出现巨大的终身收入差距；而在追踪成功的学习环境中，早期职业歧视可以自我纠正，因此生产率相近的群体获得相近的终身收入。这种对比在大型劳动力市场以及灵活工资、非结论性学习和雇主信念设定错误的情况下依然存在。

source_records.title: Why Veil? Religious Headscarves and the Economic Role of Women
source_records.abstract: We show that the emergence of new economic opportunities that draw women away from their traditional domestic roles has significantly influenced the adoption of religious veiling. We measure the prevalence of veiling among young women across Indonesia’s districts for more than two decades by hand-coding around a quarter million photographs attached to Indonesia’s public high school registers. To establish causality, we exploit exogenous variation generated by international demand for Indonesia’s products, interacted with the gender and sectoral composition of local industries. Districts exposed to stronger positive economic shocks—and thus greater economic opportunities for women—exhibit higher rates of veiling adoption. Our findings suggest that veiling facilitates young women’s participation in formal labour markets while safeguarding their personal and social image in society.

title_zh: 为何戴面纱？宗教头巾与女性的经济角色
abstract_zh: 我们表明，吸引女性脱离其传统家庭角色的新经济机会的出现，显著影响了宗教面纱的采用。我们通过手工编码约25万张附于印度尼西亚公立高中登记册上的照片，衡量了二十多年来印度尼西亚各地区年轻女性中戴面纱的普遍程度。为确立因果关系，我们利用印度尼西亚产品的国际需求所产生的外生变异，并将其与当地产业的性别和部门构成进行交互。暴露于更强的正向经济冲击——因而女性拥有更大经济机会——的地区，表现出更高的面纱采用率。我们的发现表明，戴面纱促进了年轻女性参与正规劳动力市场，同时维护了她们在社会中的个人形象和社会形象。

source_records.title: Paying to Match: Decentralized Markets with Information Frictions
source_records.abstract: We experimentally study decentralized one-to-one matching markets with transfers. We vary the information available to participants, complete or incomplete, and the surplus structure, supermodular or submodular. Several insights emerge. First, while markets often culminate in efficient matchings, stability is more elusive, reflecting the difficulty of arranging attendant transfers. Second, incomplete information and submodularity present hurdles to efficiency and especially stability; their combination drastically diminishes stability's likelihood. Third, matchings form ``from the top down'' in complete-information supermodular markets, but exhibit many more and less-obviously ordered offers otherwise. Last, participants' market positions matter far more than their dynamic bargaining styles for outcomes.

title_zh: 付费匹配：存在信息摩擦的分散化市场
abstract_zh: 我们通过实验研究了带有转移支付的分散化一对一匹配市场。我们改变了参与者可获得的信息，即完全信息或不完全信息，以及剩余结构，即超模或次模。由此得出若干见解。第一，尽管市场往往最终形成有效匹配，但稳定性更难实现，这反映出安排相应转移支付的困难。第二，不完全信息和次模性对效率、尤其是稳定性构成障碍；二者结合会大幅降低稳定性的可能性。第三，在完全信息超模市场中，匹配“自上而下”形成，但在其他情况下，报价数量要多得多，且顺序不那么明显。最后，参与者的市场位置对结果的影响远大于其动态议价风格。

source_records.title: Affective Polarization, Media Outlets, and Opinion Dynamics
source_records.abstract: We study opinion dynamics in a social network consisting of two groups. Agents update their opinions by conforming to members of their own group while rejecting the views of the opposing group (affective polarization), and by listening to a media outlet that may provide biased information. We characterize the long-run opinions and identify when affective polarization and media bias lead to ideological polarization, persistent disagreement, or failures of learning. We also derive when information interventions or censorship improve the accuracy of average opinions and reduce disagreement, and when they backfire: better information helps only under specific media bias configurations and when directed to the agents we identify as most effective at propagating it through the network.

title_zh: 情感极化、媒体渠道与观点动态
abstract_zh: 我们研究一个由两个群体组成的社交网络中的观点动态。代理人通过遵从本群体成员而拒绝对立群体的观点（情感极化），以及通过倾听可能提供有偏信息的媒体渠道来更新其观点。我们刻画了长期观点，并识别出情感极化和媒体偏见何时导致意识形态极化、持续分歧或学习失败。我们还推导出信息干预或审查何时能提高平均观点的准确性并减少分歧，以及何时会适得其反：更好的信息仅在特定的媒体偏见配置下，并且当指向我们识别出的最能在网络中传播该信息的代理人时，才会有所帮助。

source_records.title: Public Employee Pensions and Municipal Insolvency
source_records.abstract: This paper studies how municipal governments jointly manage spending, credit market borrowing, and a public employee pension system. I model governments as levered investors who must meet non-defaultable pension obligations and may value government spending more than citizens. I quantify the model using data on California cities, including a new record of fiscal emergencies, tax increases required to maintain essential city services. After the financial crisis depleted pension funds, cities engaged in excessive risk-taking: the fiscal emergency option encouraged gambling for resurrection that kept cities vulnerable to shocks well into the recovery. To correct this problem, a savings requirement works better than a restriction on risk-taking or a pension funding requirement. The policy experiments emphasize that effective policies need to target the combined pension and bond finances, as policies that only target one, such as a pension funding requirement, are undermined by endogenous changes to the other.

The policy experiments emphasize that effective policies need to target the combined pension and bond finances, as policies that only target one, such as a pension funding requirement, are undermined by endogenous changes to the other.
title_zh: 公共雇员养老金与市政破产
abstract_zh: 本文研究市政府如何共同管理支出、信贷市场借款以及公共雇员养老金体系。我将政府建模为杠杆投资者，其必须履行不可违约的养老金义务，并且可能比公民更看重政府支出。我利用加利福尼亚州城市的数据对模型进行量化，其中包括一项关于财政紧急状态的新记录，以及为维持基本城市服务所需的增税。金融危机耗尽养老金资金后，城市进行了过度风险承担：财政紧急状态选项鼓励了“赌一把以求复活”的行为，使城市在复苏期很长一段时间内仍易受冲击影响。为纠正这一问题，储蓄要求比限制风险承担或养老金注资要求更有效。政策实验强调，有效的政策需要针对养老金和债券融资的组合，因为只针对其中一项的政策（例如养老金注资要求）会被另一项的内生变化所削弱。

source_records.title: Equity Frictions and Firm Ownership
source_records.abstract: In this paper, I document systematic heterogeneity in ownership and financing of firms across Eurozone countries. To rationalize these differences, I build a quantitative general equilibrium model of workers and entrepreneurs who choose debt and equity financing of their firms, subject to rich country-specific financial frictions. The novel data on firm ownership and financing, combined with the structure of the model, allows me to quantify the level of debt and equity frictions in each country. Quantitatively, I find much larger output effects from equity frictions: harmonizing them across countries would lead to nearly four times larger output effects compared to debt frictions, and removing them would increase aggregate output by 73\% more. The larger impact on output is due not only to the estimated levels and dispersion of equity frictions but also to the greater risk sharing provided by equity, which further incentivizes entrepreneurs to expand their firms. Through their effect on risk sharing, equity frictions also rationalize the observed negative relationship between equity financing and wealth inequality. Quantitatively, they are responsible for over 70\% of the explained variation in top wealth shares across countries.

title_zh: 股权摩擦与企业所有权
abstract_zh: 本文记录了欧元区各国企业在所有权和融资方面存在的系统性异质性。为解释这些差异，我构建了一个工人与企业家的一般均衡量化模型，其中企业家在丰富的国别特定金融摩擦约束下，为其企业选择债务融资和股权融资。关于企业所有权与融资的新颖数据，结合模型结构，使我能够量化每个国家的债务摩擦与股权摩擦水平。在量化层面，我发现股权摩擦带来的产出效应要大得多：在各国之间统一股权摩擦所带来的产出效应，几乎是统一债务摩擦的近四倍；而消除股权摩擦将使总产出增加73\%以上。对产出更大的影响不仅源于所估计的股权摩擦水平及其离散程度，还源于股权所提供的更大风险分担，这进一步激励企业家扩张其企业。通过其对风险分担的影响，股权摩擦也解释了所观察到的股权融资与财富不平等之间的负相关关系。在量化层面，在各国顶层财富份额的可解释变异中，股权摩擦贡献了超过70\%。

source_records.title: Sovereign Default and the Decline in Interest Rates*
source_records.abstract: Sovereign debt yields have undergone a historic decline over the last half century. Standard explanations, including aging populations and increases in asset demand from abroad, encounter difficulties when confronted with the full range of evidence. We propose an explanation based on a decline in inflation and default risk. We show that a model with sovereign default captures the decline in interest rates, the stability of equity valuation ratios, and the reduction in investment and output growth. Calibrations of the model post-COVID suggest that sovereign default risk may have returned.

title_zh: 主权违约与利率下降*
abstract_zh: 过去半个世纪，主权债务收益率经历了历史性下降。包括人口老龄化和来自海外的资产需求增加在内的标准解释，在面对全部证据时遇到了困难。我们提出一种基于通胀和违约风险下降的解释。我们表明，一个包含主权违约的模型能够捕捉利率的下降、股权估值比率的稳定以及投资和产出增长的放缓。新冠疫情后对该模型的校准表明，主权违约风险可能已经回归。

source_records.title: International Arbitrage Premia
source_records.abstract: We introduce the nonlinear arbitrage correction (NAC), the residual that renders a linear benchmark model arbitrage-free while preserving the law of one price. The price of NAC captures the marginal Sharpe ratio increase consistent with no-arbitrage and upper-bounds the constrained Hansen–Jagannathan distance. Using four decades of international equity, currency, and factor returns, NAC is strongly countercyclical, peaking during crises when linear models turn negative. The implied Sharpe ratio increase reaches 0.3, underscoring its economic relevance. While linear models perform well on average, they fail in distressed states, underpricing nonlinear payoffs. Incorporating NAC restores positivity and stabilizes pricing across regimes.

title_zh: 国际套利溢价
abstract_zh: 我们引入非线性套利修正（NAC），这是一种残差，它使线性基准模型在保持一价定律的同时实现无套利。NAC的价格捕捉了与无套利相一致的边际夏普比率增量，并为受约束的Hansen–Jagannathan距离提供了上界。利用四十年的国际股票、货币和因子收益数据，NAC表现出强烈的逆周期性，在线性模型转为负值的危机期间达到峰值。隐含的夏普比率增量达到0.3，凸显了其经济相关性。虽然线性模型平均表现良好，但在困境状态下失效，对非线性收益定价过低。纳入NAC可恢复正性并稳定跨状态定价。

source_records.title: Government Intervention in the Financial Market
source_records.abstract: Government intervention in the financial market through its own trading fundamentally changes the market’s structure, function, and outcome. I develop a general equilibrium framework to study the impact of government trading on investor welfare. I show that with incompleteness and information asymmetry, the market equilibrium is in general suboptimal, and government intervention can potentially improve investor welfare even with no additional information. However, the actual welfare impact of government intervention is sensitive to the details of the economy and the policy design. Popular policy targets such as price stability, market liquidity, and informational efficiency can have different welfare implications.

title_zh: 政府对金融市场的干预
abstract_zh: 政府通过自身交易对金融市场进行干预，从根本上改变了市场的结构、功能与结果。我构建了一个一般均衡框架，以研究政府交易对投资者福利的影响。我表明，在存在不完全性和信息不对称的情况下，市场均衡通常并非最优，即使没有额外信息，政府干预也有可能改善投资者福利。然而，政府干预的实际福利影响对经济体的具体细节和政策设计十分敏感。诸如价格稳定、市场流动性和信息效率等流行的政策目标，可能具有不同的福利含义。

source_records.title: What Hundreds of Economic News Events Say About Belief Overreaction in the Stock Market
source_records.abstract: We measure the nature and severity of a variety of belief distortions in market reactions to hundreds of economic news events by synthesizing structural estimation with algorithmic machine learning to quantify bias. We find that investors systematically overreact to perceptions about multiple fundamental shocks, a phenomenon we show often dampens rather than amplifies market volatility via a “shock composition effect.” Such effects imply that the stock market can underreact to news, even when investors overreact to all shocks.

title_zh: 数百个经济新闻事件对股市信念过度反应说明了什么
abstract_zh: 我们通过将结构估计与算法机器学习相结合来量化偏差，衡量了市场对数百个经济新闻事件反应中多种信念扭曲的性质与严重程度。我们发现，投资者会系统性地对多种基本面冲击的感知过度反应，我们表明这一现象往往通过一种“冲击构成效应”抑制而非放大市场波动。此类效应意味着，即便投资者对所有冲击都过度反应，股市仍可能对新闻反应不足。

source_records.title: Generative AI and Data Quality: Implications for Productivity, Labor Displacement, and Policy
source_records.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly consuming and producing huge amounts of data. We propose a social learning model of AI, emphasizing a data-AI feedback loop: data quality affects AI productivity, which influences AI adoption and, consequently, the composition (AI versus human-generated) and quality of future data. Calibrated to evidence on synthetic training loops, the model predicts hump-shaped labor dynamics—short-term displacement that partially reverses as data quality deteriorates. A Grossman–Stiglitz-style externality emerges: AI adopters free-ride on the human-generated actions that supply the novel information on which AI itself relies. In a competitive market, AI should be taxed to correct the data-quality externality; a concentrated AI industry overcorrects, making a subsidy optimal. (JEL O33, D62, D83, J24)

abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能（AI）正日益消耗并产生海量数据。我们提出一个AI的社会学习模型，强调数据—AI反馈循环：数据质量影响AI生产率，进而影响AI采用，并因此影响未来数据的构成（AI生成与人类生成）和质量。根据合成训练循环的证据进行校准后，该模型预测出驼峰状的劳动力动态——短期替代会随着数据质量恶化而部分逆转。由此出现一种Grossman–Stiglitz式外部性：AI采用者免费搭便车于人类生成的行动，而这些行动提供了AI自身所依赖的新信息。在竞争性市场中，应当对AI征税以纠正数据质量外部性；而集中的AI产业会过度纠正，从而使补贴成为最优选择。（JEL O33, D62, D83, J24）

source_records.title: Voting Choice
source_records.abstract: Traditionally, fund managers cast votes on behalf of fund investors. Recently, there is a shift toward “pass-through voting,” with funds offering investors a choice: delegate votes to the fund or vote themselves. We develop a framework to study the implications of voting choice. While it helps reflect heterogeneous investor preferences, it also shapes the informational content of the vote, and these forces can conflict. When interests are aligned, voting choice improves information aggregation and investor welfare. With preference heterogeneity or costly information, however, it can make investors worse off by weakening informed decision making and fund managers’ incentives to acquire information.

title_zh: 投票选择
abstract_zh: 传统上，基金经理代表基金投资者行使投票权。近来，出现了一种向“传递投票”的转变，即基金为投资者提供选择：将投票权委托给基金，或自行投票。我们构建了一个框架来研究投票选择的含义。尽管它有助于反映投资者的异质性偏好，但它也会塑造投票的信息内容，而这些力量可能相互冲突。当利益一致时，投票选择能改善信息聚合和投资者福利。然而，在偏好异质性或信息成本高昂的情况下，它可能削弱知情决策和基金经理获取信息的激励，从而使投资者境况变差。

source_records.title: Dollar Asset Holdings and Hedging around the Globe
source_records.abstract: We collect and analyze detailed filings from global institutional investors to estimate foreign investors’ U.S. dollar (USD) security holdings and currency hedging. Over two decades, foreign USD holdings grew sixfold, while hedge ratios rose by 15 percentage points after the 2008–2009 crisis. Currency hedging across mutual funds, pensions, and insurance reached $2 trillion by 2019. Hedging demand varies across investors, currency areas, and banking systems. We show that expected FX returns, beyond variance minimization, drive currency exposure in portfolios. Finally, we demonstrate and quantify how aggregate hedging demand affects hedging costs in the presence of constrained intermediaries.

title_zh: 全球范围内的美元资产持有与对冲
abstract_zh: 我们收集并分析全球机构投资者的详细申报文件，以估算外国投资者的美元（USD）证券持有量及货币对冲情况。在二十年间，外国美元持有量增长了六倍，而对冲比率在2008—2009年危机后上升了15个百分点。到2019年，共同基金、养老金和保险公司的货币对冲规模达到2万亿美元。对冲需求因投资者、货币区和银行体系而异。我们表明，除方差最小化之外，预期外汇收益也驱动着投资组合中的货币敞口。最后，我们展示并量化了在 intermediary 受限的情况下，总体对冲需求如何影响对冲成本。

source_records.title: Pension Liquidity Risk
source_records.abstract: Pension funds use interest rate swaps to hedge the interest rate risk arising from their liabilities. Analyzing regulatory data on Dutch pension funds, we show that pension funds with worse funding ratios, indicating greater fragility, use swaps more aggressively. These swap positions expose pension funds to the risk of margin calls, which can exceed 6% of their total assets, when interest rates rise. Pension funds respond to realized margin calls by selling safe government bonds with medium-term maturities. This procyclical selling behavior adversely affects the prices of the sold bonds and thereby exposes pension funds to market liquidity risk.

title_zh: 养老金流动性风险
abstract_zh: 养老金基金使用利率互换来对冲其负债所产生的利率风险。通过分析荷兰养老金基金的监管数据，我们表明，融资比率较差（表明脆弱性更大）的养老金基金更激进地使用互换。当利率上升时，这些互换头寸使养老金基金面临追加保证金的风险，其规模可能超过其总资产的6%。养老金基金通过出售中等期限的安全政府债券来应对已实现的追加保证金。这种顺周期出售行为对出售债券的价格产生不利影响，从而使养老金基金面临市场流动性风险。

source_records.title: Learning by Investing: Entrepreneurial Spillovers from Venture Capital
source_records.abstract: This paper studies how investing in venture capital (VC) affects the entrepreneurial outcomes of individual limited partners (LPs). Using comprehensive administrative data on entrepreneurial activities and VC fundraising and investments in China, we find that after investing in a successfully launched VC fund, individual LPs create significantly more ventures than do LPs in funds that failed to launch. These new ventures tend to be high-tech firms with better employment outcomes and more patent activity. Our results suggest that venture investments are a channel through which individual LPs learn. (JEL D83, G23, G24, L25, L26)

title_zh: 通过投资学习：来自风险投资的企业家溢出效应
abstract_zh: 本文研究投资于风险投资（VC）如何影响个人有限合伙人（LP）的创业结果。利用中国创业活动以及风险投资募资与投资的全面的行政数据，我们发现，在投资于一只成功设立的风险投资基金之后，个人有限合伙人创办的企业数量显著多于那些投资于未能设立成功的基金的有限合伙人。这些新创企业往往是高科技企业，具有更好的就业结果和更多的专利活动。我们的结果表明，风险投资是个人有限合伙人借以学习的一条渠道。（JEL D83, G23, G24, L25, L26）

source_records.title: Stocks as Lotteries? An Experimental Test of Expected Utility versus Behavioral Models
source_records.abstract: Our study provides the first causal test of classical and behavioral asset pricing models that incorporate skewness pricing. In line with these models, our experimental markets show that skewness is systematically priced. Our findings also reveal that positively skewed assets available in small supply exhibit negative expected returns, which is consistent with prospect theory, but not with expected utility models. Furthermore, in line with the mechanism underlying prospect theory, we show that the negative returns of the positively skewed asset are most pronounced during market sessions where traders overweight the low probability of receiving a large payoff.

title_zh: 股票如同彩票？对期望效用模型与行为模型的实验检验
abstract_zh: 我们的研究首次对纳入偏度定价的经典与行为资产定价模型进行了因果检验。与这些模型一致，我们的实验市场显示偏度被系统性地定价。我们的发现还揭示，以小供给量提供的正偏资产表现出负的预期收益，这与前景理论一致，但与期望效用模型不一致。此外，与前景理论背后的机制一致，我们表明正偏资产的负收益在交易者高估获得大额收益的低概率的市场时段中最为显著。

source_records.title: Size-Based Regulation and Bank Fragility: Evidence from the Wells Fargo Asset Cap
source_records.abstract: We argue that heightened regulation on large banks contributed to the rise in fragility of smaller banks revealed by the 2023 regional bank crisis. In 2018, regulators restricted Wells Fargo, the third largest U.S. bank, from growing its total assets. We estimate this asset cap led Wells Fargo to give up deposits amounting to 2.2% of aggregate bank deposits. These deposits, primarily uninsured, were reallocated to banks geographically proximate to Wells Fargo, including smaller, less regulated banks. In turn, these banks experienced higher deposit outflows once monetary tightening commenced and saw their stock prices plummet during the 2023 stress.

title_zh: 基于规模的监管与银行脆弱性：来自富国银行资产上限的证据
abstract_zh: 我们认为，对大型银行加强监管促成了2023年区域性银行危机所揭示的小型银行脆弱性上升。2018年，监管机构限制美国第三大银行富国银行扩大其总资产。我们估计，这一资产上限导致富国银行放弃了相当于银行总存款2.2%的存款。这些存款主要是未保险存款，被重新配置到地理上靠近富国银行的银行，包括规模较小、受监管较少的银行。反过来，一旦货币紧缩开始，这些银行便经历了更高的存款流出，并在2023年的压力期间其股价暴跌。

source_records.title: Stablecoin Runs and the Centralization of Arbitrage
source_records.abstract: Stablecoins are cryptoassets designed to be pegged to the dollar, but they are backed by imperfectly liquid USD assets. We show that stablecoins feature concentrated arbitrage: the largest issuer, Tether, allows only six agents in an average month to redeem stablecoins for cash. We argue that the issuers’ choice of arbitrage concentration reflects a trade-off: efficient arbitrage improves stablecoin price stability in secondary markets but amplifies run risks by reducing investors’ price impact from selling stablecoins. Our findings imply that policies designed to improve stablecoin price stability may have the unintended consequence of increasing stablecoin run risks. (JEL G01, G23)

title_zh: 稳定币挤兑与套利的中心化
abstract_zh: 稳定币是旨在与美元挂钩的加密资产，但其背后由流动性不完美的美元资产支持。我们表明，稳定币具有集中的套利特征：最大的发行方Tether平均每月仅允许六个代理将稳定币兑换为现金。我们认为，发行方对套利集中度的选择反映了一种权衡：高效的套利改善了稳定币在二级市场的价格稳定性，但通过降低投资者出售稳定币的价格影响而放大了挤兑风险。我们的发现意味着，旨在改善稳定币价格稳定性的政策可能会产生增加稳定币挤兑风险的意外后果。（JEL G01, G23）

source_records.title: The Real Effects of Environmental Activist Investing
source_records.abstract: We study the real effects of environmental activist investing. Using plant-chemical-level data, we find that targeted firms reduce their production-related emissions. Air quality improvements in the vicinity of targeted plants suggest potentially significant externalities for local economies. Reductions come from increased abatement expenditures and on-site source reduction initiatives, which negatively affect the financial performance of targeted firms. title_zh: 环境积极主义投资的真实效应
abstract_zh: 我们研究环境积极主义投资的真实效应。利用工厂—化学品层面的数据，我们发现被针对的企业减少了其与生产相关的排放。被针对工厂附近空气质量的改善表明，这可能对当地经济产生显著的外部性。排放的减少来自减排支出的增加和现场源头削减举措，这些举措对被针对企业的财务表现产生了负面影响。我们排除了其他解释，包括产量下降和工厂关闭，并提供证据表明企业会回应积极主义者的具体诉求。我们的发现表明，环境积极主义是长期股东应对气候变化风险的有效工具。

source_records.title: What Do Impact Investors Do Differently?
source_records.abstract: Do impact investors seek impact, or merely “impact wash”? We provide systematic evidence on the nonfinancial determinants of impact investing. Impact investors focus on firms aligned with the priorities of the federal government and disproportionately invest in economically disadvantaged regions. While we find high levels of coinvestment between impact and traditional investors, we also show that impact investors influence the strategies of their traditional coinvestors, are more likely to fund firms in nascent industries, and invest countercyclically. Finally, we characterize investment heterogeneity based on a novel classification of impact investment theses, with a focus on climate, environment, and jobs and equity.

title_zh: 影响力投资者有何不同做法？
abstract_zh: 影响力投资者是在寻求影响力，还是仅仅进行“影响力漂洗”？我们提供了关于影响力投资非财务决定因素的系统性证据。影响力投资者关注与联邦政府优先事项一致的公司，并不成比例地投资于经济欠发达地区。虽然我们发现影响力投资者与传统投资者之间存在高水平的共同投资，但我们也表明，影响力投资者会影响其传统共同投资者的策略，更有可能资助新兴产业中的公司，并进行逆周期投资。最后，我们基于对影响力投资主题的一种新分类来刻画投资异质性，重点关注气候、环境以及就业与公平。

source_records.title: Personal Bankruptcy Protection and Household Debt
source_records.abstract: Increasing personal bankruptcy protection raises consumers’ desire to borrow and lenders’ cost of extending credit; the impact on equilibrium borrowing is ambiguous. Using bankruptcy protection changes between 1999 and 2005 across U.S. states, we find that borrowers respond to greater protection by increasing their unsecured debt. Border county estimates suggest that local economic conditions do not drive these results. Borrowers pay more for protection through higher interest rates, yet delinquency is unaffected. Our results indicate that rising borrower demand outstripped decreasing supply. Increased protections did not reduce the aggregate level of household debt but affected the composition of borrowing. (JEL G00, G33, G51, D14, D18, K35, R2)

title_zh: 个人破产保护与家庭债务
abstract_zh: 提高个人破产保护会增强消费者的借款意愿，并提高贷款人提供信贷的成本；对均衡借款的影响则不确定。利用1999年至2005年间美国各州破产保护的变化，我们发现借款人通过增加其无担保债务来对更强的保护作出反应。边境县估计表明，当地经济状况并未驱动这些结果。借款人通过更高的利率为保护支付更多成本，但拖欠情况未受影响。我们的结果表明，借款人需求的上升超过了供给的下降。保护力度的增强并未降低家庭债务的总体水平，但影响了借款的构成。（JEL G00, G33, G51, D14, D18, K35, R2）

source_records.title: Underrepresentation of Women CEOs
source_records.abstract: Why do so few women become CEOs? To understand this glass ceiling, we estimate a dynamic model of the CEO gender decision, which contains perceived gender productivity differences, search costs reflecting limited female labor supply, and employer disutility from discrimination. The key factor is the shortage of suitable female candidates, as boards prefer hiring women, and productivity differences between genders are minimal. We find no evidence of a glass cliff in which women become CEOs just as firms are failing. While better governance is associated with women becoming CEOs, the importance of limited female labor supply is unrelated to governance.

title_zh: 女性CEO的代表性不足
abstract_zh: 为什么成为CEO的女性如此之少？为了理解这一玻璃天花板现象，我们估计了一个关于CEO性别决策的动态模型，该模型包含感知到的性别生产率差异、反映女性劳动力供给有限的搜寻成本，以及雇主因歧视而产生的负效用。关键因素是合适女性候选人的短缺，因为董事会更倾向于聘用女性，而性别之间的生产率差异极小。我们没有发现女性恰好在公司陷入困境时成为CEO的“玻璃悬崖”证据。尽管更好的治理与女性成为CEO相关，但女性劳动力供给有限的重要性与治理无关。

source_records.title: Carbon Emissions and the Bank-Lending Channel
source_records.abstract: We study how firm-level carbon emissions affect bank lending and real outcomes in a sample of global firms with syndicated loans. We exploit bank-level climate commitments as firm-level shocks to lending relationships, using firms' prior credit exposures to identify credit supply effects. Firms with higher emissions that previously borrowed from committed banks receive less bank credit. Evidence from lending volumes, prices, and within-firm-time loan-level data indicates a supply-side shift away from high-emission firms, not explained by borrower risk. Affected firms reduce debt, leverage, size, and investment, yet we find no reduction in future emissions, instead documenting evidence consistent with greenwashing.

title_zh: 碳排放与银行借贷渠道
abstract_zh: 我们研究在企业层面碳排放如何影响银行借贷和实际结果，样本为拥有银团贷款的全球企业。我们将银行层面的气候承诺作为企业层面借贷关系的冲击，利用企业先前的信贷敞口来识别信贷供给效应。此前曾向作出承诺的银行借款的高排放企业获得的银行信贷减少。来自贷款量、价格以及企业内部-时间贷款层面数据的证据表明，供给端从高排放企业转移，而这不能由借款人风险解释。受影响的企业减少债务、杠杆、规模和投资，但我们未发现未来排放减少，反而记录了与漂绿相一致证据。

source_records.title: Long Rates, Life Insurers, and Credit Spreads
source_records.abstract: This paper proposes a new channel through which long-term interest rates transmit to credit spreads. When life insurers carry negative duration gaps, higher rates reduce their liabilities more than assets. Rate increases therefore boost equity and risk-bearing capacity, lowering equilibrium credit spreads. Empirically, I test this channel with bond-level yields and a maturity-based discontinuity in bond ownership. Insurers’ trades confirm the mechanism: after rates rise, insurers shift portfolios towards riskier, high-yield bonds. As rates increase, bonds more heavily held by life insurers experience greater spread reductions. The results show that institutional duration mismatch shapes credit spreads and corporate financing conditions. (JEL G12, G22, G23, E50)

title_zh: 长期利率、寿险公司与信用利差
abstract_zh: 本文提出了长期利率向信用利差传导的一条新渠道。当寿险公司存在负久期缺口时，利率上升对其负债的减少幅度大于对资产的减少幅度。因此，利率上升会提升其权益和风险承担能力，从而降低均衡信用利差。在实证上，我利用债券层面的收益率以及债券所有权中基于期限的不连续性来检验这一渠道。保险公司的交易证实了该机制：利率上升后，保险公司将投资组合转向风险更高的高收益债券。随着利率上升，被寿险公司持有比例更高的债券经历了更大幅度的利差收窄。结果表明，机构久期错配会影响信用利差和企业融资条件。（JEL G12, G22, G23, E50）

source_records.title: Flow
source_records.abstract: Performance chasing is pervasive in active mutual funds, index mutual funds, and ETFs, with positive flow-performance sensitivity evident in both broad-based and niche funds and for the skill and nonskill components of returns. The sensitivity of ETFs is greatest, with insignificant differences between active and index mutual funds. The heightened sensitivity of ETFs is not explained by benchmark design or exchange trading, and is amplified by institutional ownership. Institutional trading of ETFs follows a momentum strategy, rather than flow management or benchmarking. Institutional herding and the outsourcing of investment management to model portfolios heightens the performance sensitivity of ETF flows. (JEL G10, G11, G23)

abstract_zh: 业绩追逐在主动型共同基金、指数型共同基金和ETF中普遍存在，在广泛型基金和利基基金中，以及在收益的技能与非技能成分中，都表现出正的流量-业绩敏感性。ETF的敏感性最大，而主动型与指数型共同基金之间的差异不显著。ETF更高的敏感性无法由基准设计或交易所交易来解释，并且会因机构持股而被放大。机构对ETF的交易遵循动量策略，而非流量管理或基准化。机构羊群行为以及将投资管理外包给模型组合，加剧了ETF流量的业绩敏感性。（JEL G10, G11, G23）

source_records.title: “Megadeal” Subsidies, Local Spillovers, and Corporate Innovation
source_records.abstract: We examine whether the largest place‐based, firm‐specific corporate subsidies (“Megadeals”) awarded by state and local governments affect local firms’ innovation. First, we document that (1) subsidy firms innovate in the subsidized county and (2) subsidy firms bring inventors from other counties into the subsidized county, consistent with subsidy firms generating new knowledge locally. In our main test, we use a stacked cohort design with stringent fixed effects to document that local firms increase patenting following a Megadeal. Cross‐sectionally, effects are increasing (1) in subsidy firm innovativeness, (2) in the technological closeness of subsidy firms and local firms, (3) when subsidy and local firms share an industry, and (4) when the subsidized location has a heavy college presence. Additionally, we document that following a Megadeal, local firms increasingly make citations to subsidy firm patents and that the patent similarity of local and subsidy firms increases. We document that subsidy firm inventors are more likely to move to local firms following a Megadeal. We also find that subsidies for labs, headquarters, and high‐tech manufacturing plants drive our main results. These results are consistent with knowledge spillovers being one channel through which we observe an increase in local firm patenting following Megadeals.
