title_zh: “巨额交易”补贴、本地溢出效应与企业创新
abstract_zh: 我们考察州和地方政府授予的最大规模、基于地点且针对特定企业的公司补贴（“巨额交易”）是否会影响本地企业的创新。首先，我们记录到：(1) 补贴企业在受补贴县进行创新；(2) 补贴企业将其他县的发明人带入受补贴县，这与补贴企业在本地产生新知识相一致。在我们的主要检验中，我们使用带有严格固定效应的堆叠队列设计，记录到本地企业在巨额交易之后增加了专利申请。在横截面上，效应随着以下因素而增强：(1) 补贴企业的创新性；(2) 补贴企业与本地企业的技术接近度；(3) 补贴企业与本地企业属于同一行业；(4) 受补贴地点拥有大量高校存在。此外，我们记录到，在巨额交易之后，本地企业越来越多地引用补贴企业的专利，并且本地企业与补贴企业之间的专利相似度上升。我们记录到，在巨额交易之后，补贴企业的发明人更有可能流向本地企业。我们还发现，针对实验室、总部和高科技制造工厂的补贴驱动了我们的主要结果。这些结果与知识溢出相一致，即知识溢出是我们在巨额交易之后观察到本地企业专利申请增加的一个渠道。

source_records.title: Non‐Fundamental Loan Renegotiations
source_records.abstract: Prior studies predominantly examine fundamental performance‐driven explanations of loan renegotiations. We contrast with this work by investigating the improvement in secondary loan market trading conditions as a non‐fundamental driver of loan renegotiation. Exploiting a regression discontinuity design around the LSTA 100 Index reconstitution, we find that index‐included loans are around five times more likely to receive interest‐rate–reducing amendments than comparable loans just below the index inclusion threshold. Within‐loan‐package tests confirm that these renegotiations are not driven by changes in the borrower's fundamental performance. The threat of refinancing likely drives this effect, as the results are more pronounced when such threats are more credible.

title_zh: 非基本面贷款重新谈判
abstract_zh: 以往研究主要考察贷款重新谈判的基本面业绩驱动解释。我们与这一研究相对照，考察二级贷款市场交易条件的改善作为贷款重新谈判的非基本面驱动因素。利用围绕LSTA 100指数重构的断点回归设计，我们发现，与刚好低于指数纳入阈值的可比贷款相比，被纳入指数的贷款获得降低利率修正的可能性大约高出五倍。贷款组合内部检验证实，这些重新谈判并非由借款人基本面业绩的变化所驱动。再融资威胁可能驱动了这一效应，因为当此类威胁更为可信时，结果更为显著。

source_records.title: Disaggregating Cash Flows: The Effect of Linking and Labeling on Investors’ Understanding of the Statement of Cash Flows
source_records.abstract: Operating cash flows are a critical input to valuation activities. Research and practice indicate that the most common method of presenting operating cash flows, the indirect method, is viewed as overly complex. We experimentally examine whether two theoretically motivated factors represent shortcomings of the indirect method: (1) inadequate linking of related components of net income and changes in working capital accounts, and (2) inconsistent income statement labeling between components of net income and their corresponding working capital changes. Drawing on causal reasoning theory, we predict and find that these factors hinder the decision usefulness of the operating section of the statement of cash flows. The results of our study are informative to the academic literature and standard setters, as we examine underlying reasons why the indirect method may be viewed unfavorably.

title_zh: 分解现金流量：关联与标签对投资者理解现金流量表的影响
abstract_zh: 经营活动现金流量是估值活动的一项关键输入。研究表明与实践显示，最常用的经营活动现金流量列报方法——间接法——被认为过于复杂。我们通过实验检验两个具有理论依据的因素是否构成间接法的缺陷：（1）净利润相关组成部分与营运资本账户变动之间关联不足；（2）净利润组成部分与其相应营运资本变动之间在利润表标签上的不一致。基于因果推理理论，我们预测并发现，这些因素会削弱现金流量表经营活动部分的决策有用性。我们的研究结果对学术文献和准则制定者具有参考价值，因为我们考察了间接法可能被视为不受欢迎的深层原因。

source_records.title: Informing Entrepreneurs? Initial Public Offerings and New Business Formation
source_records.abstract: We examine the spillover effects of local initial public offerings (IPOs) on new business formation. An IPO in a local area is associated with a 1%–4% increase in new business registrations, and this effect is particularly pronounced in counties facing higher economic uncertainty. New business registrations are significantly influenced by the extent of EDGAR downloads related to the IPO firm's public disclosures and the information in the IPO firm's S‐1 disclosure. The findings highlight the role of IPOs in conveying crucial information through signaling of potential success prospects and additional provision of information through disclosures. A field survey of 503 entrepreneurs further supports these conclusions.

title_zh: 告知企业家？首次公开发行与新企业形成
abstract_zh: 我们考察了本地首次公开发行（IPO）对新企业形成的溢出效应。本地IPO与新企业注册数量增加1%–4%相关，且这一效应在面临更高经济不确定性的县尤为显著。新企业注册数量显著受到与IPO公司公开披露相关的EDGAR下载量以及IPO公司S-1披露中信息的影响。研究结果凸显了IPO通过传递潜在成功前景的信号以及通过披露额外提供信息来传达关键信息的作用。一项针对503名企业家的实地调查进一步支持了这些结论。

source_records.title: Beyond Automation: AI and the Human Value of Sell‐Side Analysts
source_records.abstract: We examine how analysts’ information acquisition and processing differ when analysts have access to AI resources, focusing on investment banks’ AI investments. We propose and test a two‐step framework, which is informed by in‐depth interviews with analysts. First, consistent with AI facilitating automation‐assisted public information processing, we show that AI investments are associated with more timely earnings forecasts following 10‐K filings, particularly after the implementation of iXBRL, which increases the machine readability of filings. Second, we show that analysts reallocate the time and capacity freed by automation toward acquiring and incorporating private information, supported by several sets of evidence: AI investments (1) are associated with higher quality and bolder earnings forecasts, particularly when private information is more important and accessible to analysts; (2) are associated with an expansion of analyst coverage to new firms and industries; and (3) are associated with higher information‐seeking efforts, particularly greater participation in earnings conference calls. Additionally, exploiting the launch of AskResearchGPT at Morgan Stanley, an in‐house generative AI designed for research, we find results consistent with our main analyses. Overall, our study provides insights into the potential for AI to reshape the human value of sell‐side analysts.

abstract_zh: 我们考察当分析师能够使用人工智能资源时，其信息获取与处理方式有何不同，重点关注投资银行的人工智能投资。我们提出并检验了一个两步框架，该框架基于对分析师的深度访谈。第一，与人工智能促进自动化辅助的公开信息处理相一致，我们表明人工智能投资与10-K文件提交后更及时的盈余预测相关，尤其是在iXBRL实施之后，因为iXBRL提高了文件的机器可读性。第二，我们表明分析师将自动化所释放的时间和能力重新配置到获取和纳入私有信息上，这得到了多组证据的支持：人工智能投资（1）与更高质量和更大胆的盈余预测相关，尤其是在私有信息对分析师更重要且更易获取时；（2）与分析师的覆盖范围扩展到新公司和新行业相关；（3）与更高的信息搜寻努力相关，尤其是更多地参与盈余电话会议。此外，利用摩根士丹利推出AskResearchGPT——一款专为研究设计的内部生成式人工智能——我们发现了与主要分析一致的结果。总体而言，我们的研究为人工智能重塑卖方分析师人力价值的潜力提供了洞见。

source_records.title: Taxes and Investment: Evidence from the “Halloween Massacre” of 2006
source_records.abstract: This study examines the relation between taxes and business investment using the setting of an unexpected and economically significant federal corporate income tax rate increase in Canada known colloquially as the Halloween Massacre of 2006. This tax increase only applies to firms organized as income trusts, but not corporations. Using a difference‐in‐differences design, we find that investment by income trusts decreases about 0.67% for each 1 percentage point increase in the tax rate, translating into over $10 billion in reduced aggregate investment. In decomposing total investment, our results reveal that capital expenditures exhibit an immediate decrease while there is a delayed decrease in acquisition activity. Our results are concentrated in high‐investment income trusts that are most sensitive to the link between investment and taxes. Our study helps resolve conflicting prior results by providing robust evidence that tax increases have an economically significant and negative causal effect on business investment.

source_records.title: Analyst Integrity
source_records.abstract: We empirically investigate the impact of financial analysts' integrity on their information outputs and career success. Using analysts' off‐the‐job behavior, specifically their legal records, to proxy for analyst integrity, we predict and find that weak‐integrity analysts engage more in opportunistic behaviors, including “speaking in two tongues” and earnings forecast walk‐down. These analysts obtain favorable management access and make more accurate earnings forecasts. Further analyses indicate that while the market as a whole does not distinguish weak‐integrity analysts from others, sophisticated investors discount their information outputs. Weak‐integrity analysts also experience less favorable career outcomes. Our results have important implications for investors, professional bodies, employers, and regulators.

title_zh: 分析师诚信
abstract_zh: 我们实证研究了金融分析师的诚信对其信息产出和职业成功的影响。我们使用分析师的业余行为，具体而言是其法律记录，作为分析师诚信的代理变量，预测并发现诚信较弱的分析师更多从事机会主义行为，包括“两面三刀”和盈利预测下调。这些分析师获得了有利的管理层接触机会，并做出更准确的盈利预测。进一步分析表明，尽管市场整体并不区分诚信较弱的分析师与其他分析师，但成熟投资者会对其信息产出打折扣。诚信较弱的分析师也经历较不利的职业结果。我们的结果对投资者、专业机构、雇主和监管机构具有重要启示。

source_records.title: Tax Payments in Loss Firms
source_records.abstract: In a broad sample of publicly traded firms, we observe that the share of firms annually reporting pre‐tax book losses increased from about 20% to 40% during 1988–2023. We also observe that 68% of those loss firms have positive cash tax payments (taxpaying loss firms). The amount of taxes paid by these loss firms is substantial and increasing over time. Surprisingly, we observe that taxes paid increase with the magnitude of pre‐tax losses. This study seeks to understand the prevalence of taxpaying loss firms. We examine whether both the extensive margin—the likelihood that a loss firm pays taxes—and the intensive margin—the magnitude of taxes paid—are explained by firm characteristics. We find that multinational status, state taxes, consolidation differences, goodwill impairments, asset write‐downs, extraordinary items, discontinued operations, depreciation differences, the frequency and magnitude of losses, and firm size are key determinants of both the likelihood and the amount of taxes paid by loss firms. We find that the decrease in the statutory tax rate included in the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017 did not decrease the tax burden on loss firms.

title_zh: 亏损公司的税款支付
abstract_zh: 在一个广泛的上市公司样本中，我们观察到，在1988年至2023年期间，年度报告税前账面亏损的公司比例从约20%上升至40%。我们还观察到，这些亏损公司中有68%具有正数的现金税款支付（即纳税的亏损公司）。这些亏损公司所支付的税款金额相当可观，并且随时间推移而增加。令人惊讶的是，我们观察到所支付的税款随着税前亏损规模的增大而增加。本研究旨在理解纳税亏损公司的普遍性。我们考察了广延边际——亏损公司支付税款的可能性——和集约边际——所支付税款的规模——是否都能由公司特征来解释。我们发现，跨国身份、州税、合并差异、商誉减值、资产减记、非常项目、终止经营、折旧差异、亏损的频率和规模以及公司规模，是亏损公司支付税款的可能性和金额两者的关键决定因素。我们发现，2017年《减税与就业法案》中所包含的法定税率下调并未减轻亏损公司的税收负担。

source_records.title: The Epistemic Rise of Accounting Research in Financial Economics: A Historical Study on the Conception of the Usefulness of Accounting
source_records.abstract: RÉSUMÉ L'étude publiée par Ball et Brown en 1968 (ci‐après « BB68 ») est principalement reconnue pour son affirmation selon laquelle la comptabilité de l'époque était utile pour les investisseurs, s'inscrivant alors en contradiction avec la littérature comptable normative faisant office d'autorité. Or, une telle affirmation n'allait pas de soi. Notre manuscrit vise à mieux comprendre comment l'affirmation initialement proposée dans BB68 en est venue à s'imposer au sein d'une branche importante de la littérature académique en comptabilité, à savoir la recherche comptable « empirique » en économie financière. Ainsi, nous réalisons une étude historique mobilisant certains concepts issus de la « sociologie de la traduction » pour examiner l'envolée de la recherche comptable en économie financière qui s'est déployée au fil des différentes réinterprétations de la notion d'utilité, où l'on est passé de l'évaluation boursière à l'encadrement de clauses contractuelles, en passant par la découverte des anomalies de marché. Nos analyses mettent en exergue, d'une part, le processus social entourant la naissance et le développement de la recherche comptable en économie financière et, d'autre part, la fragilité et le flou des prémisses sur lesquelles ce type de recherche s'est construit. Contrairement à la prétention selon laquelle la recherche comptable en économie financière s'est naturellement imposée en raison de sa supériorité sur le plan des connaissances, nous proposons que cette fragilité et ce flou, plutôt que de miner la crédibilité de ladite perspective, ont pu favoriser l'établissement d'un climat d'ambiguïté conceptuelle propice à sa prolifération. Cette ambiguïté s'articule sur deux plans : la mobilisation ambiguë de l'hypothèse de l'efficience des marchés et l'ambiguïté sémantique quant à la conception de l'utilité de l'information comptable. De façon plus générale, notre manuscrit alimente la discussion sur le cheminement des idées et le contrôle des frontières entourant certaines idées établies.

De façon plus générale, notre manuscrit alimente la discussion sur le cheminement des idées et le contrôle des frontières entourant certaines idées établies.
title_zh: 会计研究在金融经济学中的认识论崛起：关于会计有用性概念的历史研究
abstract_zh: 摘要 鲍尔和布朗于1968年发表的研究（以下简称“BB68”）主要因其主张而得到认可，即当时的会计对投资者是有用的，这与作为权威的规范性会计文献相矛盾。然而，这样的主张并非不言自明。本文手稿旨在更好地理解BB68最初提出的主张如何在一个重要的会计学术文献分支——金融经济学中的“实证”会计研究——中逐渐占据主导地位。因此，我们进行了一项历史研究，运用“转译社会学”中的某些概念，考察金融经济学中会计研究的兴起，这一兴起是在有用性概念的不同重新诠释中展开的，从股票估值到合同条款的约束，再到市场异象的发现。我们的分析一方面突出了围绕金融经济学中会计研究诞生与发展的社会过程，另一方面也突出了此类研究赖以建立的前提的脆弱性与模糊性。与那种认为金融经济学中的会计研究因其在知识上的优越性而自然占据主导地位的主张相反，我们提出，这种脆弱性与模糊性非但没有削弱该视角的可信度，反而可能促成了一个有利于其扩散的概念模糊氛围。这种模糊性体现在两个层面：对市场效率假说的模糊运用，以及关于会计信息有用性概念在语义上的模糊性。更一般地说，本文手稿为关于思想演进以及围绕某些既定思想的边界控制的讨论提供了素材。

source_records.title: From Words to Actions: The Impact of Specificity and Causality in Narrative Feedback on Employee Performance Improvement
source_records.abstract: With the widespread use of narrative feedback in companies, understanding how such feedback can be valuable for employee performance improvement is important. Drawing on proprietary data from an e‐commerce company, we investigate the role of specificity and causality—two key language characteristics for self‐regulation and learning. Our findings suggest that neither specificity nor causality is always beneficial; instead, their effects depend on whether the feedback refers to strengths or weaknesses. Specifically, employees are more likely to improve when they receive more specific narrative feedback on their strengths, consistent with employees engaging in more systematic exploration when feedback provides concrete references to desirable behaviors. In contrast, we find that increases in the specificity of narrative feedback on weaknesses can have negative performance consequences, as employees who are confronted with many specific examples of undesirable behaviors may attempt too many behavioral changes at once, undermining learning and improvement. Furthermore, employees are more likely to improve when feedback on their weaknesses uses more causal language, suggesting that explanations of why certain behaviors were ineffective help employees understand and correct those behaviors. Our study informs HR leaders, supervisors, and experts responsible for designing management control systems by showing that narrative feedback should be specific when describing strengths, but more selective and richer in causal explanations when addressing weaknesses.

title_zh: 从言语到行动：叙事反馈中的具体性与因果性对员工绩效改进的影响
abstract_zh: 随着叙事反馈在企业中的广泛使用，理解此类反馈如何对员工绩效改进具有价值十分重要。基于一家电子商务公司的专有数据，我们考察了具体性与因果性——这两个对自我调节和学习至关重要的关键语言特征——的作用。我们的研究结果表明，具体性和因果性并非总是有益的；相反，它们的效果取决于反馈是指向优势还是劣势。具体而言，当员工收到关于其优势的更具体的叙事反馈时，他们更有可能改进，这与员工在反馈为可取行为提供具体参照时进行更系统性探索的情况一致。相比之下，我们发现，关于劣势的叙事反馈具体性的增加可能对绩效产生负面影响，因为面对许多具体的不良行为实例的员工可能试图一次性做出过多行为改变，从而损害学习和改进。此外，当关于劣势的反馈使用更多因果性语言时，员工更有可能改进，这表明对某些行为为何无效的解释有助于员工理解和纠正这些行为。我们的研究为负责设计管理控制系统的HR领导者、主管和专家提供了启示，表明叙事反馈在描述优势时应具体，而在处理劣势时应更具选择性并包含更丰富的因果解释。

source_records.title: Employee Non‐Disclosure Agreements and Corporate News
source_records.abstract: This study examines whether weakening employee non‐disclosure agreements (NDAs) affects the flow of information to capital markets via the business press. After state laws weakened NDAs related to misconduct, treated firms exhibit a significant increase in corporate news relative to control firms. The increase is driven by non‐financial news, particularly about legal issues and corporate social responsibility. Articles become significantly more negative in tone and generate stronger market reactions, indicating that employees increasingly share informative negative information with journalists. Further, we document increased interactions between employees and journalists, with more articles citing employees as sources. Our evidence suggests that employees are an important source of corporate information for journalists and that blanket NDAs can impede this channel. Overall, the study highlights an important trade‐off between protecting firms' confidential information and preserving transparency. Our findings suggest that boards, executives, and regulators should design employment confidentiality policies that protect legitimate proprietary information without suppressing the disclosure of misconduct that is important for market discipline and governance.

title_zh: 员工保密协议与企业新闻
abstract_zh: 本研究考察削弱员工保密协议（NDAs）是否会影响通过商业媒体流向资本市场的信息流。在州法律削弱与不当行为相关的保密协议后，相对于控制组企业，处理组企业的企业新闻显著增加。这一增加由非财务新闻驱动，尤其是关于法律问题和公司社会责任的新闻。文章语气显著变得更加负面，并引发更强的市场反应，表明员工越来越多地与记者分享具有信息含量的负面信息。此外，我们记录了员工与记者之间互动的增加，更多文章将员工列为信息来源。我们的证据表明，员工是记者获取企业信息的重要来源，而一刀切的保密协议可能阻碍这一渠道。总体而言，本研究凸显了保护企业机密信息与维护透明度之间的重要权衡。我们的发现表明，董事会、高管和监管者应设计雇佣保密政策，既能保护合法的专有信息，又不压制对市场纪律和治理至关重要的不当行为披露。

source_records.title: The Falling Roe and Relocation of Skilled Women
source_records.abstract: We examine the impact of abortion restrictions on the geographic mobility of college‐educated skilled women. Exploiting the staggered adoption of Targeted Regulation of Abortion Providers (TRAP) laws across US states that restrict women's access to abortion, we find that skilled women who relocate exhibit a greater propensity to move to states without TRAP laws (non‐TRAP states) than they did prior to the TRAP law adoption. This pattern is stronger among women in more liberal and less religious areas than among women in more conservative and more religious areas. These findings are consistent with the view that relocation decisions are often driven by the alignment between personal values and the local policy environment. We use the audit industry as a specific setting to address the implications for employer performance. We find that TRAP law adoption increases female auditor turnover at local offices relative to same‐firm offices in non‐TRAP states, and the resulting loss of human capital lowers audit quality.

title_zh: 罗伊案被推翻与技能女性的迁移
abstract_zh: 我们考察堕胎限制对受过大学教育的技能女性地理流动性的影响。利用美国各州交错采用针对堕胎服务提供者的定向监管（TRAP）法律——这些法律限制女性获得堕胎服务——我们发现，与TRAP法律通过之前相比，迁移的技能女性更倾向于迁往没有TRAP法律的州（非TRAP州）。这一模式在更自由派和宗教氛围较弱地区的女性中，比在更保守和宗教氛围较强地区的女性中更为明显。这些发现与以下观点一致：迁移决策往往由个人价值观与当地政策环境之间的一致性所驱动。我们以审计行业作为具体情境来探讨对雇主绩效的影响。我们发现，TRAP法律的通过提高了当地办事处相对于非TRAP州同一公司办事处的女性审计师流失率，由此造成的人力资本损失降低了审计质量。

source_records.title: Black Representation Through the University to Audit Firm Pipeline
source_records.abstract: This study evaluates the auditing profession's diversity outcomes by comparing diversity along the university to job pipeline for auditing and other comparison disciplines. My tests show consistently anomalous outcomes for Black people in the audit labor pipeline, and therefore, I focus the study on them. I find that, among college freshmen planning to major in accounting, Black college freshmen are significantly overrepresented relative to freshmen planning to major in other business disciplines or nonbusiness disciplines. I find evidence of Black underrepresentation in the audit labor pipeline at every subsequent point: among accounting bachelor's and master's degree recipients, in the audit firm recruiting process, and among young professional auditors. My evidence of especially sharp Black attrition from accounting degree programs is, to my knowledge, novel. Although I lack sufficient data to pinpoint the mechanisms causing this sharp Black attrition from accounting degree programs, my findings are inconsistent with the popular theory that Black college students are distinctively uninterested in pursuing accounting education. It is not yet possible to make well‐targeted and data‐driven policy prescriptions to counter Black attrition from accounting degree programs because its causes are not well understood. Universities could contribute to the diagnosis process by systematically collecting and distributing data characterizing when and why students select away from accounting. My findings on audit firm recruiting are inconsistent with popular theories that Black underrepresentation in audit firms is attributable to overtly racially biased recruiters or lower interest among Black accounting graduates in pursuing careers in audit firms. Rather, my findings conform best with unintentionally biased recruiting by audit firms, which appear to make recruiting investments using outdated definitions of school quality. My evidence suggests that campus‐recruiting leaders within audit firms have the opportunity to hire more Black auditors without reducing the quality of the schools from which they recruit.

I find evidence of Black underrepresentation in the audit labor pipeline at every subsequent point: among accounting bachelor's and master's degree recipients, in the audit firm recruiting process, and among young professional auditors. My evidence of especially sharp Black attrition from accounting degree programs is, to my knowledge, novel. Although I lack sufficient data to pinpoint the mechanisms causing this sharp Black attrition from accounting degree programs, my findings are inconsistent with the popular theory that Black college students are distinctively uninterested in pursuing accounting education. It is not yet possible to make well‐targeted and data‐driven policy prescriptions to counter Black attrition from accounting degree programs because its causes are not well understood. Universities could contribute to the diagnosis process by systematically collecting and distributing data characterizing when and why students select away from accounting. My findings on audit firm recruiting are inconsistent with popular theories that Black underrepresentation in audit firms is attributable to overtly racially biased recruiters or lower interest among Black accounting graduates in pursuing careers in audit firms. Rather, my findings conform best with unintentionally biased recruiting by audit firms, which appear to make recruiting investments using outdated definitions of school quality. My evidence suggests that campus‐recruiting leaders within audit firms have the opportunity to hire more Black auditors without reducing the quality of the schools from which they recruit.
title_zh: 从大学到审计事务所管道中的黑人代表性
abstract_zh: 本研究通过比较审计学科与其他对照学科从大学到就业管道中的多样性，评估审计行业的多样性结果。我的检验显示，黑人在审计劳动力管道中持续出现异常结果，因此我将研究聚焦于他们。我发现，在计划主修会计的大学新生中，黑人大学新生相对于计划主修其他商科或非商科学科的新生显著过度代表。我发现有证据表明，在审计劳动力管道的每一个后续节点上，黑人都代表性不足：在会计学士和硕士学位获得者中、在审计事务所招聘过程中，以及在年轻专业审计人员中。据我所知，关于黑人从会计学位项目中异常严重流失的证据是新颖的。尽管我缺乏足够数据来精确识别导致黑人从会计学位项目中严重流失的机制，但我的发现与一种流行理论不一致，即黑人大学生对追求会计教育特别不感兴趣。目前尚不可能制定有针对性的、数据驱动的政策处方来应对黑人从会计学位项目中的流失，因为其原因尚未被充分理解。大学可以通过系统性地收集和发布数据来为诊断过程作出贡献，这些数据刻画学生何时以及为何选择离开会计。我关于审计事务所招聘的发现与流行理论不一致，这些理论认为黑人在审计事务所中代表性不足可归因于招聘人员公开的种族偏见或黑人会计毕业生对追求审计事务所职业的兴趣较低。相反，我的发现最符合审计事务所无意偏见的招聘，这些事务所似乎使用过时的学校质量定义进行招聘投资。我的证据表明，审计事务所内部的校园招聘负责人有机会在不降低其招聘学校质量的情况下雇用更多黑人审计人员。

source_records.title: Do Key Audit Matters in Hong Kong and Mainland China Provide Incremental Information and Improve Audit Quality?
source_records.abstract: We examine the adoption of expanded audit reports that include key audit matters (KAMs) in Hong Kong (2016) and mainland China (2017). These jurisdictions are highly integrated and together constitute one of the largest economies to adopt the IAASB's reporting standards in a staggered fashion, while also differing in investor protection and legal enforcement. Using matched samples, pre‐post tests, and staggered difference‐in‐differences analyses with company fixed effects, we do not find compelling evidence that expanded audit reports affect market reactions or audit quality. These findings suggest a substantial gap between regulatory intent and implementation—on average, in these markets, KAMs do not appear to meet investors' demand for incremental information or to improve audit quality substantially. At the same time, our cross‐sectional evidence on KAM characteristics is more nuanced. A higher number of KAMs and the presence of novel or transaction‐specific KAMs are associated with stronger pricing of fundamentals, consistent with investors perceiving the related financial statements as better vetted. Yet a higher number of KAMs and novel KAMs are also associated with lower profitability persistence, consistent with these disclosures reflecting company risk and volatility. In contrast, industry‐common KAMs appear less relevant for valuation, consistent with investors discounting routine disclosures, even though they are associated with more persistent performance likely reflecting more stable industry conditions. Overall, our evidence suggests that mandating expanded audit reports alone may be of limited value, whereas better tailored KAM disclosures may still serve as signals of firm fundamentals and future performance.

title_zh: 香港和中国内地的关键审计事项是否提供增量信息并提高审计质量？
abstract_zh: 我们考察了香港（2016年）和中国内地（2017年）采用包含关键审计事项（KAMs）的扩展审计报告的情况。这两个司法管辖区高度一体化，共同构成了以交错方式采用国际审计与鉴证准则理事会（IAASB）报告准则的最大经济体之一，同时在投资者保护和法律执行方面存在差异。使用匹配样本、前后对比检验以及带有公司固定效应的交错双重差分分析，我们未发现令人信服的证据表明扩展审计报告影响市场反应或审计质量。这些发现表明监管意图与实施之间存在实质性差距——平均而言，在这些市场中，KAMs似乎既不能满足投资者对增量信息的需求，也不能大幅提高审计质量。与此同时，我们关于KAM特征的横截面证据则更为细致。KAM数量较多以及存在新颖或交易特定KAM与基本面定价更强相关，这与投资者认为相关财务报表得到更好审查的认知一致。然而，KAM数量较多和新颖KAM也与较低的盈利持续性相关，这与这些披露反映公司风险和波动性一致。相比之下，行业常见的KAM似乎与估值相关性较低，这与投资者对常规披露给予折价一致，尽管它们与更持续的业绩相关，可能反映更稳定的行业状况。总体而言，我们的证据表明，仅强制要求扩展审计报告可能价值有限，而更具针对性的KAM披露仍可作为公司基本面和未来业绩的信号。

source_records.title: Firm Investments in Employee‐Led Entrepreneurial Ventures
source_records.abstract: Firms increasingly support employee‐led startups by providing funding in exchange for equity. These investments create a dual role for employees, who pursue their entrepreneurial ventures as shared residual claimants while continuing to work on core tasks under incomplete fixed‐pay contracts. Although the investments align incentives within the startup, their effects on employees' effort in their core roles remain unclear. Using an experimental economics approach, I examine how a firm's investment decision affects employees' effort on core tasks. To isolate what is unique about equity investments, I use a non‐equity gift of equal monetary value as the baseline. The results show that employees reduce effort more when the firm denies a non‐equity gift than when it denies an equity investment. This difference arises because employees view a denied equity investment as the firm's business judgment based on risk and expected return, rather than as a failure to act generously. When funding in either form is provided, employees reciprocate positively, resulting in similarly high effort. Overall, the findings suggest that equity‐based entrepreneurship programs can help motivate effort on both startups and core tasks while mitigating the harm of rejecting employees' proposals.

title_zh: 企业对员工主导型创业项目的投资
abstract_zh: 企业越来越多地通过提供资金换取股权来支持员工主导的初创企业。这些投资为员工创造了双重角色：他们作为共享剩余索取权人推进自己的创业项目，同时继续在不完全固定薪酬合同下从事核心任务。尽管这些投资在初创企业内部对齐了激励，但其对员工在核心角色中努力程度的影响仍不明确。我采用实验经济学方法，考察企业的投资决策如何影响员工在核心任务上的努力。为分离出股权投资独特之处，我以等额货币价值的非股权赠与作为基准。结果表明，当企业拒绝一项非股权赠与相比拒绝一项股权投资时，员工会更多地降低努力。这一差异的产生是因为员工将拒绝股权投资视为企业基于风险和预期回报的商业判断，而非未能表现出慷慨。当以任一形式提供资金时，员工都会做出积极回报，从而产生同样高的努力。总体而言，研究结果表明，基于股权的创业项目有助于激励员工在初创企业和核心任务上的努力，同时减轻拒绝员工提案所带来的伤害。

source_records.title: Performance Manipulation as a Reaction to the Prevalence of Gossip: The Role of the Self‐Monitoring Trait
source_records.abstract: We examine how the prevalence of gossip about peers' performance (peer performance gossip), a form of informal communication, influences employees' performance manipulation. Gossip is often viewed as a mechanism that disciplines behavior and deters misconduct. Yet, it may also serve as a salient cue of social evaluation, heightening employees' concerns about appearing incompetent to others. We predict that the prevalence of peer performance gossip increases employees' fear of negative social evaluation, which in turn leads them to inflate their reported performance to protect their social image. We further predict that this effect is weaker for employees with higher self‐monitoring, as they are more adept at tailoring their behavior to social cues and managing impressions. Data from two field surveys and an experiment support our predictions. Peer performance gossip increases performance manipulation by heightening social image concerns, particularly among employees with lower self‐monitoring. We contribute to the accounting literature by uncovering a social motive for performance manipulation and highlighting how informal social dynamics can shape reporting behavior beyond formal control systems. Accordingly, leaders should explicitly consider gossip when designing compensation systems, training programs, and internal communication practices. If left unaddressed, gossip may encourage performance manipulation and distort performance evaluations.

title_zh: 作为对八卦普遍性反应的表现操纵：自我监控特质的作用
abstract_zh: 我们考察关于同事绩效的八卦（同事绩效八卦）——一种非正式沟通形式——的普遍性如何影响员工的表现操纵。八卦常被视为一种约束行为、阻止不当行为的机制。然而，它也可能作为一种社会评价的显著线索，加剧员工对在他人面前显得无能的担忧。我们预测，同事绩效八卦的普遍性会增加员工对负面社会评价的恐惧，进而促使他们夸大所报告的表现以保护自己的社会形象。我们进一步预测，这种效应对自我监控较高的员工较弱，因为他们更擅长根据社会线索调整行为并管理印象。来自两项实地调查和一项实验的数据支持了我们的预测。同事绩效八卦通过加剧社会形象担忧而增加表现操纵，尤其是在自我监控较低的员工中。我们通过揭示表现操纵的社会动机，并强调非正式社会动态如何能够在正式控制系统之外塑造报告行为，为会计文献做出贡献。因此，领导者在设计薪酬体系、培训项目和内部沟通实践时应明确考虑八卦。若不加处理，八卦可能助长表现操纵并扭曲绩效评价。

source_records.title: Lending Relationships Along Ownership Lines: Institutional Cross‐Ownership and Bank Loan Contracts
source_records.abstract: We find that banking relationships built through institutional cross‐ownership influence the granting of loans as well as loan contract terms. Firms that are newly added to institutional cross‐owners' portfolios are more likely to borrow from banks that previously issued loans to other firms within the same portfolio. These related banks charge lower loan interest spreads and offer greater loan amounts than other banks issuing loans to the same borrower. However, such loans also are more likely to include capital covenants in the presence of high shareholder–debtholder conflicts. Thus, lenders appear to value the benefits of common institutional ownership while still protecting themselves against potential risk shifting. The interest spread effect is stronger for borrowers with high information asymmetry, low accounting quality, more financial distress risk, and dedicated institutional common owners. These results are consistent with either direct information flows or indirect signaling effects and are robust to different fixed effects specifications as well as to an identification strategy that exploits common ownership stemming from financial institution mergers. title_zh: 沿着所有权界线的借贷关系：机构交叉持股与银行贷款合同
abstract_zh: 我们发现，通过机构交叉持股建立的银行关系会影响贷款的发放以及贷款合同条款。被新纳入机构交叉所有者投资组合的公司，更可能向此前已向同一投资组合内其他公司发放过贷款的银行借款。与向同一借款人发放贷款的其他银行相比，这些关联银行收取更低的贷款利率差，并提供更大的贷款金额。然而，在股东与债权人冲突较高的情况下，此类贷款也更可能包含资本契约。因此，贷款人似乎既看重共同机构所有权带来的好处，同时仍保护自身免受潜在的风险转移影响。对于信息不对称程度高、会计质量低、财务困境风险更大以及由专注型机构共同所有者持股的借款人而言，利率差效应更强。这些结果与直接信息流动或间接信号效应相一致，并且在不同固定效应设定下以及在使用金融机构合并所产生的共同所有权作为识别策略时均保持稳健。总体而言，我们的研究提供了证据，表明投资者网络在契约相关信息的产生和传播中发挥着有益作用，并凸显交叉持股是超越传统会计指标的契约效率的有利决定因素。

source_records.title: Intense Scrutiny of ICFR and Regulatory Compliance: Evidence From FDA ‐Regulated Firms
source_records.abstract: Mandatory audits of internal controls over financial reporting (ICFR), intended to strengthen financial reporting processes, may also have implications for broader organizational compliance systems. Increased scrutiny of financial controls could either enhance overall control quality, yielding benefits for nonfinancial controls, or induce firms to reallocate resources away from those areas. We exploit quasi‐exogenous variation in financial control scrutiny arising from (1) the initial implementation of ICFR audits, (2) the subsequent relaxation of ICFR auditing standards, and (3) the introduction of management assessments of financial controls absent concurrent ICFR audits, to examine how changes in external scrutiny affect Food and Drug Administration (FDA) inspection findings, an important form of regulatory noncompliance with direct public health implications. Our results show that the introduction of ICFR audits is associated with a reduction in FDA inspection findings; however, these benefits reverse when ICFR audit scrutiny declines. Mechanism analyses suggest that remediation of control deficiencies, investments in information systems, and expanded internal audit functions facilitate spillovers to compliance controls. Importantly, we find limited evidence that management assessments alone, without concurrent ICFR audits, generate similar spillover effects. Overall, our findings suggest that internal control systems operate as integrated organizational processes rather than isolated financial reporting mechanisms and that external scrutiny plays a critical role in enabling spillovers across control domains. These insights have implications for audit committees, auditors, regulators, and other stakeholders.

title_zh: 对ICFR与监管合规的严格审查：来自FDA监管企业的证据
abstract_zh: 对财务报告内部控制（ICFR）的强制审计旨在强化财务报告流程，但也可能对更广泛的组织合规体系产生影响。对财务控制的审查加强，既可能提升整体控制质量，从而为非财务控制带来益处，也可能促使企业将资源从这些领域重新配置出去。我们利用由以下情形产生的财务控制审查的准外生变异——（1）ICFR审计的初始实施，（2）随后ICFR审计标准的放宽，以及（3）在没有同步ICFR审计的情况下引入管理层对财务控制的评估——来考察外部审查的变化如何影响美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）的检查发现，这是一种具有直接公共卫生影响的重要监管不合规形式。我们的结果表明，ICFR审计的引入与FDA检查发现的减少相关；然而，当ICFR审计审查减弱时，这些益处会逆转。机制分析表明，控制缺陷的整改、信息系统的投资以及内部审计职能的扩展促进了向合规控制的溢出。重要的是，我们发现的证据有限，表明在没有同步ICFR审计的情况下，仅靠管理层评估就能产生类似的溢出效应。总体而言，我们的发现表明，内部控制系统作为整合的组织流程运作，而非孤立的财务报告机制，并且外部审查在促成跨控制领域的溢出方面发挥着关键作用。这些见解对审计委员会、审计师、监管机构及其他利益相关者具有启示意义。

source_records.title: Profits Lost in the Haze: Evidence From Wildfire Smoke
source_records.abstract: Whereas prior studies primarily examine how environmental shocks affect manufacturing, distribution, and supply chains, we examine a distinct and understudied channel: the effect of wildfire smoke on human capital operating from firm headquarters. Using satellite‐based smoke plume measures, we show that wildfire smoke exposure in a firm's headquarters county is associated with lower operating income, with effects strengthening as smoke becomes more frequent and severe. Exposure is associated with increased employee health concerns, higher employee turnover, and shorter tenure. The negative association is stronger for firms that rely more heavily on skilled employees, and it is concentrated in higher operating costs. Collectively, these findings are consistent with wildfire smoke impairing workforce stability and productivity. Our study points to the need for enhanced climate‐risk and human‐capital disclosures. It also informs HR managers' planning for absenteeism and employee well‐being, and helps investors, audit committees, and auditors better assess smoke‐related operating risks.

title_zh: 迷雾中损失的利润：来自野火烟雾的证据
abstract_zh: 以往研究主要考察环境冲击如何影响制造业、分销和供应链，而我们考察一个独特且研究不足的渠道：野火烟雾对企业总部运营的人力资本的影响。利用基于卫星的烟羽测量数据，我们表明，企业总部所在县暴露于野火烟雾与较低的营业利润相关，且随着烟雾变得更加频繁和严重，这种效应会增强。暴露与员工健康担忧增加、员工流动率上升和任期缩短相关。对于更依赖熟练员工的企业，这种负相关关系更强，并且集中于更高的运营成本。总体而言，这些发现与野火烟雾损害劳动力稳定性和生产率相一致。我们的研究指出需要加强气候风险和人力资本披露。它还为人力资源管理者规划缺勤和员工福祉提供信息，并帮助投资者、审计委员会和审计师更好地评估与烟雾相关的运营风险。

source_records.title: Staffing Leverage at the Audit Office and Audit Quality
source_records.abstract: The PCAOB posits that audit partner and manager involvement, primarily through greater supervision and review (“oversight”) of audit engagements, is an important determinant and indicator of audit quality. We test this notion by empirically examining the link between staffing leverage, as measured by an office's ratio of audit partners and managers to audit employees, and audit outcomes from 2008 to 2022. We find staffing leverage is associated with lower rates of client misstatements, comment letters, and PCAOB inspection deficiencies, suggesting higher audit quality. When disaggregated, the association pertains to both partners and nonpartner managers. This relation is stronger for more complex clients and for offices with better management. We also find that staffing leverage measured at the firm level predicts audit quality, and that both office‐ and firm‐level staffing leverage are incrementally informative of audit quality, suggesting disclosing audit oversight metrics at multiple levels could be beneficial. However, the association between firm‐level staffing leverage and audit quality is statistically detected only within Big 4 audits. These findings suggest that audit committees, investors, and regulators can use audit‐office partner‐staffing and manager‐staffing leverage as an informative indicator of audit quality, particularly for complex engagements.

When disaggregated, the association pertains to both partners and nonpartner managers. This relation is stronger for more complex clients and for offices with better management. We also find that staffing leverage measured at the firm level predicts audit quality, and that both office‐ and firm‐level staffing leverage are incrementally informative of audit quality, suggesting disclosing audit oversight metrics at multiple levels could be beneficial. However, the association between firm‐level staffing leverage and audit quality is statistically detected only within Big 4 audits. These findings suggest that audit committees, investors, and regulators can use audit‐office partner‐staffing and manager‐staffing leverage as an informative indicator of audit quality, particularly for complex engagements.

source_records.title: Voluntary Disclosure Through the Prominence of Risk Factors in the 10‐K
source_records.abstract: Prior research finds that the textual content of Item 1A risk factor disclosures in 10‐K filings provides valuable information about firm risk. However, less is known about whether the ordering of these disclosures conveys useful information. We examine whether the relative prominence of individual risk factors within Item 1A reflects firms' exposure to the underlying risks and predicts future adverse outcomes. Focusing on credit and goodwill risk disclosures, we find that risk factor prominence is associated with proxies for the underlying risks and predicts credit rating downgrades, bankruptcy filings, and goodwill impairments. We further find that prominence is more informative during periods of high information uncertainty, when the benefits of risk disclosure are predicted to be greater. Overall, our findings suggest that risk factor prominence offers a valuable signal of firm risk that complements the textual disclosures in Item 1A. Accordingly, investors, analysts, lenders, auditors, boards, and regulators should consider both the level of, and changes in, risk factor prominence when evaluating firm risk.

title_zh: 通过10-K中风险因素显著程度进行的自愿披露
abstract_zh: 先前研究发现，10-K申报文件中第1A项风险因素披露的文本内容提供了关于公司风险的有价值信息。然而，关于这些披露的排序是否传递有用信息，人们知之甚少。我们考察第1A项中个别风险因素的相对显著程度是否反映了公司对基础风险的暴露，并预测未来的不利结果。聚焦于信用风险和商誉风险披露，我们发现风险因素显著程度与基础风险的代理变量相关，并能预测信用评级下调、破产申请和商誉减值。我们进一步发现，在信息不确定性高的时期，当风险披露的收益被预测为更大时，显著程度更具信息含量。总体而言，我们的发现表明，风险因素显著程度提供了公司风险的有价值信号，补充了第1A项中的文本披露。因此，投资者、分析师、贷款人、审计师、董事会和监管者在评估公司风险时，应考虑风险因素显著程度的水平及其变化。

source_records.title: Personal Costs of Executive Turnovers
source_records.abstract: This study examines the income loss following forced CEO turnovers using income data from the official records at the Danish Tax Authority. We find that dismissed CEOs’ personal income is 40% lower in the five years following forced turnovers. The decline is driven by labor market outcomes: labor and entrepreneurial incomes decline, while other sources of income increase. We find larger declines in income for executives with poor performance during their tenures, consistent with the executive labor market being the main channel for the lower income. Overall, the findings suggest that executives face significant personal costs from forced turnovers.

title_zh: 高管更替的个人成本
abstract_zh: 本研究利用丹麦税务局官方记录中的收入数据，考察了被迫CEO更替后的收入损失。我们发现，被解职CEO的个人收入在被迫更替后的五年内降低了40%。这一下降由劳动力市场结果驱动：劳动收入和创业收入下降，而其他收入来源增加。我们发现，在任期间业绩不佳的高管收入下降幅度更大，这与高管劳动力市场是收入降低的主要渠道相一致。总体而言，研究结果表明，高管因被迫更替而面临巨大的个人成本。

source_records.title: M&As, Employee Costs, and Labor Reallocation
source_records.abstract: Mergers are associated with large and persistent earnings declines for incumbent employees in target firms. Linking employer‐employee administrative data with information on merger activity in Brazil, I find the negative effects concentrate on employees who exit target firms and reflect displacement in the short run and wage declines in the long run. Low‐skilled, managerial, and older employees fare worse. Overall, I conclude that mergers are followed by substantial reallocation costs reflecting losses of firm‐specific wage premiums, matching inefficiencies, and industry‐specific human capital depreciation, with employees transitioning to lower paying firms considered to be of lower productivity and employment value.

title_zh: 并购、员工成本与劳动力再配置
abstract_zh: 并购与目标企业现有员工大幅且持续的收益下降相关。通过将雇主—雇员行政数据与巴西并购活动信息相连接，我发现负面影响集中于退出目标企业的员工，并反映为短期内的岗位流失和长期内的工资下降。低技能、管理岗位和年龄较大的员工境况更差。总体而言，我得出结论：并购之后会出现显著的再配置成本，反映企业特定工资溢价的损失、匹配低效以及行业特定人力资本的贬值，员工流向被认为生产率和雇佣价值更低的低薪企业。

source_records.title: The Rising Tide Lifts Some Interest Rates: Climate Change, Natural Disasters, and Loan Pricing
source_records.abstract: Banks adjust loan spreads after observing natural disasters linked to climate change. We isolate this updating process by identifying loans to borrowers at risk of, but not directly affected by, such disasters. Loan spreads for these borrowers spike in both primary and secondary markets, while no such updating occurs for non–climate‐related disasters. Evidence suggests a heightened perceived credit risk, which nonetheless cannot fully explain the increase in rates. Taken altogether, increased spreads are explained primarily by salience bias, as they are short‐lived and amplified by media attention. This salience impacts financial decisions at bank‐dependent firms.

title_zh: 潮水上涨抬高了部分利率：气候变化、自然灾害与贷款定价
abstract_zh: 银行在观察到与气候变化相关的自然灾害后调整贷款利差。我们通过识别向面临此类灾害风险但未直接受其影响的借款人发放的贷款，分离出这一更新过程。这些借款人的贷款利差在一级和二级市场均大幅上升，而对于非气候相关的灾害则不会发生此类更新。证据表明，感知信用风险上升，但这仍无法完全解释利率的上升。总体而言，利差上升主要由显著性偏差解释，因为其持续时间短暂，并因媒体关注而被放大。这种显著性影响了依赖银行的企业的财务决策。

source_records.title: The Cross‐Section of Household Preferences
source_records.abstract: This paper estimates the cross‐sectional distribution of Epstein‐Zin preferences using the wealth and risky portfolio shares of a large panel of Swedish households. We find modestly heterogeneous risk aversion (standard deviation 0.97, median 7.50) and a meaningfully heterogeneous and right‐skewed time preference rate (TPR; standard deviation 7.31%, median 4.08%) and elasticity of intertemporal substitution (EIS; standard deviation 3.17, median 0.70). Risk aversion and the EIS are only very weakly negatively correlated. We estimate lower risk aversion for households with riskier labor income, and a higher TPR and lower EIS for households that enter our sample with low wealth.

title_zh: 家庭偏好的横截面分布
abstract_zh: 本文利用一个大型瑞典家庭面板的财富与风险资产组合份额，估计了Epstein-Zin偏好的横截面分布。我们发现风险厌恶存在适度异质性（标准差0.97，中位数7.50），时间偏好率（TPR）具有显著异质性且右偏（标准差7.31%，中位数4.08%），跨期替代弹性（EIS）也具有显著异质性（标准差3.17，中位数0.70）。风险厌恶与EIS之间仅存在非常微弱的负相关。我们估计，劳动收入风险更高的家庭风险厌恶更低，而进入样本时财富较低的家庭TPR更高、EIS更低。

source_records.title: Sequential Search for Corporate Bonds
source_records.abstract: Customers in over‐the‐counter (OTC) markets must find a counterparty to trade. Little is known about this process, however, because existing data consist of transaction records, which only reveal the outcome of a search. Using data from a trading platform for corporate bonds, we unpack the search process. We analyze how long it takes customers to trade and how dealers' offers evolve across repeated inquiries. We estimate that it takes two to three days to complete a transaction after an unsuccessful attempt, with substantial variation across trade and customer characteristics. Our analysis offers insights into the sources of trading delays in OTC markets.

title_zh: 公司债券的序贯搜索
abstract_zh: 场外（OTC）市场中的客户必须找到交易对手才能进行交易。然而，由于现有数据由交易记录构成，仅能揭示搜索的结果，人们对这一过程知之甚少。我们利用公司债券交易平台的数据，剖析了搜索过程。我们分析了客户完成交易所需的时间，以及交易商的报价在重复询价中如何演变。我们估计，在一次不成功的尝试之后，完成一笔交易需要两到三天，且这一时间在交易特征和客户特征之间存在显著差异。我们的分析为场外市场中交易延迟的来源提供了洞见。

source_records.title: Dynamic Self‐Fulfilling Fire Sales
source_records.abstract: Why do fire sales occur if many risks are hedgeable? We study a version of Brunnermeier and Sannikov (2014, American Economic Review 104, 379–421) in which all fundamental risks can be hedged frictionlessly. Our analysis shows that fire sales are inherently self‐fulfilling. Fundamental shocks can never cause fire sales, and an efficient, safe equilibrium exists. On the other hand, there exists an equilibrium in which agents coordinate fire sales on nonfundamental shocks. A simple refinement based on vanishingly small perceived fundamental risk eliminates the safe equilibrium and selects the fire‐sale equilibrium as the unique outcome.

We study a version of Brunnermeier and Sannikov (2014, American Economic Review 104, 379–421) in which all fundamental risks can be hedged frictionlessly. Our analysis shows that fire sales are inherently self‐fulfilling. Fundamental shocks can never cause fire sales, and an efficient, safe equilibrium exists. On the other hand, there exists an equilibrium in which agents coordinate fire sales on nonfundamental shocks. A simple refinement based on vanishingly small perceived fundamental risk eliminates the safe equilibrium and selects the fire‐sale equilibrium as the unique outcome.

title_zh: 动态的自我实现的抛售
abstract_zh: 如果许多风险是可对冲的，为什么还会发生抛售？我们研究Brunnermeier和Sannikov（2014，American Economic Review 104, 379–421）的一个版本，其中所有基本面风险都可以无摩擦地对冲。我们的分析表明，抛售本质上是自我实现的。基本面冲击永远不会引发抛售，并且存在一个有效、安全的均衡。另一方面，存在一个均衡，其中代理人围绕非基本面冲击协调抛售。基于消失般小的感知基本面风险的简单精炼消除了安全均衡，并选择抛售均衡作为唯一结果。

source_records.title: Do Equity and Options Markets Agree about Volatility?
source_records.abstract: We derive tight pricing kernel restrictions from options with same‐day expiration (“0DTEs”). These restrictions concern the volatility of small and frequent asset price moves that the equity and options markets must agree on in a frictionless economy. Their violation leads to pseudo‐arbitrage opportunities, characterized by nontrivial reward‐to‐risk ratios over arbitrarily short horizons and achieved by a combined position in 0DTEs and the underlying asset. Empirically, we find no evidence of feasible pseudo‐arbitrage opportunities, as transaction costs, estimation risk, and short‐term volatility risk prevent investors from taking advantage of small and infrequent disagreements about volatility between equity and options markets.

title_zh: 股票市场与期权市场对波动率的看法一致吗？
abstract_zh: 我们从当日到期期权（“0DTE”）中推导出严格的定价核限制。这些限制涉及小额且频繁的资产价格变动波动率，在无摩擦经济中，股票市场和期权市场必须对此达成一致。违反这些限制会导致伪套利机会，其特征是在任意短的期限内具有非平凡的收益风险比，并通过0DTE与标的资产的组合头寸来实现。实证上，我们没有发现可行的伪套利机会的证据，因为交易成本、估计风险和短期波动率风险阻止投资者利用股票市场与期权市场之间关于波动率的小额且不频繁的分歧。

source_records.title: Climate Change, Demand Uncertainty, and Firms' Investments: Evidence from Planned Power Plants
source_records.abstract: How does demand uncertainty affect firms' investment decisions? We examine this question in the context of electricity‐producing firms' planned investments in new power plants. We measure uncertainty about future electricity demand using plausibly exogenous variation in temperature projections across scientific climate models. The results show that uncertainty increases investment in power plants with flexible production technologies, while reducing investment in less flexible technologies. Overall, the net effect of uncertainty on investment is positive when firms have access to flexible investment opportunities. These findings are consistent with models in which production flexibility shapes the investment response to demand uncertainty.

title_zh: 气候变化、需求不确定性与企业投资：来自拟建电厂的证据
abstract_zh: 需求不确定性如何影响企业的投资决策？我们在发电企业新建电厂计划投资的背景下考察这一问题。我们利用各科学气候模型之间温度预测的看似外生变异来度量未来电力需求的不确定性。结果表明，不确定性增加了对具有灵活生产技术的电厂的投资，同时减少了对灵活性较低技术的投资。总体而言，当企业能够获得灵活的投资机会时，不确定性对投资的净效应为正。这些发现与生产灵活性塑造投资对需求不确定性反应的模型相一致。

source_records.title: Board Dynamics over the Startup Life Cycle
source_records.abstract: We explore the dynamics of venture capital (VC)‐backed startup boards using novel data on director entry, exit, and characteristics. At formation, a typical board is entrepreneur‐controlled. Independent directors join the median board after the second financing and hold a tie‐breaking vote. Their presence is particularly likely when potential VC‐entrepreneur conflicts are larger. At later stages, control switches to VCs and independent director characteristics change. These patterns align with key financial contracting theories, but also highlight unique roles of independent directors over the life cycle: mediation followed by advising. Independent directors thus represent another potential source of value‐add to startup performance.

title_zh: 创业生命周期中的董事会动态
abstract_zh: 我们利用关于董事进入、退出及特征的新颖数据，探讨了风险投资（VC）支持的初创企业董事会的动态。在成立时，典型的董事会由企业家控制。独立董事在第二轮融资后加入中位数董事会，并持有打破僵局的投票权。当潜在的风险投资家与企业家冲突较大时，独立董事的存在尤为可能。在后期阶段，控制权转移给风险投资家，独立董事的特征也随之改变。这些模式与关键的金融契约理论相一致，但也凸显了独立董事在生命周期中的独特作用：先是调解，随后是咨询。因此，独立董事代表了初创企业绩效的另一个潜在增值来源。

source_records.title: Discretionary Announcement Timing and Stock Returns
source_records.abstract: Discretionary announcement timing generates high conditional risk premia of stock returns and a pattern of negative drifts followed by positive jumps. Average announcement returns are much larger than unconditional risk premia. Capital Asset Pricing Model alphas turn negative when conditioning on nondisclosure because betas rise faster than risk premia prior to disclosures, but average announcement returns may appear to be too large relative to market risk when betas are estimated from past returns. The effects are amplified when multiple firms exercise discretion over the timing of correlated announcements. We present evidence that firms time earnings announcements in a manner consistent with our model.

title_zh: 自主决定的公告时机与股票收益
abstract_zh: 自主决定的公告时机产生了股票收益的高条件风险溢价，以及负漂移后跟随正跳跃的模式。平均公告收益远大于无条件风险溢价。当以未披露为条件时，资本资产定价模型阿尔法转为负值，因为在披露之前贝塔上升快于风险溢价，但当贝塔根据过去收益估计时，平均公告收益相对于市场风险可能显得过大。当多家公司对相关公告的时机行使自主决定权时，这些效应会被放大。我们提供的证据表明，公司选择收益公告时机的方式与我们的模型一致。

source_records.title: Marginal Q
source_records.abstract: We propose a new method to estimate the marginal value of capital under minimal assumptions. By combining asset prices with fundamentals, our method provides a quasi‐model‐free marginal q together with a simple correction for measurement error in (average) Tobin's Q using linear regressions. Marginal q yields plausible and robust estimates of adjustment costs and investment sensitivities to fundamentals. The widening gap between marginal q and Tobin's Q is driven primarily by market power and intangible capital. Our novel findings strongly support the neoclassical theory of investment and challenge the widespread use of Tobin's Q as proxy for investment opportunities.

title_zh: 边际Q
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种在最小假设下估计资本边际价值的新方法。通过将资产价格与基本面相结合，我们的方法提供了一个准无模型的边际q，并利用线性回归对（平均）托宾Q中的测量误差进行了简单校正。边际q对调整成本以及投资对基本面的敏感性给出了合理且稳健的估计。边际q与托宾Q之间不断扩大的差距主要由市场势力和无形资本驱动。我们的新发现有力地支持了新古典投资理论，并对广泛使用托宾Q作为投资机会代理变量的做法提出了质疑。

source_records.title: The Unintended Consequences of #MeToo: Evidence from Research Collaborations in Economics and Finance
source_records.abstract: How did #MeToo alter collaboration between women and men? I show junior female researchers start fewer projects after #MeToo. A decrease in collaborations with male coauthors—especially new senior male coauthors at the same institution—largely explains the decline. The decrease is larger at universities with higher perceived harassment accusation risk and smaller where both women and men publicly express greater awareness of gender issues. I find no evidence that reduced collaboration improves research outcomes for junior female researchers. The results suggest that #MeToo led to a breakdown in trust that came at a cost for junior women's career opportunities.

title_zh: #MeToo的意外后果：来自经济学与金融学研究合作的证据
abstract_zh: #MeToo如何改变了女性与男性之间的合作？我表明，#MeToo之后，初级女性研究人员开始的项目更少。与男性合著者——尤其是同一机构中新加入的资深男性合著者——合作的减少在很大程度上解释了这一下降。在感知的骚扰指控风险较高的大学，这一下降更大；而在女性和男性都公开表达对性别问题有更高意识的大学，这一下降更小。我没有发现任何证据表明合作减少改善了初级女性研究人员的研究成果。结果表明，#MeToo导致了信任的破裂，而这以初级女性的职业机会为代价。

source_records.title: Can Small Businesses Survive Chapter 11?
source_records.abstract: A majority of small U.S. businesses attempting to reorganize in bankruptcy fail to do so. Subchapter V of Chapter 11 (SubV) streamlines bankruptcy for small firms by reducing bankruptcy costs and negotiation frictions, and enables entrepreneurs to retain ownership. We show that many businesses reorganize under SubV that otherwise would liquidate. Creditor recoveries and postbankruptcy survival rates are at least as high in SubV as in traditional Chapter 11s. Our results show the increase in reorganizations is not associated with continuation of unviable firms, and that creditors are not harmed by a shift in bargaining power toward small business owners.

source_records.title: Can Small Businesses Survive Chapter 11?
source_records.abstract: A majority of small U.S. businesses attempting to reorganize in bankruptcy fail to successfully do so. Subchapter V of Chapter 11 was introduced in 2020 for firms with less than $7.5 million in liabilities to streamline the process by reducing bankruptcy costs and negotiation frictions, and enabling entrepreneurs to retain their ownership. Employing regression-discontinuity and difference-in-differences designs, we show that many small businesses reorganize under the new procedures that otherwise would have been liquidated. Further, expected creditor recoveries and post-bankruptcy survival rates are at least as high in Subchapter V as in similar traditional small business reorganizations. Our results show that the increased ability to preserve small businesses is not associated with a bias toward continuing unviable firms, and that creditors are not harmed by a shift in bargaining power toward small business owners.

source_records.title: Longevity, Health, and Housing Risk Management in Retirement
source_records.abstract: Annuities, long‐term care insurance, and reverse mortgages remain puzzlingly unpopular to manage post‐retirement longevity, health, and housing price risks. We use a flexible life‐cycle model structurally estimated with a unique stated‐preference survey experiment of Canadian households to understand why. Key factors include high risk aversion, concern over long‐run risks, strong discounting of valuation in disability states, imperfect housing substitutability, and bequest motives. The remaining disinterest is accounted for by information frictions and inertia. We also document evidence of public insurance crowding out, spousal co‐insurance, and responsiveness to product bundling.

title_zh: 退休中的长寿、健康与住房风险管理
abstract_zh: 年金、长期护理保险和反向抵押贷款在管理退休后的长寿、健康和房价风险方面仍然令人费解地不受欢迎。我们使用一个灵活的生命周期模型，该模型通过一项针对加拿大家庭的独特陈述性偏好调查实验进行结构估计，以理解其中的原因。关键因素包括高风险厌恶、对长期风险的担忧、对残疾状态下估值的强烈折现、不完全的住房可替代性以及遗赠动机。剩余的不感兴趣可由信息摩擦和惯性解释。我们还记录了公共保险挤出、配偶共同保险以及对产品捆绑的响应性的证据。

source_records.title: The Market for ESG Ratings
source_records.abstract: We present a model of competition between environmental, social, and governance (ESG) raters who acquire information about multiple unrelated categories and sell ratings. Raters specializing in different categories maximize the amount of information transmitted and surplus, and can be an equilibrium outcome. When investors place a high value on ESG performance across multiple categories, the unique equilibrium is for the raters to generalize—splitting their effort among the categories, resulting in less informative ratings. Greenwashing by firms can make generalization the only equilibrium. We also demonstrate that specialization maximizes ratings disagreement, and thus empirical measures of disagreement may be poor measures of surplus.

title_zh: ESG评级市场
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个环境、社会和治理（ESG）评级机构之间竞争的模型，这些评级机构获取关于多个不相关类别的信息并出售评级。专注于不同类别的评级机构能够最大化所传递的信息量和剩余，并且可以成为一种均衡结果。当投资者高度重视多个类别上的ESG表现时，唯一的均衡是评级机构进行泛化——将努力分散到各个类别中，导致评级的信息量降低。企业的漂绿行为可能使泛化成为唯一的均衡。我们还证明，专业化最大化了评级分歧，因此分歧的实证度量可能是不良的剩余度量。

source_records.title: Reference‐Dependent Preferences and Sentiment‐Driven Asset Prices
source_records.abstract: This paper studies asset pricing under expectations‐based reference‐dependent preferences in a general equilibrium framework. We show that reference‐dependent preferences can generate self‐fulfilling risk panics, producing sentiment‐driven asset price fluctuations through a feedback loop between current prices and perceived future downside risk—dynamics impossible under standard expected utility. The model helps explain empirical puzzles including (i) excess volatility, (ii) asymmetric volatility, (iii) asymmetric sentiment over the business cycle, (iv) excess asset price comovement, and (v) weak correlations between stock returns and economic fundamentals, alongside a sizable equity premium. Additional empirical evidence based on closed‐end fund discounts and quantitative analysis support the theory.

title_zh: 参照依赖偏好与情绪驱动的资产价格
abstract_zh: 本文在一般均衡框架下研究基于预期的参照依赖偏好下的资产定价。我们表明，参照依赖偏好能够产生自我实现的风险恐慌，通过当前价格与感知的未来下行风险之间的反馈循环，产生情绪驱动的资产价格波动——这种动态在标准期望效用下不可能出现。该模型有助于解释若干实证谜题，包括：(i) 过度波动，(ii) 非对称波动，(iii) 商业周期中的非对称情绪，(iv) 资产价格的过度共同变动，以及 (v) 股票收益与经济基本面之间的弱相关，同时伴随可观的股权溢价。基于封闭式基金折价的额外实证证据以及定量分析支持该理论。

source_records.title: O*NET Plus: A Review and Organizing Framework Extending O*NET’s Content Model in Management Research
source_records.abstract: The Occupational Information Network (O*NET) is a database of occupational descriptors sponsored by the U.S. Department of Labor. Since its release around the turn of the century, O*NET has taken on a broad and important role in management and organizational research as a key data source for occupational characteristics. It is common practice for researchers to combine or adapt descriptors from O*NET’s content model to measure constructs that O*NET does not capture directly (e.g., job complexity, emotional labor demands). This practice has enabled a great deal of research and poses potential extensions to O*NET’s content model, but has also come with challenges, including the proliferation of redundant measures with varying levels of validation. The purpose of this review is to synthesize the studies using O*NET-based measures and curate a database of measures with considerable evidence supporting their validity. In doing so, we contribute to the literature in three ways: (1) we introduce an extended content model that we call “O*NET Plus” and offer it as an expanded organizing framework for occupational description; (2) we review evidence for the psychometric soundness of O*NET Plus measures, highlight those with considerable evidence, and amass these measures in a central location to offer a “one-stop-shop” for researchers looking to leverage O*NET Plus; and (3) we offer guidance and implications for further expansions to O*NET Plus.

title_zh: O*NET Plus：一个在管理研究中扩展O*NET内容模型的综述与组织框架
abstract_zh: 职业信息网络（O*NET）是由美国劳工部资助的一个职业描述符数据库。自世纪之交发布以来，O*NET在管理与组织研究中扮演了广泛而重要的角色，成为职业特征的关键数据来源。研究者的常见做法是结合或改编O*NET内容模型中的描述符，以测量O*NET并未直接捕捉的构念（例如工作复杂性、情绪劳动需求）。这一做法促成了大量研究，并为O*NET内容模型带来了潜在的扩展，但也伴随着挑战，包括具有不同程度验证的冗余测量工具的激增。本综述的目的是综合使用基于O*NET的测量工具的研究，并整理一个数据库，收录有相当证据支持其效度的测量工具。在此过程中，我们以三种方式对文献做出贡献：（1）我们引入一个扩展的内容模型，称之为“O*NET Plus”，并将其作为职业描述的扩展组织框架；（2）我们回顾O*NET Plus测量工具心理测量学稳健性的证据，突出那些有相当证据的测量工具，并将这些测量工具汇集于一个中心位置，为希望利用O*NET Plus的研究者提供“一站式”服务；（3）我们为O*NET Plus的进一步扩展提供指导与启示。

source_records.title: Bodily Data Control, Human Agency Threats, and Job Insecurity
source_records.abstract: Across contemporary workplaces, organizations are increasingly deploying biometric technologies that capture, analyze, and act upon workers’ physiological and behavioral data, including heart rate variability, movement patterns, and keystroke dynamics. These technologies do not merely monitor workers; they introduce a qualitatively distinct form of managerial authority that is shaping perceptions of employees’ future organizational standing. We term this phenomenon bodily data control, defined as the organizational expectation that workers’ bodily data constitutes a legitimate input into evaluation, coordination, and intervention. We contend that bodily data control threatens a worker’s ability to think, plan, and act, which elicits job insecurity. Job insecurity refers to the perceived threat to the stability and continuity of one’s employment. We propose a theoretical model in which bodily data control threatens three dimensions of human agency: interpretive agency, moral agency, and instrumental agency. We theorize that these agency threats manifest experientially as perceived creepiness, affronts to inherent and meritocratic dignity, and reduced job autonomy, respectively, each of which elicits job insecurity through a distinct causal pathway. Our theoretical model and propositions contribute to job insecurity scholarship by reframing technology-induced job insecurity as a function of managerial authority over bodily data, rather than task displacement alone. We also contribute to broader management conversations regarding human agency, algorithmic governance, and the ethical treatment of workers in an era of pervasive surveillance.

title_zh: 身体数据控制、人类能动性威胁与工作不安全感
abstract_zh: 在当代职场中，组织越来越多地部署生物识别技术，以捕获、分析并作用于员工的心理生理与行为数据，包括心率变异性、运动模式和击键动态。这些技术不仅仅监控员工；它们引入了一种性质上截然不同的管理权威形式，正在塑造员工对自身未来组织地位的认识。我们将这一现象称为身体数据控制，其定义为组织期望员工的身体数据构成评估、协调与干预的合法输入。我们认为，身体数据控制威胁到员工思考、计划和行动的能力，从而引发工作不安全感。工作不安全感是指对自身就业稳定性与连续性的感知威胁。我们提出一个理论模型，其中身体数据控制威胁人类能动性的三个维度：解释性能动性、道德能动性和工具性能动性。我们理论化地认为，这些能动性威胁分别以感知到的诡异感、对固有尊严与精英制尊严的冒犯以及工作自主性的降低等形式在经验中显现，而每一种都通过一条独特的因果路径引发工作不安全感。我们的理论模型与命题为工作不安全感研究作出贡献，其方式是将技术引发的工作不安全感重新界定为对身体的數據的管理权威的函数，而不仅仅是任务替代。我们还为关于人类能动性、算法治理以及普遍监控时代对员工伦理对待的更广泛管理讨论作出贡献。

source_records.title: Digital Institutions and Occupational Fraud
source_records.abstract: How do a country’s digital institutions influence the magnitude of occupational fraud within firms? Leveraging and extending the institution-based view, we address this understudied question by conceptualizing digital institutions as a new genre of institutions that condition the deterrence calculus within firms. We define digital institutions as the foundational structures and resources that shape a country’s digital environment along three key dimensions: (1) digital infrastructure, (2) digital governance, and (3) digital innovation. While strengthening digital institutions has become a priority for policymakers worldwide, the unintended consequences of doing so, such as the potential to facilitate occupational fraud within firms, remain insufficiently understood. Using a unique dataset of 3,974 cases from 41 countries, we find that digital infrastructure is linked to higher fraud magnitude in firms, whereas digital governance is associated with lower occupational fraud magnitude. Our analysis further uncovers the nuanced ways in which digital institutions condition the effectiveness of firm-level internal controls. Overall, policymakers must recognize that digital institutions are a “double-edged sword,” as developing digital infrastructure without reinforcing digital governance can negate efforts to control occupational fraud at the firm level.

title_zh: 数字制度与职业欺诈
abstract_zh: 一个国家的数字制度如何影响企业内职业欺诈的严重程度？我们利用并拓展基于制度的视角，通过将数字制度概念化为一种新型制度来回应这一尚未得到充分研究的问题，这种制度会制约企业内部的威慑权衡。我们将数字制度定义为沿着三个关键维度塑造一国数字环境的基础结构与资源：（1）数字基础设施，（2）数字治理，（3）数字创新。尽管加强数字制度已成为全球政策制定者的优先事项，但这样做所带来的意外后果，例如可能助长企业内职业欺诈，仍未得到充分理解。我们使用来自41个国家的3974个案例的独特数据集发现，数字基础设施与企业中更高的欺诈严重程度相关，而数字治理则与更低的职业欺诈严重程度相关。我们的分析进一步揭示了数字制度制约企业层面内部控制有效性的微妙方式。总体而言，政策制定者必须认识到，数字制度是一把“双刃剑”，因为发展数字基础设施而不加强数字治理，可能会抵消在企业层面控制职业欺诈的努力。

source_records.title: Make the Alliance Personal: A Dependence Framework of Managerial Personal Tie Activation in Alliance Management
source_records.abstract: In this study, we explore an intriguing yet understudied question: Would top managers decide to activate personal ties to manage their firms’ alliances? We address this question by synthesizing the insights of the research on personal tie activation and resource dependence theory to develop a nuanced theoretical framework on the mechanisms underlying top managers’ personal tie activation decisions in alliance management. We highlight that the interdependence features between two alliance partner firms (i.e., mutual dependence, power imbalance, interpartner competition, and the interactions thereof) together shape the partner firms’ relational dynamics in the value creation and value appropriation in their alliance. Accordingly, these features determine the potential benefits and costs for top managers of the partner firms to activate their personal ties to manage this alliance, both for their firms and for themselves. We draw empirical evidence from a field study with 244 alliances between Chinese firms and an experimental vignette study with 212 real-world managers in China. Results of our analyses support our predictions, with a few intriguing exceptions. We derive valuable implications for theory and practice.

title_zh: 让联盟个人化：联盟管理中管理者个人关系激活的依赖框架
abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们探讨了一个有趣但尚未得到充分研究的问题：高层管理者是否会决定激活个人关系来管理其公司的联盟？我们通过综合个人关系激活研究与资源依赖理论的洞见来回应这一问题，从而构建一个关于高层管理者在联盟管理中个人关系激活决策背后机制的细致理论框架。我们强调，两个联盟伙伴企业之间的相互依赖特征（即相互依赖、权力失衡、伙伴间竞争及其交互作用）共同塑造了伙伴企业在联盟价值创造与价值获取中的关系动态。相应地，这些特征决定了伙伴企业的高层管理者激活其个人关系来管理该联盟时，对其企业及对其自身而言的潜在收益与成本。我们从一项涉及中国企业内部244个联盟的实地研究以及一项有中国212名现实管理者参与的实验性情景研究中获取经验证据。我们的分析结果支持了我们的预测，但也有一些有趣的例外。我们从中得出了对理论与实践有价值的启示。

source_records.title: The Anatomy of Earnings Conference Calls: An Integrative Framework for Management Research
source_records.abstract: The use of earnings conference calls in management research has exploded over recent years, yet insights remain fragmented due to differing assumptions about how calls should be analyzed and interpreted. To synthesize this work, we review 207 articles across management, accounting, and finance journals and map how prior studies have drawn on specific call components—structural attributes, prepared remarks, and question-and-answer exchanges. Building on this anatomical mapping, we inductively identify three epistemic roles through which earnings calls have been mobilized in management research: communicative disclosure (“window”), performative communication (“stage”), and communicative trace (“fingerprint”). Each role reflects distinct assumptions about how earnings calls reveal, enact, or encode managerial and organizational phenomena, and each highlights different opportunities for future theorizing. By making these inferential logics explicit, our framework provides a conceptual foundation for more precise and cumulative use of earnings conference calls as a data source in management scholarship and outlines promising areas for future research.

title_zh: 盈余电话会议的解构：管理研究的一个整合性框架
abstract_zh: 近年来，盈余电话会议在管理研究中的使用呈爆炸式增长，然而，由于对电话会议应如何被分析和解读存在不同假设，相关洞见仍显零散。为综合这一领域的研究，我们回顾了管理、会计与金融期刊上的207篇文章，并梳理了以往研究如何利用电话会议的特定组成部分——结构性特征、事先准备的发言以及问答交流。在这一解构性映射的基础上，我们归纳性地识别出盈余电话会议在管理研究中被调动的三种认识论角色：沟通性披露（“窗口”）、表演性沟通（“舞台”）以及沟通性痕迹（“指纹”）。每种角色都反映了关于盈余电话会议如何揭示、演绎或编码管理者与组织现象的独特假设，且各自凸显了不同的未来理论化机遇。通过明确这些推断逻辑，我们的框架为在管理学术中更精确、更具累积性地将盈余电话会议用作数据来源提供了概念基础，并勾勒出有前景的未来研究方向。

source_records.title: A Multidimensional Model of Entrepreneurial Career Success: A Literature Review and Research Agenda
source_records.abstract: People are choosing to pursue entrepreneurship as a career at increasing rates; yet, we lack an overarching conceptualization of entrepreneurial career success. Instead, scholars rely on a fragmented set of measures and outcomes, limiting cumulative knowledge about the factors that shape persistence and long-term success in entrepreneurial careers. To address this gap, we integrate career success and entrepreneurship research to develop a multidimensional model of entrepreneurial career success. Drawing on an empirically validated multidimensional framework from career literature, we organize the variety of individual success measures that have been used in the entrepreneurship literature, distinguishing entrepreneurial career success from related constructs such as venture performance and well-being. We further identify entrepreneurship-specific dimensions, including legacy and venture satisfaction, that reflect the heterogeneity of entrepreneurial careers and extend existing career success models. Using the ability-motivation-opportunity (AMO) framework, we review antecedents of entrepreneurial career success and suggest patterns of relationships with different objective and subjective success dimensions. We conclude by presenting an integrative model of antecedents, mechanisms, and boundary conditions to guide future research on entrepreneurial career success.

title_zh: 创业生涯成功的多维模型：文献综述与研究议程
abstract_zh: 人们正以越来越高的比例选择将创业作为职业；然而，我们缺乏对创业生涯成功的总体性概念化。相反，学者们依赖一套碎片化的测量指标和结果，这限制了对塑造创业生涯中坚持与长期成功之因素的累积性知识。为弥补这一空白，我们整合生涯成功与创业研究，构建了一个创业生涯成功的多维模型。借鉴生涯文献中一个经实证验证的多维框架，我们对创业文献中使用过的各种个体成功测量指标进行组织，将创业生涯成功与创业绩效和幸福感等相关构念区分开来。我们进一步识别出创业特有的维度，包括传承和创业满意度，这些维度反映了创业生涯的异质性，并扩展了现有的生涯成功模型。运用能力—动机—机会（AMO）框架，我们回顾了创业生涯成功的前因，并提出了其与不同客观和主观成功维度之间关系模式的建议。最后，我们提出了一个关于前因、机制和边界条件的整合模型，以指导未来关于创业生涯成功的研究。

source_records.title: Making Words Count: Computational Linguistics in Management Research
source_records.abstract: In recent years, a rapidly growing number of management scholars are using computational linguistics (CL) to analyze vast corpora of naturally occurring organizational language. Yet the rapid adoption of CL methods has outpaced the development of shared standards for linking theoretical constructs, linguistic data, and computational measurement. We synthesize 353 articles published in leading management journals for 2013–2025, identifying four recurring challenges shaping the credibility of CL-based research: misalignment between constructs and textual corpora, unnecessary model complexity, the opacity of large language model workflows, and insufficient transparency in reporting. Building on these patterns, we develop four integrative design principles—construct-language fit, minimal sufficient complexity, LLM sensitivity and auditability, and disclosure-as-assessability—and identify key research implications that reposition CL as a theoretically consequential lens for management scholarship.

title_zh: 让文字发挥作用：管理研究中的计算语言学
abstract_zh: 近年来，越来越多的管理学学者正在使用计算语言学（CL）来分析大量自然产生的组织语言语料库。然而，CL方法的迅速采用已超过了将理论构念、语言数据和计算测量联系起来的共享标准的发展速度。我们综合了2013—2025年发表于领先管理学期刊的353篇文章，识别出四个反复出现、影响基于CL研究可信度的挑战：构念与文本语料库之间的错位、不必要的模型复杂性、大语言模型工作流程的不透明性，以及报告透明度的不足。基于这些模式，我们提出四项整合性设计原则——构念—语言契合、最小充分复杂性、LLM敏感性与可审计性，以及披露即可评估性——并识别出关键的研究启示，从而将CL重新定位为一种对管理学术具有理论重要性的视角。

source_records.title: The Impact of Strategic Leaders’ International Experience on Organizations: An Integrative Review and Multilevel Framework
source_records.abstract: Internationally experienced business leaders bring distinct human capital, social capital, and cognitive schemas into organizations, influence strategic orientation through their decision-making, and in turn shape organizations’ strategies and performance. The impact of the international experience (IE) of an organization’s upper echelon has been studied in various bodies of management literature, varying in terms of the theoretical perspectives, conceptualizations of the IE construct, and outcomes considered. However, the effects are not straightforward with regard to which elements of IE affect which aspects of organizational dynamics, and how. This review integrates separate streams of organizational research to develop a more holistic understanding of the role of the IE held by strategic leaders such as chief executive officers, entrepreneurial founders, top management teams, and boards of directors, and its impact on organizational strategies and performance. We refine the conceptualization of the IE construct at multiple levels of analysis and explore cross-level mechanisms suggested by multiple theories to develop an integrative framework that links strategic leaders’ IE to organizational decisions, strategies, and performance. On this basis, we propose an agenda for future research.

title_zh: 战略领导者的国际经验对组织的影响：一项整合性综述与多层次框架
abstract_zh: 具有国际经验的商业领袖将独特的人力资本、社会资本和认知图式带入组织，通过其决策影响战略导向，进而塑造组织的战略与绩效。组织高层梯队的国际经验（IE）的影响已在多个管理文献领域中得到研究，这些研究在理论视角、IE构念的概念化以及所考察的结果方面各不相同。然而，关于IE的哪些要素影响组织动态的哪些方面以及如何影响，其效应并不直接明了。本综述整合了组织研究中相互分离的流派，以更全面地理解首席执行官、创业创始人、高层管理团队和董事会等战略领导者所拥有的IE的作用，及其对组织战略与绩效的影响。我们在多个分析层次上完善了IE构念的概念化，并探索了多种理论所提示的跨层次机制，以构建一个将战略领导者的IE与组织决策、战略和绩效联系起来的整合性框架。在此基础上，我们提出了未来研究的议程。

source_records.title: Understanding the Individual-Level Consequences of Strikes: A Systematic Review and Future Research Directions
source_records.abstract: Strikes are a recurring workplace phenomenon that affects strikers, their families, and managers, but also others such as commuters. To date, studies examining individual-level effects of strikes have been scattered across different fields of study. This systematic literature review summarizes studies on these effects and on how unaffected third parties, such as the public, evaluate strikes. We conducted searches in four databases. The 72 included studies show that strikes can have detrimental effects, for example, on psychological health, but these can be decreased with resources such as social support. Based on the existing literature, we developed the comprehensive strike aftermath framework as an overarching framework in which we incorporate avenues for future research. We conclude that research on this work phenomenon is still scarce and future research on long-lasting effects of strikes on managers’ and employees’ health and work attitudes is needed.

title_zh: 理解罢工的个体层面后果：一项系统性综述与未来研究方向
abstract_zh: 罢工是一种反复出现的工作场所现象，不仅影响罢工者、其家人和管理者，还影响通勤者等其他人群。迄今为止，考察罢工个体层面影响的研究分散于不同研究领域。本系统性文献综述总结了关于这些影响的研究，以及未受影响的第三方（如公众）如何评价罢工。我们在四个数据库中进行了检索。纳入的72项研究表明，罢工可能产生不利影响，例如对心理健康的影响，但这些影响可以通过社会支持等资源而减轻。基于现有文献，我们构建了综合性的罢工后续框架，作为总体框架，并在其中纳入了未来研究的方向。我们得出结论：关于这一工作现象的研究仍然稀缺，未来需要研究罢工对管理者和员工健康与工作态度的长期影响。

source_records.title: How Followers Respond to Leader Differentiation: The Importance of Considering All Leader Differentiation Properties
source_records.abstract: A central tenet of many leadership theories is that leaders treat their followers differently. Although leader differentiation is ubiquitous, its effects on leaders and followers are not well understood and theory and research have not simultaneously considered its three key properties: Leader–member exchange (LMX) differentiation, LMX quality, and LMX social comparison. We developed a theoretical model in which these three properties interact to influence followers’ supervisory interactional justice perceptions and subsequently their supervisor-directed deviance and supervisor-directed organizational citizenship behaviors (OCBs). To test our model, we conducted a pre-registered experiment (Study 1), a single-level, multi-wave study (Study 2), and a multilevel, multi-wave, multisource study (Study 3). Results consistently supported our theoretical model. First, LMX differentiation indirectly influenced supervisor-directed deviance and OCBs via supervisory interactional justice. Second, the three leader differentiation properties interacted to predict supervisory interactional justice. Specifically, when LMX quality and LMX social comparison were both high, the negative impact of LMX differentiation on followers’ supervisory interactional justice perceptions was the weakest and did not reliably differ from zero. Third, when LMX quality and LMX social comparison were both high, LMX differentiation’s positive indirect effect on supervisor-directed deviance, and its negative indirect effect on supervisor-directed OCBs, via supervisory interactional justice perceptions, were the weakest and not reliably different from zero. These are among the first studies to simultaneously theorize and investigate the interactive effects of the three central properties of leader differentiation, and to demonstrate its effects for both followers and leaders.

title_zh: 追随者如何回应领导者差异化：考虑所有领导者差异化属性的重要性
abstract_zh: 许多领导力理论的一个核心原则是，领导者会区别对待其追随者。尽管领导者差异化普遍存在，但其对领导者和追随者的影响尚未得到充分理解，理论与研究也未同时考虑其三个关键属性：领导—成员交换（LMX）差异化、LMX质量和LMX社会比较。我们构建了一个理论模型，其中这三个属性相互作用，影响追随者的主管互动公平感知，进而影响其针对主管的越轨行为和针对主管的组织公民行为（OCBs）。为检验我们的模型，我们进行了一项预注册实验（研究1）、一项单层次多波研究（研究2）和一项多层次、多波、多来源研究（研究3）。结果一致支持我们的理论模型。首先，LMX差异化通过主管互动公平间接影响针对主管的越轨行为和OCBs。其次，三个领导者差异化属性相互作用以预测主管互动公平。具体而言，当LMX质量和LMX社会比较均高时，LMX差异化对追随者主管互动公平感知的负面影响最弱，且与零无可靠差异。第三，当LMX质量和LMX社会比较均高时，LMX差异化通过主管互动公平感知对针对主管的越轨行为的正向间接效应，以及对针对主管的OCBs的负向间接效应最弱，且与零无可靠差异。这些是首批同时理论化并研究领导者差异化三个核心属性交互效应，并展示其对追随者和领导者影响的研究之一。

source_records.title: Survival Is Triumph Enough: Rhythmic Resilience Amid Chronic Adversity and Acute Shocks
source_records.abstract: Contexts of adversity generate a wide range of challenges that expose entrepreneurs to compounding hardship yet paradoxically stimulate entrepreneurship as a means of regaining control. Existing research often portrays adversity in two distinct ways, either as a one-time disruptive event or as a persistent condition of the same underlying hardship, overlooking how adversity increasingly unfolds as chronic adversity compounded by multiple acute shocks—a setting that characterizes the lived reality of many entrepreneurs in today’s turbulent world. In such contexts, entrepreneurial resilience is not oriented toward recovery or thriving but toward enduring recurring crises, resource scarcity, and persistent uncertainty. We conducted an inductive, longitudinal study of 32 displaced entrepreneurs living in conflict-affected regions of Iraq. Our analysis reveals a process model of rhythmic resilience in a context of chronic adversity compounded by acute shocks. We show that resilience unfolds through dynamic cycles of withdrawal, reengagement, and adaptation over time that sustain survival across household, venture, and community levels. Yet these processes entail difficult trade-offs, giving rise to a resilience–survival paradox in which entrepreneurs protect survival at the expense of personal well-being, business growth, and social ties.

source_records.title: Survival Is Triumph Enough: Rhythmic Resilience Amid Chronic Adversity and Acute Shocks
source_records.abstract: Contexts of adversity generate a wide range of challenges that expose entrepreneurs to compounding hardship yet paradoxically stimulate entrepreneurship as a means of regaining control. Existing research often portrays adversity in two distinct ways, either as a one-time disruptive event or as a persistent condition of the same underlying hardship, overlooking how adversity increasingly unfolds as chronic adversity compounded by multiple acute shocks—a setting that characterizes the lived reality of many entrepreneurs in today’s turbulent world. In such contexts, entrepreneurial resilience is not oriented toward recovery or thriving but toward enduring recurring crises, resource scarcity, and persistent uncertainty. We conducted an inductive, longitudinal study of 32 displaced entrepreneurs living in conflict-affected regions of Iraq. Our analysis reveals a process model of rhythmic resilience in a context of chronic adversity compounded by acute shocks. We show that resilience unfolds through dynamic cycles of withdrawal, reengagement, and adaptation over time that sustain survival across household, venture, and community levels. Yet these processes entail difficult trade-offs, giving rise to a resilience–survival paradox in which entrepreneurs protect survival at the expense of personal well-being, business growth, and social ties.
