title_zh: 生存即是足够的胜利：长期逆境与急性冲击中的节律性韧性
abstract_zh: 逆境情境会产生一系列广泛的挑战，使创业者暴露于叠加的困境之中，却又悖论性地激发以创业作为重获控制手段的行为。既有研究往往以两种截然不同的方式描绘逆境：要么将其视为一次性的破坏性事件，要么将其视为同一根本性困境的持续状态，从而忽视了逆境日益呈现为长期逆境叠加多重急性冲击的形态——这一情境正是当今动荡世界中许多创业者亲身经历的现实。在此类情境中，创业韧性并非指向恢复或繁荣，而是指向在反复出现的危机、资源稀缺和持续不确定性中坚持下去。我们对生活在伊拉克受冲突影响地区的32名流离失所创业者开展了一项归纳性纵向研究。我们的分析揭示了一个在长期逆境叠加急性冲击情境下的节律性韧性过程模型。我们表明，韧性通过随时间推移的退缩、重新投入和适应的动态循环而展开，从而在家庭、企业和社区层面维持生存。然而，这些过程伴随着艰难的权衡取舍，产生了一种韧性—生存悖论，即创业者在牺牲个人福祉、企业成长和社会联系的情况下保护生存。

source_records.title: Bittersweet Symphony: A Music Theory Approach to Stakeholder Dissonance and Value Creation
source_records.abstract: Stakeholder theory emphasizes value creation for diverse stakeholders, yet it offers limited guidance for understanding how value is created when a firm’s and a stakeholder’s values differ. We reconceptualize firm–stakeholder relationships as dynamic processes in which value accumulates through the engagement and resolution of value dissonance. Drawing on tonal harmony from music theory, we develop a framework that treats dissonance not as a defect to be eliminated but as generative pressure for value creation. The framework evaluates value dissonance at the issue level and aggregates tension at the relationship level, enabling systematic assessment of where firms can productively intervene. We then theorize three mechanisms through which firms convert dissonance into value: managerial intervention, structural resolution, and timing. Our central insight is that value emerges from the sequenced movement between tension and release. This dynamic perspective advances stakeholder theory by explaining how value can be created across the full stakeholder portfolio, including relationships that firms might otherwise avoid, suppress, or attempt to force into alignment.

title_zh: 苦乐交响曲：一种音乐理论视角下的利益相关者不协和与价值创造
abstract_zh: 利益相关者理论强调为多元利益相关者创造价值，但对于当企业与利益相关者的价值观存在差异时价值如何被创造，该理论提供的指导有限。我们将企业—利益相关者关系重新概念化为动态过程，在这一过程中，价值通过价值不协和的介入与解决而累积。借鉴音乐理论中的调性和声，我们构建了一个框架，将不协和视为价值创造的生成性压力，而非需要消除的缺陷。该框架在议题层面评估价值不协和，并在关系层面聚合张力，从而能够系统性地评估企业可以在何处进行富有成效的干预。随后，我们理论化了企业将不协和转化为价值的三种机制：管理干预、结构性解决和时机。我们的核心洞见是，价值产生于张力与释放之间的序列性运动。这一动态视角推进了利益相关者理论，解释了价值如何能够在整个利益相关者组合中被创造，包括那些企业原本可能回避、压制或试图强行使其趋于一致的关系。

source_records.title: Countering Organizational Rigidity Through Operational Resource Bundling: Integrating Resource Orchestration and Dynamic Capabilities
source_records.abstract: As organizations mature, standardized systems help meet increasing needs for efficiency. However, this often results in resources being used in rigid ways, compromising the flexibility necessary to leverage opportunities, create value, and address customers’ emerging needs. Here we address solutions to this drift to rigidity, focusing on how operational managers bundle resources to create value for the firm. Our qualitative study is based on data collected from an organization with operations across 252 locations. This data consists of 92 interviews with strategic and operational managers, ethnographic observations, and archival records. We uncovered three pathways for resource bundling that are focused on markets, customers, or organizational renewal. In each, senior-level strategic managers initially provided resources, including channels for standardization, information systems, and technical infrastructure that became rigid in their usage. When operational managers sensed this drift to rigidity, they seized flexible resources (connection, solution development, and employee development processes) to combine with the rigid resources. We refer to this as Operational Resource Bundling (ORB). Strategic managers collaborated with the operational managers to adapt how resources were used, helping to ratify, endorse, and mobilize the bundles to achieve value creation and competitive advantage. We extend earlier work by specifying how a particular type of resource orchestration—ORB—constitutes a value-generating micro-mechanism of dynamic capabilities. ORB uncovers the role of operational managers in balancing standardization versus customization through identifying and combining resources.

title_zh: 通过运营资源捆绑应对组织刚性：整合资源编排与动态能力
abstract_zh: 随着组织日趋成熟，标准化体系有助于满足不断增长的效率需求。然而，这往往导致资源以僵化的方式被使用，损害了利用机会、创造价值以及应对客户新兴需求所必需的灵活性。在此，我们探讨应对这种向刚性漂移的解决方案，重点关注运营管理者如何捆绑资源以为企业创造价值。我们的定性研究基于从一家在252个地点开展运营的组织收集的数据。这些数据包括对战略管理者和运营管理者的92次访谈、民族志观察以及档案记录。我们揭示了三条资源捆绑路径，分别聚焦于市场、客户或组织更新。在每一条路径中，高层战略管理者最初提供资源，包括标准化渠道、信息系统和技术基础设施，而这些资源在使用中变得僵化。当运营管理者察觉到这种向刚性的漂移时，他们抓住灵活资源（连接、解决方案开发和员工发展流程）与僵化资源相结合。我们将其称为运营资源捆绑（ORB）。战略管理者与运营管理者协作，调整资源的使用方式，帮助批准、认可并动员这些捆绑，以实现价值创造和竞争优势。我们扩展了先前的研究，具体说明了某一特定类型的资源编排——ORB——如何构成动态能力的价值生成微观机制。ORB揭示了运营管理者通过识别和组合资源在平衡标准化与定制化中的作用。

source_records.title: The Networks of Others: A Model of Secondhand Brokerage and its Effects on Employee Innovation
source_records.abstract: Social network research on creativity and innovation has primarily focused on the focal employee (i.e., ego), implicitly assuming that ego’s own network position determines the resources available for creative work. We advance an alter-centric perspective, arguing that what matters is not merely the availability of diverse information but the capacity of network contacts (i.e., alters) to make it usable. The brokerage characteristics of ego’s alters (i.e., secondhand brokerage) are decisive in that alters who are brokers are likely to have both valuable non-redundant information and the capability to convey it effectively. Prior work treating secondhand brokerage as a monolithic construct has yielded equivocal results; we reconcile these findings by decomposing it into distinct forms and matching each to the demands of a specific phase of the innovation process (i.e., idea generation, idea elaboration, idea championing, and idea implementation). We theorize that external secondhand brokerage facilitates idea generation, internal secondhand brokerage facilitates idea elaboration, internal alters’ network oscillation facilitates idea championing, and external alters’ network oscillation facilitates idea implementation, with ego’s knowledge integration capability, psychological ownership, organizational status, professional status, and tie strength serving as phase-specific and cross-phase boundary conditions. In doing so, we also challenge the prevailing view of brokers as default opportunists, specifying when cooperation, rather than opportunism, is the more rational strategy. By integrating the social network and innovation literatures, our framework clarifies how, when, and why the networks of others shape ego’s success across the innovation process.

title_zh: 他人的网络：二手经纪模型及其对员工创新的影响
abstract_zh: 关于创造力和创新的社会网络研究主要聚焦于焦点员工（即自我），隐含地假设自我自身的网络位置决定了可用于创造性工作的资源。我们提出一种以他人为中心的视角，认为重要的不仅仅是多样化信息的可获得性，还包括网络联系人（即他人）使信息变得可用的能力。自我他人的经纪特征（即二手经纪）具有决定性作用，因为作为经纪人的他人可能既拥有有价值的非冗余信息，又具备有效传递这些信息的能力。先前将二手经纪视为单一构念的研究得出了模棱两可的结果；我们通过将其分解为不同形式，并将每种形式与创新过程特定阶段（即想法产生、想法细化、想法倡导和想法实施）的需求相匹配，来调和这些发现。我们理论化认为，外部二手经纪促进想法产生，内部二手经纪促进想法细化，内部他人的网络振荡促进想法倡导，外部他人的网络振荡促进想法实施，而自我的知识整合能力、心理所有权、组织地位、专业地位和关系强度则作为特定阶段和跨阶段的边界条件。在此过程中，我们还挑战了将经纪人视为默认机会主义者的主流观点，具体说明了合作而非机会主义何时是更理性的策略。通过整合社会网络与创新文献，我们的框架阐明了他人的网络如何、何时以及为何在创新过程中塑造自我的成功。

source_records.title: Presidential Address: Neighborhood Effects and Missing Markets for Opportunity
source_records.abstract: Experimental and quasi-experimental studies show that childhood neighborhoods have substantial causal impacts on children's adult earnings and other long-term socioeconomic outcomes. Several market failures are likely to lead to excessive residential segregation by parental income and to an undersupply of mixed-income neighborhoods. Missing markets for opportunity originate in capital market imperfections for borrowing on children's future earnings, neighbor spillovers, behavioral biases, and housing search frictions. Customized housing mobility services combined with subsidized housing vouchers can help low-income families move to higher-opportunity areas. Place-based policies that create mixed-income neighborhoods appear to increase long-term outcomes for less-advantaged children. (JEL I12, I32, I38, J13, J15, R23, R38)

title_zh: 主席演讲：邻里效应与机会市场的缺失
abstract_zh: 实验与准实验研究表明，童年时期的邻里环境对儿童成年后的收入及其他长期社会经济结果具有显著的因果影响。若干市场失灵很可能导致按父母收入划分的过度居住隔离，以及混合收入邻里供给不足。机会市场的缺失源于以下方面：以子女未来收入为抵押进行借贷的资本市场不完善、邻里溢出效应、行为偏差以及住房搜寻摩擦。定制化的住房流动服务与补贴性住房券相结合，可帮助低收入家庭迁往机会更多的地区。旨在创建混合收入邻里的地方性政策似乎能改善弱势儿童的长期结果。（JEL I12, I32, I38, J13, J15, R23, R38）

source_records.title: Talent Hoarding in Organizations
source_records.abstract: Most organizations rely on managers to identify talented workers. However, managers who are evaluated on team performance have an incentive to hoard workers. This study provides the first empirical evidence of talent hoarding using personnel records and survey evidence from a large firm. Talent hoarding is self-reported by three-fourths of managers, is detectable in manager ratings of worker talent, and occurs more frequently under stronger hoarding incentives, proxied by performance-related pay, team size, and talent visibility. Using quasi-random exposure to talent hoarding, I show that hoarding deters internal job applications, inhibiting career progression and altering talent allocation in the firm. (JEL D22, J23, L60, M12, M51, M54)

title_zh: 组织中的人才囤积
abstract_zh: 大多数组织依靠管理者识别有才干的员工。然而，当管理者的考核依据是团队绩效时，他们就有动机囤积员工。本研究利用一家大型企业的人事记录和调查证据，首次提供了关于人才囤积的经验证据。四分之三的管理者自述存在人才囤积行为；从管理者对员工才能的评分中也能发现这种行为。当囤积人才的激励更强时，这种行为出现得更频繁；本文以绩效相关薪酬、团队规模和人才的可见度作为这些激励的代理指标。利用员工受到人才囤积影响的准随机差异，我发现，人才囤积会抑制企业内部职位申请，阻碍职业发展，并改变企业内部的人才配置。（JEL D22, J23, L60, M12, M51, M54）

source_records.title: Optimal Public Transportation Networks: Evidence from the World's Largest Bus Rapid Transit System in Jakarta
source_records.abstract: Designing public transport networks involves trade-offs between coverage, service frequency, and direct service. We use the expansion of the bus system in Jakarta, Indonesia, to study these trade-offs. We analyze how new direct connections, changes in bus travel time, and wait-time reductions affect bus ridership and aggregate flows and estimate a transit network demand model by matching the route launch events. Commuters in Jakarta are 2–3 times more sensitive to wait time than bus time and inattentive to long routes. We develop a flexible framework to characterize optimal networks. A less concentrated network would increase ridership and commuter welfare. (JEL L92, L98, O18, R41, R42, R48)

title_zh: 最优公共交通网络：来自雅加达全球最大快速公交系统的证据
abstract_zh: 公共交通网络的设计需要在覆盖范围、服务频率和直达服务之间进行权衡。我们利用印度尼西亚雅加达公交系统的扩张来研究这些权衡。我们分析新增直达连接、公交行程时间的变化以及候车时间缩短如何影响公交客流量和总体出行流量，并通过匹配线路开通事件来估计交通网络需求模型。雅加达通勤者对候车时间的敏感程度是对乘车时间的 2–3 倍，而且对较长线路关注不足。我们构建了一个灵活的框架来刻画最优网络。集中程度较低的网络将提高客流量和通勤者福利。（JEL L92, L98, O18, R41, R42, R48）

source_records.title: Remote Work and City Structure
source_records.abstract: Relative to remote work, working downtown facilitates valuable interactions with other in-office workers but entails commuting costs. The resulting coordination mechanism can lead to multiple stationary equilibria with varying levels of remote work. Temporary reductions in commuters, as in the COVID-19 pandemic, can lead to persistently large fractions of remote workers. Cell phone-based mobility data for the United States shows commuting trips in the largest cities, which are more likely to exhibit multiplicity, have stabilized at only 60 percent of prepandemic levels, while they are fully back in smaller cities. Cities with permanently low commuting experience average welfare losses of 2.3 percent. (JEL I12, J22, M54, R23, R31)

title_zh: 远程办公与城市结构
abstract_zh: 与远程办公相比，在市中心工作有助于与其他在办公室工作的人员开展有价值的互动，但也会带来通勤成本。由此产生的协调机制可能导致多个稳态均衡，各均衡中的远程办公程度不同。通勤人数的暂时减少，例如 COVID-19 疫情期间的情况，可能使远程办公者的占比长期保持在较高水平。基于手机的美国人口流动数据表明，在那些更可能出现多重均衡的最大城市中，通勤出行次数已稳定在仅为疫情前 60% 的水平；而在较小城市中，通勤出行次数已完全恢复。通勤长期处于低水平的城市平均承受 2.3% 的福利损失。（JEL I12, J22, M54, R23, R31）

source_records.title: Professional Motivations in the Public Sector: Evidence from Police Officers
source_records.abstract: We study how public sector workers balance their professional motivations with private economic concerns, focusing on police arrests. Arrests made near the end of an officer's shift typically require overtime work, and officers respond by reducing arrest frequency but increasing arrest quality. Days in which an officer works a second job after their police shift have higher opportunity cost, also reducing late-shift arrests. Combining our estimates in a dynamic model identifies officer preferences over workplace activity and overtime work. Our results indicate that officers' private costs of arrests have a first-order impact on the quantity and quality of enforcement. (JEL K42, J33, J45)

title_zh: 公共部门的职业动机：来自警察的证据
abstract_zh: 我们以警察的逮捕行为为重点，研究公共部门工作人员如何在职业动机与个人经济考量之间进行权衡。临近交班时实施逮捕通常需要加班，因此警察会减少逮捕频率，但提高逮捕质量。在警察结束警务班次后还要从事第二份工作的日子里，机会成本更高，这也会减少临近交班时的逮捕。将我们的估计结果纳入一个动态模型，可以识别警察对工作活动和加班的偏好。我们的结果表明，警察因逮捕而承担的个人成本，对执法的数量和质量具有一阶影响。（JEL K42, J33, J45）

source_records.title: Uncertainty and Change: Survey Evidence of Firms' Subjective Beliefs
source_records.abstract: This paper studies how managers plan under uncertainty. In a new panel survey of German manufacturing firms, we observe both forecasts of sales growth and a quantitative measure of subjective uncertainty. We show that subjective uncertainty reflects change experienced by firms: It is high when growth is either unusually low or unusually high. Subjective uncertainty is more than conditional volatility; while more volatile firms are typically more uncertain, experienced change alone increases uncertainty, consistent with a model of learning. Uncertainty over our sample is mostly idiosyncratic but varies substantially over time and leads managers to plan lower employment and prices. (JEL C83, D22, E20, E23)

title_zh: 不确定性与变化：关于企业主观信念的调查证据
abstract_zh: 本文研究管理者如何在不确定性下制定计划。在一项针对德国制造业企业的新面板调查中，我们同时观察到销售增长预测和主观不确定性的定量度量。我们发现，主观不确定性反映了企业经历的变化：当增长异常低或异常高时，主观不确定性都会较高。主观不确定性不仅仅是条件波动性；虽然波动更大的企业通常也面临更高的不确定性，但仅仅经历变化本身就会增加不确定性，这与一个学习模型相一致。在我们的样本中，不确定性主要是企业特有的，但随时间变化的幅度很大，并促使管理者计划采用较低的用工规模和价格。（JEL C83, D22, E20, E23）

source_records.title: Energy Transitions in Regulated Markets
source_records.abstract: Natural gas has replaced coal as the dominant fuel for US electricity generation. However, utilities in regulated US states have retired coal more slowly than others. We build a structural model of rate-of-return regulation during an energy transition where utilities face trade-offs between lowering costs and maintaining and using legacy capacity. A regulated utility facing carbon taxes lowers short-run coal generation 48 percent as much as a cost minimizer would. Thirty years after a sudden energy transition, a cost minimizer has retired 71 percent more coal capacity than the regulated utility. title_zh: 受监管市场中的能源转型
abstract_zh: 天然气已取代煤炭成为美国发电的主要燃料。然而，美国受监管各州的公用事业公司淘汰煤炭的速度慢于其他公司。我们构建了一个能源转型期间收益率监管的结构模型，其中公用事业公司面临降低成本与维持和使用既有产能之间的权衡。面对碳税，受监管的公用事业公司减少的短期燃煤发电量仅为成本最小化者的48%。在突然的能源转型发生三十年后，成本最小化者淘汰的煤炭产能比受监管的公用事业公司多71%。替代性监管可能在能源转型期间危及可负担性和可靠性目标。（JEL D24, L94, L98, Q35, Q48）

source_records.title: Corporate Tax Cuts, Firm Growth, and Workers' Earnings
source_records.abstract: We study the effects of the largest corporate income tax cut in US history on firms and workers. To identify causal effects, we use employer-employee matched tax records and event studies comparing similarly sized firms in the same industry that faced divergent tax changes due to their preexisting legal status. Tax cuts cause increases in firms' investment, sales, profits, employment, and payrolls, with earnings gains concentrated among highly paid workers. In the short run, 87 percent of private income gains flow to the top 10 percent of the income distribution. (JEL D22, D31, G31, H25, H32, J23, L25)

title_zh: 企业减税、企业成长与劳动者收入
abstract_zh: 我们研究美国历史上规模最大的企业所得税减税对企业与劳动者的影响。为识别因果效应，我们使用雇主—雇员匹配的税务记录，并进行事件研究，比较同一行业中规模相近、但因既有法律地位不同而面临不同税负变化的企业。减税导致企业投资、销售额、利润、就业和工资总额上升，而收入增长集中于高薪劳动者。短期内，87%的私人收入增长流向收入分配前10%的人群。（JEL D22, D31, G31, H25, H32, J23, L25）

source_records.title: Merger Effects and Antitrust Enforcement: Evidence from US Consumer Packaged Goods
source_records.abstract: We document the effects of a comprehensive set of mergers of consumer packaged goods manufacturers on prices, quantities, and product assortment. Across specifications, we find a small average price effect of mergers (−0.5−1.1 percent) but substantial heterogeneity, with a standard deviation between 3.9 and 7.6 percentage points. Through a model of enforcement, we find that agencies act as if they challenge mergers they expect would increase prices more than 4.8 to 6.3 percent. Increases in stringency would reduce prices and the prevalence of completed price-increasing mergers, with minimal impacts on blocked price-decreasing mergers, at significantly greater agency burden. (JEL D43, G34, K21, L13, L41, L66)

title_zh: 合并效应与反垄断执法：来自美国消费品包装行业的证据
abstract_zh: 我们记录了消费品包装制造商的一系列全面合并对价格、数量和产品种类的影响。在不同设定下，我们发现合并的平均价格效应较小（−0.5%至−1.1%），但异质性显著，标准差在3.9至7.6个百分点之间。通过一个执法模型，我们发现执法机构的行为方式似乎是：对于它们预期会使价格提高超过4.8%至6.3%的合并，它们会提出异议。严格程度的提高会降低价格和已完成的价格上涨型合并的发生率，而对被阻止的价格下降型合并影响极小，但会给执法机构带来显著更大的负担。（JEL D43, G34, K21, L13, L41, L66）

source_records.title: Contextually Private Mechanisms
source_records.abstract: A designer employs a dynamic protocol to elicit private information. Protocols produce a set of contextual privacy violations—information learned that may be superfluous given the context. A protocol is maximally contextually private if there is no protocol that produces a proper subset of the violations it produces, while implementing the choice rule. Contextual privacy violations arise when a choice rule makes some agents collectively, but not individually, pivotal. In auctions, designing for contextual privacy requires choosing an initial question posed to each agent and the order for querying agents. Ascending-join protocols are maximally contextually private for k-item Vickrey auctions. (JEL D44, D82)

title_zh: 情境隐私机制
abstract_zh: 设计者采用动态协议来引出私人信息。协议会产生一组情境隐私侵犯——即在给定情境下可能多余而获知的信息。如果一个协议在实施选择规则的同时，不存在另一个协议能产生其侵犯集合的真子集，则该协议是最大情境隐私的。当某一选择规则使某些代理人集体而非个体成为关键时，就会出现情境隐私侵犯。在拍卖中，为情境隐私而设计需要选择向每个代理人提出的初始问题以及询问代理人的顺序。对于k件物品的维克里拍卖，升序加入协议是最大情境隐私的。（JEL D44, D82）

source_records.title: Designing Dynamic Reassignment Mechanisms: Evidence from GP Allocation
source_records.abstract: We study the problem of designing a dynamic reassignment mechanism when agents' preferences over objects change over time. In the context of Norway's system for (re)assigning patients to general practitioners (GPs), we provide direct evidence of misallocation under the current mechanism—patients waiting for each others' GPs, but who cannot trade—and estimate a structural model of GP-switching behavior to evaluate alternatives. Introducing top trading cycles (TTC) would, on average, reduce waiting times and increase patient welfare. However, patients endowed with less desirable GPs would be harmed. Prioritizing these patients can avoid these harms while preserving most of the gains from TTC. (JEL D82, H51, I11, I13, I18)

title_zh: 设计动态重新分配机制：来自全科医生分配的证据
abstract_zh: 我们研究当代理人对对象的偏好在时间上发生变化时，设计动态重新分配机制的问题。在挪威将患者（重新）分配给全科医生（GP）的体系背景下，我们提供了当前机制下错配的直接证据——患者等待彼此的全科医生，但无法进行交换——并估计了一个全科医生转换行为的结构模型以评估替代方案。引入最高交易循环（TTC）平均而言会减少等待时间并提高患者福利。然而，被赋予较不受欢迎的全科医生的患者将受到损害。优先考虑这些患者可以避免这些损害，同时保留TTC的大部分收益。（JEL D82、H51、I11、I13、I18）

source_records.title: Risk-Sharing Tests and Covariate Shocks: Drought, Floods, and Pests in Uganda
source_records.abstract: Efficient risk sharing implies a simple factor structure for marginal utilities of expenditure (MUEs): Pareto weights divided by a common price. The standard approach infers MUEs from total expenditures, implicitly assuming homothetic preferences, unitary income elasticities, and identical price elasticities. Risk-sharing tests using total expenditures work for idiosyncratic shocks (budgets change, but not prices), but not “covariate” shocks (prices change). I describe all preferences that permit one to infer MUEs from expenditures and estimate nonhomothetic MUEs to test whether covariate shocks are shared efficiently in Uganda. This delivers sensible results; the standard approach suggests that droughts, floods, and pests are beneficial. (JEL D12, D81, O12, O13, Q12)

title_zh: 风险分担检验与协变量冲击：乌干达的干旱、洪水和虫害
abstract_zh: 有效的风险分担意味着支出边际效用（MUEs）具有简单的因子结构：帕累托权重除以共同价格。标准方法从总支出推断MUEs，隐含地假设了同质偏好、单位收入弹性和相同价格弹性。使用总支出的风险分担检验适用于特异性冲击（预算变化，但价格不变），但不适用于“协变量”冲击（价格变化）。我描述了所有允许从支出推断MUEs的偏好，并估计非齐次MUEs以检验乌干达的协变量冲击是否被有效分担。这得出了合理的结果；标准方法表明干旱、洪水和虫害是有益的。（JEL D12, D81, O12, O13, Q12）

source_records.title: Rationing by Race
source_records.abstract: We document how deepening resource scarcity results in rationing on the basis of race in a high-stakes setting: health care. Using detailed, time stamped data on 107,000 inpatient admissions to a large health system, we find that in-hospital mortality increases for Black but not White patients as hospitals reach capacity. These findings are not explained by differential patient selection. We identify rationing by wait times as a mechanism, documenting that sicker Black patients wait longer for care than healthier White patients at almost all capacity levels. Text analysis of unstructured clinical notes reveals rationing of provider effort as another mechanism. (JEL I11, I12, I14, J15)

title_zh: 按种族配给
abstract_zh: 我们记录了在高风险情境——医疗保健中，资源稀缺加剧如何导致基于种族的配给。利用一个大型医疗系统中107,000例住院入院的详细、带时间戳的数据，我们发现，随着医院达到容量上限，黑人患者的院内死亡率上升，而白人患者则没有。这些发现无法由患者选择差异来解释。我们识别出按等待时间配给作为一种机制，记录了在几乎所有容量水平下，病情更重的黑人患者比病情更轻的白人患者等待更长时间才能获得治疗。对非结构化临床笔记的文本分析揭示了提供者努力的配给作为另一种机制。(JEL I11, I12, I14, J15)

source_records.title: Random Utility with Unobservable Alternatives
source_records.abstract: The random utility model (RUM), a cornerstone in economics, is typically studied under the assumption that choice frequencies of all alternatives are observable. In practice, however, some alternatives have unobservable choice frequencies and are commonly aggregated into a single category called an outside option. We study RUM in such environments and derive a finite, nonredundant system of inequality constraints on observed choice frequencies that characterizes RU-rationalizability. We show that the conventional practice of aggregating unobserved alternatives can miss key information leading to incorrect conclusions such as that observed choices are rationalizable, even when no RUM is consistent with them. (JEL D11, D44, D83)

title_zh: 存在不可观测备选项的随机效用
abstract_zh: 随机效用模型（RUM）是经济学的基石，通常在所有备选项的选择频率均可观测的假设下进行研究。然而在实践中，某些备选项的选择频率不可观测，通常被合并为一个称为外部选项的单一类别。我们研究此类环境下的RUM，并推导出关于可观测选择频率的一个有限、非冗余的不等式约束系统，用以刻画RU可理性化。我们表明，将不可观测备选项进行合并的常规做法可能遗漏关键信息，从而导致错误结论，例如得出可观测选择是可理性化的结论，即使不存在与之相容的RUM。（JEL D11, D44, D83）

source_records.title: Defying Distance? The Provision of Medical Services in the Digital Age
source_records.abstract: Digital platforms reduce geographic frictions, enabling better matching between service providers and users. I quantify reallocation gains in Swedish online health care, using nationwide time-conditional random assignment between patients and physicians. Matching high-risk patients with doctors effective at reducing Emergency Room visits lowers such visits by 4.4 percent (SE 1.3); reallocations also reduce Counter-Guideline antibiotics by 3.1 percent (1.4). I find limited trade-offs in matching; horizontal differentiation among doctors and varied patient needs allow improvement in multiple outcomes simultaneously. Efficiency-enhancing reallocations also affect equity. The findings highlight the potential for care reorganization aligning provider heterogeneity with patient needs when geographic constraints are lifted. (JEL C78, H51, I11, I13, I14, I18)

title_zh: 无视距离？数字时代的医疗服务提供
abstract_zh: 数字平台减少了地理摩擦，使服务提供者与用户之间能够更好地匹配。我利用瑞典全国范围内患者与医生之间的时间条件随机分配，量化了瑞典在线医疗中的再配置收益。将高风险患者与能有效减少急诊就诊的医生匹配，可使此类就诊减少4.4%（标准误1.3）；再配置还使违反指南的抗生素使用减少3.1%（1.4）。我发现匹配中的权衡有限；医生之间的横向差异以及患者需求的多样性使得多个结果可以同时改善。提高效率的再配置也会影响公平。这些发现凸显了当地理约束被解除时，通过将提供者异质性与患者需求对齐来重组医疗服务的潜力。（JEL C78, H51, I11, I13, I14, I18）

source_records.title: Intergenerational Impacts of Secondary Education: Experimental Evidence from Ghana
source_records.abstract: We provide experimental evidence on the intergenerational impacts of secondary education subsidies in a low-income context, leveraging a randomized controlled trial and 15-year longitudinal follow-up. Secondary school scholarships delay fertility, reduce unwanted pregnancies, and change partner selection. Under-one mortality is reduced by half. We also document cognitive development gains of 0.24 standard deviations of test scores by age five among children of female scholarship recipients. Means-tested secondary school scholarships are a high-return investment, with a conservatively estimated US$4.1 in benefits for each US$1 the policy would cost the government in the long run. (JEL H52, I12, I21, I26, J13, J16, O15)

title_zh: 中等教育的代际影响：来自加纳的实验证据
abstract_zh: 我们利用一项随机对照试验和为期15年的纵向追踪，提供了在低收入背景下中等教育补贴代际影响的实验证据。中学奖学金推迟了生育，减少了意外怀孕，并改变了伴侣选择。一岁以下死亡率降低了一半。我们还记录了女性奖学金获得者的子女在五岁时认知发展方面的提升，其测试成绩高出0.24个标准差。以经济状况调查为基础的中学奖学金是一项高回报投资，从长期来看，保守估计，政府在该政策上每花费1美元，可获得4.1美元的收益。（JEL H52, I12, I21, I26, J13, J16, O15）

source_records.title: The Productivity of Professions: Evidence from the Emergency Department
source_records.abstract: This paper studies the productivity of nurse practitioners (NPs) and physicians, two professions performing overlapping tasks but with starkly different backgrounds, training, and pay. Using quasi-experimental variation in patient assignment to NPs versus physicians in Veterans Health Administration emergency departments, we find that, on average, NPs use more resources and exhibit a higher 30-day preventable hospitalization rate than physicians. However, the NP-physician performance difference varies by case complexity and severity. Importantly, even larger productivity variation exists within each profession, leading to substantial overlap between the productivity distributions of the two professions; NPs outperform physicians in 38 percent of random pairs. (JEL I11, I18, J24, J44, M53)

title_zh: 职业的生产率：来自急诊科的证据
abstract_zh: 本文研究了执业护士（NPs）与医生这两种职业的生产率，二者执行相互重叠的任务，但背景、培训和薪酬截然不同。利用退伍军人健康管理局急诊科中患者被分配给执业护士还是医生的准实验变异，我们发现，平均而言，执业护士比医生使用更多资源，并表现出更高的30天可预防住院率。然而，执业护士与医生的绩效差异因病例复杂性和严重程度而异。重要的是，即使在每个职业内部也存在更大的生产率变异，导致两种职业的生产率分布存在大量重叠；在38%的随机配对中，执业护士的表现优于医生。（JEL I11, I18, J24, J44, M53）

source_records.title: Manipulation-Robust Prediction
source_records.abstract: An increasing number of decisions are guided by machine learning algorithms. But when consequential decisions are encoded in algorithms, individuals may strategically alter their behavior to achieve desired outcomes. This paper develops an empirical approach that adjusts decision algorithms to anticipate manipulation. By explicitly modeling incentives to manipulate, our approach produces decision rules that are stable under manipulation, even when the rules are fully transparent. We stress-test this approach through a large field experiment in Kenya. When implemented, linear strategy-robust decision rules outperform standard linear models such as LASSO. (JEL C45, C93, D12, D91, G51, O12, O16)

title_zh: 抗操纵预测
abstract_zh: 越来越多的决策由机器学习算法指导。但当重大决策被编码进算法时，个体可能会策略性地改变其行为以达成期望的结果。本文提出一种实证方法，通过调整决策算法来预判操纵行为。通过明确地对操纵激励进行建模，我们的方法能产生在操纵下保持稳定的决策规则，即使这些规则完全透明。我们通过在肯尼亚开展的一项大规模实地实验对该方法进行了压力测试。在实施时，线性策略稳健决策规则的表现优于LASSO等标准线性模型。（JEL C45, C93, D12, D91, G51, O12, O16）

source_records.title: Marriage, Fertility, and Cultural Integration in Italy
source_records.abstract: We study cultural integration as an equilibrium outcome of marital matching along cultural and education lines and intrahousehold investment decisions regarding fertility and cultural socialization. Our model allows us to identify cultural-ethnic-group-specific investment parameters and spousal preferences for marital matching. Structural estimates reveal a strong demand to preserve cultural identity on the part of immigrants and limited acceptance of the immigrants' cultural diversity on the part of natives. Furthermore, these estimates reveal a substantial heterogeneity of the parental value of children's education across cultures. Nonetheless, our estimates simulate substantial—though heterogeneous—cultural integration rates across immigrant groups. (JEL D13, J12, J13, J15, Z13)

title_zh: 意大利的婚姻、生育与文化融合
abstract_zh: 我们将文化融合作为沿文化和教育维度的婚姻匹配以及关于生育和文化社会化的家庭内部投资决策的均衡结果加以研究。我们的模型使我们能够识别特定文化—族群群体的投资参数以及配偶对婚姻匹配的偏好。结构估计揭示出，移民一方对保持文化身份有强烈需求，而本地人一方对移民文化多样性的接受有限。此外，这些估计揭示出，父母对子女教育的价值在不同文化之间存在显著异质性。尽管如此，我们的估计模拟出各移民群体中显著——尽管异质——的文化融合率。（JEL D13, J12, J13, J15, Z13）

source_records.title: The Environmental Bias of Corporate Income Taxation
source_records.abstract: We study the relationship between corporate income taxation and carbon dioxide (CO 2 ) emissions in the United States. We show CO 2 -intensive firms benefit more from the tax advantage of debt and pay lower income taxes on their capital income. Building on these new facts, we provide evidence that a cut in the corporate income tax rate leads to a larger expansion of clean firms. We develop a multisector general equilibrium model that accounts for our evidence and quantify the impact of corporate tax reforms on aggregate emissions. A policy that eliminates the tax advantage of debt could reduce aggregate emissions without affecting GDP. (JEL D22, G32, H25, H32, Q52, Q54, Q58)

title_zh: 企业所得税的环境偏向
abstract_zh: 我们研究美国企业所得税与二氧化碳（CO2）排放之间的关系。我们表明，CO2密集型企业在债务的税收优势中获益更多，并对其资本收入缴纳较低的企业所得税。基于这些新事实，我们提供证据表明，企业所得税税率的削减会导致清洁企业更大幅度的扩张。我们构建了一个多部门一般均衡模型，该模型能够解释我们的证据，并量化企业税改革对总排放的影响。一项消除债务税收优势的政策可以在不影响GDP的情况下减少总排放。（JEL D22, G32, H25, H32, Q52, Q54, Q58）

source_records.title: Additionality and Asymmetric Information in Environmental Markets: Evidence from Conservation Auctions
source_records.abstract: Mechanisms that aim to reduce environmental degradation at low cost can be undermined when participants' conservation actions are not marginal to the incentive—or “additional”—as the lowest-cost participants may not be the highest social value. We investigate this challenge in the Conservation Reserve Program's auction mechanism for ecosystem services, linking bids to satellite-derived land use. Three-quarters of marginal auction winners are not additional. The heterogeneity in counterfactual land use introduces adverse selection. We develop a model of bidding and additionality to quantify welfare implications. Alternative auctions increase efficiency by using scoring rules that incorporate expected land use impacts. (JEL D44, D82, Q24, Q57, R14)

title_zh: 环境市场中的额外性与不对称信息：来自保护拍卖的证据
abstract_zh: 当参与者的保护行动对激励而言并非边际——或并非“额外”的——时，旨在以低成本减少环境退化的机制可能会被削弱，因为成本最低的参与者可能并非社会价值最高的参与者。我们在保护储备计划（Conservation Reserve Program）的生态系统服务拍卖机制中研究了这一挑战，将出价与卫星衍生的土地利用数据相关联。四分之三的边际拍卖获胜者并非额外的。反事实土地利用的异质性引入了逆向选择。我们构建了一个出价与额外性的模型，以量化福利影响。替代性拍卖通过采用纳入预期土地利用影响的评分规则来提高效率。（JEL D44, D82, Q24, Q57, R14）

source_records.title: Community Engagement and Public Safety: Evidence from Crime Enforcement Targeting Immigrants
source_records.abstract: We study the role of victim reporting in the production of public safety. We examine the Secure Communities program, a crime-reduction policy that involved police in detecting unauthorized immigrants and increased deportation fears in immigrant communities. We find that the policy reduced the likelihood that Hispanic victims report crimes to police and increased offending against Hispanics. The number of reported crimes is unchanged, masking these opposing effects. We show that reduced reporting drives the offending increase and provide the first elasticity of offending to victim reporting in the literature, calculating that a 10 percent decline in reporting increases offending by 7.9 percent. (JEL J15, K37, K42)

title_zh: 社区参与与公共安全：来自针对移民的犯罪执法的证据
abstract_zh: 我们研究受害者报案在公共安全生产中的作用。我们考察“安全社区”项目，这是一项减少犯罪的政策，该政策让警察参与侦查无证移民，并加剧了移民社区对驱逐出境的恐惧。我们发现，该政策降低了拉美裔受害者向警方报案的可能性，并增加了针对拉美裔的犯罪行为。已报告的犯罪数量没有变化，掩盖了这些相反方向的影响。我们表明，报案减少推动了犯罪增加，并提供了文献中首个犯罪对受害者报案的弹性，计算出报案下降10%会使犯罪增加7.9%。（JEL J15, K37, K42）

source_records.title: Taxes and Executive Pay: Evidence from Nonqualified Deferred Compensation
source_records.abstract: I study the influence of tax deductibility on decisions to defer executive compensation by exploiting a plausibly exogenous tax change that increases the deductibility of the chief financial officer’s (CFO’s) nonperformance-based compensation, with no impact on the nontax determinants of deferrals. Using a difference-in-differences research design, I find that CFO deferred compensation significantly decreases after the tax change, relative to the deferrals of the chief executive officer (CEO) and the highest paid non-CEO and non-CFO executive in the same firm. This finding is more pronounced for firms with higher marginal tax rates and thus greater tax benefits of deferrals. Additional tests show that tax deductibility also influences firms’ decisions on nonperformance-based compensation and that CFO total pay appears to decline in response to decreased deferrals. This paper was accepted by Shivaram Rajgopal, accounting. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2020.01483 .

title_zh: 税收与高管薪酬：来自非合格递延薪酬的证据
abstract_zh: 我利用一项看似外生的税收变化来研究税收可扣除性对递延高管薪酬决策的影响，该税收变化提高了首席财务官（CFO）非绩效型薪酬的可扣除性，且对递延的非税决定因素没有影响。采用双重差分研究设计，我发现，相对于同一公司中首席执行官（CEO）以及薪酬最高的非CEO和非CFO高管的递延薪酬，CFO递延薪酬在税收变化后显著下降。这一发现在边际税率更高、从而递延税收收益更大的公司中更为明显。进一步测试表明，税收可扣除性还影响公司对非绩效型薪酬的决策，并且CFO总薪酬似乎因递延薪酬减少而下降。本文由会计领域编辑Shivaram Rajgopal接受。补充材料：数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2020.01483 获取。

source_records.title: Do Job Applicants Consider Founder Race and Gender? Evidence from a Field Experiment
source_records.abstract: Do job seekers consider the race or gender of an employer when applying for a job? Although we have extensive research on employer-side discrimination, we know less about employee-side biases and their consequences. In this study, we examine how the gender and race of the employer shape the willingness of prospective employees to apply for a job. To examine this, we conducted a field experiment where we randomized real jobseekers into three conditions according to employer demographics. We find that job candidates were less likely to apply to a job when they learn that the founders are Black, and, when they did apply, they requested 10% higher salary. In addition, the more qualified a candidate, the less likely they were to apply to Black founders, leaving Black founders with a pool of candidates that is smaller, worse, and more expensive than their White peers. We find no gender penalty for White female founders. Findings from two survey experiments suggest that the penalty is unique to White applicants evaluating Black founders and reflects a concern among White applicants that they will be less likely to fit within a firm and that the firm is less likely to be successful in the long run. We find no evidence of a widespread applicant homophily where all applicants favor founders of their own ethnic group, nor do we find evidence of widespread statistical discrimination whereby all applicants penalize Black founders for being atypical members of the entrepreneurial class. This paper was accepted by Olav Sorenson, organizations. Funding: Financial support from the INSEAD Alumni Fund is gratefully acknowledged. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.00481 .

title_zh: 求职者会考虑创始人的种族和性别吗？来自一项实地实验的证据
abstract_zh: 求职者在申请工作时会考虑雇主的种族或性别吗？尽管我们对雇主方的歧视已有大量研究，但对雇员方的偏见及其后果了解较少。在本研究中，我们考察雇主的性别和种族如何影响潜在雇员的求职意愿。为对此进行考察，我们开展了一项实地实验，将真实求职者按雇主人口特征随机分配到三种条件中。我们发现，当求职者得知创始人是黑人时，他们申请该工作的可能性更低，而且当他们确实提出申请时，他们要求的薪资高出10%。此外，候选人越优秀，他们申请黑人创始人公司的可能性越低，从而使黑人创始人拥有的候选人池比其白人同行更小、更差且更昂贵。我们未发现对白人女性创始人存在性别惩罚。两项调查实验的结果表明，这种惩罚是白人申请者在评估黑人创始人时所特有的，反映了白人申请者的一种担忧，即他们不太可能融入该公司，且该公司不太可能长期成功。我们未发现存在广泛的申请者同质性偏好，即所有申请者都偏爱与自己同一种族群体的创始人，也未发现存在广泛的统计性歧视，即所有申请者都因黑人创始人属于创业阶层中的非典型成员而对其加以惩罚。本文由Olav Sorenson（组织）接受。资助：谨此感谢INSEAD校友基金提供的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.00481获取。

source_records.title: Learning Optimal Prescriptive Trees from Observational Data
source_records.abstract: We consider the problem of learning an optimal prescriptive tree (i.e., an interpretable treatment assignment policy in the form of a binary tree) of moderate depth from observational data. This problem arises in numerous socially important domains, such as public health and medicine, where interpretable and data-driven interventions are sought based on data gathered in deployment rather than from randomized trials. We propose a method for learning optimal prescriptive trees using mixed-integer optimization technology assuming that our data satisfy standard causal inference assumptions (conditional exchangeability and positivity) and are discrete/discretized. We show that under mild conditions, our method is asymptotically exact (i.e., it converges to an optimal out-of-sample treatment assignment policy as the number of historical data samples tends to infinity). Contrary to the existing literature, our approach (a) does not require data to be randomized, (b) does not impose stringent assumptions on the learned trees, and (c) has the ability to model domain-specific constraints. Through extensive computational experiments, we demonstrate that our asymptotic guarantees translate to significant performance improvements in finite samples as well as showcase our uniquely flexible modeling power by incorporating budget and fairness constraints. This paper was accepted by Chung Piaw Teo, optimization. Funding: N. Jo acknowledges support from the Epstein Institute at the University of Southern California. N. Jo, S. Aghaei, and P. title_zh: 从观察数据中学习最优处方树
abstract_zh: 我们考虑从观察数据中学习一棵中等深度的最优处方树（即以二叉树形式表示的可解释治疗分配策略）的问题。该问题出现在许多具有社会重要性的领域，例如公共卫生和医学，在这些领域中，人们寻求基于部署过程中收集的数据而非随机试验数据来制定可解释且数据驱动的干预措施。我们提出了一种使用混合整数优化技术学习最优处方树的方法，假设我们的数据满足标准因果推断假设（条件可交换性和正值性）且为离散/离散化数据。我们证明，在温和条件下，我们的方法是渐近精确的（即，随着历史数据样本数量趋于无穷，它收敛到最优的样本外治疗分配策略）。与现有文献相比，我们的方法（a）不要求数据是随机的，（b）不对所学习的树施加严格假设，并且（c）能够对领域特定约束进行建模。通过大量计算实验，我们证明我们的渐近保证在有限样本中转化为显著的性能改进，并通过纳入预算和公平性约束展示了我们独特的灵活建模能力。本文由Chung Piaw Teo（优化领域）接受。资助：N. source_records.title: Can Employees’ Past Helping Behavior Be Used to Improve Shift Scheduling? Evidence from ICU Nurses
source_records.abstract: Employees routinely make valuable contributions at work that are not part of their formal job description, such as helping a struggling coworker. These contributions, termed organizational citizenship behavior, are studied from many angles in the organizational behavior literature. However, the degree to which the past helping behavior of employees scheduled to a shift impacts that shift’s operational outcomes remains an underexplored question. We define two measures of past helping behavior for members of a shift—the total past helping of each employee and the past helping between each pair of employees—and hypothesize that they are associated with shift performance. We empirically confirm our hypotheses with detailed scheduling and patient outcome data from six intensive care units (ICUs) at a large academic medical center, using the hospital’s electronic medical records to identify cases of one nurse helping another. Our empirical results indicate that both measures of past helping are predictive of patient length of stay (LOS), more so than the broadly studied notion of team familiarity. Counterfactual analysis shows that relatively small changes in shift composition can yield significant reduction in total LOS, indicating the managerial significance of the results. Overall, our study suggests the potential value of shift scheduling using data on past helping behaviors, and this may have promise far beyond the selected application to ICU nursing. This paper was accepted by Elena Katok, operations management. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.00465 .

title_zh: 员工过去的帮助行为能否用于改进排班？来自ICU护士的证据
abstract_zh: 员工在工作中经常做出不属于其正式工作职责的有价值贡献，例如帮助一位陷入困境的同事。这些贡献被称为组织公民行为，组织行为学文献从多个角度对其进行了研究。然而，被安排到某一班次的员工过去的帮助行为在多大程度上影响该班次的运营结果，仍是一个尚未得到充分探讨的问题。我们为班次成员定义了两种过去帮助行为的度量——每位员工过去帮助的总量以及每对员工之间的过去帮助——并假设它们与班次绩效相关。我们利用一家大型学术医疗中心六个重症监护病房（ICU）的详细排班和患者结果数据，并使用该医院的电子病历来识别一名护士帮助另一名护士的案例，从而实证证实了我们的假设。我们的实证结果表明，这两种过去帮助的度量都能预测患者的住院时长（LOS），其预测能力超过被广泛研究的团队熟悉度概念。反事实分析表明，班次构成的相对较小变化可以显著减少总LOS，这表明了结果的管理意义。总体而言，我们的研究表明使用过去帮助行为数据进行排班具有潜在价值，而这可能远不止于所选的ICU护理应用。本文由运营管理领域的Elena Katok接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.00465 获取。

source_records.title: Group-Sparse Matrix Factorization for Transfer Learning of Word Embeddings
source_records.abstract: Unstructured text provides decision makers with a rich data source in many domains, ranging from product reviews in retail to nursing notes in healthcare. To leverage this information, words are typically translated into word embeddings—vectors that encode the semantic relationships between words—through unsupervised learning algorithms such as matrix factorization. However, learning word embeddings from new domains with limited training data can be challenging because the meaning/usage may be different in the new domain; for example, the word “positive” typically has positive sentiment, but often has negative sentiment in medical notes because it may imply that a patient tested positive for a disease. In practice, we expect that only a small number of domain-specific words may have new meanings. We propose an intuitive two-stage estimator that exploits this structure via a group-sparse penalty to efficiently transfer learn domain-specific word embeddings by combining large-scale text corpora (such as Wikipedia) with limited domain-specific text data. We bound the generalization error of our transfer learning estimator, proving that it can achieve high accuracy with substantially less domain-specific data when only a small number of embeddings are altered between domains. Furthermore, we prove that all local minima identified by our nonconvex objective function are statistically indistinguishable from the global minimum under standard regularization conditions, implying that our estimator can be computed efficiently. Our results provide the first bounds on group-sparse matrix factorization, which may be of independent interest. We empirically evaluate our approach compared with state-of-the-art fine-tuning heuristics from natural language processing. This paper was accepted by Chung Piaw Teo, optimization. title_zh: 用于词嵌入迁移学习的组稀疏矩阵分解
abstract_zh: 非结构化文本为许多领域中的决策者提供了丰富的数据来源，涵盖从零售中的产品评论到医疗保健中的护理记录。为利用这些信息，通常通过无监督学习算法（如矩阵分解）将词语转换为词嵌入——即编码词语之间语义关系的向量。然而，从训练数据有限的新领域学习词嵌入可能具有挑战性，因为其含义/用法在新领域中可能不同；例如，“positive”一词通常具有正面情感，但在医疗记录中往往具有负面情感，因为它可能意味着患者某种疾病检测呈阳性。在实践中，我们预计只有少量领域特定词可能具有新含义。我们提出一种直观的两阶段估计器，通过组稀疏惩罚利用这一结构，将大规模文本语料库（如Wikipedia）与有限的领域特定文本数据相结合，从而高效地迁移学习领域特定词嵌入。我们给出了迁移学习估计器的泛化误差界，证明当领域之间只有少量嵌入发生变化时，它能够以显著更少的领域特定数据实现高精度。此外，我们证明在标准正则化条件下，我们的非凸目标函数所识别出的所有局部最小值在统计上都无法与全局最小值区分，这意味着我们的估计器可以高效计算。我们的结果为组稀疏矩阵分解提供了首个界，这可能具有独立的研究价值。我们将我们的方法与自然语言处理中最先进的微调启发式方法进行了实证比较。本文由Chung Piaw Teo（优化领域）接受。资助：作者衷心感谢Wharton Analytics Initiative和Wharton Dean’s Fund提供不可或缺的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.01740 获取。

source_records.title: Scalable Bundle Recommendations: A Large-Scale Field Experiment
source_records.abstract: We develop an end-to-end, scalable machine learning framework for designing bundle recommendations in a high-dimensional choice setting. We leverage historical purchases and consideration sets determined from clickstream data to generate dense representations (embeddings) of products. We impose minimal structure on these embeddings and develop heuristics for complementarity and substitutability among products. Subsequently, we use the heuristics to create multiple bundle recommendations for each of 4,500 focal products and test their performance using a field experiment with a large retailer. We use the experimental data to optimize the recommendation design policy with offline policy learning. Our optimized policy is robust across product categories, generalizes well to the retailer’s entire assortment, and provides an expected improvement of 35% ([Formula: see text] per 100 visits) in revenue from bundle recommendations over the baseline policy. This paper was accepted by Hemant Bhargava, information systems. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.01864 .

title_zh: 可扩展的捆绑推荐：一项大规模实地实验
abstract_zh: 我们开发了一个端到端、可扩展的机器学习框架，用于在高维选择环境中设计捆绑推荐。我们利用历史购买数据以及由点击流数据确定的考虑集，生成产品的稠密表示（嵌入）。我们对这些嵌入施加最小结构，并开发了用于衡量产品之间互补性和替代性的启发式方法。随后，我们使用这些启发式方法为4,500个焦点产品中的每一个创建多个捆绑推荐，并通过与一家大型零售商开展的实地实验来检验其表现。我们利用实验数据，通过离线策略学习来优化推荐设计策略。我们优化后的策略在不同产品类别中具有稳健性，能够很好地推广到零售商的整个商品组合，并且相较于基线策略，在捆绑推荐带来的收入上提供了35%（[公式：见正文]每100次访问）的预期提升。本文由信息系统领域的Hemant Bhargava接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.01864获取。

source_records.title: Crowdsourcing from Hackers: Strategic Coopetition and Governance in Bug Bounty Programs
source_records.abstract: In a bug bounty program (BBP), organizations incentivize hackers—who could otherwise be “enemies”—to report security vulnerabilities by publicly offering monetary rewards. This paper develops an analytical framework to characterize BBPs and their strategic and economic impacts. Strategically, BBPs induce some hackers to self-select into cooperative vulnerability discovery and reporting, diverting them away from attacking (attack diversion) and delegating part of the protection effort to them (protection delegation). We show that (i) BBPs can be beneficial even when hackers are inefficient at vulnerability identification, yet more participants might make BBPs less attractive to firms. (ii) Although BBPs improve security, they might encourage competitive hackers (i.e., attackers) to exert more efforts. (iii) The coopetition dynamics can render a firm’s provision of rewards and in-house efforts socially inefficient. Common cybersecurity regulations, such as breach penalties and bounty reward subsidies, may exacerbate the inefficiency. We find complementarity between bounty subsidies and breach penalties, suggesting that combining and customizing them according to firm characteristics could enhance BBP efficiency. (iv) Contrary to the conventional wisdom that crowdsourcing rewards increase with participant size, we identify scenarios in which a firm should reduce or make nonmonotonic adjustments to a bounty reward as participant size increases. (v) Legal safe harbor for security testing or policies that reduce duplicate report submissions can lower firm payoffs under BBPs. We draw related implications for research and practice in information security and crowdsourcing. This paper was accepted by Hemant Bhargava, information systems. Funding: This research is supported in part by the HKSAR General Research Fund Project 16503620. Supplemental Material: The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02682 .

title_zh: 从黑客处众包：漏洞赏金计划中的战略竞合与治理
abstract_zh: 在漏洞赏金计划（BBP）中，组织通过公开提供金钱奖励，激励黑客——他们原本可能成为“敌人”——报告安全漏洞。本文构建了一个分析框架，以刻画BBP及其战略与经济影响。在战略层面，BBP促使部分黑客自我选择进入合作性的漏洞发现与报告，使其从攻击行为中转移（攻击转移），并将部分保护努力委托给他们（保护委托）。我们表明：（i）即使黑客在漏洞识别方面效率低下，BBP仍可能有益，但更多参与者可能使BBP对企业吸引力下降。（ii）尽管BBP改善了安全，但它们可能激励竞争性黑客（即攻击者）付出更多努力。（iii）这种竞合动态可能使企业提供奖励与内部努力在社会层面变得低效。常见的网络安全监管，如违规处罚和赏金奖励补贴，可能加剧这种低效。我们发现赏金补贴与违规处罚之间存在互补性，表明根据企业特征将二者结合并定制化，可提升BBP效率。（iv）与传统观点认为众包奖励随参与者规模增加而增加相反，我们识别出在参与者规模增加时，企业应降低赏金奖励或对其进行非单调调整的情形。（v）安全测试的法律安全港或减少重复报告提交的政策，可能在BBP下降低企业收益。我们为信息安全与众包领域的研究与实践得出相关启示。本文由信息系统领域Hemant Bhargava接受。资助：本研究部分得到香港特别行政区研究资助局优配研究金项目16503620的支持。补充材料：在线附录可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.02682获取。

source_records.title: Firms’ Stock Prices, Stock Returns, and Remaining Lifetime Earnings
source_records.abstract: We document the disconnect between earnings expectations as captured in stock prices and the ultimate realization of earnings over long periods. To do so, we compare firms’ stock prices on the first trading day and the beginning of each year to the realized earnings over their remaining lifetime (RLTEP ratio). We document that the RLTEP ratio, averaged over long periods and over 15,000 U.S. domestic public firms, approximates one, suggesting that expectations match actuals in the aggregate. However, most firms fail to deliver an RLTEP ratio greater than one. Acquisition prices are the largest contributors to the RLTEP ratio, with many surviving firms failing to generate enough earnings even after operating for between 15 and 45 years. The RLTEP ratio for survivors is positively associated with the future RLTEP ratio, future lifetime wealth creation, and future lifetime stock returns. Significant returns-based wealth creation by firms in the short term does not persist in the long term unless it is supported by fundamental wealth creation (high past RLTEP ratio). This paper was accepted by Eric So, accounting. Funding: Financial support from SC Johnson Graduate School of Management, Cornell University, Columbia Business School, Columbia University, Binghamton University School of Management, and Haskayne School of Business, University of Calgary is gratefully acknowledged. source_records.title: Does Corporate Tax Planning Affect Firm Productivity?
source_records.abstract: We examine the relation between corporate tax planning and firm-level productivity. Using a sample of U.S. public firms from 1993 to 2017, we find that tax planning is positively associated with productivity. Our findings further indicate that tax planning contributes to growth in production input factors: capital and labor. We also test the underlying mechanisms, documenting that the observed association between productivity and tax planning is more pronounced in financially constrained and knowledge capital–intensive firms. We exploit the initiation of new banking relationships and the introduction of Check-the-Box regulations as sources of tax planning variation to facilitate difference-in-differences analyses. The empirical evidence holds consistently across a wide array of robustness tests. Taken together, the results enhance the understanding on the economic implications of tax planning and provide insights for informed tax policy debates. This paper was accepted by Suraj Srinivasan, accounting. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.03569 .

title_zh: 公司税收筹划是否影响企业生产率？
abstract_zh: 我们考察了公司税收筹划与企业层面生产率之间的关系。使用1993年至2017年美国上市公司样本，我们发现税收筹划与生产率正相关。我们的研究结果进一步表明，税收筹划促进了生产投入要素——资本和劳动——的增长。我们还检验了潜在机制，发现生产率与税收筹划之间的观察到的关联在融资受限和知识资本密集型企业中更为显著。我们利用新银行关系的建立和Check-the-Box法规的引入作为税收筹划变异的来源，以促进双重差分分析。实证证据在一系列稳健性检验中保持一致。总体而言，这些结果增进了对税收筹划经济影响的理解，并为知情的税收政策辩论提供了见解。本文由会计学领域的Suraj Srinivasan接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.03569获取。

source_records.title: Convex Surrogate Loss Functions for Contextual Pricing with Transaction Data
source_records.abstract: We study an off-policy contextual pricing problem in which the seller has access to samples of prices that customers were previously offered, whether they purchased at that price, and auxiliary features describing the customer and/or item being sold. This is in contrast to the well-studied setting in which samples of the customer’s valuation (willingness to pay) are observed. In our setting, the observed data are influenced by the previous pricing policy, and we do not know how customers would have responded to alternative prices. We introduce suitable loss functions for this setting that can be directly optimized to find an effective pricing policy with expected revenue guarantees without the need for estimation of an intermediate demand function. We focus on convex loss functions, which are especially important when linear pricing policies are preferred for interpretability. In such cases, the revenue optimization problem remains convex and tractable. Specifically, we propose generalized hinge and quantile pricing loss functions that price at a multiplicative factor of the conditional expected valuation or a particular quantile of the prices that sold despite the valuation data not being observed. We prove expected revenue bounds for these pricing policies when the valuation distribution is log-concave, and we provide generalization bounds for the finite sample case. Finally, we conduct simulations on both synthetic and real-world data to demonstrate that this approach is competitive with and, in some settings, outperforms state-of-the-art methods in contextual pricing. This paper was accepted by Vivek Farias, data science. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00122 .

title_original: Convex Surrogate Loss Functions for Contextual Pricing with Transaction Data
abstract_original: We study an off-policy contextual pricing problem in which the seller has access to samples of prices that customers were previously offered, whether they purchased at that price, and auxiliary features describing the customer and/or item being sold. This is in contrast to the well-studied setting in which samples of the customer’s valuation (willingness to pay) are observed. In our setting, the observed data are influenced by the previous pricing policy, and we do not know how customers would have responded to alternative prices. We introduce suitable loss functions for this setting that can be directly optimized to find an effective pricing policy with expected revenue guarantees without the need for estimation of an intermediate demand function. We focus on convex loss functions, which are especially important when linear pricing policies are preferred for interpretability. In such cases, the revenue optimization problem remains convex and tractable. Specifically, we propose generalized hinge and quantile pricing loss functions that price at a multiplicative factor of the conditional expected valuation or a particular quantile of the prices that sold despite the valuation data not being observed. We prove expected revenue bounds for these pricing policies when the valuation distribution is log-concave, and we provide generalization bounds for the finite sample case. Finally, we conduct simulations on both synthetic and real-world data to demonstrate that this approach is competitive with and, in some settings, outperforms state-of-the-art methods in contextual pricing. title_zh: 面向交易数据情境定价的凸代理损失函数
abstract_zh: 我们研究一个离策略情境定价问题，其中卖方可以获得客户先前被提供的价格样本、客户是否以该价格购买，以及描述客户和/或所售商品的辅助特征。这与已被充分研究的、可观测到客户估值（支付意愿）样本的情形形成对比。在我们的设定中，观测数据受到先前定价策略的影响，并且我们不知道客户对替代价格会如何反应。我们为该设定引入合适的损失函数，这些损失函数可以直接优化，以找到一个有效的定价策略，并具有期望收益保证，而无需估计中间需求函数。我们关注凸损失函数，当线性定价策略因可解释性而更受偏好时，凸损失函数尤为重要。在此类情况下，收益优化问题保持凸且可处理。具体而言，我们提出广义合页和分位数定价损失函数，它们在条件期望估值的乘性因子处定价，或在尽管估值数据未被观测到但仍售出的价格的特定分位数处定价。我们证明，当估值分布为对数凹时，这些定价策略的期望收益界，并为有限样本情形提供泛化界。最后，我们在合成数据和真实世界数据上进行模拟，以表明该方法与情境定价中最先进的方法相比具有竞争力，并在某些设定中优于这些方法。本文由Vivek Farias，数据科学领域接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00122获取。

source_records.title: Dynamic Pricing with Infrequent Inventory Replenishments
source_records.abstract: We consider a joint pricing and inventory control problem in which pricing can be adjusted more frequently than inventory ordering decisions. More specifically, the pricing decision is adjusted every period, whereas new inventory is ordered every epoch, with each epoch consisting of multiple periods. This setting is motivated by many examples, especially among online retailers, in which prices are much easier to change than inventory levels, because changing the latter is subject to prior arrangements or logistical constraints. In this setting, the retailer determines the inventory level at the beginning of each epoch and solves a dynamic pricing problem within that epoch, with no further replenishment opportunities. The optimal pricing and inventory control policy is obtained from an intricate dynamic program (DP), in which the inventory level is the state variable and the pricing policy is characterized as a function of the inventory level. We consider the situation in which the demand-price function and the distribution of random demand noise are both unknown to the retailer, who must develop an online learning algorithm to learn this information while simultaneously maximizing total profit. We propose a learning algorithm that applies linear bandit techniques under the upper confidence bound framework, and we prove that it converges through the DP recursions to the optimal pricing and inventory control policy that would be obtained under complete demand information. The theoretical lower bound for the convergence rate of the learning algorithm is proved based on the multivariate Van Trees inequality coupled with some structural DP analyses, and we show that the upper bound of our algorithm’s convergence rate matches the theoretical lower bound. Numerical results show that our learning algorithm performs very well. This paper was accepted by J. George Shanthikumar, data science. title_zh: 补货不频繁情形下的动态定价
abstract_zh: 我们研究一个联合定价与库存控制问题，其中定价的调整频率可以高于库存订购决策。更具体地说，定价决策在每个周期都进行调整，而新库存则在每个阶段（epoch）订购，每个阶段由多个周期组成。这一设定受到许多实例的启发，尤其是在在线零售商中，价格比库存水平更容易改变，因为改变后者受到事先安排或物流约束的限制。在这一设定下，零售商在每个阶段开始时确定库存水平，并在该阶段内求解一个动态定价问题，且没有进一步的补货机会。最优定价与库存控制策略由一个复杂的动态规划（DP）得到，其中库存水平是状态变量，定价策略被刻画为库存水平的函数。我们考虑需求-价格函数和随机需求噪声的分布对零售商均未知的情形，零售商必须开发一种在线学习算法来学习这些信息，同时最大化总利润。我们提出一种在上置信界框架下应用线性bandit技术的学习算法，并证明它通过DP递推收敛到在完全需求信息下会得到的最优定价与库存控制策略。学习算法收敛速度的理论下界基于多元Van Trees不等式并结合一些结构性DP分析得到证明，并且我们表明该算法收敛速度的上界与理论下界相匹配。数值结果表明，我们的学习算法表现非常好。本文由J. George Shanthikumar（数据科学）接受。资助：本工作得到MIT数据科学实验室、普渡大学数据科学决策中心、香港研究资助局（RGC）早期职业计划[CityU21505825]、香港RGC一般研究基金[CityU11508223]，以及伊利诺伊大学系统与台湾大学学术联盟之间的联合研究与创新种子资助计划的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00129获取。

source_records.title: Collaborative Learning and Decision Making on Pricing and Recommendation: A Simple Framework for Planning
source_records.abstract: We formulate a collaborative learning and decision-making problem involving contextual information. In current business practices, pricing and recommendation decisions often are made jointly by multiple teams in sequence. The decision-making processes for different teams can be controlled by either a centralized or decentralized planner. We propose a simple collaboration framework that integrates the learning about decision making in an unknown environment. The main challenge in a decentralized framework is that the decision-making process in other teams is unknown, but the subsequent decisions are mutually dependent. From a practical concern about high exploration costs and implementation complexity, we propose a simple greedy algorithm for centralized planners and a “greedy” + “weighted sampling” (GWS) algorithm for both centralized and decentralized planners to balance the learning and earning. We show that the exploration-free greedy algorithm can achieve the optimal rate when context diversity holds. The GWS algorithm works effectively for either centralized or decentralized planners under a much weaker condition, which we call context variation. Furthermore, we extend our framework to the multiproduct pricing and ranking problem and study the model misspecification issue. We validate our results using simulations on synthetic and real data. Numerical studies show the superior performance of the two proposed frameworks for different types of planners. This paper was accepted by J. George Shanthikumar, data science. Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00320 .

title_zh: 关于定价与推荐的协作学习与决策：一个简单的规划框架
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个涉及情境信息的协作学习与决策问题。在当前商业实践中，定价与推荐决策通常由多个团队按顺序共同做出。不同团队的决策过程既可以由集中式规划者控制，也可以由分散式规划者控制。我们提出了一个简单的协作框架，将未知环境中的决策学习整合起来。分散式框架中的主要挑战在于，其他团队的决策过程是未知的，但后续决策却相互依赖。出于对高探索成本和实施复杂性的实际考虑，我们提出了一种适用于集中式规划者的简单贪心算法，以及一种适用于集中式和分散式规划者的“贪心”+“加权采样”（GWS）算法，以平衡学习与收益。我们证明，在情境多样性成立时，无探索的贪心算法可以达到最优速率。GWS算法在一种弱得多的条件下——我们称之为情境变化——对集中式或分散式规划者都能有效运行。此外，我们将框架扩展到多产品定价与排序问题，并研究了模型误设问题。我们使用合成数据和真实数据通过模拟验证了结果。数值研究表明，所提出的两个框架对不同类型规划者均具有优越性能。本文由J. George Shanthikumar（数据科学）接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00320获取。

source_records.title: Predictive Production-and-Service Planning: Ambiguity Aversion with Performance Guarantees
source_records.abstract: We consider a two-stage joint production and service planning problem under demand ambiguity. The product-service provider receives a fixed amount of revenue from the recipient in advance (first-stage), and is committed to fulfill all the demands realized over a specific period (second-stage). The provider aims to determine the portfolio of products with the associated service levels and the capacity to maximize the expected total profit. We study the problem in a data-driven setting assuming the historical information on demand and the associated covariates are available, where the service decision is itself a key covariate for demand. In order to capture the effect of demand correlation and variance-heterogeneity across products and the effect of service dependency under demand ambiguity, we construct a predictive ambiguity set leveraging seemingly unrelated regression (SUR) estimated with feasible generalized least squares (FGLS), which treats the service level as a regressor and addresses the heteroskedasticity. We then develop a decision-dependent two-stage distributionally robust optimization (DRO) model. Operationally, we identify that the developed predictive DRO model can be reformulated as an empirical counterpart under the predicted demand distribution regularized by a perceived shortage cost as the shadow price for ambiguity aversion. Exploiting this structure, we analyze the ambiguity-averse operational properties and risk exposure in terms of worst-case performance sensitivity. Statistically, our approach enjoys finite-sample performance guarantee and asymptotic consistency under several regularity conditions. Computationally, the proposed model can be reformulated as a mixed-integer conic program that enjoys an appealing structure for optimization. Finally, sufficient numerical experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach. This paper was accepted by J. George Shanthikumar, data science. Funding: S. M. F. Saldanha-da-Gama and S. M. Wang are also jointly supported by the President’s International Fellowship Initiative [Grant 2025PVA0080] of the Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS). S. Y. title_zh: 预测性生产与服务规划：具有性能保证的模糊厌恶
abstract_zh: 我们研究需求模糊下的两阶段联合生产与服务规划问题。产品服务提供方预先从接受方获得固定金额的收入（第一阶段），并承诺履行在特定期间内实现的所有需求（第二阶段）。提供方旨在确定产品组合及相应的服务水平与产能，以最大化期望总利润。我们在数据驱动的设定下研究该问题，假设可获得关于需求及相关协变量的历史信息，其中服务决策本身即为需求的一个关键协变量。为了刻画需求相关性以及跨产品的方差异质性效应，以及需求模糊下服务依赖性的效应，我们构建了一个预测性模糊集，利用可行广义最小二乘法（FGLS）估计的似不相关回归（SUR），将服务水平视为回归变量并处理异方差性。随后，我们建立了一个决策依赖的两阶段分布鲁棒优化（DRO）模型。在操作层面，我们发现所构建的预测性DRO模型可以重新表述为预测需求分布下的经验对应模型，并以感知短缺成本作为模糊厌恶的影子价格进行正则化。利用这一结构，我们从最坏情况性能敏感性的角度分析了模糊厌恶的运营属性与风险暴露。在统计层面，我们的方法在若干正则条件下具有有限样本性能保证和渐近一致性。在计算层面，所提出的模型可以重新表述为一个混合整数锥规划，其结构在优化方面具有吸引力。最后，充分的数值实验证明了所提方法的有效性。本文由J. George Shanthikumar（数据科学）接受。资助：S. M. Wang受国家自然科学基金[资助号72471224、72171221、71922020和71988101]、中央高校基本科研业务费[资助号UCAS-E2ET0808X2]以及中国科学院大学数字经济预测与政策模拟教育部社会科学实验室资助。F. Saldanha-da-Gama和S. M. Wang还共同受到中国科学院（CAS）院长国际 fellowship 计划[资助号2025PVA0080]的资助。S. Y. Wang受国家自然科学基金[资助号71988101]资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00608获取。

source_records.title: Entrepreneurial Teams: Prior Industry Experience and Early-Stage Growth
source_records.abstract: We use career backgrounds of initial employees from a full cohort of U.S. startups to measure founding teams’ skillsets. Startups with more diverse prior industry experience grow faster than same-industry local peers. One-standard-deviation-higher diversity is associated with 16% (10%) higher five-year employment (sales) growth, controlling for demographic diversity, prestartup wages, and other observables. Startups in innovative industries and facing lower coordination costs among team members drive the results. To address endogeneity, we exploit shocks in which teams suddenly lose members with unduplicated skills. Overall, combining individual specialization with team-level diversification allows teams to act as “jacks of all trades and masters of each.” This paper was accepted by Bo Becker, finance. Funding: This research uses data from the Census Bureau’s Longitudinal Employer Household Dynamics Program, which was partially supported by the National Science Foundation [Grants SES-9978093, SES-0339191 and ITR-0427889], the National Institute on Aging [Grant AG018854], and grants from the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation. Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00773 .

title_zh: 创业团队：先前的行业经验与早期成长
abstract_zh: 我们利用美国全部初创企业初始员工的职业背景来衡量创始团队的技能组合。先前行业经验更多样化的初创企业，比同行业的本地同行增长更快。在控制人口统计多样性、创业前工资及其他可观测因素后，多样性每高出1个标准差，与五年就业（销售）增长高出16%（10%）相关。创新型行业中的初创企业以及团队成员间协调成本较低的企业推动了这一结果。为解决内生性问题，我们利用了团队突然失去拥有不可替代技能的成员这一冲击。总体而言，将个人专业化与团队层面的多样化相结合，使团队能够成为“样样通，样样精”。本文由Bo Becker（金融学）接受。资助：本研究使用了美国人口普查局纵向雇主—家庭动态项目的数据，该项目部分得到美国国家科学基金会[资助号SES-9978093、SES-0339191和ITR-0427889]、美国国家老龄化研究所[资助号AG018854]以及阿尔弗雷德·P·斯隆基金会资助的支持。补充材料：互联网附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00773获取。

source_records.title: Assortment Optimization with α-Similar Substitutes: Insights from Customer Browsing Patterns
source_records.abstract: We propose an approach to model assortment optimization problems based on two observations we made from customer browsing history on Taobao. First, most customers consider very few items (no more than five) before purchasing. Second, there exists a sorting of items so that most customer consideration sets are contained in small intervals in this sorting. This sorting can be discovered by the Cuthill-McKee algorithm, which is designed to work with sparse matrices. We encode these two observations into the [Formula: see text]-similar substitutes property, which requires that all customers have consideration sets that lie in intervals (in the sorting) of length at most [Formula: see text], where [Formula: see text] is a parameter we select and is fitted from data. The assortment optimization and pricing problems associated with this property are fixed-parameter tractable for a fixed [Formula: see text]. Moreover, we show that the assortment optimization for some specific choice model with [Formula: see text]-similar substitutes property is polynomial-time solvable. We demonstrate our approach—going from data to modeling (i.e., selecting an appropriate [Formula: see text]) and finally to optimization—on another data set of customer click history on JD.com. Lastly, we conduct sensitivity tests on choice models that satisfy the [Formula: see text]-similar substitutes property in the presence of customers with large consideration sets. We provide an approximation guarantee in terms of revenue when asserting the [Formula: see text]-similar substitutes property. Both theoretical and numerical results show that the optimal assortment of our estimated model captures most of the revenue even when there are customers with large consideration sets. This paper was accepted by Vivek Farias, data science. Funding: B. title_zh: 具有α-相似替代品的品类优化：来自顾客浏览模式的洞见
abstract_zh: 我们基于从淘宝顾客浏览历史中得到的两个观察，提出了一种对品类优化问题进行建模的方法。第一，大多数顾客在购买前考虑的商品非常少（不超过五件）。第二，存在一种商品排序，使得大多数顾客考虑集都包含在该排序中的小间隔内。这种排序可以通过Cuthill-McKee算法发现，该算法专为处理稀疏矩阵而设计。我们将这两个观察编码为[公式：见正文]-相似替代品性质，该性质要求所有顾客的考虑集都位于（该排序中）长度至多为[公式：见正文]的间隔内，其中[公式：见正文]是我们选择并从数据中拟合得到的参数。与这一性质相关的品类优化和定价问题对于固定的[公式：见正文]是固定参数可处理的。此外，我们证明，对于具有[公式：见正文]-相似替代品性质的某些特定选择模型，品类优化是多项式时间可解的。我们在另一个京东顾客点击历史数据集上展示了我们的方法——从数据到建模（即选择合适的[公式：见正文]），最后到优化。最后，我们在存在具有大考虑集的顾客时，对满足[公式：见正文]-相似替代品性质的选择模型进行了敏感性测试。当断言[公式：见正文]-相似替代品性质时，我们提供了关于收入的近似保证。理论和数值结果均表明，即使存在具有大考虑集的顾客，我们估计模型的最优品类仍能捕获大部分收入。本文由Vivek Farias，数据科学领域接受。资助：B. source_records.title: Why Context Influences Preferences Elicited with Willingness to Pay Less Than Preferences Elicited with Choice
source_records.abstract: Normative theories assume that people have stable preferences across logically equivalent decision contexts. Preference reversals, cases where preferred options vary across decision contexts, violate this assumption and suggest that preferences are constructed during the decision-making process. We contribute to this literature by identifying a boundary condition for these context effects. We theorize that monetary preference elicitations, such as willingness to pay (WTP) and willingness to accept (WTA), evoke comparisons to external out-of-context standards, such as the market price of similar goods. These out-of-context comparisons should weaken the influence of the local context. Our theory predicts that context effects will be weaker for (1) monetary versus nonmonetary preference elicitations (e.g., WTP/WTA versus choice) and when (2) options differ on attributes highly correlated with market prices of similar goods and services. Across 22 studies, we find support for these predictions using three canonical decision context effects (intertemporal tradeoffs, framing effects, and attraction effects), incentive-compatible and stated preferences, and different response formats (binary, continuous, and mixed). Preferences for a wide range of goods and services—including baked goods, apartments, and lotteries—exhibit these patterns. Our theory explains substantial variance in context effects and offers testable predictions for when context effects will arise in research and practice. This paper was accepted by George Wu, behavioral economics and decision analysis. Funding: This work was supported by Connaught Fund. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00913 .

title_zh: 为什么情境对支付意愿所引出的偏好的影响小于对选择所引出的偏好的影响
abstract_zh: 规范理论假设人们在逻辑等价的决策情境中具有稳定的偏好。偏好反转，即偏好的选项在不同决策情境中发生变化的情况，违背了这一假设，并表明偏好是在决策过程中建构的。我们通过识别这些情境效应的一个边界条件，为这一文献做出贡献。我们提出理论认为，货币化的偏好引出方式，如支付意愿（WTP）和接受意愿（WTA），会引发与情境之外的外部标准的比较，例如类似商品的市场价格。这些脱离情境的比较应当会削弱局部情境的影响。我们的理论预测，情境效应在以下情况下会更弱：（1）货币化与非货币化偏好引出方式相比（例如WTP/WTA与选择相比），以及（2）当选项在与类似商品和服务的市场价格高度相关的属性上存在差异时。在22项研究中，我们使用三种典型的决策情境效应（跨期权衡、框架效应和吸引效应）、激励相容偏好与陈述性偏好，以及不同的作答格式（二元、连续和混合），发现了对这些预测的支持。对广泛商品和服务的偏好——包括烘焙食品、公寓和彩票——都表现出这些模式。我们的理论解释了情境效应中的大量方差，并为情境效应在研究与实践中何时会出现提供了可检验的预测。本文由George Wu，行为经济学与决策分析领域接受。资助：本工作得到Connaught Fund的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.00913获取。

source_records.title: Linking Firm-Generated Social Media Content to Sales and Returns
source_records.abstract: The growing importance of content marketing on social media has made it imperative for firms to evaluate the effectiveness of their posts in driving business performance. However, academic research offers limited insight into how firm-generated content on social platforms affects performance metrics such as product sales and returns. This paper contributes to addressing that gap by examining the relationship between social media marketing on Facebook and transactional outcomes, using data from the online channel of a luxury fashion accessory manufacturer. We augment the transaction data with the firm’s Facebook posts, classifying them as either informative or persuasive. Informative posts are further distinguished based on whether they pertain to standard (ISP posts) or customizable (ICP posts) product features. Our results indicate that ISP posts are associated with increases in sales and returns, whereas ICP posts are associated with decreases in both outcomes. Moreover, we find that the associations of ISP posts with sales and returns are weaker when accompanied by persuasive content, whereas persuasive content only attenuates the relationship between ICP posts and returns. These findings are robust across alternative model specifications and estimation methods and offer valuable managerial insights for firms seeking to optimize their social media marketing strategies. This paper was accepted by D. J. Wu, information systems. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01432 .

title_zh: 将企业生成的社交媒体内容与销售额和退货量相联系
abstract_zh: 社交媒体上内容营销日益重要，这使得企业必须评估其帖子在推动业务绩效方面的有效性。然而，学术研究对于企业在社交平台上生成的内容如何影响产品销售和退货等绩效指标所提供的洞见仍然有限。本文通过考察Facebook上的社交媒体营销与交易结果之间的关系，为弥补这一空白作出贡献，所用数据来自一家奢侈时尚配饰制造商的线上渠道。我们在交易数据中加入了该公司的Facebook帖子，并将其分类为信息型或说服型。信息型帖子又根据其涉及的是标准产品特征（ISP帖子）还是可定制产品特征（ICP帖子）进一步区分。我们的结果表明，ISP帖子与销售额和退货量的增加相关，而ICP帖子则与这两项结果的下降相关。此外，我们发现，当ISP帖子伴随说服型内容时，其与销售额和退货量的关联较弱，而说服型内容仅减弱ICP帖子与退货量之间的关系。这些发现在替代模型设定和估计方法下均保持稳健，并为寻求优化其社交媒体营销策略的企业提供了有价值的管理启示。本文由D. J. Wu（信息系统领域）接受。补充材料：数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01432获取。

source_records.title: Nonadditivity of Subjective Expectations over Different Time Intervals
source_records.abstract: We examine the additivity of expectations over different time intervals. For example, when asked about 10-year stock price growth, survey respondents report an expected change that is not equal to, but closer to zero than, the sum of their expectations over two shorter time intervals that cover the same 10 years. Such subadditivity, which we also find in expectations for other economic variables, is irrational, as it cannot stem from aggregating short-term expectations. Model estimates show that the pattern is consistent with a time perception where shorter time intervals have a proportionally larger weight. We also find that the respondents’ degree of additivity is correlated with making larger financial investments. This paper was accepted by Manel Baucells, behavioral economics and decision analysis. Funding: This work was supported by Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (the German Science Foundation) via CRC TRR 190 [Grant 280092119]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01558 .

title_zh: 不同时间区间上主观期望的不可加性
abstract_zh: 我们考察了不同时间区间上期望的可加性。例如，当被问及10年期股价增长时，调查受访者所报告的预期变化并不等于、而是比他们对覆盖同一10年的两个较短时间区间期望之和更接近于零。这种次可加性——我们在其他经济变量的期望中也发现了这一点——是不理性的，因为它不可能源于对短期期望的加总。模型估计表明，该模式与一种时间感知相一致，即较短的时间区间具有按比例更大的权重。我们还发现，受访者的可加性程度与进行更大规模的金融投资相关。本文由Manel Baucells（行为经济学与决策分析）接受。资助：本工作由德国研究基金会（Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft）通过CRC TRR 190 [Grant 280092119]资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01558获取。

source_records.title: Is It Always “the Faster, the Better?” The Role of a Nudging-Based Function in the Relationship Between Product Delivery and Online Sales
source_records.abstract: Delivery time is one of the keys to e-commerce success. Although retailers are taking steps to offer fast delivery services, these approaches are expensive, and they may not be sustainable in the long term. By leveraging a unique shift resulting from user-interface designs on eBay.com, we find that introducing a nudging-based function (i.e., a guaranteed delivery toggle) is a promising cost-effective approach that may ameliorate the relationship between slow delivery time and product sales. Specifically, our research devises three complementary studies—(1) examining the sales impact of the toggle function using a large-scale secondary data set, (2) investigating the underlying mechanism of the toggle effectiveness through laboratory and online experiments, and (3) analyzing the far-reaching impacts on consumers’ subsequent rating behaviors—to establish the external and internal validity and the robustness of this finding. We attribute the expansion of slow-delivery item sales (Study 1) to the subtle change in the design of the choice architecture from simultaneous attribute choices to sequential attribute choices (Study 2). Study 3 reveals the mitigation of dimensional rating bias toward delivery time, further interpreting the nudging effect of sequential attribute choices. Given the dilemma of e-commerce for fast-delivery provision, our research elucidates how practitioners improve their operational decisions to address the last-mile logistics problem by factoring in a simple and free delivery-related nudge. This paper was accepted by D. J. Wu, information systems. Funding: This research was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72101104, 72471106, and 72571259], and it was partially supported by the Soft Science Special Project of the Gansu Basic Research Plan [Grant 24JRZA032] and the Fundamental Research Funds for the Central Universities [Grant 2024lzujbkyqm009]. source_records.abstract: Delivery time is one of the keys to e-commerce success. Although retailers are taking steps to offer fast delivery services, these approaches are expensive, and they may not be sustainable in the long term. By leveraging a unique shift resulting from user-interface designs on eBay.com, we find that introducing a nudging-based function (i.e., a guaranteed delivery toggle) is a promising cost-effective approach that may ameliorate the relationship between slow delivery time and product sales. Specifically, our research devises three complementary studies—(1) examining the sales impact of the toggle function using a large-scale secondary data set, (2) investigating the underlying mechanism of the toggle effectiveness through laboratory and online experiments, and (3) analyzing the far-reaching impacts on consumers’ subsequent rating behaviors—to establish the external and internal validity and the robustness of this finding. We attribute the expansion of slow-delivery item sales (Study 1) to the subtle change in the design of the choice architecture from simultaneous attribute choices to sequential attribute choices (Study 2). Study 3 reveals the mitigation of dimensional rating bias toward delivery time, further interpreting the nudging effect of sequential attribute choices. Given the dilemma of e-commerce for fast-delivery provision, our research elucidates how practitioners improve their operational decisions to address the last-mile logistics problem by factoring in a simple and free delivery-related nudge. This paper was accepted by D. J. Wu, information systems. title_zh: 总是“越快越好”吗？基于助推的功能在产品配送与在线销售关系中的作用
abstract_zh: 配送时间是电子商务成功的关键之一。尽管零售商正在采取措施提供快速配送服务，但这些方法成本高昂，且从长期来看可能不可持续。通过利用eBay.com用户界面设计所带来的一次独特转变，我们发现，引入一种基于助推的功能（即保证送达切换按钮）是一种有前景且具有成本效益的方法，可能改善慢配送时间与产品销售之间的关系。具体而言，我们的研究设计了三项互补研究——（1）使用大规模二手数据集考察该切换按钮功能对销售的影响，（2）通过实验室实验和在线实验探究该切换按钮有效性的潜在机制，（3）分析其对消费者后续评分行为的深远影响——以确立该发现的外部效度、内部效度及稳健性。我们将慢配送商品销售的扩大（研究1）归因于选择架构设计从同时属性选择到序贯属性选择的细微变化（研究2）。研究3揭示了针对配送时间的维度评分偏差得到缓解，进一步解释了序贯属性选择的助推效应。鉴于电子商务在提供快速配送方面的困境，我们的研究阐明了从业者如何通过纳入一个简单且免费的配送相关助推来改进其运营决策，以应对最后一公里物流问题。本文由信息系统领域的D. J. Wu接受。资助：本研究得到国家自然科学基金[资助号72101104、72471106和72571259]的资助，并得到甘肃省基础研究计划软科学专项[资助号24JRZA032]和中央高校基本科研业务费[资助号2024lzujbkyqm009]的部分资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01572获取。

source_records.title: Duplicated Orders, Swift Cancellations, and Fast Market Making in Fragmented Markets
source_records.abstract: Employing unique data from 91 stocks trading on their primary exchanges and three alternative venues, we show that liquidity suppliers post duplicate limit orders on competing trading venues and cancel the duplicated orders immediately after one of them is filled. This is consistent with liquidity suppliers engaging in crossvenue market making. This duplicated-then-canceled liquidity is predominantly used by high-frequency traders when their inventories are not excessive. It reduces execution costs of fast traders on alternative venues. It, however, has some adverse impact on execution costs on primary exchanges, but those negative effects fail to outweigh the liquidity benefits of market fragmentation. This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance. Funding: The authors thank the Agence Nationale de la Recherche [Grant ANR-15-CE33-0006] for funding the project and Centre pour la recherche économique et ses applications for granting additional research budget. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01789 .
