title_zh: 分割市场中的重复订单、快速撤单与快速做市
abstract_zh: 利用来自91只股票在其主要交易所和三个替代交易场所交易的独特数据，我们表明流动性提供者在相互竞争的交易场所提交重复的限价订单，并在其中一个订单成交后立即撤销重复订单。这与流动性提供者从事跨场所做市相一致。这种先重复后撤销的流动性主要被高频交易者在其余额不过度时使用。它降低了快速交易者在替代交易场所的执行成本。然而，它对主要交易所的执行成本产生了一定的不利影响，但这些负面影响未能超过市场分割带来的流动性收益。本文被Agostino Capponi（金融学）接受。资助：作者感谢法国国家研究署[Grant ANR-15-CE33-0006]为本项目提供资助，并感谢经济研究及其应用中心提供额外研究预算。补充材料：数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01789获取。

source_records.title: The Nonstationary Newsvendor: Data-Driven Nonparametric Learning
source_records.abstract: We study a newsvendor problem with unknown demand distribution in a nonstationary demand environment over a multiperiod time horizon. The demand in each period consists of a time-varying demand level and an additive random shock. Neither the demand level nor the random shock is separately observable. The amount of change in the demand level over the time horizon is measured by a cumulative variation metric. The problem has widespread applications, such as perishable inventory planning, staffing, and medical resource capacity planning in the wake of COVID-19. We design a family of nonparametric dynamic ordering policies, termed two-stage estimation (2SE) policies, that track the shifts in the unknown demand level while accounting for the unobservable random demand shocks. To compute the order quantity in each period, these policies only need the past demand observations, without any access to the underlying demand distribution. For a finite variation “budget,” we prove that our ordering policies are first-order optimal in the sense that their regret grows at the smallest possible rate. We also extend our analysis to the case of asymptotically large variation budgets. Through case studies based on real-life data, we show that our policies can save more than 20% of overage and underage costs, relative to policies widely used for perishable inventory replenishment and nurse staffing. Moreover, our simulation experiments indicate that our policies consistently maintain superior performance across diverse patterns of nonstationary demand environments. This paper was accepted by David Simchi-Levi, operations management. Funding: N. B. Keskin and J.-S. Song were supported by the Duke University Fuqua School of Business, and X. Min was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72401195] and the China Postdoctoral Science Foundation [2025T180216]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01823 .

source_records.title: Rational Abandonment from Observable Priority Queues: Equilibrium Strategy, Performance, and Pricing Implications
source_records.abstract: Observable priority queues, where some customers are served ahead of others, are prevalent in many service systems, ranging from the entertainment industry to emergency departments (EDs). In this paper, we study the rational abandonment behavior of utility-maximizing customers in the context of an observable two-class priority queue and identify novel performance and pricing implications. We first characterize the structure of the rational abandonment strategy and show that it has a threshold-based last-come, first-abandon structure. We then examine the steady-state performance of the system under the rational abandonment strategy and in contrast with an exogenous abandonment model commonly used in the literature. We show that using the exogenous abandonment model could result in highly suboptimal decisions when considering capacity planning to meet target waiting times and/or abandonment rates. We further investigate optimal pricing strategies under rational abandonment. Our results highlight the importance of the timing of payments. We show that welfare maximization requires charging only a service fee and no entrance fee. In contrast, revenue maximization generally requires a combination of both an entrance and a service fee. Furthermore, welfare-maximizing prices always involve abandonment, whereas revenue maximization may require pricing strategies that prevent abandonment. Finally, we discuss the implications of our results for our motivating applications, including the perils of charging nonurgent ED patients upfront. This paper was accepted by Baris Ata, stochastic models and simulation. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01924 .

title_zh: 可观测优先队列中的理性放弃：均衡策略、绩效与定价含义
abstract_zh: 可观测优先队列——即某些顾客先于其他顾客获得服务——在从娱乐产业到急诊科（ED）的许多服务系统中普遍存在。本文研究在可观测的两类优先队列情境中，追求效用最大化的顾客的理性放弃行为，并识别出新的绩效与定价含义。我们首先刻画理性放弃策略的结构，并表明其具有基于阈值的后到先放弃结构。随后，我们考察在理性放弃策略下系统的稳态绩效，并与文献中常用的外生放弃模型进行对比。我们表明，在考虑容量规划以满足目标等待时间和/或放弃率时，使用外生放弃模型可能导致高度次优的决策。我们进一步研究理性放弃下的最优定价策略。我们的结果凸显了付款时机的重要性。我们表明，福利最大化要求只收取服务费而不收取入场费。相反，收入最大化通常要求同时收取入场费和服务费。此外，福利最大化的价格总是涉及放弃，而收入最大化可能要求采取防止放弃的定价策略。最后，我们讨论我们的结果对启发性应用的含义，包括向非紧急急诊科患者预先收费的危险。本文由Baris Ata、随机模型与仿真领域接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01924获取。

source_records.title: Measurement for Dummies? Exploring the Role of Regulatory Metrics and Firm Strategy
source_records.abstract: Most regulations are operationalized through metrics: numerical thresholds, targets, or test procedures that translate broad policy objectives into enforceable rules. Yet we know little about how these metrics shape firms’ strategic behavior. This paper aims to fill this gap by studying the introduction of the side impact dummy (SID) in U.S. automotive regulation, which established a regulatory metric based on the average male-sized body. Using detailed data on U.S. vehicular accidents, I find that the regulation led to large reductions in side-impact fatalities, but there were disproportionate benefits for occupants whose body sizes resembled SID. Furthermore this pattern is driven by heterogeneous firm behavior: Some firms delivered safety improvements across all occupants, whereas others focused narrowly on meeting the metric. This was moderated by two factors: firms’ strategic alignment with safety and their metric-based capabilities. Only firms with both dimensions were able to make broad improvements in line with policy objectives. These findings underscore the powerful role of regulatory metrics in channeling firm attention and effort. The ultimate impact of a regulation therefore depends not only on what policymakers measure but also which firms have the motivation and capabilities to act on them in a broad policy-consistent way. This paper was accepted by Toby Stuart, entrepreneurship and innovation. Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01987 .

title_original: Measurement for Dummies? Exploring the Role of Regulatory Metrics and Firm Strategy
abstract_original: Most regulations are operationalized through metrics: numerical thresholds, targets, or test procedures that translate broad policy objectives into enforceable rules. Yet we know little about how these metrics shape firms’ strategic behavior. This paper aims to fill this gap by studying the introduction of the side impact dummy (SID) in U.S. automotive regulation, which established a regulatory metric based on the average male-sized body. Using detailed data on U.S. vehicular accidents, I find that the regulation led to large reductions in side-impact fatalities, but there were disproportionate benefits for occupants whose body sizes resembled SID. Furthermore this pattern is driven by heterogeneous firm behavior: Some firms delivered safety improvements across all occupants, whereas others focused narrowly on meeting the metric. This was moderated by two factors: firms’ strategic alignment with safety and their metric-based capabilities. Only firms with both dimensions were able to make broad improvements in line with policy objectives. These findings underscore the powerful role of regulatory metrics in channeling firm attention and effort. The ultimate impact of a regulation therefore depends not only on what policymakers measure but also which firms have the motivation and capabilities to act on them in a broad policy-consistent way. title_zh: 为傻瓜而设的测量？探究监管指标与企业战略的作用
abstract_zh: 大多数监管都是通过指标来实施的：数值阈值、目标或测试程序，将宽泛的政策目标转化为可执行的规则。然而，我们对这些指标如何塑造企业的战略行为知之甚少。本文旨在填补这一空白，通过研究美国汽车监管中侧面碰撞假人（SID）的引入，该假人建立了一个基于平均男性体型身体的监管指标。利用美国车辆事故的详细数据，我发现该监管导致了侧面碰撞死亡人数的大幅减少，但对体型与SID相似的乘员带来了不成比例的益处。此外，这一模式是由异质性企业行为驱动的：一些企业在所有乘员中实现了安全改进，而另一些企业则狭隘地专注于满足指标。这受到两个因素的调节：企业与安全的战略一致性以及其基于指标的能力。只有同时具备这两个维度的企业才能按照政策目标实现广泛的改进。这些发现强调了监管指标在引导企业注意力和努力方面的强大作用。因此，一项监管的最终影响不仅取决于政策制定者衡量什么，还取决于哪些企业有动机和能力以广泛且与政策一致的方式对其采取行动。本文由Toby Stuart，创业与创新领域接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.01987 获取。

source_records.title: The Engineering of Consumer Experiences Under Affect Assimilation and Quality Contrast
source_records.abstract: Consumer experiences are inherently dynamic. When engaging in a sequence of activities, consumers are influenced by past experiences in two ways: negatively by their objective quality, through quality contrast; and positively by their subjective appreciation of them, through affect assimilation. How should experience curators sequence activities to maximize consumer satisfaction in the presence of such intertemporal effects? We formulate an experience curator’s problem as a dynamic optimization program. We show that, because of affect assimilation, the best activity may be scheduled at the beginning or in the middle of an experience, in contrast to the common peak-end rule—this provides a rationale for the saying that “first impressions matter.” Under uncertainty, it may be valuable to save the best activity as a “wild card” to recover from bad outcomes. We calibrate our model to four distinct experiential contexts (namely, watching movies, reading books, visiting touristic attractions, and eating out) and consistently find the presence of both quality contrast and affect assimilation. Through a counterfactual study in the context of touristic tours, we show that experience curators may significantly benefit from offering different fixed sequences to different types of consumers, but they tend to gain little from dynamically adjusting them. This paper was accepted by David Simchi-Levi, operations management. Funding: This work was supported by the Agencia Estatal de Investigación [Grant PID2020-116135GB-I00 MCIN/AEI/10.13039/50110001]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02150 .

title_zh: 情感同化与质量对比下的消费者体验工程
abstract_zh: 消费者体验本质上是动态的。在参与一系列活动时，消费者会以两种方式受到过去体验的影响：通过质量对比，其客观质量会带来负面影响；通过情感同化，消费者对过去体验的主观欣赏会带来正面影响。在这种跨期效应存在的情况下，体验策划者应如何安排活动顺序以最大化消费者满意度？我们将体验策划者的问题表述为一个动态优化规划。我们表明，由于情感同化，最佳活动可能被安排在体验的开头或中间，这与常见的峰终定律形成对比——这为“第一印象很重要”这一说法提供了依据。在不确定情况下，将最佳活动保留为“外卡”以从糟糕结果中恢复可能是有价值的。我们将模型校准到四种不同的体验情境（即看电影、读书、游览旅游景点和外出就餐），并一致发现质量对比和情感同化同时存在。通过在旅游线路情境中的反事实研究，我们表明体验策划者可能从向不同类型的消费者提供不同的固定顺序中显著受益，但他们从动态调整这些顺序中往往获益甚微。本文由David Simchi-Levi，运营管理领域接受。资助：本研究得到Agencia Estatal de Investigación的资助[Grant PID2020-116135GB-I00 MCIN/AEI/10.13039/50110001]。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02150 获取。

source_records.title: Does Renewable Energy Renew Energy Efficiency?
source_records.abstract: Since 2015, global progress in improving energy efficiency has lagged behind the targets set by the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals, in part due to behavioral barriers to such improvement. Rising renewable energy adoption may impact energy efficiency improvement by raising or lowering these barriers. The well-documented rebound effect—where renewable energy adoption may increase energy consumption—could hinder efficiency gains, whereas renewable energy adoption may also raise awareness of energy use, thereby driving efficiency improvement. This paper examines whether and how renewable energy adoption influences energy efficiency improvement. Using data from 183 sites of a multinational industrial conglomerate from 2015 to 2020, we estimate the impact of changes in renewable energy usage and procurement methods on energy efficiency improvement. We find that using renewable energy to satisfy an additional 10% of a site’s energy demand caused an additional 2.8%–6.1% improvement in energy efficiency. However, the impact varies significantly depending on the procurement approach. Sourcing off-site renewable energy led to energy efficiency improvement, whereas installing on-site renewable energy generation had either no effect or a negative effect. To understand the mechanism, we surveyed site managers and conducted further analysis by leveraging variations in on-site generation costs. Our results indicate that the rebound effect prevailed when sites adopted renewable energy with low ongoing costs. For corporations expanding renewable energy usage, we offer evidence of additional energy efficiency benefits, but capitalizing on these benefits requires careful consideration of the procurement approach. For policymakers, we provide guidance on prioritizing certain procurement methods to accelerate progress toward net-zero. This paper was accepted by Jay Swaminathan, operations management. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02165 .

title_zh: 可再生能源能否提升能源效率？
abstract_zh: 自2015年以来，全球在提升能源效率方面的进展一直落后于联合国可持续发展目标所设定的指标，部分原因在于此类改进面临行为障碍。可再生能源采用的增加可能通过提高或降低这些障碍来影响能源效率的提升。有充分文献记录的反弹效应——即可再生能源采用可能增加能源消耗——可能阻碍效率提升，而可再生能源采用也可能提高对能源使用的意识，从而推动效率提升。本文考察可再生能源采用是否以及如何影响能源效率提升。利用一家跨国工业集团183个站点2015年至2020年的数据，我们估计了可再生能源使用量和采购方式的变化对能源效率提升的影响。我们发现，使用可再生能源满足一个站点额外10%的能源需求，会使能源效率额外提升2.8%–6.1%。然而，这一影响因采购方式不同而存在显著差异。采购场外可再生能源带来了能源效率提升，而安装场内可再生能源发电则要么没有影响，要么产生负面影响。为理解其机制，我们调查了站点管理者，并利用场内发电成本的变化进行了进一步分析。我们的结果表明，当站点采用持续成本较低的可再生能源时，反弹效应占主导。对于扩大可再生能源使用的企业，我们提供了额外能源效率收益的证据，但要利用这些收益，需要仔细考虑采购方式。对于政策制定者，我们提供了关于优先采用某些采购方式以加快实现净零排放进展的指引。本文由运营管理领域的Jay Swaminathan接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02165 获取。

source_records.title: Representing Random Utility Choice Models with Neural Networks
source_records.abstract: Motivated by the successes of deep learning, we propose a class of neural network–based discrete choice models, called RUMnets, inspired by the random utility maximization (RUM) framework. This model formulates the agents’ random utility function using a sample average approximation. We show that RUMnets sharply approximate the class of RUM discrete choice models: Any model derived from random utility maximization has choice probabilities that can be approximated arbitrarily closely by a RUMnet. Reciprocally, any RUMnet is consistent with the RUM principle. Our approach is closely related to ranking-based models and mixtures of multinomial logits proposed in previous literature in a more general contextual setting. We derive an upper bound on the generalization error of RUMnets fitted on choice data and provide theoretical insights on their ability to predict choices on new unseen data depending on critical parameters of the data set and architecture. The models are estimated by leveraging open-source libraries for training neural networks. We find that RUMnets are competitive against several choice modeling and machine learning methods in terms of predictive accuracy on two real-world data sets. We also conduct synthetic experiments that isolate the effects of each architecture component. This paper was accepted by George Shanthikumar, data science. Funding: A. Désir is supported by the Desmarais Fund for Research in AI from INSEAD. Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02189 .

title_zh: 用神经网络表示随机效用选择模型
abstract_zh: 受深度学习成功的启发，我们提出了一类基于神经网络的离散选择模型，称为RUMnets，其灵感来自随机效用最大化（RUM）框架。该模型使用样本平均近似来构建代理人的随机效用函数。我们证明RUMnets能够精确逼近RUM离散选择模型类：任何源自随机效用最大化的模型，其选择概率都可以被RUMnet任意接近地逼近。反过来，任何RUMnet都与RUM原理一致。我们的方法与先前文献中提出的基于排名的模型和多项对数混合模型密切相关，但处于更一般的上下文设置中。我们推导了在选择数据上拟合的RUMnets的泛化误差上界，并基于数据集和架构的关键参数，对其预测新未见数据选择的能力提供了理论见解。这些模型通过利用用于训练神经网络的开源库进行估计。我们发现，在两个真实世界数据集上，RUMnets在预测准确性方面与若干选择建模和机器学习方法相比具有竞争力。我们还进行了合成实验，以分离每个架构组件的效应。本文由George Shanthikumar（数据科学）接受。资助：A. source_records.title: Assortment Optimization for the Multinomial Logit Model with Repeated Customer Interactions
source_records.abstract: This paper presents the multinomial logit model with repeated customer interactions. In each period, the same customer selects a product from the recommended assortment or opts out. From the seller’s perspective, the choice probability in the current period is updated based on the purchase history of the customer. We derive this conditional choice probability and study the adaptive assortment recommendation strategy. Although the problem is generally intractable, we discover the structures of the optimal assortment when the customer interacts with the seller for two periods and the available products to recommend are identical in the two periods. For a general number of periods, we find that the optimal fixed assortments that are not adapted to the purchase history can achieve 50% of the optimal expected revenue, and the approximation ratio increases to 68.47% when the available products across periods are disjoint. Using real-world data sets, we demonstrate that the model with repeated customer interactions can better predict the purchase behavior and generate higher revenues. This paper was accepted by Chung Piaw Teo, optimization. Funding: The authors gratefully acknowledge the funding support from Meituan. C. title_zh: 具有重复顾客交互的多项Logit模型的产品组合优化
abstract_zh: 本文提出了具有重复顾客交互的多项Logit模型。在每个时期，同一顾客从推荐的产品组合中选择一个产品，或者选择不购买。从卖方的角度来看，当前时期的选择概率根据顾客的购买历史进行更新。我们推导了这一条件选择概率，并研究了自适应产品组合推荐策略。尽管该问题通常是难以处理的，但我们发现了当顾客与卖方交互两个时期且两个时期可推荐的产品相同时最优产品组合的结构。对于一般的时期数量，我们发现不根据购买历史进行调整的最优固定产品组合能够达到最优预期收入的50%，而当各时期可用的产品互不相交时，近似比提高到68.47%。使用真实世界的数据集，我们证明具有重复顾客交互的模型能够更好地预测购买行为并产生更高的收入。本文由Chung Piaw Teo（优化领域）接受。资助：作者们感谢美团提供的资助支持。C. source_records.title: Realized Illiquidity
source_records.abstract: We develop a simple theory of realized illiquidity, defined as the ratio of realized volatility to trading volume. Building on the widely used price impact measure of Amihud (2002), we introduce the realized Amihud, which significantly improves measurement accuracy. Our theoretical and numerical results show that it robustly captures cumulative intraday price sensitivity to trading, accounting for stochastic volatility, microstructure noise, and information jumps. Empirically, we uncover distinct time-series patterns in realized stock illiquidity—heterogeneous clustering, leverage effects—and show that it predicts short-term returns. This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance. Funding: A. Ranaldo acknowledges financial support from the Swiss National Science Foundation [SNSF Grant 182303]. P. title_zh: 已实现非流动性
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个关于已实现非流动性的简单理论，将其定义为已实现波动率与交易量之比。在广泛使用的Amihud（2002）价格冲击测度基础上，我们引入了已实现Amihud，其显著提高了测量精度。我们的理论和数值结果表明，它能够稳健地捕捉日内价格对交易的累积敏感性，同时考虑了随机波动率、微观结构噪声和信息跳跃。在实证方面，我们揭示了已实现股票非流动性中不同的时间序列模式——异质性聚集、杠杆效应——并表明它能够预测短期收益。本文由金融领域编辑Agostino Capponi接受。资助：A. source_records.title: Cooking or Clicking: The Impact of Online Food Delivery Platforms on Domestic Food Preparation
source_records.abstract: One of the most notable developments of the sharing economy is the unfettered proliferation of on-demand services. In this work, we examine how a subset of such platforms, online food delivery (e.g., Grubhub, UberEats, DoorDash), has affected the meal preparation and dining behaviors of American households. To do so, we exploit the phased entry of the platform Grubhub into U.S. counties from 2005 to 2019 using a difference-in-difference approach. Results indicate that the availability of such delivery services leads to a significant reduction in time spent preparing meals within the home, with no concomitant change in dining out. This effect is intensified in areas subject to greater demand and in areas with a greater number of restaurants but abates when less economically feasible (i.e., in areas with higher unemployment and households with more children). We also explore the association of Grubhub availability with subsequent changes in population body mass index. Implications for research, consumers, platforms, and public health are discussed. This paper was accepted by Anindya Ghose, information systems. Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02636 .

title_zh: 烹饪还是点击：在线食品配送平台对家庭食品制备的影响
abstract_zh: 共享经济最显著的发展之一是按需服务的无限制激增。在本研究中，我们考察了此类平台的一个子集——在线食品配送（例如Grubhub、UberEats、DoorDash）——如何影响了美国家庭的备餐和用餐行为。为此，我们利用平台Grubhub于2005年至2019年间分阶段进入美国各县这一事实，采用双重差分方法进行研究。结果表明，此类配送服务的可获得性导致在家准备餐食的时间显著减少，而外出就餐并未发生相应变化。这一效应在需求更大的地区以及餐馆数量更多的地区更为强烈，但在经济可行性较低时（即在失业率较高的地区以及有更多孩子的家庭中）则会减弱。我们还探讨了Grubhub可获得性与随后人口身体质量指数变化之间的关联。本文讨论了其对研究、消费者、平台和公共卫生的启示。本文由信息系统领域的Anindya Ghose接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02636获取。

source_records.title: A Flash in the Pan(Demic)? Migration Risks and Municipal Bonds
source_records.abstract: We show that migration induced by the COVID-19 pandemic significantly predicts changes in municipal bond yields. Negative migration shocks have made debt more expensive, especially in the areas and bonds most exposed to the work-from-home (WFH) transition. Over the full sample, a one-standard-deviation increase in COVID period out-migration predicts an approximate 4.5-basis-point rise in municipal bond yields, after controlling for a range of local economic factors including state- or core-based statistical area (CBSA)-year fixed effects. This effect is 40% larger for areas in the top decile of WFH exposure and approximately twice as large for transportation-backed bonds. Moreover, areas containing the most exposed bonds (i.e., those with out-migration and high WFH exposure) also experience relatively large post-COVID declines in municipal revenue. Overall, our results suggest that investors have changed their estimates of the level or uncertainty of municipalities’ future cash flows, especially for areas and bonds most exposed to the transition toward remote work. This paper was accepted by Bo Becker, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02674 .

title_zh: 昙花一现（疫情）？迁移风险与市政债券
abstract_zh: 我们表明，由COVID-19大流行引发的迁移显著预测了市政债券收益率的变化。负向迁移冲击使债务变得更加昂贵，尤其是在受居家办公（WFH）转型影响最大的地区和债券中。在整个样本期内，在控制了包括州或核心基础统计区（CBSA）-年份固定效应在内的一系列地方经济因素后，COVID期间迁出人口每增加一个标准差，预测市政债券收益率上升约4.5个基点。对于WFH暴露程度最高十分位的地区，这一效应大40%，而对于交通收入支持的债券，这一效应大约是其两倍。此外，包含最暴露债券（即那些存在迁出人口且WFH暴露程度高的债券）的地区，在COVID之后也经历了相对较大的市政收入下降。总体而言，我们的结果表明，投资者已改变了对市政当局未来现金流水平或不确定性的估计，尤其是对受远程工作转型影响最大的地区和债券而言。本文由Bo Becker（金融学）接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02674获取。

source_records.title: Who Falls Prey to the Wolf of Wall Street? Investor Participation in Market Manipulation
source_records.abstract: Price distortions created by so-called “pump-and-dump” schemes are well documented, but relatively little is known about the investors in these schemes. By examining 470 pump-and-dump schemes and a large data set of trading records for over 110,000 individual investors from a major German bank, we provide comprehensive evidence on the participation rate, the magnitude of the investments, the losses, and the characteristics of the individuals who invest in such schemes. Participation is quite common, with nearly 8% of active retail investors participating in at least one pump-and-dump losing on average nearly 30%. We identify several distinct types of participating investors, some of which (e.g., speculating day trader) should not be viewed as falling prey to the schemes. We also show that portfolio composition and past trading behavior better explain scheme participation than demographics. Last, we document longer-lasting effects on participating investors beyond their immediate financial losses. Our analysis highlights that an effective regulatory response to pump-and-dump schemes requires understanding who invests in such schemes and why, as, for instance, not all investors are likely to be dissuaded from investing by traditional regulatory disclosures. This paper was accepted by Eric So, accounting. Funding: This work was supported by the Clark Center for Global Markets at the University of Chicago and the Danish Finance Institute. Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03181 .

source_records.title: Punish One, Teach a Hundred: The Sobering Effect of Peer Punishment on the Unpunished
source_records.abstract: Direct experience of a peer’s punishment might have a sobering effect above and beyond deterrence (information about punishments). We test this mechanism in China, studying the reactions to listed state-owned enterprises’ (SOEs) punishments for fraudulent loan guarantees by firms in the same location (peers) and nonpeer firms across SOEs and non-SOEs. After experiencing SOEs’ punishments, peer SOEs cut their loan guarantees by more than nonpeer SOEs and peer non-SOEs even if information and local economic shocks are common to all firms. The reaction is stronger for peer SOEs whose CEOs have higher career concerns and/or face lower costs of reducing loan guarantees. This paper was accepted by Bo Becker, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03309 .

title_zh: 惩一儆百：同伴惩罚对未受罚者的警醒效应
abstract_zh: 直接经历同伴受罚可能产生超出威慑（关于惩罚的信息）之外的警醒效应。我们在中国检验这一机制，研究同一地区企业（同伴）对上市国有企业因违规贷款担保所受惩罚的反应，并比较国有企业与非国有企业中的同伴企业与非同伴企业。在经历国有企业的惩罚后，同伴国有企业减少贷款担保的幅度大于非同伴国有企业，也大于同伴非国有企业，即使信息与地方经济冲击对所有企业都是共同的。对于CEO具有更强职业关注和/或降低贷款担保成本更低的同伴国有企业，这一反应更强。本文由Bo Becker（金融领域）接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03309获取。

source_records.title: Nonstationary Experimental Design Under Structured Trends
source_records.abstract: Experimentation is increasingly used across domains such as healthcare and online platforms to inform decision making, with a central goal often being the estimation of the average treatment effect (ATE). However, in many real-world settings, treatment effects, or even the treatments themselves, evolve over time, making classical experimental designs, which assume stationarity, less effective or even misleading. This paper studies nonstationary experimental design under structured trends, addressing two key objectives: (i) accurately estimating the dynamic treatment effect and (ii) minimizing regret (e.g., revenue or welfare loss) during the experiment. We propose a flexible design framework that can be tailored to achieve Pareto-optimal tradeoff between the two objectives. We further analyze how time-varying noise levels affect this tradeoff. Additionally, we establish asymptotic normality of the estimators and show that different trend orders yield different convergence rates, enabling efficient statistical tests for the existence of high-order trends. This paper was accepted by J. George Shanthikumar, data science. Funding: D. Simchi-Levi and C. Wang were partially supported by the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) Data Science Lab and the MIT-IBM partnership in artificial intelligence. Z. Zheng was partially supported by the National Science Foundation Division of Mathematical Sciences [AwardDMS-2220537] and the Avenir Public Welfare Foundation. Supplemental Material: The online appendices and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03329 .

source_records.title: Nonstationary Experimental Design Under Structured Trends
source_records.abstract: Experimentation has become increasingly popular across various domains, such as clinical trials and online platforms, due to its widely recognized benefits. One of the primary objectives of classical experiments is to estimate the average treatment effect (ATE) to inform future decision-making. However, in healthcare and many other settings, treatment effects may be non-stationary, meaning that they can change over time, rendering the traditional experimental design inadequate and the classical static ATE uninformative. In this work, we address the problem of non-stationary experimental design under structured trends by considering two objectives: estimating the dynamic treatment effect and minimizing welfare loss within the experiment. We propose an efficient design that can be customized for optimal estimation error rate, optimal regret rate, or the Pareto optimal trade-off between the two objectives. We establish information-theoretical lower bounds that highlight the inherent challenge in estimating dynamic treatment effects and minimizing welfare loss, and also statistically reveal the fundamental trade-off between the two objectives.

title_zh: 结构化趋势下的非平稳实验设计
abstract_zh: 实验越来越多地被用于医疗保健和在线平台等领域以指导决策，其核心目标通常是估计平均处理效应（ATE）。然而，在许多现实场景中，处理效应、甚至处理本身会随时间演变，这使得假设平稳性的经典实验设计效果较差，甚至产生误导。本文研究结构化趋势下的非平稳实验设计，针对两个关键目标：(i) 准确估计动态处理效应，以及 (ii) 在实验过程中最小化遗憾（例如，收入或福利损失）。我们提出一个灵活的设计框架，可加以调整以在两个目标之间实现帕累托最优权衡。我们进一步分析随时间变化的噪声水平如何影响这一权衡。此外，我们建立估计量的渐近正态性，并表明不同趋势阶数会产生不同的收敛速率，从而能够对高阶趋势的存在进行高效统计检验。本文由数据科学领域的J. George Shanthikumar接受。资助：D. Simchi-Levi和C. Wang部分获得麻省理工学院（MIT）数据科学实验室以及MIT-IBM人工智能合作项目的支持。Z. source_records.title: Incentivizing Resource Pooling
source_records.abstract: Resource pooling improves system efficiency drastically in large stochastic systems, but its effective implementation in decentralized systems remains relatively underexplored. This paper studies how to incentivize resource pooling when agents are self-interested, and their states are private information. Our primary motivation is applications in the design of decentralized computing markets, among others. We study a standard multiserver queueing model in which each server is associated with an [Formula: see text] queue and aims to minimize its time-average job holding and processing costs. We design a simple token-based mechanism where servers can earn tokens by offering help and spend tokens to request help from other servers, all in their self-interest. The mechanism induces a complex game among servers. We employ the fluid mean-field equilibrium (FMFE) concept to analyze the system, combining mean-field approximation with fluid relaxation. This framework enables us to derive a closed-form characterization of servers’ FMFE strategies. We show that these FMFE strategies approximate well the servers’ rational behavior. We leverage this framework to optimize the design of the mechanism and present our main results: As the number of servers increases, the proposed mechanism incentivizes complete resource pooling—that is, the system dynamics and performance under our mechanism match those under centralized control. Finally, we show that our mechanism achieves the first-best performance even when helping others incurs higher job processing costs and remains nearly optimal in settings with heterogeneous servers. This paper was accepted by Omar Besbes, revenue management and market analytics. Funding: Y. Chen acknowledges the support by the National Natural Science Foundation of China (NSFC) [Grants NSFC-72501250 and NSFC-72394361] and by the Guangdong Key Lab of Mathematical Foundations for Artificial Intelligence. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03550 .

title_zh: 激励资源池化
abstract_zh: 资源池化能大幅提升大型随机系统的效率，但其在去中心化系统中的有效实施仍相对缺乏探索。本文研究当代理人自利且其状态为私人信息时，如何激励资源池化。我们的主要动机是去中心化计算市场设计等应用。我们研究一个标准的多服务器排队模型，其中每台服务器关联一个[公式：见正文]队列，并旨在最小化其时间平均的作业持有与处理成本。我们设计了一种简单的基于代币的机制，服务器可以通过提供帮助赚取代币，并花费代币向其他服务器请求帮助，而这一切都出于其自身利益。该机制在服务器之间诱发了一个复杂博弈。我们采用流体平均场均衡（FMFE）概念来分析该系统，将平均场近似与流体松弛相结合。该框架使我们能够推导出服务器FMFE策略的闭式刻画。我们表明，这些FMFE策略能很好地近似服务器的理性行为。我们利用该框架来优化机制设计，并给出主要结果：随着服务器数量的增加，所提出的机制激励实现完全资源池化——也就是说，在该机制下系统的动态与性能与集中控制下相匹配。最后，我们表明，即使帮助他人会带来更高的作业处理成本，我们的机制也能实现最优绩效，并且在服务器异质的设定中仍近乎最优。本文由Omar Besbes（收益管理与市场分析领域）接受。资助：Y. Chen感谢国家自然科学基金（NSFC）[资助号NSFC-72501250和NSFC-72394361]以及广东省人工智能数学基础重点实验室的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03550获取。

source_records.title: The Dark Side of Liquid Bonds in Fire Sales
source_records.abstract: We investigate which bonds investors should sell when they need to raise cash quickly. Our model shows that the intuitive strategy of selling the most liquid bonds can backfire. In over-the-counter markets, liquid bonds trade fastest, but when many investors simultaneously sell the same liquid, widely held bonds while buying capital is scarce, their prices fall the most. Individual investors do not fully internalize how their sales amplify the liquidation losses of others, making the outcome privately optimal but collectively inefficient. We test these predictions using property and casualty insurers around major natural catastrophes and find that insurers sell liquid bonds first, only partially avoid crowded bonds, and that liquid bonds experience the largest price declines during fire sales. The overlap in liquid holdings thus emerges as a key source of systemic risk that should receive greater weight in regulation and risk measurement. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Funding: C. Scheuch is grateful for financial support from the Austrian Science Fund (FWF) [Grant DOC 23-G16]. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03670 .

title_zh: 抛售中流动性债券的阴暗面
abstract_zh: 我们研究了当投资者需要快速筹集现金时应出售哪些债券。我们的模型表明，出售流动性最强债券这一直觉性策略可能适得其反。在场外交易市场中，流动性债券交易最快，但当许多投资者同时出售相同的流动性、广泛持有的债券，而购买资本稀缺时，其价格下跌幅度最大。个体投资者并未完全内化其出售行为如何放大他人的清算损失，使得结果在个体层面最优但在集体层面无效率。我们利用重大自然灾害前后的财产与意外伤害保险公司检验了这些预测，发现保险公司首先出售流动性债券，仅部分避免拥挤债券，并且流动性债券在抛售期间经历最大价格跌幅。因此，流动性持仓的重叠成为系统性风险的一个关键来源，应在监管和风险度量中给予更大权重。本文由Lukas Schmid（金融学）接受。资助：C. source_records.title: Training Frontline Health Workers in Low- and Middle-Income Countries to Reduce Contraceptive Stock-Outs: Evidence from Indonesia
source_records.abstract: Frontline health workers are an indispensable asset in the healthcare ecosystem of low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). They not only provide clinical care to patients but also frequently shoulder nonclinical responsibilities such as inventory management. However, many lack the necessary skills to effectively manage inventories, leading to the pervasive problem of health commodity stock-outs. To address this problem, several LMICs have launched training programs aimed at enhancing the inventory management skills and capabilities of frontline health workers. Leveraging fine-grained data over a five-year period (2015–2019) from approximately 17,000 health facilities across Indonesia—where the public health supply chain operates as a hybrid push–pull model—we evaluate the impact of a large-scale inventory management training program on contraceptive stock-outs. Applying difference-in-differences estimations, we find that the training program is associated with a significant reduction in stock-outs (i.e., 6.52 percentage points, or approximately 30%). Our numerical calculations suggest that the training program prevents, on average, more than 800 unintended pregnancies and saves 4.25 maternal and newborn lives per 100,000 women of reproductive age within the catchment area of a treated health facility. A counterfactual benefit–cost analysis shows that on-site delivery of the training program (i.e., on the job within a health facility) yields operational and public health benefits that significantly exceed those achieved through off-site delivery (i.e., outside the health facility in a classroom). Our research highlights the practicality and scalability of human-capital-focused interventions in improving health commodity availability and public health outcomes in LMICs. This paper was accepted by Stefan Scholtes, healthcare management. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03696 .

title_zh: 培训中低收入国家一线卫生工作者以减少避孕药具缺货：来自印度尼西亚的证据
abstract_zh: 一线卫生工作者是中低收入国家（LMICs）医疗生态系统中不可或缺的资产。他们不仅为患者提供临床护理，还经常承担库存管理等非临床职责。然而，许多人缺乏有效管理库存的必要技能，导致卫生商品缺货这一普遍问题。为解决这一问题，若干中低收入国家已启动培训项目，旨在提升一线卫生工作者的库存管理技能和能力。利用印度尼西亚约17,000家卫生机构五年期间（2015—2019年）的细粒度数据——该国公共卫生供应链采用推拉混合模式运行——我们评估了一项大规模库存管理培训项目对避孕药具缺货的影响。应用双重差分估计，我们发现该培训项目与缺货显著减少相关（即6.52个百分点，约30%）。我们的数值计算表明，该培训项目平均每100,000名育龄妇女在受训卫生机构服务区内防止了800多例意外怀孕，并挽救了4.25例孕产妇和新生儿生命。一项反事实效益—成本分析显示，现场交付培训项目（即在卫生机构内边工作边培训）所产生的运营和公共卫生效益显著超过异地交付（即在卫生机构外的教室中）所取得的效益。我们的研究凸显了以人力资本为重点的干预措施在改善中低收入国家卫生商品可及性和公共卫生结果方面的实用性和可扩展性。本文由Stefan Scholtes接受，医疗管理领域。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03696获取。

source_records.title: Behavioral Simulation of Blockchain-Enabled Market for Supplier Capacity Trading Among Retailers
source_records.abstract: We study a supply chain distribution system and investigate experimentally operations of markets where retailers can trade digital claims (tokens) on the supplier’s capacity. Subjects play the role of retailers, have heterogeneous valuations of goods, face random demands, and buy tokens on the supplier’s capacity. Following demand realization, retailers trade tokens with each other in markets implemented as double-sided, single-price, blind, batch auctions. We compare six behavioral treatments, featuring two wholesale prices and three market sizes. As expected, markets reduce leftovers and shortages. Interestingly, market-clearing prices are anchored to wholesale prices and do not signal the value of goods in large markets. Players deploy novel ordering and trading strategies that differ from the transshipment literature. We identify strategies by applying unsupervised machine learning algorithms. In one strategy, players buy a few claims and, after demand realization, use the market to satisfy it. Other players buy more claims than the maximum demand and, once demand is known, sell their excess on the market. Both strategies reduce costs from demand uncertainty but expose players to liquidity and mistakes risks. A third strategy, in which players order from the supplier initially as if expecting the market to be cleared cooperatively, is more profitable. This strategy diversifies demand and market risks. The introduction of markets causes the “pull-to-the-mean” effect and increases order variability. Thus, markets can cause the Bullwhip Effect. Retailers’ and the supply chain’s average profits are higher with markets, but suppliers with low wholesale prices suffer from lower revenues because of the pull-to-the-mean effect. This paper was accepted by Elena Katok, operations management. Supplemental Material: The data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03771 .

title_zh: 区块链赋能的零售商间供应商产能交易市场的行为仿真
abstract_zh: 我们研究一个供应链分销系统，并通过实验考察零售商可以交易供应商产能数字凭证（代币）的市场运作。被试扮演零售商的角色，对商品具有异质性估值，面临随机需求，并购买供应商产能代币。在需求实现后，零售商在实施为双边、单一价格、盲拍、批量拍卖的市场中相互交易代币。我们比较六种行为处理，涉及两种批发价格和三种市场规模。正如预期，市场减少了剩余和短缺。有趣的是，市场出清价格锚定于批发价格，在大市场中并不传递商品价值信号。参与者采用了不同于转运文献的新型订购和交易策略。我们通过应用无监督机器学习算法来识别策略。在一种策略中，参与者购买少量凭证，并在需求实现后利用市场满足需求。其他参与者购买超过最大需求的凭证，并在需求已知后将其超额部分在市场上出售。这两种策略都降低了需求不确定性带来的成本，但使参与者面临流动性和失误风险。第三种策略中，参与者最初从供应商订购时仿佛预期市场将被合作性地出清，这种策略更有利可图。该策略分散了需求风险和市场风险。市场的引入导致“向均值拉动”效应并增加订单变异性。因此，市场可能导致牛鞭效应。零售商和供应链的平均利润因市场而更高，但低批发价格的供应商因向均值拉动效应而收入下降。本文由Elena Katok，运营管理领域接受。补充材料：数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03771获取。

source_records.title: Managing Perishable Inventory Systems with Positive Lead Times: Inventory Position vs. Projected Inventory Level
source_records.abstract: We study periodic review perishable inventory systems with a fixed product lifetime, positive replenishment lead times, and a general issuance policy under the average cost criterion. The optimal replenishment policy for such systems is notoriously complex and computationally intractable because of the curse of dimensionality. To address this challenge, we propose a class of projected inventory level (PIL) policies, which maintain a constant expected on-hand inventory level, and compare them with conventional base-stock (BS) policies that maintain a constant inventory position. For both backlogging and lost-sales systems, we show that the best PIL policy is asymptotically optimal with large unit penalty costs for a broad class of unbounded demand distributions. When demand is bounded and the unit penalty cost is sufficiently large, we prove that the best BS policy is optimal under first-in-first-out issuance, whereas the best PIL policy is optimal under last-in-first-out issuance (under certain conditions). Furthermore, we show that both policies are asymptotically optimal as the demand population size grows large, and their optimality gaps diminish exponentially fast in backlogging systems under a broad range of issuance policies. To facilitate computation, we introduce a class of approximate PIL (APIL) policies and extend most theoretical results for PIL to the APIL policy. Numerical results show that both PIL and APIL policies perform very close to optimal and significantly outperform BS policies. This paper was accepted by Jeannette Song, operations management. title_zh: 管理具有正提前期的易腐库存系统：库存头寸与预计库存水平
abstract_zh: 我们研究在平均成本准则下，具有固定产品寿命、正补货提前期和一般发放策略的周期性检查易腐库存系统。由于维数灾难，此类系统的最优补货策略以极其复杂和计算上难以处理而著称。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一类预计库存水平（PIL）策略，其维持恒定的预期在手库存水平，并将其与维持恒定库存头寸的传统基本库存（BS）策略进行比较。对于缺货补货和销售损失系统，我们证明，对于一大类无界需求分布，当单位惩罚成本较大时，最优PIL策略是渐近最优的。当需求有界且单位惩罚成本足够大时，我们证明在先进先出发放下最优BS策略是最优的，而在后进先出发放下（在某些条件下）最优PIL策略是最优的。此外，我们证明，随着需求总体规模变得很大，两种策略都是渐近最优的，并且在缺货补货系统中，在广泛的发放策略范围内，它们的最优性差距以指数速度快速缩小。为便于计算，我们引入了一类近似PIL（APIL）策略，并将PIL的大部分理论结果推广到APIL策略。数值结果表明，PIL和APIL策略的表现都非常接近最优，并且显著优于BS策略。本文由运营管理领域的Jeannette Song接受。资助：X. source_records.title: From Canvas to Blockchain: Impact of Royalties on Art Market Efficiency
source_records.abstract: Since the advocacy for droit de suite in France in the 1890s, policymakers and the public have recognized artworks as intellectual property and sought to grant artists resale royalties—yet encountered heated debates and various logistical obstacles. The emergence of blockchain technology now makes automated royalty collection feasible. We examine the impact of resale royalties on artists’ pricing decisions and the overall efficiency of the art market. We build an infinite-horizon model in which an artist sells her artwork in the primary market, after which it can be resold in a sequence of secondary markets. We find that when artwork popularity is public information, royalties—acting as a tax on resales—reduce the artwork’s resale value and transaction volume, lowering the artist’s profit and leaving all market participants worse off. However, when the artist possesses superior information about artwork popularity compared with buyers, a popular artist may set an inefficiently high price to signal its appeal, which hurts primary market efficiency. In this case, royalties benefit the popular artist by reducing the unpopular artist’s incentive to mimic, thereby mitigating price distortion in the primary market. Consequently, the profit of a popular artist first increases and then decreases with the royalty rate, peaking at a unique positive rate. Social welfare may either rise or fall with the royalty rate, depending on whether the reduction in primary-market price distortion outweighs the deadweight loss in resale markets. We also analyze alternative cases of incomplete information in which either the primary buyer or neither party has superior information, and show that royalties may still increase the artist’s expected profit by reducing the price distortion in the primary market. source_records.title: Redesigning VolunteerMatch’s Search Algorithm: Toward More Equitable Access to Volunteers
source_records.abstract: In collaboration with VolunteerMatch (VM)—the world’s largest online platform for connecting volunteers with volunteering opportunities—we designed and implemented a new display ranking algorithm. VM’s original ranking algorithm was intended to maximize efficiency (i.e., the total number of connections), but as a consequence, it repeatedly displayed the same few opportunities at the top of its ranking, effectively limiting access to volunteers for the other opportunities. To incorporate VM’s desire for equity (defined as the weekly number of opportunities with at least one connection) along with efficiency, we propose a modeling framework for online display ranking in settings where it is important to manage the trade-off between the total number of connections and the equitable allocation of these connections. We take an adversarial approach in evaluating the performance of online algorithms and show that a class of algorithms that applies a penalty to opportunities after each connection provides a strong (and, in certain regimes, optimal) performance guarantee. Inspired by our theoretical results yet mindful of practical considerations on VM’s platform, we propose SmartSort, a simple score-based ranking algorithm that enjoys comparable guarantees in many regimes. We implemented SmartSort in two experiments, covering Dallas–Fort Worth and all of Southern California. Using a difference-in-differences analysis, we find that the implementation of SmartSort led to an estimated 8% increase in the weekly average number of opportunities with at least one connection (consistent across both experiments) without any significant decrease in the total number of connections. If SmartSort has a similar distributional effect on a national scale, an additional 30,000 connections every year will go to opportunities that would have otherwise lacked access to volunteers. This paper was accepted by Omar Besbes, revenue management and market analytics. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03838 .

title_zh: 重新设计VolunteerMatch的搜索算法：迈向更公平的志愿者获取途径
abstract_zh: 我们与VolunteerMatch（VM）——全球最大的连接志愿者与志愿服务机会的在线平台——合作，设计并实施了一种新的展示排序算法。VM原有的排序算法旨在最大化效率（即连接总数），但结果是，它反复将同样的少数几个机会展示在排序顶部，实际上限制了其他机会获取志愿者的途径。为了将VM对公平性的追求（定义为每周至少获得一个连接的机会数量）与效率相结合，我们提出了一个在线展示排序的建模框架，适用于需要管理连接总数与这些连接公平分配之间权衡的情境。我们采用对抗性方法评估在线算法的性能，并证明了一类在每次连接后对机会施加惩罚的算法提供了强有力的（且在某些情形下是最优的）性能保证。受理论结果的启发，同时考虑到VM平台上的实际因素，我们提出了SmartSort，一种简单的基于分数的排序算法，在许多情形下具有可比的保证。我们在两个实验中实施了SmartSort，覆盖达拉斯-沃斯堡和整个南加州地区。使用双重差分分析，我们发现SmartSort的实施使每周平均至少获得一个连接的机会数量估计增加了8%（在两个实验中结果一致），而连接总数没有显著下降。如果SmartSort在全国范围内具有类似的分布效应，那么每年将额外有30,000个连接流向那些原本无法获得志愿者的机会。本文由Omar Besbes（收益管理与市场分析领域）接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03838获取。

source_records.title: Setup Costs and the Financing of Young Firms
source_records.abstract: Firm births are key drivers of employment growth, productivity gains, and “creative destruction.” We show that setup costs create sizable financial constraints for new firms. When firms face high setup costs, they can only be established by leveraging up and lengthening debt maturity. We empirically confirm these predictions in a large sample of young French firms. Leverage is higher and debt maturity is longer in industries with high setup costs. Last, we show that following an exogenous shock that reduces banks’ supply of long-term loans, there is relatively lower firm creation in manufacturing industries with high setup costs. This paper was accepted by Bo Becker, finance. Funding: This work was supported by Observatoire du financement des entreprises par le marché (OFEM) (NA) and Agence Nationale de la Recherche [Grant F-STAR ANR-17-CE26-0007-01]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03846 .

title_zh: 开办成本与年轻企业的融资
abstract_zh: 企业诞生是就业增长、生产率提升和“创造性破坏”的关键驱动因素。我们表明，开办成本会给新企业带来相当大的融资约束。当企业面临高开办成本时，它们只能通过加杠杆和延长债务期限来设立。我们在一大批法国年轻企业样本中实证证实了这些预测。在开办成本高的行业中，杠杆率更高，债务期限更长。最后，我们表明，在降低银行长期贷款供给的外生冲击之后，开办成本高的制造业行业中企业创建相对较少。本文由Bo Becker（金融领域）接受。资助：本研究得到Observatoire du financement des entreprises par le marché（OFEM）（NA）和Agence Nationale de la Recherche [Grant F-STAR ANR-17-CE26-0007-01]的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03846 获取。

source_records.title: Constructing New Product Development Portfolios with Internal and External Projects
source_records.abstract: In order to build a successful new product development (NPD) portfolio, a firm must ensure not only its access to a wide variety of candidate NPD projects but also its capacity to collect and verify vital information about these projects prior to project selection. In practice, a popular strategy to enrich the set of candidate projects is to contemplate investing in both internal and external NPD projects; however, this approach often interferes with the firm’s ability to evaluate its own projects reliably, which in turn results in subpar project selections. To meet this managerial challenge, the firm must carefully craft its project selection process and incentivize its project managers to evaluate projects thoroughly and share their honest evaluation of outcomes. We address these issues by developing a principal–multiagent model, and our findings yield direct managerial implications. First, we show that the relative importance of a firm’s NPD portfolio scope versus its project evaluation costs is what dictates how flexibly the firm should select between internal and external projects; of course, greater flexibility leads to broader portfolios but also to higher evaluation costs. Second, controlling the tension between internal and external NPD projects while ensuring effective project evaluation requires that the firm offers—in addition to individual performance incentives—shared incentives, which signal its project selection preferences and also limit project managers’ opportunities to extract rent. This paper was accepted by Sridhar Tayur, entrepreneurship and innovation. Supplemental Material: The online appendices are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03917 .

title_zh: 构建包含内部与外部项目的新产品开发组合
abstract_zh: 为了构建成功的新产品开发（NPD）组合，企业不仅必须确保能够获得种类丰富的候选NPD项目，还必须具备在项目选择之前收集并核实这些项目关键信息的能力。在实践中，丰富候选项目集合的一种流行策略是考虑同时投资于内部和外部NPD项目；然而，这种做法往往会干扰企业可靠评估自身项目的能力，进而导致项目选择欠佳。为应对这一管理挑战，企业必须精心设计其项目选择流程，并激励项目经理全面评估项目并分享其对结果的诚实评价。我们通过构建一个委托人—多代理人模型来解决这些问题，我们的研究结果得出了直接的管理启示。第一，我们表明，企业NPD组合范围相对于其项目评估成本的相对重要性，决定了企业应在内部与外部项目之间以多大灵活性进行选择；当然，更大的灵活性会带来更广泛的组合，但也会带来更高的评估成本。第二，在确保有效项目评估的同时控制内部与外部NPD项目之间的张力，要求企业除个人绩效激励外还提供共享激励，这种激励既传递其项目选择偏好，也限制项目经理攫取租金的机会。本文由Sridhar Tayur（创业与创新领域）接受。补充材料：在线附录可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03917获取。

source_records.title: Rational Choice Models: The Temporal Tree Representation
source_records.abstract: Choice models, which specify the consumers’ choice probabilities of options over a given choice set, are widely studied and applied in many fields. We propose a temporal tree representation of choice that covers all rational choice models. Compared with existing structural choice models, the tree representation exhibits two major advantages that address the key challenges of model identification. First, all rational choice models have a tree representation, and a subclass of tree representation (with set-dependent branching) has a one-to-one correspondence with the rational choice models. This bridges the gap in the existing characterizations of structural models, which are unidentifiable, impose uninterpretable conditions, or do not cover the entire space of rational choice models. Second, the tree representation allows for the flexibility of systematically specifying the choice model structure based on available knowledge and data. In particular, the number of parameters needed to specify a tree representation can be primarily determined by the sufficient knowledge level, which corresponds to a specific layer of the tree branching. The sufficient knowledge level can be empirically determined based on the amount of available data, which, in turn, determines the number of parameters needed for model estimation. Therefore, the tree representation allows for a natural way of data integration, avoiding misspecification from restrictive assumptions and overfitting for general models. This paper was accepted by David Simchi-Levi, operations management. Funding: M. Xue’s research is partly support by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [72201257, 72571069, 72371240]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03967 .

title_zh: 理性选择模型：时间树表示
abstract_zh: 选择模型规定了消费者在给定选择集上对各选项的选择概率，已被广泛研究并应用于许多领域。我们提出了一种选择的时间树表示，它涵盖了所有理性选择模型。与现有的结构化选择模型相比，该树表示具有两大优势，可应对模型识别中的关键挑战。第一，所有理性选择模型都具有树表示，而树表示的一个子类（具有集合依赖分支）与理性选择模型一一对应。这弥合了现有结构化模型刻画中的空白，这些刻画要么不可识别，要么施加不可解释的条件，要么未覆盖理性选择模型的整个空间。第二，树表示允许根据可用知识和数据系统地指定选择模型结构的灵活性。特别地，指定树表示所需的参数数量可以主要由充分知识水平决定，该水平对应于树分支的特定层。充分知识水平可以根据可用数据量经验性地确定，而这反过来又决定了模型估计所需的参数数量。因此，树表示允许一种自然的数据整合方式，避免了限制性假设导致的误设定以及一般模型的过拟合。本文由运营管理领域的David Simchi-Levi接受。资助：M. source_records.title: Contextual Offline Demand Learning and Pricing with Separable Models
source_records.abstract: This paper, inspired by a collaboration with a leading consumer electronics retailer in the Middle East, explores the challenge of demand learning and pricing using separable demand models. The data scarcity issue, characterized by limited price changes and low sales volumes, renders traditional models ineffective in deriving reasonable price elasticity. To address this issue, we advocate a separable model that leverages two submodels to distinctly capture the effects of price and contextual information. The separable structure enables us to invest special emphasis on the role of price and impose specific structural assumptions on the submodel for pricing effects, such as the monotone decreasing property. Theoretical analysis sheds light on the statistical complexity of demand learning with the separable structure, highlighting its capacity to reduce the necessary sample size to achieve a desired level of accuracy. We also introduce a computationally efficient iterative algorithm for deriving submodels from offline datasets, complete with convergence guarantees. In an empirical context, we demonstrate how our method can yield meaningful price elasticity estimations and revenue increase based on real sales data from the retailer. This paper was accepted by J. George Shanthikumar, data science. Funding: This work was supported by funding from the MIT Data Science Lab, Hong Kong Research Grants Council (RGC) General Research Fund [CityU11508223], and Hong Kong Research Grants Council (RGC) Early Career Scheme [CityU21505825]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04026 .

title_zh: 可分离模型下的情境化离线需求学习与定价
abstract_zh: 本文受与中东一家领先消费电子产品零售商合作的启发，探讨了使用可分离需求模型进行需求学习与定价的挑战。数据稀缺问题——表现为价格变动有限和销售量低——使得传统模型无法得出合理的价格弹性。为解决这一问题，我们提倡一种可分离模型，利用两个子模型分别捕捉价格和情境信息的影响。这种可分离结构使我们能够特别强调价格的作用，并对定价效应子模型施加特定的结构假设，例如单调递减性质。理论分析揭示了具有可分离结构的需求学习的统计复杂性，突出了其减少达到所需精度水平所需样本量的能力。我们还引入了一种计算高效的迭代算法，用于从离线数据集中推导子模型，并附有收敛性保证。在实证情境中，我们展示了我们的方法如何基于零售商的真实销售数据得出有意义的价格弹性估计和收入增长。本文由J. George Shanthikumar，数据科学领域接受。资助：本工作得到了MIT数据科学实验室、香港研究资助局（RGC）一般研究基金[CityU11508223]以及香港研究资助局（RGC）早期职业计划[CityU21505825]的资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04026获取。

source_records.title: Does Personality Similarity Influence the Formation of Auditor-in-Charge–Client Relationships and Audit Quality? Evidence from Swedish Military Conscription Data
source_records.abstract: This study investigates the role of personality similarity in the formation of auditor-in-charge (AIC)–client management dyads and the development of a collaborative relationship in auditing engagements. We apply the principle of homophily from sociology, that is, the attraction of individuals with similar traits to one another, to the formation of supplier–customer dyads in auditing engagements. Our analyses suggest that AIC–management personality similarity increases the likelihood of dyad formation and facilitates client retention. Using an instrumental variable approach, we further find evidence that AIC–chief executive officer (CEO) personality similarity enhances audit quality, and that this effect is stronger for clients with higher misreporting risk and at the beginning of the AIC–client tenure relationship. Among publicly listed clients, where chief financial officer (CFO) data are available, we find that AIC–CFO personality similarity plays a more important role in AIC–client matching and audit outcomes than AIC–CEO personality similarity. Collectively, our results suggest that a personality homophily-based relationship facilitates collaboration in auditing engagements, ultimately enhancing audit quality. Overall, our evidence highlights the benefit of interpersonal relationships in the production of audit services. This paper was accepted by Ranjani Krishnan, accounting. Funding: This work was supported by the Penn State Smeal College of Business, the Handelsbanken Jan Wallanders and Tom Hedelius Foundation [Grants P25-0334 and W21-0009], the Torsten Söderbergs Foundation [Grant ET4/17], and the Mistra Center for Sustainable Markets at the Stockholm School of Economics. title_zh: 人格相似性是否影响主审会计师与客户关系的形成及审计质量？来自瑞典征兵数据的证据
abstract_zh: 本研究考察人格相似性在主审会计师（AIC）与客户管理层二元关系形成以及审计业务中协作关系发展中的作用。我们将社会学中的同质性原则，即具有相似特质的个体之间相互吸引，应用于审计业务中供应商—客户二元关系的形成。我们的分析表明，AIC与管理层的人格相似性提高了二元关系形成的可能性，并有助于客户保留。使用工具变量方法，我们进一步发现证据表明，AIC与首席执行官（CEO）的人格相似性提升了审计质量，而且这一效应在错报风险较高的客户以及AIC—客户聘用关系初期更强。在可获得首席财务官（CFO）数据的公开上市客户中，我们发现AIC与CFO的人格相似性在AIC—客户匹配和审计结果中比AIC与CEO的人格相似性发挥更重要的作用。总体而言，我们的结果表明，基于人格同质性的关系促进了审计业务中的协作，最终提升了审计质量。总体而言，我们的证据凸显了人际关系在审计服务生产中的益处。本文由会计领域编辑Ranjani Krishnan接受。资助：本工作得到宾夕法尼亚州立大学Smeal商学院、Handelsbanken Jan Wallanders and Tom Hedelius基金会[资助号P25-0334和W21-0009]、Torsten Söderbergs基金会[资助号ET4/17]以及斯德哥尔摩经济学院Mistra可持续市场中心的资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04195 获取。

source_records.title: Learning in Lost-Sales Inventory Systems with Stochastic Lead Times and Random Supplies
source_records.abstract: Supply uncertainty, characterized by stochastic lead times and random supply quantities, has attracted increasing attention from academia, industries, and governments, particularly in the aftermath of the COVID-19 pandemic. In this paper, we consider the problem of managing lost-sales inventory systems with general supply uncertainty: stochastic lead times and random supplies. Unlike the previous studies, we assume the decision maker has no prior information on the stochastic demand and supply. We propose the first provably effective learning algorithm for inventory management problems with censored demand and supply data under general supply uncertainty. Then, we establish a cumulative regret of [Formula: see text] for this learning algorithm compared with the best constant-order policy, where [Formula: see text] is the upper bound of the random part, and L is the deterministic part of the stochastic lead times. We also conduct numerical experiments to demonstrate the effectiveness of our algorithm. Our approach lies in developing a new framework for transformed convexity. Furthermore, we address the unique challenges of our problem through new techniques, for example, estimating the long-run cost by establishing coupling and concentration results utilizing the system structures. These techniques are also of independent interest. Beyond our problem, our framework provides broad implications for other operations management (OM) problems exhibiting transformed convexity. This paper was accepted by J. George Shanthikumar, data science. Funding: J. Lyu and Y. Zhou are supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 52494974]. S. Yuan is supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72588101, 72425008]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04203 .

source_records.title: Factor Models of Asset Returns and Bear Market Risk
source_records.abstract: We propose a conditional model of asset returns that allows for good and bad states of the world, depending on bear market risk. Specifically, we generalize existing latent factor models in three ways: we show how to estimate the threshold that identifies the “disappointment” event triggering the bad state of the world, we permit different factor structures for asset returns in good and bad states, and we show how to estimate consistently the conditional risk premia of observable factors from the estimated latent factors. The usefulness of the conditional model is illustrated with an empirical application to a broad cross-section of stock portfolio excess returns. This paper was accepted by Kay Giesecke, finance. Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04276 .

title_zh: 资产收益的因子模型与熊市风险
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种资产收益的条件模型，该模型根据熊市风险允许世界存在好状态与坏状态。具体而言，我们以三种方式推广了现有的潜在因子模型：我们展示了如何估计识别触发世界坏状态的“失望”事件的阈值，我们允许资产收益在好状态与坏状态下具有不同的因子结构，并且我们展示了如何从估计的潜在因子中一致地估计可观测因子的条件风险溢价。该条件模型的有用性通过对一个广泛的股票投资组合超额收益横截面进行实证应用而得到说明。本文由金融学领域编辑Kay Giesecke接受。补充材料：互联网附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.04276 获取。

source_records.title: The Salience of Entrepreneurship: Evidence from Online Business
source_records.abstract: We examine the decision to become an entrepreneur in the context of online business. Using data on entrepreneurs from a large e-commerce marketplace in China, we find that individuals are more likely to start online businesses after observing the salient success of nearby stores. Leveraging the platform’s store rating system and detailed geographic information in rural China, we show that an upgrade in a local store’s rating leads to a significant increase in new store entries nearby. This effect diminishes with physical distance and intensifies with the salience of the upgrade. However, these entry decisions appear to be suboptimal; entrants driven by local upgrade events underperform in sales and are more likely to exit, especially during downturns in overall market conditions. Our findings are consistent with salience-based theories of decision making, in which individuals overweight highly visible local information. This paper was accepted by Lin William Cong, finance. title_zh: 创业的显著性：来自在线商业的证据
abstract_zh: 我们在在线商业的背景下考察成为企业家的决策。利用来自中国一个大型电子商务市场中企业家的数据，我们发现，个体在观察到附近店铺的显著成功后，更有可能开办在线企业。借助该平台的店铺评级系统和中国农村的详细地理信息，我们表明，本地店铺评级的提升会导致附近新店铺进入显著增加。这一效应随物理距离的增加而减弱，并随评级提升的显著性而增强。然而，这些进入决策似乎并非最优；受本地评级提升事件驱动的进入者在销售额上表现不佳，且更有可能退出，尤其是在整体市场状况低迷期间。我们的发现与基于显著性的决策理论一致，即个体会过度重视高度可见的本地信息。本文由林威廉·康（Lin William Cong）接受，金融领域。资助：C. source_records.title: Are Subjective Expectations Formed as in Rational Expectations Models of Active Management?
source_records.abstract: We recover forward-looking expected net-of-fee abnormal returns (alphas) for active equity mutual funds from analyst ratings. In contrast to the typical equilibrium implication of zero alphas, analyst alphas are negative for most funds, but positive for the largest funds. We compare analysts’ subjective expectations with expectations from a rational expectations learning model. The model’s rational learner believes that an increase in fund size leads to a decrease in returns, but we find no evidence that analysts believe so. Consistently, counterfactual ratings based on the rational model tend to outperform analysts’ ratings out of sample. Investor fund flows respond significantly to analyst ratings. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. title_zh: 主观预期是否如主动管理理性预期模型那样形成？
abstract_zh: 我们从分析师评级中还原出主动型股票共同基金的前瞻性预期费后异常收益（阿尔法）。与零阿尔法的典型均衡含义相反，分析师的阿尔法对大多数基金为负，但对最大的基金为正。我们将分析师的主观预期与理性预期学习模型的预期进行比较。该模型的理性学习者在基金规模增加时认为收益会下降，但我们没有发现分析师持此看法的证据。与此一致，基于理性模型的反事实评级在样本外往往优于分析师的评级。投资者基金资金流对分析师评级有显著反应。本文由Lukas Schmid（金融学）接受。资助：感谢金融大数据中心[Grant DNRF167]、丹麦金融研究院和瑞典金融研究院的支持。本工作由Fundação para a Ciência e a Tecnologia（UIDB/00124/2025、UID/PRR/124/2025、Nova School of Business and Economics）和LISBOA2030（DataLab2030 - LISBOA2030-FEDER-01314200）资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04419 获取。

source_records.title: Financial Inclusion via FinTech: From Digital Payments to Platform Investments
source_records.abstract: We study household finance in the age of FinTech, where digital payments are integrated with various financial services through all-in-one super apps. We hypothesize that increased FinTech adoption via digital payments can lower the nonmonetary costs (e.g., psychological barriers) associated with financial market participation. We find that higher FinTech adoption leads to greater participation and increased risk taking in mutual fund investments. Using distance from Ant as an instrument for FinTech penetration, as well as the exogenous penetration of QRPay in Shenzhen, we further provide causal evidence from digital payment to risky fund investment. Moreover, the effect of FinTech is stronger among individuals who are otherwise more constrained, those with higher risk tolerance, or those living in under-banked counties. This paper was accepted by Will Cong, finance. Funding: C. Y. Hong acknowledges financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72003125]. X. title_zh: 通过金融科技实现普惠金融：从数字支付到平台投资
abstract_zh: 我们研究金融科技时代的家庭金融，其中数字支付通过一站式超级应用与各类金融服务相整合。我们假设，通过数字支付提高金融科技采用率，能够降低与金融市场参与相关的非货币成本（例如心理障碍）。我们发现，金融科技采用率越高，共同基金投资的参与度越高，风险承担也越大。使用与蚂蚁集团的距离作为金融科技渗透率的工具变量，以及深圳二维码支付的外生渗透，我们进一步提供了从数字支付到风险基金投资的因果证据。此外，金融科技的效果在原本受到更多约束的个体、风险容忍度更高的个体，或居住在银行服务不足县的个体中更强。本文由Will Cong（金融领域）接受。资助：洪常雨感谢国家自然科学基金[项目编号72003125]的资助。卢旭感谢国家自然科学基金[项目编号72473028]的资助。潘军感谢国家自然科学基金[项目编号W2431051]的资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04423获取。

source_records.title: Disintermediation Governance and Complementor Innovation: An Empirical Look at Amazon.com
source_records.abstract: This study investigates how the platform’s disintermediation governance policy (i.e., the policy that disciplines complementors and consumers circumventing the platform to transact directly) affects complementors’ product innovation and launching strategies. We leverage a change in the Communication Guideline on Amazon.com (i.e., the focal platform), which prohibits complementors (i.e., sellers) from sending external website links, telephone numbers, and email addresses to buyers in direct messaging, as a policy shock to Amazon complementors. By conducting a difference-in-differences analysis, we find that the governance policy significantly reduces product innovation on the focal platform among complementors with direct selling channels as measured by the number of new products and the innovativeness of new products. These main effects are mitigated by complementor reputation on Amazon and complementor multihoming. Mechanism analyses show that complementors with direct selling channels increase the number of new products launched through those channels after the policy change (i.e., the switching effect). Moreover, complementors tend to strategically switch innovative and high-value products away from the focal platform while leaving less innovative but price-competitive products on it to attract Amazon consumers before diverting to their direct selling channels (i.e., the bait effect). Our results have implications for platform governance policies regarding disintermediation and its impact on complementor product innovation and launch strategies both on and off the focal platform. This paper was accepted by D. J. Wu, information systems. Funding: G. Gu gratefully acknowledges research support from the USC Marshall School of Business. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04439 .

source_records.title: Disintermediation Governance and Complementor Innovation: An Empirical Look at Amazon.com
source_records.abstract: This study investigates how the platform’s disintermediation governance policy (i.e., the policy that disciplines complementors and consumers circumventing the platform to transact directly) affects complementors’ product innovation and launching strategies. title_zh: 去中介化治理与互补者创新：对Amazon.com的实证考察
abstract_zh: 本研究考察平台的去中介化治理政策（即约束互补者和消费者绕过平台直接进行交易的政策）如何影响互补者的产品创新与发布策略。我们利用Amazon.com（即焦点平台）《沟通准则》的一项变更作为针对Amazon互补者的政策冲击，该变更禁止互补者（即卖家）在直接消息中向买家发送外部网站链接、电话号码和电子邮件地址。通过进行双重差分分析，我们发现，该治理政策显著降低了拥有直销渠道的互补者在焦点平台上的产品创新，衡量指标为新产品数量和新产品的创新性。这些主效应被互补者在Amazon上的声誉以及互补者的多归属所缓解。机制分析表明，在政策变更后，拥有直销渠道的互补者通过那些渠道发布的新产品数量增加（即转换效应）。此外，互补者倾向于策略性地将创新性和高价值产品从焦点平台转移出去，同时将创新性较低但具有价格竞争力的产品留在焦点平台上，以吸引Amazon消费者，然后再将其引流至自己的直销渠道（即诱饵效应）。我们的结果对有关去中介化的平台治理政策及其对互补者在焦点平台上和平台外的产品创新与发布策略的影响具有启示意义。本文由信息系统领域的D. J. Wu接受。资助：G. Gu感谢USC Marshall商学院的研究支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04439获取。

source_records.title: Leveraging Collective Advice-Taking Behavior to Infer Accuracy and Improve the Wisdom of Crowds
source_records.abstract: Wisdom of crowds estimates can be compromised when some agents’ predictions are systematically biased. A natural remedy is to aggregate predictions from a subset of more accurate agents rather than the entire crowd. I propose cluster weight on advice (CWOA), a novel “two-shot” algorithm to identify a more accurate subgroup in a single-prediction-problem context. CWOA first applies kernel density estimation to identify clusters of similar initial predictions. If multiple clusters emerge—indicating potential heterogeneity in agents’ information—the algorithm proceeds to present a piece of numerical advice (e.g., the group mean) and elicit updated predictions. This enables the calculation of the weight on advice (WOA)—the scaled magnitude of each agent’s belief revision. CWOA then averages the updated predictions within the cluster with the lowest mean WOA. A behavioral model and simulations explain both why and when cluster-level WOA signals accuracy. Better-informed agents—having already incorporated higher-quality information—perceive less corrective value in the advice and therefore, exhibit lower WOA. CWOA does not require agents to know the true biases or the composition of the crowd; a modest relative advantage in perceived estimation bias by better-informed agents may be sufficient, even under misperceptions of variance, advice quality, and psychological biases in advice taking. Empirically, I first test and confirm the model’s key insight in a controlled experimental setting. I then validate CWOA’s performance across multiple preregistered and archival data sets, including a study in which numerical advice comes from artificial intelligence. CWOA consistently outperforms benchmarks, including the state-of-the-art metaprediction-based methods. This paper was accepted by Jack Soll, behavioral economics and decision analysis. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04499 .

title_zh: 利用集体建议采纳行为推断准确性并提升群体智慧
abstract_zh: 当一些主体的预测存在系统性偏差时，群体智慧的估计可能会受到影响。一种自然的补救方法是聚合来自一个更准确主体子集的预测，而不是整个群体。我提出了建议聚类权重（CWOA），一种新颖的“两阶段”算法，用于在单一预测问题情境中识别一个更准确的子群。CWOA首先应用核密度估计来识别相似初始预测的聚类。如果出现多个聚类——表明主体信息可能存在异质性——该算法接着呈现一条数值建议（例如，群体均值）并引出更新后的预测。这使得能够计算建议权重（WOA）——每个主体信念修正的缩放幅度。CWOA随后对平均WOA最低的聚类内的更新预测取平均。一个行为模型和模拟解释了聚类层面WOA为何以及何时能够信号准确性。信息更充分的主体——已经纳入了更高质量的信息——认为建议的纠正价值较小，因此表现出更低的WOA。CWOA不要求主体知道真实偏差或群体的构成；信息更充分的主体在感知估计偏差上的适度相对优势可能就足够了，即使在对方差、建议质量存在误判以及建议采纳中存在心理偏差的情况下也是如此。在实证方面，我首先在受控实验环境中检验并确认了该模型的关键洞见。随后，我在多个预注册和档案数据集中验证了CWOA的表现，包括一项数值建议来自人工智能的研究。CWOA始终优于基准方法，包括最先进的基于元预测的方法。本文由Jack Soll接受，行为经济学与决策分析。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04499 获取。

source_records.title: Incentivizing Crowds and Intergroup Spillovers: Evidence from the Internet Bug Bounty Program
source_records.abstract: Online communities can create complex knowledge products, such as software, by leveraging collaboration and division of labor between their core members and the crowd across tasks. Recent literature has focused on how incentives stimulate crowd contributions. Limited attention has been paid to potential intergroup spillovers, that is, how incentivizing crowd contributions affects nonincentivized core members’ contributions. In this paper, we examine how core members of the Python developer community responded to the Internet Bug Bounty program, an initiative that offers monetary incentives for bug reporting by the crowd. Using a difference-in-differences strategy and the Java community as the control group, we find that the Python core members reduced their contributions to the incentivized task of bug reporting after the program’s implementation. Importantly, they also reduced their contributions to the nonincentivized task of enhancement reporting, a critical knowledge creation task for improving Python. Such reduction has led to a decline in the overall contributions of enhancement reports and related code commits to Python. Further analysis suggests that the negative intergroup spillover of the incentive on core members’ nonincentivized task contributions can plausibly be explained by reduced intertask learning. Our study offers implications for crowdsourcing, the design of incentives for digital public goods, and task delegation. This paper was accepted by Anindya Ghose, information systems. Funding: This research is supported in part by the HKSAR General Research Fund Project 16503620. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04544 .

title_zh: 激励众包与群体间溢出效应：来自互联网漏洞赏金计划的证据
abstract_zh: 在线社区可以通过利用其核心成员与大众之间在任务上的协作和分工，创造出复杂的知识产品，例如软件。近期文献主要关注激励如何促进大众贡献。对于潜在的群体间溢出效应，即激励大众贡献如何影响未受激励的核心成员的贡献，关注有限。本文考察Python开发者社区的核心成员如何回应互联网漏洞赏金计划，该计划为大众报告漏洞提供金钱激励。使用双重差分策略并以Java社区作为对照组，我们发现Python核心成员在该计划实施后减少了对受激励任务即漏洞报告的贡献。重要的是，他们还减少了对未受激励任务即改进报告的贡献，而改进报告是改进Python的一项关键知识创造任务。这种减少导致了对Python的改进报告及相关代码提交的总体贡献下降。进一步分析表明，激励对核心成员未受激励任务贡献的负面群体间溢出效应，可能可以通过任务间学习减少来解释。我们的研究对众包、数字公共物品激励机制设计以及任务委托具有启示意义。本文由信息系统领域的Anindya Ghose接受。资助：本研究部分得到香港特别行政区研究资助局一般研究基金项目16503620的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04544获取。

source_records.title: Explaining Corporate Tax Avoidance
source_records.abstract: The tax avoidance literature identifies dozens of variables that are related to corporate tax avoidance, but it lacks a framework for understanding the relative importance of these variables and the theories that drive these relations. We distill decades of tax avoidance research into key theories and create a unified sample that contains 31 independent variables from prior literature to quantify the relative and total importance of proposed explanations. Using Shapley value variance decomposition, we show that investment-related factors and operating metrics dominate effective tax rate (ETR) measures and consistently rank high across a range of tax avoidance proxies. When we examine the relative importance of time-invariant effects, we find that manager, firm, and segment fixed effects explain the greatest variation in tax avoidance. We offer several actionable opportunities for future research and offer several key takeaways for researchers and policymakers. This paper was accepted by Eric So, accounting. title_zh: 解释企业避税
abstract_zh: 避税文献识别出数十个与企业避税相关的变量，但缺乏一个框架来理解这些变量的相对重要性以及驱动这些关系的理论。我们将数十年的避税研究提炼为关键理论，并构建了一个统一样本，其中包含来自先前文献的31个自变量，以量化所提出解释的相对重要性和总重要性。使用Shapley值方差分解，我们表明与投资相关的因素和经营指标在有效税率（ETR）度量中占主导地位，并在一系列避税代理变量中始终排名靠前。当我们考察时不变效应的相对重要性时，我们发现管理者、企业和分部固定效应解释了避税中最大的变异。我们为未来研究提供了若干可操作的机遇，并为研究者和政策制定者提供了若干关键启示。本文由会计领域的Eric So接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.04839 获取。

source_records.title: Public Enforcement and Initial Public Offering Reporting Quality in Weak Institutional Environments: Evidence from a Random Experiment in China
source_records.abstract: Using China’s randomized pre-initial public offering on-site inspection program, we examine the causal effects of proactive public enforcement on the financial reporting quality of initial public offering applicants. Our analysis shows that the program enhances the reporting quality of selected applicants by screening out firms with questionable financial disclosures. More importantly, it generates a significant deterrence effect, discouraging future applicants from submitting low-quality financial reports. However, we also find that public enforcement can lead to the rejection of some firms that may otherwise merit approval. These findings highlight both the benefits and costs of employing public enforcement to improve financial reporting in settings with weak institutional oversight. This paper was accepted by Eric So, accounting. Funding: K. Guo acknowledges financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grants 72302146 and 72132006], the Shanghai Pujiang Program, and the National Social Science Fund of China [Grant 22AZD034]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05042 .

title_zh: 制度环境薄弱下的公共执法与首次公开发行报告质量：来自中国随机实验的证据
abstract_zh: 利用中国随机化的首次公开发行前现场检查计划，我们考察了主动公共执法对首次公开发行申请人的财务报告质量的因果效应。我们的分析表明，该计划通过筛除财务披露存在问题的公司，提高了被选中申请人的报告质量。更重要的是，它产生了显著的威慑效应，阻止未来申请人提交低质量财务报告。然而，我们也发现，公共执法可能导致一些原本可能值得批准的公司被拒绝。这些发现凸显了在制度监管薄弱的环境中运用公共执法改善财务报告的收益与成本。本文由会计学领域编辑Eric So接受。资助：K. Guo感谢国家自然科学基金[资助号72302146和72132006]、上海浦江人才计划以及国家社会科学基金[资助号22AZD034]的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05042获取。

source_records.title: Why Do Product Prices Affect Review Ratings? Evidence from a Japanese Online Travel Agency
source_records.abstract: I examine why the prices that consumers pay influence their ratings of products. In the context of hotel reviews on an online booking platform, I find that prices have larger impact on ratings when consumers face larger uncertainty about hotel quality, indicating that prices affect satisfaction through consumers’ quality expectation. On the other hand, I find that the mere fact that the reviewer received higher surplus through a lower price by itself is not a primary reason for a higher rating. I also present suggestive evidence of consumer reciprocation, in which consumers experiencing a high-quality staff service likely become more forgiving of higher prices. I show that introductory pricing can have a substantial impact on the distribution of review rankings among new entrants because of the role of prices as quality signals. Understanding the price effect on ratings is crucial to designing review systems robust to potential distortion. This paper was accepted by Raphael Thomadsen, marketing. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05043 .

title_zh: 为什么产品价格会影响评论评分？来自日本一家在线旅行社的证据
abstract_zh: 我考察了消费者支付的价格为何会影响其对产品的评分。在在线预订平台的酒店评论情境中，我发现当消费者对酒店质量面临更大的不确定性时，价格对评分的影响更大，这表明价格通过消费者的质量预期影响满意度。另一方面，我发现仅仅因为评论者通过较低价格获得了更高剩余本身并不是更高评分的主要原因。我还提供了消费者互惠的提示性证据，即体验到高质量员工服务的消费者可能对较高价格变得更加宽容。我表明，由于价格作为质量信号的作用， introductory pricing 可能对新进入者之间评论排名的分布产生实质性影响。理解价格对评分的影响对于设计能够抵御潜在扭曲的评论系统至关重要。本文由营销学领域的Raphael Thomadsen接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05043 获取。

source_records.title: Misreporting of Mandatory ESG Disclosures: Evidence from Gender Pay Gap Information
source_records.abstract: We examine environmental, social, and governance (ESG) misreporting in the context of the UK government requirement to report gender employment ratios and pay gaps. Highlighting misreporting, many employers report a set of disclosures that are together mathematically impossible. Further, a disproportionate number of employers report perfectly balanced gender statistics, consistent with misreporting as a form of ESG-washing. Suggesting that a lack of ethical considerations encourages misreporting, employers involved in ESG controversies and who commit labor violations are more likely to misreport. Suggesting that capital market and media scrutiny discourage misreporting, employers that are the subject of an article about their gender pay gap reports and employers that receive an ESG audit or financial audit from a Big 4 auditor are less likely to misreport. Overall, our results suggest that 12%–15% of employers misreport in 2017 and 8%–11% misreport in subsequent years. Our findings highlight the importance of meaningful oversight within the context of ESG reporting. This paper was accepted by Ranjani Krishnan, accounting. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05125 .
